Rockwell is looking for a Senior Software Test Engineer to join an agile team. This team is building and validating FactoryTalk Optix, a modern industrial visualization and HMI platform. The platform is used by customers to design, deploy, and maintain applications for manufacturing environments.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Test Engineer will help ensure the quality of FactoryTalk Optix by creating and executing manual and automated tests for new and existing product functionality. This role will work closely with product owners, developers, and other test engineers to understand requirements, validate features, reproduce and document defects, and support regression and release testing activities. The scope of work is focused on developing solid test engineering practices, learning the product and industrial automation domain, and contributing to a high-quality customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and execute manual and automated tests for FactoryTalk Optix features.
  • Validate design-time and runtime workflows to help ensure a reliable customer experience.
  • Lead test planning, estimation, execution, and defect triage as part of an Agile team.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects with clear titles, descriptions, steps, and supporting details.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other test engineers to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support regression, release, and exploratory testing activities.
  • Contribute to test documentation, quality procedures, and continuous improvement of test practices.
  • Use tools such as JIRA, QTest, Confluence, GitHub, and Jenkins to support testing and quality tracking.
  • Learn FT Optix product functionality and relevant industrial automation concepts over time.
  • Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams.

The Essentials - You Will Have

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in software testing, software development, test automation, or a related technical role.
  • Experience creating, executing, and documenting manual or automated test cases.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated tests using Python, C#, or similar programming or scripting languages.
  • Experience with Squish and Selenium test frameworks
  • Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Linux
  • Experience with C# scripting
  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, JIRA, Confluence, or QTest.
  • Exposure to performance, reliability, longevity, or regression testing.
  • Experience with industrial automation, HMI software, PLCs, and protocols such as CIP or OP-CUA

What We Offer

  • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401k
  • Paid Time off
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

descriptionHtml:
As a quality automation tester, you will make an impact by validating the quality and reliability of card processing and payments systems through hands-on functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. You will be a valued member of the Software Engineering team and work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, testing teams, offshore team members, and Test leads.

In this role, you will

  • Design the test strategy and test plan, estimate and track testing efforts, and develop, review, and execute detailed test scenarios and test cases based on functional requirements and banking business workflows.
  • Coordinate defect triage with developers, business analysts, and testing teams to investigate, prioritize, and resolve defects, and perform defect retesting, regression validation, and root cause investigation.
  • Support test data preparation, test environment validation, and troubleshooting of testing dependencies.
  • Coordinate day-to-day testing activities across offshore team members, ensuring timely completion of assigned deliverables.
  • Work closely with the Test Lead to communicate testing progress, defects, blockers, and quality risks, and provide test execution status, defect metrics, and regression results to support release readiness, along with test closure and status reports.

Work model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Alpharetta, GA. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • Strong knowledge of card processing, payments, and customer servicing systems, including TS2, card lifecycle management, account servicing, card issuance and replacements, authorization processing, settlement, transaction research, fraud blocks, back-office operations, and customer service workflows.
  • Strong understanding of ISO 8583 message formats and payment interchange protocols, including validating financial transaction card-originated messages such as MTIs, bitmaps, and data elements, plus packet and protocol testing to ensure data integrity during transmission.
  • Strong hands-on experience in REST/SOAP API testing using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or Thunder Client, along with web UI functional and integration testing.
  • Strong experience in defect identification, defect triage, defect lifecycle management, and retesting, with Jira or similar defect and test management tools.
  • Good understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, and STLC, with strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on complex testing scenarios while supporting offshore team coordination.

These will help you stand out

  • Experience executing, developing, and maintaining automation scripts using frameworks such as BDD/Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured, or Robot.
  • Experience with data synchronization, source-to-target validation, and data lake/data-processing validation.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Git.
  • Knowledge of Kafka or other event-driven messaging platforms.
  • Basic understanding of microservices architecture, API integrations, and cloud-hosted applications, with experience using application monitoring and log analysis tools such as Splunk.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Applications will be accepted until November 20th, 2026.

The annual salary for this position is from $53k to $92.500K depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Description

Senior Software Test Engineer

Omaha, NE

No clearance required to start – Must be clearable to Secret

Ready for your next career step? Leidos has an immediate opportunity for a Senior Software Test Engineer to help with automated testing of our state-of-the-art software solutions delivered to our government customers. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with an outstanding software engineering team and will support the team’s software deployed into our customers' classified networks. Our engineers are at the forefront of defining and building solutions to address the challenges faced by our end users, applying a go-fast, agile approach driven by small teams that rely on and value each team member's contributions.

As a Senior Software Test Engineer, you’ll participate in planning, designing and executing end-to-end automated testing in support of the Continuous Integration (CI)/Continuous Deployment (CD) of our products to customers worldwide. You’ll identify opportunities to increase the level of automated testing of our customer products and solutions, plan and execute strategies to achieve test automation objectives, continuously measure and improve the effectiveness of that testing based on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and evaluate and integrate new testing tools, technologies, and procedures to achieve the organization’s technical objectives.

In this capacity, you’ll collaborate with engineering and product team members, architects, and other IT resources to create and execute test strategies, detailed test plans, and scenarios. You’ll always respect others' opinions, accept constructive criticism, share your views with a passion for improving the team’s performance, and collaborate openly and positively with your teammates.

Most of the work will be on site in Leidos' facility in Omaha, Nebraska. Some level of remote/work from home is possible.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain test methodology documentation for traceability and repeatability.
  • Identify regression test candidates for automation, plan automation activities across the team and automate test cases.
  • Execute test cases/scripts including functional, regression, exploratory, performance, load and smoke tests for both web applications and database.
  • Report issues in work management tool (e.g., Jira) along with steps required to re-create the issue.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning meetings, sprint reviews and sprint retrospectives.
  • Participate in all phases of risk management assessments and software development with emphasis on analysis of user requirements, test design and test tools selection.
  • Support metrics program by creating, collecting and tracking test related metrics.
  • Inform innovative solutions for more efficient testing strategy.

Basic Qualifications

  • US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of prior relevant experience or a Master’s degree with 6+ years of experience. Additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Experience with software development (Java, NodeJS/JS, C++, Rust).
  • Experience with writing and/or developing test procedures and automated test scripts (e.g., Test Complete, Selenium, Playwright, Puppeteer, Cucumber, QFTest or Cypress).

Preferred Qualifications

  • US Citizen with an active Secret security clearance or higher.
  • Experience with Agile development principles and methodologies.
  • Experience with automating unit, functional, integration and performance testing of web applications using industry-standard tools such as Playwright, JUnit, SoapUI, Cucumber, Selenium, and JMeter.
  • Working knowledge of continuous integration and delivery methodologies and tools.
  • Familiarity with software design patterns.
  • Solid understanding of software development process fundamentals.
  • Experience managing projects within the Atlassian suite of tools (Confluence, JIRA, Bitbucket).
  • Familiarity with component-based web frameworks & libraries (React, Vue, Angular).
  • Knowledge of a version control system (e.g., Git).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes and tools (Gitlab).
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with USSTRATCOM Nuclear Planning process.

DABAOPP1

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

October 30, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range

Pay Range $92,300.00 - $166,850.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline onlyand not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

descriptionHtml:
Position Summary

Rooms To Go is seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Application Development team. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our web and desktop applications through a combination of manual and automated testing.

Working closely with developers, business analysts, and product stakeholders, you'll develop test strategies, execute manual and automated test cases, identify defects, and help improve the overall software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate has experience with both manual testing and test automation and enjoys building quality into every stage of the development process.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web and desktop applications.
  • Perform manual functional, regression, smoke, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using modern automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, WebDriverIO, or similar frameworks.
  • Validate software against business requirements, user stories, and technical specifications.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution using defect management tools.
  • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and project teams to ensure software quality throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness activities.
  • Execute regression testing before software releases to ensure application stability.
  • Improve testing processes, standards, and automation coverage to increase efficiency and product quality.
  • Assist in designing scalable automation frameworks and reusable test assets.
  • Communicate testing progress, results, and quality metrics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stay current with emerging testing tools, technologies, and industry best practices.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, including manual testing and/or test automation.
  • At least one year of hands-on experience with Playwright or another Node.js-based automation testing tool (such as Cypress or WebDriverIO).
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, testing lifecycle, and SDLC.
  • Experience creating test plans, test cases, and test strategies from business requirements or user stories.
  • Experience performing manual functional, smoke, regression, and integration testing.
  • Experience using defect tracking and test management tools.
  • Experience with JavaScript and Node.js-based automation tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a development team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Playwright.
  • Experience testing web, desktop, and API applications.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices.
  • Programming or scripting experience.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

The QA Automation Test Engineer supports VA-EISS modernization. Own hands-on test execution and automation inside an optional pod under the value-stream QA Lead. Review AI-generated test cases and scripts for meaningful coverage of NCA business rules, integration behavior and release risk.

  • Design, execute and maintain unit/integration, API, regression and end-to-end automated tests; coordinate coverage with developers and the QA Lead.

  • Support performance/load testing, Section 508/accessibility checks and security-related validation, coordinating with platform specialists for deep assessments.
  • Validate workflows, interface contracts, data migration outputs and defect fixes; document evidence and trace to acceptance criteria.
  • Publish clear defects, monitor CI test results and contribute to UAT preparation, release readiness and regression stability.


Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree in an IT-related field with 3-6 years’ experience. Additional years of experience can substitute for a degree for the right candidate.
  • Hands-on test automation for web applications and REST APIs, including regression frameworks and CI/CD integration.
  • Proficiency in writing or reviewing automated test scripts and validating expected outcomes against functional requirements.
  • Ability to detect false positives, brittle or incomplete AI-generated tests, and supplement them with human-designed checks.
  • Experience with defect management, test evidence, SQL/data checks and Agile collaboration.
  • Public Trust


Preferred

  • C#/.NET testing stacks, Playwright, xUnit/NUnit, Postman, k6/JMeter and accessibility tools such as axe/WAVE.
  • Performance/load test execution, VA Section 508 and federal UAT/release environments.
  • EISS/VA/NCA workflows and approved AI-assisted test generation.

Overview Of Opportunity

Two Six Technologies is actively seeking an Automation Tester to support motivated to learn and contribute to a growing team that is solving complex problems for our intelligence community. We work in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment. This role will be primarily responsible for developing and maintaining automated end-to-end, integration and performance tests. This position offers the opportunity to provide robust and comprehensive testing of features that serve an enterprise level tool supporting users across the IC and the DoW.

What You Will Do

  • Performs software product testing and investigates possible causes of problems
  • Performs manual testing as stop-gap for automated testing
  • Develops functional, end-to-end, regression, and performance tests in automated test environments
  • Detects and writes software bug reports and feature requests
  • Understands, reproduces, troubleshoots product defects and works with developers to determine the best resolution
  • Assists in the planning and implementation of testing new features

What You Will Need

  • 1-3 years of professional software testing experience
  • Strong proficiency in automated testing frameworks and methodologies
  • Proven experience designing and implementing integration test suites
  • Experience with REST API testing and validation
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration for automated tests
  • Knowledge of test design patterns and best practices
  • Experience with Git version control and collaborative workflows
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle and agile methodologies
  • Strong analytical and debugging skills
  • Excellent written communication for test documentation and defect reporting
  • Experience working collaboratively with development teams

Nice To Haves

  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proficiency with Cypress or similar end-to-end testing frameworks
  • Experience testing microservice architectures
  • Familiarity with additional testing frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, Jest, Mocha)
  • Knowledge of performance and load testing tools (k6, JMeter, Gatling)
  • Experience with contract testing (Pact, or similar)
  • Familiarity with testing in containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with test data management and mocking strategies
  • Knowledge of accessibility testing (WCAG compliance, axe-core)
  • Experience with visual regression tools
  • Familiarity with backend technologies (go, Node.js, Python)
  • Understanding of security testing principles
  • Experience with test reporting and metrics dashboards
  • Knowledge of behavior-driven development (BDD) frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow)
  • Experience mentoring junior test engineers
  • Familiarity with cloud test platforms (AWS/C2S)

Security Clearance

  • Active TS/SCI required. Active TS/SCI w. Polygraph preferred.

Job Purpose

The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), a subsidiary of Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents an opportunity for a full-time Senior QA Engineer to join one of our Technology teams.

The individual will be responsible for functional testing, designing and developing comprehensive automated test strategies and test cases for the various applications that support our business needs. The candidate should understand modern testing tools and frameworks. We are looking for a methodical tester who is naturally curious, eager to learn new tools and technologies, and quick to pick up new testing methods.

Responsibilities

  • Review project business requirements to properly build, enhance and support related testing frameworks.
  • Design and develop comprehensive automated test strategies and test cases.
  • Automate test cases using exiting frameworks and tools.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with internal teams to better understand requirements, to provide technical solutions and support user testing.
  • Provide support throughout software delivery process, auditing as well as after-hours support, as necessary.

Knowledge And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or equivalent academic discipline.
  • 5+ years of relevant Quality Engineering experience involving application development, deployment and testing (Preferably in the financial industry).
  • Proven track record of delivering quality work on time.
  • Knowledge of software development and quality assurance best practices.
  • RDBMS (Oracle, MSSQL or MySQL) and NoSQL (PostgreSQL): 4+ years (Preferred).
  • Linux and Windows: 3+ years (Preferred).
  • Experience with Java and Python.
  • Experience with Maven, Jenkins, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Artifactory, JUnit, and TestNG.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and container-based application environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered testing and development tools.
  • Experience testing and supporting web/cloud-based applications.
  • Experience supporting production and CERT environments.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain designs and solutions clearly.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to work well independently as well as part of a team.
  • Strong aptitude for picking up new QA tools, technologies and testing methodologies quickly.
  • A methodical, detail-oriented approach to test planning, execution and defect tracking.
  • Genuine eagerness to learn, ask questions and continuously grow as a QA professional.

New York Base Salary Range

The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $120,000 - 175,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), a 401(k) plan, life insurance, time off, and paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

descriptionHtml:
Applicants must be US based Only. All Applicants must have a valid/current LinkedIn Profile URL within their resume, in order to be considered for the position.

About Us

We are a well established custom software development agency working on client projects in health care, education, environmental engineering, insurance and other industries. Our teams design, develop, test and deploy web, mobile and cloud applications. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, designers, project managers and clients throughout the process.

Our QA Engineers are involved throughout the project, not just before a release. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, asks good questions and wants to help the team deliver a quality product.

WHY JOIN US?

We offer top notch company culture, employee benefits, career growth, and have a trusted brand in our market.

  • Competitive base salary + bonus
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage on day 1 of employment
  • Generous 401(k) match and employer contribution
  • Generous PTO + 8 company paid holidays
  • Strong emphasis on work life balance , 40 hour weeks
  • Remote work opportunities and flexible working hours
  • Extensive training and career development opportunities

JOB DETAILS

We are looking for a QA Engineer with a strong understanding of software testing and experience using modern QA tools. In this role, you will create and execute test plans, maintain regression test suites, investigate issues and work with the project team to ensure that applications meet client requirements. You will work on multiple projects and be expected to manage your testing activities independently.

Candidates should have practical experience using AI tools, preferably Anthropic Claude or Claude Code, to assist with test case creation, regression testing and automated testing. You must be able to review the results, understand any test code produced, correct issues and explain how the tests work. We are not looking for someone who relies on AI to write tests without understanding or validating them.

We would ideally like someone willing to work hybrid onsite at our Cohoes, NY office, but we are willing to consider US based remote workers who are available for EST work day hours.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of software testing experience, primarily with software applications, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Strong understanding of QA fundamentals, including test planning, test case design, exploratory testing, regression testing, integration testing and user acceptance testing.
  • Ability to review requirements and acceptance criteria and develop test cases with clear steps, expected results and appropriate test data.
  • Experience with an automated testing framework. Playwright using JavaScript or TypeScript is preferred. Candidates must be able to read, troubleshoot and maintain the tests they create.
  • Experience using AI tools, preferably Anthropic Claude or Claude Code, to create and maintain test cases, regression suites and automation, with the ability to independently verify the results.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript sufficient to understand automation code, locators, assertions and basic debugging.
  • Experience testing REST APIs using Postman or a comparable tool.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, HTML, CSS and browser developer tools.
  • Experience documenting defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, and supporting evidence.
  • Experience working with Git, Agile / Scrum teams and test management tools such as Azure DevOps or TestRail.
  • Experience with responsive design, browser compatibility and mobile application testing.
  • Strong communication skills, attention to detail, independent troubleshooting and the ability to work directly with team members and clients.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and perform QA activities on multiple client projects, from requirements review through release.
  • Create, execute and maintain test plans, test cases, regression suites, test results and requirements traceability documentation.
  • Perform functional, exploratory, integration, API, browser compatibility and release testing as required by the project.
  • Create, execute, troubleshoot and maintain automated regression tests using established testing standards and good coding practices.
  • Use AI tooling to assist with test design, documentation and automation. Review and validate generated work for accuracy, appropriate coverage and maintainability.
  • Investigate issues, determine whether failures are caused by the application, test code or environment, and document defects clearly.
  • Work with Business Analysts, Designers, Developers and Project Managers to review requirements, identify gaps and establish appropriate test coverage.
  • Communicate test results, outstanding defects, risks and release readiness to the project team and clients.
  • Actively participate in Agile team activities and help maintain QA best practices and project documentation.
  • Perform quality checks on software releases and other client deliverables as required. Accurately track work activities and meet established project budgets and timelines.

Optional / Nice To Have

  • Experience running automated tests through Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Experience with accessibility testing, performance testing, security testing or mobile automation using Appium or comparative tools.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud applications or service oriented architectures.
  • Experience assisting and mentoring other team members.

Job Overview

The Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET III) plays a critical role in our Software Development Life Cycle by designing, developing, and maintaining robust end-to-end test automation frameworks. This role works with multiple teams on different products to further the test strategy and capability of the QA department, leveraging modern automation tools and AI-powered testing agents. The Senior SDET will be involved from the initial design and grooming, through development and testing, to production promotion and maintenance.

They will offer code-level feedback and perform impact and risk analysis during the early stages, perform both manual and automated testing tasks to validate changes, and serve as a subject matter expert on functionality, scope, performance, and all aspects of machine automation. This role leverages AI-powered testing agents to accelerate test creation and reduce maintenance overhead. The Sr. SDET will collaborate with development, QA, DevOps, and product teams to drive test automation excellence and ensure the delivery of world-class software.

Responsibilities And Duties

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust end-to-end test automation frameworks using Playwright as the core automation tool. Architect scalable page object models, custom fixtures, and reusable test utilities that enable efficient test creation across the organization
  • Leverage AI-powered testing agents including planner, generator, and healer capabilities to intelligently plan test scenarios, auto-generate test scripts, and self-heal broken selectors and locators, significantly reducing test maintenance overhead
  • Utilize AI-assisted coding and test generation tools to accelerate test script development, review automation code, generate test data, and analyze test results for patterns and root causes
  • Produce high-quality automation code and create solid test plans, templates, and strategies for both automated and manual testing efforts across the platform ecosystem
  • Develop integration and end-to-end test cases based on story content, including both technical backend stories and UI-involved stories, ensuring comprehensive coverage
  • Setup, deploy, and configure test environments for specific stories and perform full tear-down and reconfiguration of all required components for end-to-end testing
  • Collaborate with developers to build out acceptance criteria for stories, offer code-level feedback on bugs found during testing, and continuously improve test automation practices by creating tools or prototypes
  • Serve as a mentor for both QA and Dev engineers in all matters of machine-driven testing. Act as SME for test automation toolsets and approaches. Work with DevOps and IT to ensure testing environments are set up and configured properly and efficiently
  • Demonstrate a strong work ethic, a “can-do” attitude, and be highly productive
  • Learn new technologies and develop tools to remain abreast of current testing and development technologies, including AI-powered testing tools and methodologies
  • Take on what’s needed to help the department and the company meet objectives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or Equivalent Work Experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in software test automation with demonstrated competency in Playwright or similar modern automation frameworks.
  • Proficiency using multiple automation toolsets, browser components, page objects and structure, source control toolsets (Git, SVN), CI/CD toolsets, API scripting toolsets, and database toolsets.
  • Expertise in browser automation, API testing, visual regression testing, and advanced features such as tracing, fixtures, and parallel execution.
  • Strong, object-oriented design and coding skills with proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, or Python.
  • Experience with iterative software delivery from inception through refinement, implementation/automated testing, continuous integration, release, and production monitoring.
  • Familiarity with different development models such as TDD, BDD, SDD, and ability to support Spec Driven Test Development.

Required Software Experience

  • TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, or Python; Git or SVN; CI/CD toolsets; API scripting toolsets; database toolsets (e.g., SQL Server, MySQL); Playwright; QTest or similar test management tools

Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as requested to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. 

Salary Range: $92,000.00 - $115,000.00 USD

This role works with multiple teams on different products to further the test strategy and capability of the QA department, leveraging modern automation tools and AI-powered testing agents. The Senior SDET will be involved from the initial design and grooming, through development and testing, to production promotion and maintenance.

They will offer code-level feedback and perform impact and risk analysis during the early stages, perform both manual and automated testing tasks to validate changes, and serve as a subject matter expert on functionality, scope, performance, and all aspects of machine automation. This role leverages AI-powered testing agents to accelerate test creation and reduce maintenance overhead. The Sr. SDET will collaborate with development, QA, DevOps, and product teams to drive test automation excellence and ensure the delivery of world-class software.

Responsibilities And Duties



- Design, develop, and maintain robust end-to-end test automation frameworks using Playwright as the core automation tool. Architect scalable page object models, custom fixtures, and reusable test utilities that enable efficient test creation across the organization
- Leverage AI-powered testing agents including planner, generator, and healer capabilities to intelligently plan test scenarios, auto-generate test scripts, and self-heal broken selectors and locators, significantly reducing test maintenance overhead
- Utilize AI-assisted coding and test generation tools to accelerate test script development, review automation code, generate test data, and analyze test results for patterns and root causes
- Produce high-quality automation code and create solid test plans, templates, and strategies for both automated and manual testing efforts across the platform ecosystem
- Develop integration and end-to-end test cases based on story content, including both technical backend stories and UI-involved stories, ensuring comprehensive coverage
- Setup, deploy, and configure test environments for specific stories and perform full tear-down and reconfiguration of all required components for end-to-end testing
- Collaborate with developers to build out acceptance criteria for stories, offer code-level feedback on bugs found during testing, and continuously improve test automation practices by creating tools or prototypes
- Serve as a mentor for both QA and Dev engineers in all matters of machine-driven testing. Act as SME for test automation toolsets and approaches. Work with DevOps and IT to ensure testing environments are set up and configured properly and efficiently
- Demonstrate a strong work ethic, a “can-do” attitude, and be highly productive
- Learn new technologies and develop tools to remain abreast of current testing and development technologies, including AI-powered testing tools and methodologies
- Take on what’s needed to help the department and the company meet objectives

Qualifications



- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or Equivalent Work Experience.
- Minimum 5+ years of experience in software test automation with demonstrated competency in Playwright or similar modern automation frameworks.
- Proficiency using multiple automation toolsets, browser components, page objects and structure, source control toolsets (Git, SVN), CI/CD toolsets, API scripting toolsets, and database toolsets.
- Expertise in browser automation, API testing, visual regression testing, and advanced features such as tracing, fixtures, and parallel execution.
- Strong, object-oriented design and coding skills with proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, or Python.
- Experience with iterative software delivery from inception through refinement, implementation/automated testing, continuous integration, release, and production monitoring.
- Familiarity with different development models such as TDD, BDD, SDD, and ability to support Spec Driven Test Development.

Required Software Experience



- TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, or Python; Git or SVN; CI/CD toolsets; API scripting toolsets; database toolsets (e.g., SQL Server, MySQL); Playwright; QTest or similar test management tools

Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as requested to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

descriptionHtml:
RLDatix is on a mission to transform care delivery worldwide, ensuring every patient receives the safest, highest-quality care. Through our innovative Healthcare Operations Platform, we’re connecting data to unlock trusted insights that enable improved decision-making and help deliver safer healthcare for all.

Job Description

RLDatix (RLD) is on a mission to help raise the standard of care…everywhere. Trusted by over 10,000 healthcare organizations around the world, our solutions help improve health and care. Our applications ensure that patients receive the best and safest care while supporting the providers who deliver it.

Joining TeamRLD means being part of a global effort of over 2,000 team members in making a difference in healthcare…every day.

As a Quality Engineer, you will play a hands-on role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of RLDatix applications that support critical healthcare workflows. You will design and execute comprehensive test plans using both manual and automated methods, validate new features throughout the sprint, identify defects, maintain automation coverage, and support release readiness across a fast-moving product environment.

This role is part of a Quality Engineering team that supports multiple applications on a regular release cycle. You’ll balance manual testing with automation, contribute to regression efforts, and use AI tools responsibly to improve productivity, test coverage, and quality outcomes, while growing toward deeper technical contribution over time.

How You’ll Spend Your Time

  • Test development items throughout each sprint, plan and execute manual and automated regression testing before releases, and validate new features against functional requirements, user workflows, and customer expectations
  • Document defects clearly, partner with developers to resolve issues, verify fixes through release, and participate in release readiness activities including regression cycles, code-freeze validation, and release-night support when needed
  • Create, maintain, and expand automated tests using Playwright, validate JSON payloads, API requests and responses, and error handling, and use MySQL and MS SQL Server queries to troubleshoot issues and validate data
  • Use AI tools responsibly to support test case creation, test maintenance, and automation productivity, while reviewing and validating AI-assisted outputs for accuracy and alignment with product behavior
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other quality engineers, provide user support and case management as needed, and communicate testing status, risks, blockers, and defects clearly

What Kind of Things We’re Most Interested in You Having

  • Ideally 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering, software testing, software development, or related software delivery roles, with strong hands-on proficiency in Playwright
  • A working understanding of manual and automated testing practices, including regression testing, functional testing, unit-level concepts, and API-level testing, with experience designing, executing, and maintaining test cases and test plans
  • The ability to use SQL queries, preferably MySQL and/or MS SQL Server, to troubleshoot and validate application behavior, and to document defects clearly and validate fixes through the release lifecycle
  • A strong commitment to documentation, clean test design, and maintainable testing practices, with the ability to work independently on moderately complex assignments and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and support teams
  • Ability to commute to our Lehi, Utah office four days a week, with remote Wednesdays
  • Sincere interest in building software that improves healthcare outcomes
  • Familiar with AI-assisted development or test automation workflows
  • Nice to have: Python, React or front-end development, Selenium or other automation frameworks, API testing tools such as Postman, and healthcare or regulated software experience.

By enabling flexibility in how we work and prioritizing employee wellness, we empower our team to do and be their best. This is an in-office role based in Lehi, Utah, with remote Wednesdays. Our benefits package includes health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, 401K, paid time off, and paid holidays.

RLDatix is an equal opportunity employer, and our employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, handicap, marital status or any other status or condition protected by Federal and/or State laws.

As part of RLDatix’s commitment to the inclusion of all qualified individuals, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation in the job application and interview process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in either step, please don’t hesitate to send a note to accessibility@rldatix.com.

Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including location, relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also taken into consideration.

Job Description

Flexjet is currently seeking a QA Automation Engineer. The QA Automation Engineer analyzes the functionality of applications and designs automated tests to validate their performance and reliability. Completes development, execution, and documentation of test plans and scripts. Assists non-QA resources in the planning and execution of user acceptance testing.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain, design, and implement test automation frameworks for a continuous integration and execution model.
  • Create and design the testing approach (Unit, Functional, Integration, System, User).
  • Create automation tests by analyzing user stories, acceptance criteria, creating initial test designs, writing scripts, installing the automation testing tools, and reporting results.
  • Develop a repeatable process for designing, developing, and executing scripts.
  • Conduct tests, document, and analyze test results, and present findings to development teams.
  • Preparing reports on all aspects related to software testing.
  • Participating in project meetings including Agile/Scrum grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and daily stand-ups.
  • Collaborate within an agile software development process with software engineers, subject matter experts and stakeholders.

Education & Experience

  • Understanding and knowledge of software engineering concepts and methodologies.
  • Understanding of test cases and negative, positive and regression testing.
  • Understanding of automation testing and experience writing automation tests for REST APIs and UI.
  • Experience with writing automation tests using one or more of the following: Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, ect.
  • Extremely proficient in one or more development languages (i.e. C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry best practices for manual, automation and performance testing.
  • Experience with deployments and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience gathering, refining, and validating business/technical requirements, interdependencies, cross-functional dependencies & risks/issues.
  • Knowledge of application functions, bug fixing, and testing practices.
  • Experience with system/platform integrations and the ability to work cross-functionally.
  • Shows initiative and is motivated to learn.
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written); ability to communicate technical information to non-technical people.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration and consultative skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and committed to a high level of accuracy & quality.

We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work – ideas, experience, and passion – to drive our mission forward. Our people are our strength.

As a QA Engineer, you will help ensure the quality of Aderant’s suite of legal software, spanning our practice of law products. You will be responsible for testing within your assigned product areas – including manual verification and exploratory testing, automation and gated tests, test plans, performance and load testing, product integration testing, and production feature flag testing. In this role, you will be a key part of the quality gate for new releases, helping determine when a version is ready to roll out and when more time is needed, so our clients receive the quality they expect from Aderant. You will work closely with developers, architects, QA engineers, product owners, and support staff.

What You’ll Do In This Role

  • Plan testing for features and releases: turn requirements and user stories into test cases, identify risks and edge cases, and recommend what should be automated and what should remain manual.
  • Build and maintain automated tests across layers:
  • Web end-to-end tests (e.g., Playwright)
  • API, contract, and unit-level tests, alongside developers
  • Run manual and exploratory testing, including release checklists, regression passes, and structured test sessions on QA environments.
  • Test integrations across databases, connectors, identity/SSO, and other Aderant products, verifying data flows, contracts, and failure behavior – not just screens.
  • Contribute to non-functional testing, including performance, load, and resilience scenarios with measurable pass criteria.
  • Keep automation reliable: fix flaky tests, keep tests independent of shared accounts and pre-set configuration, and manage test data so runs do not interfere with each other.
  • Help integrate tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) so the right suites run on every pull request, nightly, and before release.
  • Report clearly: log reproducible defects with evidence, track test cases and results in Azure DevOps, and summarize coverage, results, and risks for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Work across environments (dev, QA, staging), coordinating with developers and operations on environment setup, backend support, test accounts, and configuration.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 3 months: You know our products, environments, and existing test suites; you run release manual verification independently; and you have shipped your first automated tests and fixes for flaky ones.
  • First 6 months: You are the primary tester for a product area, working with limited guidance; you have added automated coverage for paths that were previously manual-only; and your tests run reliably in CI without ongoing support.
  • First year: You are contributing improvements to integration, database, or performance testing, and sharing what you learn with newer QA engineers.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in software QA, including at least 2 years writing automated tests.
  • Hands-on experience with a modern UI automation framework, ideally Playwright.
  • Experience testing REST APIs (Postman, Playwright request, or code-based tests) and reading request/response payloads in browser DevTools.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for checking data and setting up test conditions.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, and running tests in CI pipelines.
  • A solid grasp of test design: equivalence partitioning, boundary values, state transitions, and risk-based prioritization.
  • Comfort with both manual and exploratory testing, and sound judgment about when each approach is the right one.
  • Clear written communication: bug reports a developer can act on and summaries a manager can read.
  • A working habit of using AI coding assistants to speed up test creation and investigation.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Jest or similar unit-test frameworks, and with mocking or stubbing backends.
  • Knowledge of C# scripting and TypeScript for writing and maintaining test automation.
  • Contract testing (consumer-driven contracts, schema validation) or testing third-party integrations.
  • Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar).
  • Azure DevOps Boards and Test Cases, and Azure-hosted environments.
  • Experience with SSO / OAuth / OIDC login flows and multi-tenant SaaS configuration.
  • Familiarity with legal or professional-services software.

Position Description & Qualifications

If you love high profile and challenging programing projects supporting the CMS- Serco has a great opportunity for you! This QA Test Engineer will be on a dynamic team, understandig the requirements, generating test cases, running the test cases on a large-scale federal eligibility program. This is a hands-on role where you will serve as a test engineer — expected not just to execute, but to challenge current practices, guide a growing team of engineers.

Serco supports CMS, a federal agency within the United States Department of Health and Human Services that administers the Medicare program and works in partnership with state governments to support eligibility determinations for consumers purchasing health insurance through the Federal Health Insurance Exchanges.

You will be part of a 15-member team that works closely with the customer and other Serco teams to deliver quality systems. Rakesh Vommi leads this team with over 20 years’ experience. The team has been recognized by the CMS and the industry for their outstanding contributions to the contract and program.

In This Role, You Will

  • Perform analysis of business requirements, identify gaps, and translate user requirements into desired test cases/scripts.
  • Create test scenarios, test cases, and test data, and identify candidates for regression automation.
  • Develop and maintain robust end-to-end (E2E) automated test scenarios across UI, API, and database layers.
  • Execute smoke tests prior to each code drop to confirm environment setup and readiness for testing.
  • Execute automated and manual test cases once code is deployed into the test environment.
  • Perform REST and SOAP API testing, along with DB validation, logging validation, and UI validation.
  • Build and run SQL scripts to create test data, validate test results, and support accurate test data requests.
  • Generate and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
  • Identify, document, log, re-test, and track defects through resolution in Jira.
  • Review release scope and provide effective Level of Effort (LOE) estimates.
  • Facilitate testing activities by proactively communicating with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, and Scrum Masters.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to fellow testers and contribute to team growth.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Have

  • A Bachelors degree and 4 years of QA testing experience with demonstrated expertise in creating test cases/scripts.
    • Or High School diploma with 8 years of testing experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing and running automated test scripts using Selenium and Cucumber (BDD).
  • Strong experience with REST and SOAP API testing.
  • Solid SQL skills for creating test data, querying databases, and validating test results.
  • Experience performing testing on both front-end and back-end systems, including DB, logging, and UI validation.
  • Experience performing gap analysis on business requirements and system specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS technologies such as S3, Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, AWS Batch, and CloudWatch.
  • Proficiency with Jira for defect logging, reporting, and tracking.
  • Experience working in an Agile or SAFe Agile environment with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously or collaboratively, providing guidance to other testers as needed.
  • Experience with test-driven development (TDD) and behavior-driven development (BDD) frameworks.
Additional Desired Experience And Skills

  • Deep understanding of Agile/SAFe methodologies.
  • Prior experience supporting federal healthcare or eligibility programs (CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, or Health Insurance Exchanges).
  • Experience modernizing or scaling cloud-based test automation frameworks.

Company Overview

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.

Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.

Candidates may be asked to present proof of identity during the selection process. If requested, this will require presentation of a government-issued I.D. For more information on how Serco uses your information, please see our Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice.

If you are interested in becoming an approved vendor at Serco, please email Agencies@serco-na.com.

Serco is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Pay Transparency

Our Total Rewards package includes competitive pay, performance-based incentives, and benefits that promote well-being and work-life balance—so you can thrive both professionally and personally. Eligible employees also gain access to a wide range of benefits from comprehensive health coverage and health savings accounts to retirement plans, life and disability insurance, and time-off programs that support work-life balance. Program availability may vary based on factors such as contract type, location, hire date, and applicable collective bargaining agreements.

Actual base salary will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the scope of the role, relevant experience, job-related knowledge, education and training, key skills, and geographic market considerations. For roles available in multiple states, the range may vary to reflect differences in local labor markets. In addition to base salary, eligible positions may include other forms of compensation such as annual bonuses or long-term incentive opportunities.   • 6+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance (QA) with a strong background in both Manual and Automation Testing.

  • Hands-on experience in developing and maintaining UI automation frameworks using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Solid understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile Scrum, and QA best practices.
  • Experience in Functional, Integration, Regression, Smoke, System, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Cross-Platform Testing.
  • Experience validating connected device ecosystems, IoT devices, or hardware-software integration workflows.
  • Ability to analyze business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and translate them into comprehensive manual and automated test scenarios.
  • Experience in defect tracking, root cause analysis, test execution reporting, and release validation using Azure DevOps.
  • Strong understanding of API testing concepts and experience validating RESTful services.
  • Experience validating data synchronization workflows across Web, Desktop, Mobile, and connected device platforms.
  • Knowledge of image, video, file upload/download, and data transfer validation in industrial or enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integration of Playwright automated tests into release processes.
  • Experience with source control tools such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Global QA, Product Management, Engineering, and Business teams.
  • Proven ability to work independently while managing multiple testing priorities in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Experience participating in Agile ceremonies including Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.

  • Preferred experience in Industrial Inspection, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT), Remote Visual Inspection (RVI), Borescope, or Connected Device product domains.

You will collaborate closely with the development and product teams to identify and report defects, verify bug fixes, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our software development processes. This role requires a strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices. Responsibilities

  • Test Planning and Preparation: Collaborate with the development team to understand project requirements and contribute to the creation of comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for software applications.
  • Test Execution: Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, and system testing, using Playwright automation frameworks to validate the software's behavior and performance.
  • Defect Identification and Reporting: Identify, document, and track defects, inconsistencies, and performance issues using Azure DevOps or other bug tracking tools. Work closely with the development team, project manager, and product manager to ensure timely resolution of identified issues.
  • Automated Testing: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using C# to increase test coverage, efficiency, and accuracy in the software testing process.
  • Performance and Security Testing: Conduct performance and security testing to evaluate the software's stability and safeguard against potential vulnerabilities.
  • Test Environment Setup: Assist in configuring and maintaining test environments to simulate real-world conditions and support testing activities effectively.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in process improvement initiatives, providing valuable feedback to enhance software quality and testing methodologies.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain detailed test documentation, including test cases, test data, and test results, ensuring clear and effective communication within the team.

Requirements:

  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, testing types, and best practices.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and the ability to adapt to changing project requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • A proactive attitude towards learning new technologies and staying up-to-date with industry trends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in writing and executing automated test scripts using C#.
  • Knowledge of other testing tools and frameworks related to Playwright.
  • Familiarity with web services testing (REST, SOAP, etc.).
  • Experience with performance measuring tools.
  • Working understanding of AI concepts and the ability to leverage AI tools to improve day-to-day operations, productivity, and problem-solving.

Job Description:

The Software Quality Engineer is responsible for creating end-to-end test plans, executing the test plan, and managing all activities in the plan as part of and in conjunction with an Agile Scrum development team to ensure that all objectives are met and the software solution works as expected. The solution should be tested in terms of functionality, performance, stability, and compatibility with legacy and/or third party software and integrated external hardware.

The objective of the Software Quality Engineer is to ensure that testing of every feature of the software solution and through every phase of development is well defined, planned, and executed. The work of the Software Quality Engineer should inspire confidence that any potential issue has been identified and addressed prior to release of the software solution. The Software Quality Engineer, Senior Associate Level is a professional with job area knowledge and a key contributor to the scrum team.

Essential Functions:

  • Review functional and design specifications to ensure full understanding of individual deliverables;
  • Identify test requirements from Conditions of Acceptance, map test case requirements, and design test coverage plan;
  • Develop, document and maintain functional test cases and other test artifacts such as test plans, test summaries, and process documents as needed;
  • Execute and evaluate manual test cases and report test results;
  • Participate in test case reviews with cross-functional team members;
  • Identify any potential quality issues per defined process and escalate potential quality issues immediately to Product Owners;
  • Keep team and stakeholders informed of project QA progress and emergent risks;
  • Ensure that validated deliverables meet functional and design specifications and requirements via Functional, Regression, Performance, Stress, and Endurance Testing;
  • Isolate, replicate, and report defects and verify defect fixes via Exploratory, and Usability Testing in addition to above testing methods;
  • Seek opportunities for improvement in quality, including but not limited to efficiency gains and expanding test coverage;
  • Engage as an active participant in Scrum ceremonies;
  • Required to perform other appropriate duties as requested, directed, or assigned;
  • Perform all job functions with a positive, professional attitude;
  • Ability to obtain a US Secret security clearance


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 0 to 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.


Preferred Additional Skills:

  • Knowledge and experience in test design, development, and execution of test cases, in support of software and hardware solutions;
  • Excellent observational, analytical, and problem-solving skills;
  • Excellent listening and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to stay disciplined and focused;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills;
  • Able to be productive and effective working either alone or as part of a team;
  • Strong customer service orientation;
  • Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Experience with Test Track Pro, Version One, or similar testing tools/suites;
  • Experience with software that directly interfaces with 3rd party firmware;
  • Experience in an Agile Scrum environment;
  • Familiarity with closed network environments;
  • US Government security clearance.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced, automation-focused Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our North American Sports product team. This team develops insightful analytics and Recruit products for American Football, helping high-level coaches and analysts make faster, data-driven decisions on player performance and talent acquisition.

As the testing expert within your cross-functional squad, you'll own quality end-to-end — building the strategies and automation that ensure we're shipping software our users love. You'll drive quality discussions, challenge the team to maintain high standards, and be the advocate for reliability and performance at every stage of delivery.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, You'll

  • Lead quality initiatives. Build risk-based testing strategies tailored to your squad's architecture, drive quality discussions in scrum ceremonies, challenge defect priorities, and continuously look for ways to improve practices and keep your squad's quality processes ahead of the curve.
  • Test across the stack. Design and execute tests spanning front-end UI, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines — validating transformations, service outputs, and complex logic at scale.
  • Automate with intent. Make informed decisions about what, when, and how to automate. Use Playwright and scripting to build reliable, maintainable automated checks that keep pace with development.
  • Mentor and grow others. Use your technical depth and quality instincts to coach teammates, raise the bar for quality standards across the team, and influence how the whole squad thinks about quality.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Design, contribute to hiring, and invest in your own professional development.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln and Omaha, Nebraska are prioritized, we're open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Quality focus. You see the big picture and use it to drive improvements in both quality and velocity.
  • Technical depth. 4+ years of software testing experience with hands-on expertise across the full stack — API testing, backend and data-heavy systems, and front-end validation — plus proficiency in automation frameworks like Playwright and languages like Python or TypeScript.
  • A track record of leadership. You've owned quality for a squad, led testing initiatives end-to-end, defined success criteria, and designed approaches that measurably reduce risk in production.
  • Investigative rigour. You dig to root causes of complex problems, back your findings with data, and measure outcomes.
  • User focus. You think critically about the user experience and let that understanding shape your testing approach.
  • AI-powered working. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — for test case creation, failure diagnosis, documentation, and beyond — and look for new ways to apply them to raise the team's efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Performance testing exposure. Familiarity with load, stress, and scalability testing concepts and tools (e.g. JMeter) for validating API and backend performance.
  • Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in Basketball, American Football or Ice Hockey — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent experience. A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000 - $137,000 USD
