Company Overview

Iridium is an award-winning satellite communications company operating the world's only truly global voice and data network, delivering reliable connectivity anywhere on Earth. For more than 20 years, Iridium has powered mission-critical communications for governments, businesses, aviation, maritime, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things.

Now part of Iridium, Aireon is the world’s only space-based air traffic surveillance system, providing real-time visibility of aircraft over oceans, the poles, and remote regions. Together, Iridium and Aireon are helping build a safer, more connected, and more efficient future for global aviation.

Join our team and help shape how the world stays connected. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are empowered to innovate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

What We’re Looking For:

As a Test Engineer III, you will independently plan and execute verification activities across the software development and operations lifecycle, with an emphasis on end-to-end and integration testing for complex systems. You will design and implement manual and automated test approaches (including AI-assisted techniques where appropriate), drive testing deliverables to completion, and partner with Engineering, Product, and Program stakeholders to assess risk and readiness. You will strengthen quality outcomes by reviewing test artifacts, escalating issues, and continuously improving verification processes based on results and defect trends.

What You’ll Do:

  • Participate in requirements and design discussions to define verification scope, risks, and acceptance criteria for assigned initiatives.
  • Develop test plans, estimates, and traceability for end-to-end, integration, and user acceptance testing across multiple applications and integration points.
  • Design, implement, and maintain manual and automated test cases; leverage AI-assisted tooling to accelerate test design and automation with appropriate validation and review.
  • Execute testing in Agile and/or Waterfall environments, accurately tracking progress, results, and defects, and proactively communicating status, risks, and mitigations.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for testing matters, helping remove blockers and coordinating with cross-functional teams to drive timely issue resolution.
  • Review and improve test artifacts produced by others (test cases, plans, reports) and coordinate signoff workflows with Product Owners and other stakeholders.
  • Monitor verification effectiveness (e.g., defect leakage, root cause analysis) and implement targeted process and tooling improvements to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Support deployment and launch activities by creating user-facing documentation, conducting training as needed, and assisting with initial operational readiness.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related field OR equivalent relevant experience in lieu of degree.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in software testing/quality engineering, including end-to-end and integration testing for complex applications.
  • Demonstrated expertise with the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), test planning, estimation, traceability, and verification documentation.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining test automation using modern tools and frameworks (e.g., UI, API, and integration test approaches).
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools/models to support test case design and/or automation development (tool usage; not ML model development).
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate issues across environments, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across regions and confidently present status, risks, and quality findings.
  • Ability to prioritize, manage upward, and take ownership of testing deliverables, driving work to completion with minimal day-to-day direction.

Things That Would be Great if You Brought to the Table:

  • Experience in the aviation industry and/or safety- or mission-critical software environments.
  • Experience leading E2E/UAT testing efforts for systems with multiple integration points and distributed teams.
  • Experience with CI/CD integration for automated testing and test reporting dashboards.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor peers and influence adoption of testing best practices (no direct people management required).

Work Environment:

This position primarily works in an office setting and is largely sedentary with the majority of the position working with a computer. The role typically requires the use of basic office equipment such as a phone, video, computer, keyboard, mouse, and printer.

We believe in-person connection drives innovation, strengthens mentorship, and builds culture, while flexibility enables employees to do their best work. Under Iridium’s Hybrid Work Policy, employees are expected to work at least four days per week (approximately 80%) in an Iridium office to support collaboration, relationship-building, and professional growth.

Additional Information

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work for this role and is not a comprehensive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be assigned additional responsibilities as needed.

Base Pay Range: $95,000 - $125,000 USD

Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors and this range represents an estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Base salary is only one part of our compensation package for this role. You may also be eligible for company stock and annual bonus. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

Iridium is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

We are seeking an SDET / Senior QA Engineer to accelerate functional testing through AI-augmented tools and intelligent automation. You will leverage Claude AI, Playwright, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) to design and execute comprehensive functional tests to reduce manual effort while maintaining rigorous quality standards.

As the last line of defense before production releases, you will ensure our Trading Platforms and related products function according to requirements by using AI to intelligently generate tests, analyze defects, and optimize test execution. You are passionate about quality but impatient with manual, repetitive testing, you use AI and smart tooling to amplify human expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze system specifications
  • Collaborate with team members to develop effective strategies and test plans
  • Use Claude AI to automatically generate test cases, test scenarios from requirements and user stories
  • Leverage Claude for intelligent test locator generation (Playwright selectors) to handle complex financial application UIs
  • Write and execute Playwright-based functional tests that cover critical user scenarios and Order & Trading workflows
  • Use AI to analyze test failures, suggest root causes, and recommend fixes
  • Apply MCP to connect Claude with requirements systems, defect trackers, and test execution logs for full-context analysis
  • Conduct post-release/ post-implementation testing
  • Troubleshoot system issues within QA, development and product management
  • Work with cross-functional teams (dev, product, business) to validate quality throughout SDLC

Knowledge And Experience

  • BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
  • 5+ years in Quality Assurance or software testing roles
  • Proven ability to design comprehensive test cases and test plans
  • Strong experience in functional, regression, and integration testing
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for database validation and test data queries
  • Experience in project management and QA methodology
  • Working knowledge of test management software (e.g. Jira and ALM)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Analytical mind and problem-solving aptitude
  • Strong organizational skills

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Fixed Income and/or Derivative Trading Platforms, a big plus
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks and regression testing is a plus

About Digital Harbor

Digital Harbor is a technology company developing innovative software products that transform how people communicate, collaborate, and create.


Our Business Media portfolio includes four products: Byte, Dot, Matee, and Yoodle. Each is designed to solve different challenges in modern communication and productivity.

We operate in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where engineers are encouraged to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and contribute directly to the quality and success of the products they help build.


About the Opportunity

Digital Harbor is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the reliability, performance, and usability of our growing Business Media product portfolio.


We're looking for a hands-on engineer who combines strong manual testing skills with practical test automation experience. This individual will work closely with software engineers, product leaders, and designers to identify defects, improve testing processes, and help deliver high-quality software.


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, technically curious, and comfortable taking ownership of testing activities throughout the development lifecycle.


As our products continue to expand across web, desktop, and mobile platforms, this position will play an important role in establishing repeatable testing practices and improving release confidence.


Our Products: Business Media

Byte: Video Communication Without Another Meeting

Byte enables asynchronous video communication through browser-based screen and camera recordings.

  • Record and share video messages instantly.
  • Provide feedback through time-specific comments, reactions, and annotations.
  • Catch up quickly with transcripts, AI-generated chapters, and summaries.
  • Continue conversations through video replies and Dot integration.

Value Proposition: Reduce unnecessary meetings while making communication more personal, efficient, and accessible.


Dot: Collaborative Content and Conversations

Dot makes files, screenshots, and everyday content interactive and collaborative.

  • Capture, annotate, and discuss content together.
  • Collaborate using reactions, stickers, Magic Markers, and feeds.
  • Organize communication through threads, mentions, and private conversations.
  • Stay informed through Catch-Me-Up and notifications.

Value Proposition: Make collaboration feel natural by connecting conversations directly to the content people work with.


Matee: Intelligent Writing Technology

Matee is an embeddable rich-text platform designed to make writing and communication smarter.

  • Enhance written communication using natural language understanding and generation.
  • Transform text into clearer, more actionable information.
  • Integrate intelligent writing capabilities into existing applications.
  • Deliver a consistent writing experience across multiple platforms.

Value Proposition: Help users communicate more effectively while enabling applications to offer intelligent, integrated writing experiences.


Yoodle: Connected Messaging and Collaboration

Yoodle brings messaging, meetings, and scheduling into a unified communication experience.

  • Share files, voice, video, and reactions within conversations.
  • Make video meetings more engaging and collaborative.
  • Organize conversations through threads, reminders, and calendars.

  • Basic programming skills in Java 
  • Basic understanding of Linux commands and filesystem 
  • Effective verbal and written communication; able to read, write, and speak English proficiently

descriptionHtml:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.

Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.

Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

As a Senior QA Test Engineer, you will be a key contributor in ensuring the quality of Huron’s enterprise applications. The successful candidate will help define and ensure that Huron’s applications meet high standards for reliability, usability, and performance. You will work closely with the Product Management and Engineering teams in the design, implementation, release, and maintenance of multi-user, dynamic, web-based, and analytics applications. This role requires a passion for delivering exceptional products, the curiosity and drive to understand client application usage patterns and behaviors, the technical skills to develop reusable and automated tests to ensure a high-quality user experience, and the independence and persistence to own and drive quality throughout the product lifecycle. The role requires strong expertise in AWS and Performance Testing using JMeter, Selenium Automation Framework with Java, basic database concepts including SQL queries and data validation, troubleshooting and debugging, and experience working in Agile development environments. The successful candidate must also possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Under general direction, this individual is responsible for carrying out procedures to ensure that all software, hardware, applications and services meet the standards of the organization and end-user requirements, analyzing and testing software and application configuration to ensure that products meet design specifications and are within total quality management limits and standards. This individual is expected to participate actively in Agile testing methodology including helping to develop quality standards, test cases, software/hardware and application testing, and documenting process and test outcomes. They are responsible for developing, modifying and executing test plans and suites and communicating with product developers and technical support specialists on software issues. In addition, they are expected to perform tests to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects. They may create test data to ensure thorough evaluation, documents and work to resolve basic problems and report progress on problem resolution to management.

The Senior QA Test Engineer applies company policies and procedures to address a variety of issues. They are also responsible for assisting in the development of policies and standards and ensuring adherence to company procedures and best practices.

Position Responsibilities

  • Own and execute manual and automated testing activities across the complete software development lifecycle, ensuring releases meet quality objectives and timelines.
  • Design, develop, execute, and performance test scripts using JMeter, including workload modeling, test execution, results analysis, and performance reporting.
  • Analyze test and performance results, troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and work closely with development teams to drive defects through resolution.
  • Develop and maintain UI automation using Selenium with Java, creating reliable and reusable automation scripts for functional and regression testing.
  • Review technical design documents and participate in design and architecture discussions, providing QA perspectives on testability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Estimate QA effort for user stories and defects and develop test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
  • Generate and maintain appropriate test data to address testing requirements and data gaps.
  • Perform database validation using SQL queries and validate data integrity across application and backend systems.
  • Conduct performance testing to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity limitations, scalability concerns, potential performance debt, communicate performance issues to engineering teams.
  • Identify and communicate release risks, quality concerns, and potential production-impacting issues to QA and project leadership.
  • Participate in bug scrub meetings, release readiness discussion.
  • Evaluate and recommend new tools, techniques, and automation approaches to improve testing efficiency and product quality.

McKesson is transforming healthcare through technology, data, and innovation. Within Macro Helix, part of Connected Care & Analytics, we help hospitals and health systems optimize pharmacy operations, improve financial performance, and maintain regulatory compliance.

As a Software Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software solutions. This role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation, SQL validation, and quality engineering practices to support the successful delivery of healthcare technology products. We're looking for a self-starter who can quickly learn complex applications, contribute to automation initiatives, and collaborate effectively within Agile development teams.

What You'll Do

  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for complex healthcare applications.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and reusable test frameworks.
  • Write and execute SQL queries to validate application functionality, business logic, and data integrity.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, product owners, and QA team members throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Create automated UI, API, and integration tests that run within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.
  • Analyze requirements and user stories to develop comprehensive test coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to quality engineering best practices.
  • Monitor test results, regression coverage, and quality metrics to support continuous improvement.
  • Support adoption of automation-first testing practices and emerging AI-assisted testing capabilities.


Basic Requirements

Minimum Education & Typical Experience or Equivalent Combination:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field and typically 4+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years of software testing or quality assurance experience.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience writing queries for testing and data validation.
  • Experience building or maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Tosca, Selenium, or similar platforms.
  • Experience testing APIs, integrations, and end-to-end workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control tools, and Agile teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve defects.


Preferred Skills/Experience

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience testing cloud-based applications, including Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience with API testing tools such as SoapUI or Postman.
  • Experience with Jira, qTest, or similar Agile testing tools.
  • Experience with behavior-driven development tools such as Cucumber or JUnit.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled testing tools and automation practices.
  • Healthcare technology, pharmacy, revenue cycle, or healthcare software experience


Work Environment & Travel

  • Preferred location: Atlanta, GA or Las Colinas, TX.
  • Hybrid work arrangement available based on business needs.
  • Team members in the Las Colinas office may be expected to work onsite a minimum of two days per week.
  • Atlanta-based employees may periodically attend onsite team meetings.
  • Limited travel may be required for team collaboration and business meetings.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

As a QA/Test Engineer within IBM Infrastructure, you will ensure the quality, reliability, performance, and security of enterprise software solutions. You will work closely with developers, architects, product managers, and support teams to design and execute comprehensive testing strategies, automate test coverage, identify defects, and drive continuous quality improvements throughout the software development lifecycle.

Your Role And Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute functional, integration, system, regression, performance, and end-to-end test plans.
  • Develop and maintain automated test frameworks, scripts, and test suites to improve test coverage and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with software developers and product teams to understand requirements and ensure quality is built into the development process.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Validate new features, enhancements, and bug fixes to ensure they meet functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, sprint planning, and agile development activities.
  • Perform root cause analysis of product defects and work with engineering teams to drive corrective actions.
  • Contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines by integrating automated testing and quality gates.
  • Monitor product quality metrics and recommend improvements to testing processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Create and maintain test documentation, validation reports, and quality assurance standards.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and quality assurance principles.
  • Experience developing and executing manual and automated test cases.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, or Shell scripting.
  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks and tools.
  • Knowledge of defect tracking and test management tools.
  • Experience with Linux/Unix operating systems and command-line environments.
  • Understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems testing.
  • Knowledge of source control systems such as Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Experience building and maintaining enterprise-scale test automation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native technologies including Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, and containerized applications.
  • Experience testing storage, backup, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, or infrastructure management solutions.
  • Familiarity with performance, scalability, reliability, and security testing.
  • Experience with API automation, UI automation, and service virtualization tools.
  • Knowledge of observability, monitoring, logging, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing, test analytics, or intelligent automation solutions.
  • Familiarity with IBM Infrastructure technologies, Red Hat OpenShift, hybrid cloud platforms, and enterprise software environments.

WHAT WE'RE DOING

By bringing together people that use their passion for purposeful innovation, at Lockheed Martin we keep people safe and solve the world's most complex challenges. Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work. With our employees as our priority, we provide diverse career opportunities designed to propel development and boost agility. Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. At Lockheed Martin, we place an emphasis on empowering our employees by fostering innovation, integrity, and exemplifying the epitome of corporate responsibility. Your Mission is Ours.

THE WORK

Lockheed Martin has been embedded with the USSTRATCOM Nuclear Mission for 30+ years and has a track record of bringing innovative mission software solutions to this domain. Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is seeking engineers to support our USSTRATCOM software teams which create Planning and Command and Control (C2) capabilities as part of the Strategic Mission Planning and Execution System (SMPES) in a DevSecOps environment. In this role, you will help our team create modern Web-based, Java mission systems for the Nuclear community. The successful candidate will have experience with software systems built to exacting standards that are delivered on a DevSecOps cadence using Agile Scrum.

Our team needs a full-time tester. In this role, you will:

  • Validate software deployments, author test scripts / test descriptions, and coordinate with developers on defects
  • Act as a quality gate to ensure delivered software meets its intent
  • Collaborate with architecture, cyber, integration, and product owner stakeholders.

Must be a US Citizen. This position will require a government security clearance.

WHY JOIN US

Joining our team offers you the opportunity to support a join a company and a team where your contributions are valued and you can develop your skills and expertise.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at work or online.

Instead, we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life both in and outside of work, along with competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits.

<a href=https://www.lockheedmartinjobs.com/working-here#benefits>Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s competitive and comprehensive benefits package.

Basic Qualifications

  • Software test experience
  • Familiarity with writing test procedures and conducting scenario-based tests
  • Experience running automated software testing suites
  • Must be a US Citizen; this position will require a government security clearance. This position is located at a facility that requires special access

Desired Skills

  • USSTRATCOM mission insight (Intel, Planning, or C2)
  • Ability to script or code automated tests
  • Insight into systems engineering / agile methods for documenting scope
  • Engineering experience with AFNWC SMPES, MPAS, NPES Systems

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $63400.00 - $117800.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.

Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity

This opportunity provides advanced software development support to a major United States strategic command, contributing to capabilities that underpin national‑level strategic deterrence and long‑range operational readiness.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain test frameworks and supporting documentation to ensure testing activities are repeatable, traceable, and aligned with program quality standards.
  • Expand automated testing capabilities by identifying high-value regression scenarios, prioritizing automation efforts, and implementing scalable automated test solutions.
  • Validate software functionality across multiple testing disciplines, including functional, integration, exploratory, performance, load, and smoke testing for web-based applications and supporting databases.
  • Document, track, and communicate software defects by recording issues, reproducing conditions, and collaborating with development teams to support timely resolution.
  • Contribute actively within an Agile development environment, supporting sprint planning, daily collaboration, reviews, retrospectives, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with engineers, architects, and stakeholders to create comprehensive test strategies, define acceptance criteria, and ensure quality objectives are incorporated throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support software assurance and risk reduction activities through requirements analysis, test design, validation planning, and evaluation of appropriate testing tools and methodologies.
  • Measure and improve testing effectiveness by establishing, collecting, and analyzing quality metrics that drive informed decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Evaluate emerging test technologies and best practices to improve automation coverage, accelerate delivery timelines, and increase overall product quality.
  • Support the delivery of mission-critical software solutions through comprehensive verification activities integrated with CI/CD pipelines and modern software engineering practices.

Qualifications

Required:

  • U.S. Citizen eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field and relevant software testing experience.
  • Experience developing and executing automated test solutions.
  • Knowledge of software testing methodologies, defect tracking, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Experience with functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile development practices and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience using tools such as Jira or similar work management platforms.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$65,700 - $134,400

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

POSITION PURPOSE

Individuals within the Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer role deliver automated solutions for software processes. Plans, organizes, coordinates and tracks testing activities to ensure the successful deployment of projects. Uses technical skills, expertise and application knowledge to support clients, developers and testers. Provides knowledge transfer and training to the test team as needed. Performs or participates in various types of testing and post implementation reviews as determined by the project. Helps to ensure continuous improvement in Quality Assurance processes. A QA engineer is expected to:

  • Identify opportunities for inserting more quality within software processes.
  • Design and execute QA tests.
  • Run tests for databases, systems, networks, applications, hardware and software.
  • Identify bugs and quality issues in development, service or business processes.
  • Collaborate with other business units to understand the business and ensure their quality needs are being met. QA Engineers also interact with various development teams, project managers, internal and external customers, senior management, and external vendors. Members of this role understand how to create and execute functional testing so that they can support and enable key business processes. They must have an in-depth understanding of the business environment, and strong analytical and communication skills. Individuals must work well within a team environment. Accountable for complying with all laws and regulations associated with duties and responsibilities.

NATURE AND SCOPE

  • This role does not manage people
  • This role reports to this job: Manager, IT Quality Assurance

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Management requiraed or four years of related work experience can be used in lieu of a degree.
  • Report and document defects found during testing and work across functional teams to resolve defects.

Work Experience

  • 5 years of quality assurance related work experience which could include experience in the following areas:
  • Professional systems or programming background.
  • Database technologies and SQL required.
  • Automated testing experience, including planning and conducting functional and performance testing, preferred.
  • Testing web, client-server, infrastructure, business process, or mainframe applications, testing systems installation and maintenance, automated testing tools and QA methodologies, preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft TFS/ Azure DevOps, preferred.
  • Experience on Epic Tapestry and Cheers, preferred.

Skills And Abilities

  • Must have demonstrated ability to analyze and solve logical problems such as those found in mathematics, statistics, etc.
  • Certifications in software quality, or technical equivalent, preferred.
  • Report and document defects found during testing and work across functional teams to resolve defects.
  • Responsibilities:
  • Work Complexity:Works on medium complex and cross-functional solutions. Works multiple projects as a team member.
  • Business Requirements:Works with project team and BA to understand customer needs.
  • Project/ Work Planning:Participates in or supports workstream planning process.
  • Develop & Implement: Collects, analyzes, and shares test data to help business teams drive improvement in key business metrics, customer experience, and business results.Performs testing validations, capture test cases, coordinate automated testing and report outcomes.Develops and tests solutions such as databases, queries, views, reports, and dashboards.Documents new and existing test strategies, solutions, and implementations.Conduct defect triage meetings while using reporting and analysis tools that help streamline the business and make reporting, analyzing, planning, and forecasting more efficient.Provides testing estimation to project team.Works with users and other testing groups to create and implement the test plan.
  • Production Support: Leads the effort to troubleshoots defects and or enhancements to systems and software.Tracks performance and production issues.Escalates production issues as appropriate.Supports users during post-implementation testing.
  • Quality Assurance:Ensures the code and tests are within required quality standards.Manages the defect triage meeting.Reports test/quality status and test results to all stakeholders for projects.Reports defects in the defect system and ensures the defects are tracked, retested, and closed in a timely manner.Coordinates with different testing groups, including users, to ensure testing is complete and thorough.
  • Training:May train users to create test scenarios and provide guidance in testing and to use that information correctly.
  • Process, Policies & Standards:Adheres to process, policies, and standards.Ensures Enterprise QA standards and processes are maintained.
  • Customer service: Keeps customer and project team informed about any quality issues.Tracks and reports out on issues and enhancement request for the business in a timely manner.
  • Research/Evaluation:Analyzes and tests new releases/versions of software.May participate in vendor evaluations.

Licenses and Certifications

  • None Required

Accountabilities And Essential Functions

  • Analytical Thinking: Coordinates the information gathering and reporting process. Reviews trends and compares to expectations. Conducts research to define problems and prepares responses to anticipated questions. Prioritizes multiple issues and opportunities. Identifies relationships and linkages within several information sources. Anticipates issues that are not readily apparent on the surface. Identifies root causes and effects. Defines priorities within performance objectives. Reports and identifies areas that need guidance in order to resolve complex issues. Anticipates the possible outcome of potential solutions
  • Business Function Knowledge: Involves the key players in identifying operating needs, issues and solutions. Proposes technical plans that are aligned with business objectives and technical requirements. Takes and leads actions to enhance business function standards and performance with the participation of business and technical partners
  • Consulting: Conducts investigations and interprets issues within operational and professional contexts. Provides guidance and counsel. Suggests caution to impacted areas as appropriate in relation to matters of policy interpretation and implementation of operational improvement. Conducts discussions that share information and trigger solutions and improvements
  • Customer Service Orientation: Asks questions and conducts investigations in order to understand clients' specific needs and provides prompt, attentive service. Understands client’s expectations and takes initiatives to meet and exceed them. Monitors progress and updates client and management as to status. Educates clients in ways of using products and services. Quickly and effectively solves customer problems. Develops trust and credibility with the customer
  • Information Seeking: Utilizes a variety of information and data sources pertaining to organizational and professional trends. Checks the source for omission and accuracy. Identifies the sources that are appropriate for specific types of information. Checks for bias and omission. Seeks out the appropriate people to approach for guidance either formally or informally depending on the type of issue. Links information in a lateral as well as linear manner. Finds hidden data. Relates and manipulates data from various sources to create a fuller picture. Investigates and uncovers root causes of a problem or issue.Innovation: Shares new ideas and consistently demonstrates openness to the opinions and views of others. Identifies new and different patterns, trends, and opportunities. Generates solutions that build upon, adapt, and go beyond tradition and status quo. Targets important areas for innovation and develops solutions that address meaningful work issues. Seeks to involve other stakeholders in developing solutions to problems. Takes calculated risks

Determines the potential causes of the problem and devises testing methodologies for validation. Shows empathy and objectivity toward individuals involved in the issue. Analyzes multiple alternatives, risks and benefits for a range of potential solutions. Recommends resource requirements and collaborates with impacted stakeholders

POSITION PURPOSE

Individuals within the Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer role deliver automated solutions for software processes. Plans, organizes, coordinates and tracks testing activities to ensure the successful deployment of projects. Uses technical skills, expertise and application knowledge to support clients, developers and testers. Provides knowledge transfer and training to the test team as needed. -  Identify opportunities for inserting more quality within software processes.
-  Design and execute QA tests.
-  Run tests for databases, systems, networks, applications, hardware and software.
-  Identify bugs and quality issues in development, service or business processes.
-  Collaborate with other business units to understand the business and ensure their quality needs are being met. NATURE AND SCOPE

Education

Work Experience

- Professional systems or programming background.

Skills And Abilities

- Report and document defects found during testing and work across functional teams to resolve defects.

Takes and leads actions to enhance business function standards and performance with the participation of business and technical partners

descriptionHtml:
TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a talented Sr. Software Test Engineer, Mobile Automation to join our shared Software QA Automation team in Round Rock, Texas, Atlanta, Georgia, Plano, Texas, Harrisburg, Pennsylvania.


*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*


Summary

The Sr. Mobile Test Automation Engineer will focus on automation coverage for the Smart Mobility platform. This role will primarily own native iOS and Android mobile test automation, including framework development, mobile regression coverage, device-cloud execution, CI/CD integration, and mobile quality reporting. The engineer will validate key Smart Mobility workflows across mobile applications, backend services, cloud services, and downstream transaction systems.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for native Android and iOS applications.
  • Build reusable automation components, utilities, reporting, test data handling, and execution standards.
  • Automate sanity, functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end mobile test scenarios.
  • Perform testing across real devices, emulators/simulators, OS versions, and cloud device platforms.
  • Analyze automation failures, troubleshoot flaky tests, and continuously improve framework reliability.
  • Ensure mobile apps meet expectations for functionality, usability, reliability, security, and performance.
  • Coordinate with DevOps engineers to integrate mobile smoke, regression, and end-to-end automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirements reviews, and design discussions to identify mobile quality risks early.
  • Support shift-left testing, automation-first delivery, and Test-Driven Development practices.
  • Create dashboards, automation execution reports, and mobile quality metrics for release readiness.
  • Track mobile automation coverage, pass/fail trends, flaky tests, defect leakage, and release risks.
  • Support defect triage, bug fix validation, targeted regression testing, and release sign-off activities.

Requirements And Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field required.
  • 8-12 years of QA experience, with strong automation engineering background.
  • 5+ years of hands-on mobile testing experience across iOS and Android.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining mobile automation frameworks from scratch.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile automation tools such as Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Maestro, or similar tools.
  • Experience testing native, hybrid, and mobile web applications.
  • Experience with device cloud platforms such as BrowserStack, SauceLabs, LambdaTest, or similar.
  • Programming experience in Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or C#.
  • Strong knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Agile/Scrum practices, debugging, troubleshooting, and automation best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Playwright test automation for Web UI and API testing.
  • Experience testing tolling, transportation, SaaS, payment, or transaction-based systems.
  • Experience with performance tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar.
  • Exposure to observability, logs, metrics, tracing, crash analytics, mobile performance monitoring, security, and application resiliency.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test acceleration, troubleshooting, and automation productivity.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

Physical Demands/Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

  • TransCore complies with federal and state disability laws and provides reasonable accommodation for employees with disabilities.

Meet The Team

The Cisco Wireless Test & Automation team ensures the quality, reliability, and performance of next-generation wireless products. We work closely with development, platform, and system teams to validate features, automate test coverage, and reproduce real-world customer scenarios at scale. Our work directly impacts the experience of millions of users relying on Cisco wireless infrastructure.

Your Impact

Role

As a QA / Automation Engineer, you will contribute to validating Cisco’s wireless platforms by writing test plans, developing automation, and analyzing system behavior. You will gain hands-on experience with real networking environments, lab setups, and modern AI-assisted development tools. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy breaking systems, understanding how they work, and ensuring high-quality product delivery. In This Role, You Will:

  • Write and execute test plans and test cases for wireless features and systems
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python or similar languages
  • Analyze test results and identify issues, inconsistencies, or performance gaps
  • Reproduce customer and system issues in controlled lab environments
  • Assist in setting up and maintaining testbeds and lab environments (routers, switches, access points)
  • Collaborate with development and platform teams to debug and resolve issues
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve testing efficiency and automation

Minimum Qualification

  • A Bachelor's degree (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months).
  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Network Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in Python or a similar scripting language, with a basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and routing.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach to troubleshooting system behavior.
  • Curious and interested in AI-enabled engineering practices, including using AI tools to improve productivity.

Preferred Qualification

  • Exposure to networking devices (routers, switches, access points) through coursework, labs, or internships
  • Familiarity with setting up small network environments
  • Basic understanding of wireless technologies (Wi-Fi / 802.11)
  • Certifications such as CCNA (or working toward it)

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

for carriers and brokers. You will design and automate tests across mobile and API layers, and, just as

importantly, help us push testing into an AI-assisted model, where AI generates test cases and scripts

from PRDs, Figma, and our knowledge base, and the engineer focuses on judgment, calibration, and

coverage decisions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is excited about automation-first QA and about using AI as a

serious part of the testing workflow, not just a novelty

Must-have

3+ years of experience in QA / test automation.

Solid programming ability in Python.

Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (mobile UI and/or API).

Experience with API testing and understanding of REST/HTTP .

Comfortable using AI / LLM tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot) in daily engineering work, and able to critically review AI-generated output rather than trust it blindly.

Familiarity with Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

Strong analytical mindset, able to root-cause failures from logs and evidence, not guess.

Working proficiency in English (written and spoken) for cross-region collaboration.

Nice-to-Have

Experience with Maestro (mobile automation).

Mobile app testing experience (Android / iOS).

Experience designing prompts or workflows for AI-assisted test generation.

Background in SaaS, logistics, or transportation products.

Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A Day In The Life

The Systems Software Test Engineer contributes to developing, executing, and documenting automated tests that verify end-to-end system functionality, robustness, and reliability in accordance with approved test plans, procedures, and defined metrics. The role supports system verification through test-case development, test automation and execution, analysis of data and results, and defect tracking and investigation. Working with Systems Test, Systems Engineering, Development, Test Tools, and Quality teams, the engineer contributes to verification and automation initiatives, supports CI/CD test workflows, and builds an understanding of system architecture and interfaces to support evaluation of the impact of software changes across the system.

Software Test Engineer 1's at Tandem are also responsible for:

  • Collaborates with Systems Test and Systems Engineering to review product requirements, feature designs, system robustness and reliability metrics, and system configurations, and develops test cases for system verification with appropriate guidance.
  • Develops and maintains automated test suites using established test automation frameworks and approved verification procedures.
  • Executes and monitors automated test suites through CI/CD pipelines; reviews test results, metrics, logs, and artifacts; investigates failures using established procedures; and escalates suspected product defects.
  • Participates in automation code reviews and follows established source control, branching, and documentation practices.
  • Stays current with industry trends and best practices in software testing and automation.
  • Assists development engineers in the diagnosis and replication of product failures.
  • Efficiently manages own time to complete work by assigned completion dates.
  • Records and compiles data for documentation of test procedures and prepares reports.
  • Assists with estimating test effort for project deliverables.
  • Works as a contributing member of cross-functional teams as needed, working closely with R&D engineering and Quality Engineers to match software test scope with documented specification requirements.

When & Where You’ll Work

Hybrid: This role will be a mix of in-office work at our corporate headquarters in Del Mar, CA and remote work. This position is expected to be in office 2-3 days per week but may require on-site attendance up to five days per week depending on business demands.

What You’ll Need

  • Foundational knowledge of TypeScript required; experience with additional programming or scripting languages such as C++, C#, JavaScript, or Python is preferred.
  • Familiarity with test frameworks used for automated testing, such as Cucumber, Jasmine, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to test automation tools used for web and mobile such as Appium, WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with source control concepts and CI/CD pipelines used to support automated testing workflows.
  • Ability to read and follow procedures and flow diagrams.
  • Able to effectively share information and ideas within and outside of department in written or verbal form; able to put forth own ideas and gain understanding from others.
  • Ability to support effective interactions between team members and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize assigned tasks, manage competing priorities, meet established deadlines, and produce high-quality work with appropriate guidance.
  • Experience with MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Extra Awesome

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science or related field or equivalent combination of education and applicable job experience.
  • Relevant internship, academic, project, or hands-on experience in software testing, software development, or test automation is preferred.
  • Exposure to developing and executing software test cases and documenting test results and defects, preferred.
  • Exposure to automated software testing and software verification activities.
  • Exposure to using test automation tools, source control systems, or CI/CD workflows is preferred.
  • Experience following detailed procedures, troubleshooting technical issues, and applying critical thinking to resolve problems within established guidelines.
  • Experience in mobile, cloud, or integrated software systems is preferred.

Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.

Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!

You Should Know

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a part of IT Ent Arch Data & Corp Tech team, The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare, maintain and implement test cases based on user stories; present results and track defects to closure.
  • Prepare, maintain and implement automated test scripts.
  • Maintain traceability from business requirements through test cases to automated scripts
  • Review test cases / automation approach with collaborator to ensure comprehensive coverage and acquire feedback.
  • Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
  • Construct appropriate end-2-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals.
  • Responsible for Delivery Pipeline adoption
  • Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements.
  • Contribute to standard framework of reusable functions.
  • Develop a basic understanding of the product being delivered.
  • Responsible for process compliance & associated documentation
  • Aligns risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4+ years of related experience
  • Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.

Talents Needed For Success

  • 4+ years of QA Testing experience with at least 3 years hands on Test Automation Experience
  • Develop, maintain, and implement functional and automated test scripts using Java and testing frameworks.
  • Hands-on Experience with JIRA, AQM, Bitbucket, Git, Jenkins, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum methodology through JIRA, Defect Triaging, Defect Status Reporting and Tracking
  • Knowledge of automation standard and best practices including experience with XPath axes and CSS selectors
  • In depth knowledge of common automation design patterns such as the page object model and software development methodologies
  • Sound knowledge of regression testing, Smoke & Sanity testing, compatibility testing, system functional testing, user acceptance testing etc.
  • Strong hands-on experience using Java for test automation, ability to develop, maintain, improve, and implement automated scripts.
  • Experience in API automation API testing (e.g. Rest Assured, Karate, Postman) and database testing (e.g. Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
  • Ability to write simple to medium complexity SQL queries.
  • Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Positive relationship and collaboration skills.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

Your Primary Responsibilities



-  Prepare, maintain and implement test cases based on user stories; present results and track defects to closure.
-  Prepare, maintain and implement automated test scripts.
-  Maintain traceability from business requirements through test cases to automated scripts
-  Review test cases / automation approach with collaborator to ensure comprehensive coverage and acquire feedback.
-  Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
-  Construct appropriate end-2-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals.
-  Responsible for Delivery Pipeline adoption
-  Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements.
-  Contribute to standard framework of reusable functions.
-  Develop a basic understanding of the product being delivered.
-  Responsible for process compliance & associated documentation
-  Aligns risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.

Qualifications



-  Minimum of 4+ years of related experience
-  Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.

Talents Needed For Success



-  4+ years of QA Testing experience with at least 3 years hands on Test Automation Experience
-  Develop, maintain, and implement functional and automated test scripts using Java and testing frameworks.
-  Hands-on Experience with JIRA, AQM, Bitbucket, Git, Jenkins, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium
-  Experience in Agile/Scrum methodology through JIRA, Defect Triaging, Defect Status Reporting and Tracking
-  Knowledge of automation standard and best practices including experience with XPath axes and CSS selectors
-  In depth knowledge of common automation design patterns such as the page object model and software development methodologies

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Employee Type: Regular

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity

This opportunity provides advanced software development support to a major United States strategic command, contributing to capabilities that underpin national‑level strategic deterrence and long‑range operational readiness.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end testing efforts by developing and executing comprehensive test strategies that validate software functionality, performance, and overall system readiness throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Drive test automation initiatives by designing, implementing, and maintaining automated test solutions that increase coverage, improve efficiency, and support continuous delivery objectives.
  • Develop quality-focused test plans and validation strategies through analysis of software requirements, system capabilities, and user needs.
  • Execute comprehensive software verification activities including functional, regression, integration, exploratory, performance, load, and smoke testing across web applications and databases.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams to identify risks, improve testability, and incorporate quality assurance practices throughout the software development process.
  • Manage defect identification and resolution by documenting issues, reproducing defects, and working closely with development teams through closure.
  • Evaluate and recommend testing technologies that enhance automation capabilities, improve testing efficiency, and support organizational quality objectives.
  • Measure and improve testing effectiveness through the development, collection, and analysis of quality metrics and performance indicators.
  • Provide technical leadership within Agile teams by supporting sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, release readiness activities, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Support modern CI/CD practices by integrating verification and validation activities throughout the software delivery pipeline

Qualifications

Required:

  • U.S. Citizen eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field and 8+ years relevant software testing experience.
  • Experience developing and executing automated testing solutions.
  • Knowledge of software testing methodologies, defect tracking, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Experience with Agile development practices and CI/CD environments.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira and other test management platforms.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to identify quality risks and drive testing improvement

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$65,700 - $134,400

HII works within our nation’s intelligence and cyber operations communities to defend our interests in cyberspace and anticipate emerging threats. Our capabilities in cybersecurity, network architecture, reverse engineering, software and hardware development uniquely enable us to support sensitive missions for the U.S. military and federal agency partners.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

Mission Technologies, a division of HII, is seeking a highly motivated Software Test Engineer, Associate to join our team. The role operates in our Columbia, MD location and supports critical national security missions.

The software test team is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security and meeting the requirements for customer of the Minotaur Mission Processor.

The Minotaur Mission Processor (or Minotaur Mission System/Suite) is a cutting-edge, government-owned mission management software suite and system architecture. Its core function is to integrate and fuse multiple sensor and data sources—including radar, cameras, and communications equipment—to create a single, common operating picture (COP).

The Software Test Engineer will execute responsibilities across the software development life cycle such as:

  • Test Planning
  • Writing Test Cases
  • Automation Scripting
  • Test Data Management
  • Test Execution
  • Bug Reporting
  • Regression Testing
  • Userability Testing

Why Mission Technologies?

  • Competitive Salary
  • Generous 401K Match Program
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Floating Holidays
  • Parental Leave
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage
  • Wellness Programs
  • Student Loan Repayment
  • Mentorship and Coaching
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Collaborative and supportive work environment that promotes a healthy climate

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Devise and apply testing procedures for both HII’s Minotaur product and from outside vendors.
  • Review software requirements and prepare test scenarios.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide input on requirements, product design, and potential problems.
  • Test creation, development, execution, and closure.
  • Analyze test results on database impacts, errors or bugs, and usability.
  • Perform moderately complex analysis and troubleshooting.
  • Design of both manual and automated test procedures.
  • Prepare reports on all aspects related to software testing carried out and reporting to the design team.
  • Support system integration events on various aircraft during ground/flight tests.
  • Potential to fly on aircraft to support system integration, test, and operator training
  • Willing to travel between 10-20% of the time.
  • Application of the principles, practices, and procedures used in test engineering.

Minimum Qualifications

0 years experience with Bachelors in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 4 years relevant experience.

Technical Skills And Additional Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree in Software, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline
  • Demonstrated experience working within a Linux environment
  • Scripting experience in Python, Bash or a related language
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US level Secret clearance

Preferred Requirements

  • An active US level Secret clearance

Physical Requirements

May require working in an office, industrial, shipboard, or laboratory environment. Capable of climbing ladders and tolerating confined spaces and extreme temperature variances.

When extending an offer, HII's Mission Technologies division takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function and a candidate's education or training, work experience, and key skills.

Meet HII’s Mission Technologies Division

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class.
