Duties / Responsibilities:

  • Hands-On Testing & Quality Validation
    • Execute functional, regression, integration, user acceptance, exploratory, smoke, and sanity testing across web, mobile, API, and telecommunications platforms.
    • Validate IPTV, VoIP, broadband, internet, network-based services, and customer-facing applications.
    • Perform end-to-end testing across mobile applications, web portals, backend systems, cloud services, and connected devices.
    • Test features on real iOS and Android devices and validate customer workflows across multiple environments.
    • Validate system performance, UI/UX behavior, accessibility, reliability, error handling, and cross-device compatibility.
    • Investigate complex defects using logs, API traces, system monitoring tools, and database queries to identify root causes.
  • Test Planning & Defect Management
    • Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, test suites, and testing documentation.
    • Create meaningful test scenarios based on business requirements, technical specifications, and user stories.
    • Document defects with clear reproduction steps, evidence, logs, screenshots, and impact assessments.
    • Partner with Product, Development, and Operations teams to prioritize defects and verify resolutions.
    • Maintain test execution records, release sign-off documentation, and quality metrics.
  • API, Data & Backend Validation
    • Validate REST APIs for functionality, authentication, schema compliance, and error handling.
    • Utilize Postman, API testing tools, and related technologies to verify service behavior.
    • Write SQL queries to validate data integrity, business rules, and backend processing.
    • Verify integrations between applications, cloud services, and telecommunications platforms.
  • Automation & Continuous Improvement
    • Design and develop automated test cases and scalable test suites with maintainability and efficiency in mind.
    • Contribute to automation frameworks utilizing technologies such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, Pytest, or similar tools.
    • Support CI/CD testing processes and automated regression strategies.
    • Leverage QA metrics, KPIs, and testing analytics to improve quality processes, tools, and best practices.
    • Evaluate emerging testing technologies, including AI-assisted testing solutions, where appropriate.
  • Agile Team Collaboration
    • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives.
    • Act as an advocate for quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
    • Provide testing expertise and mentorship to team members where appropriate.
    • Produce daily status updates, sprint-level reporting, and quality metrics.
    • Support production deployments through release validation and post-deployment verification activities.
    • Perform other duties as assigned

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • 4+ years of software quality assurance experience with hands-on web, mobile, API, or systems testing.
  • Experience testing software applications on real devices and across multiple environments.
  • Strong experience with API testing tools such as Postman and REST-based services.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and troubleshooting.
  • Experience using Jira, TestRail, or similar test management and defect tracking platforms.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of Git source control and pull-request workflows.
  • Experience testing telecommunications, broadband, IPTV, VoIP, or network-based services is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building or maintaining automated tests using Python, Pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud environments.
  • Experience with API performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or Locust.
  • Experience testing IoT, smart-home, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or connected-device ecosystems.
  • ISTQB Foundation or Test Automation Certification.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools and automation technologies

Benefits:

We truly appreciate and value all our employees and show our appreciation by offering a wide range of benefits, including:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare/Dental/Vision Plans
  • 401K Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and Additional Holidays (including your Birthday!)
  • Paid Volunteer Time
  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Employee Referral Bonuses

Join us at Entrust 

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely. 

Entrust's values are a cornerstone of who we are, our future business growth and how our people grow through it. We model our values by demonstrating that Customer Trust Is Earned, moving with purpose because Speed Is Intentional, taking accountability because We Own the Outcome, and building a collaborative culture where One Entrust Wins Together.

Get to Know Us 

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

Where you will be: This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Shakopee, MN headquarters office.

About Entrust

Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises and financial institutions in more than 150 countries, serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

  • Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.

Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

The Boeing Company is currently seeking an Associate Software Test Engineer to support our P-8 Mission Systems Software team located in Kent, Washington. This position will focus on supporting the Boeing Defense, Space and Security Services (BDS) Software Engineering organization.

In this position, you will be responsible for test and verification of the Mission Systems software, supporting software and system level integration and testing in labs. Expertise in Weapons integration, Sensors integration, Tactical Data Links, Operator Machine Interface (OMI) is desired.

You’ll be an integral part of supporting the Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS) P-8 Poseidon program, which is the premier Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) platform for the US Navy and several international partners. Upcoming contract awards have enabled team expansion and growth. This franchise program is anticipated to continue to be a stable program for the foreseeable future.

We are seeking an early career engineer that is passionate about aerospace and excited to work in a multi-disciplined, collaborative engineering environment that supports the design, development, and implementation of software for existing and emerging government and international programs.

This exciting position requires demonstrated experience as a Software Test Engineer, knowledge of the full software development life cycle (requirements, design, code, test), and the clear exhibition of superior judgment and decision making to engineer new solutions and support existing capabilities for multiple programs and customers. Demonstrated critical thinking and troubleshooting skills are required.

Position Responsibilities:


  • Supports the design, development, and completion of test and verification of software products to ensure quality, reliability, and functionality.
  • Participates in partnering with stakeholders to review and identify software requirements, test objectives, test strategies, and testability.
  • Supports designing test plans, cases, and scenarios to meet software requirements and specifications.
  • Contributes to the set up and configuration of test environments, including hardware, software, and network configurations to replicate production environments.
  • Supports executing test cases and scenarios to verify functionality, performance, and safety of software systems, identifying and reporting defects, issues, and potential vulnerabilities found during testing processes.
  • Contributes to providing test results and feedback on software design and functionality to resolve defects, issues, and potential vulnerabilities.
  • Supports creating, documenting, and maintaining test plans, procedures, cases, artifacts, metrics, and data in accordance with data privacy and security protocols and standards.
  • Supports developing and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks to improve efficiency and effectiveness of testing processes.
  • Contributes to software project management functions across test and verification activities involving multifunctional teams.


Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):


  • Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology, mathematics, data science, or computer science with 1 or more years of engineering work experience.
  • US Citizenship required
  • Ability to obtain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance
  • Test and Integration experience
  • Lab experience


Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):


  • Test Procedure development and execution experience
  • Software Requirements review experience
  • Interface design and control document experience
  • Troubleshooting H/W and S/W issues in a complex environment
  • Scripting languages: XML, Pearl, Python
  • Use case development
  • Supporting contractual deliverables
  • Development of User Interface design
  • Experience in Weapons Integration on military platforms
  • Experience in engineering discipline(s) (e.g., electrical, mechanical, software engineering) applied to product related systems throughout the product development life cycle, from concept development to deployment
  • Experience with implementation, validation, and verification processes, practices, and guidelines to ensure software development quality, performance, and safety


Drug Free Workplace:

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace (DFW) where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

Pay & Benefits:

At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary Pay Range: $90,950 - $123,050

Applications for this position will be accepted until Nov. 23, 2026

Export Control Requirements:

This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R.


  • 120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.


Export Control Details:

US based job, US Person required

Education

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required

Relocation

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Security Clearance

This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. An interim U.S. Secret Clearance Pre-Start and final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.

Visa Sponsorship

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Shift

This position is for 1st shift

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Boeing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you'll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:

LPL Financial is seeking a Senior Engineer, Software Development Test (QE) to design, implement, and execute comprehensive quality engineering strategies across a variety of technology platforms and applications. This role is responsible for developing automated testing solutions, validating software functionality and performance, and partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality software delivery throughout the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks and reusable test assets for enterprise applications.
  • Create and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios to ensure coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Validate complex integration workflows across multiple enterprise systems and platforms, including cloud-native and hybrid application architectures deployed on AWS.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, and technology teams to define testing strategies and quality standards.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects, partnering with development teams to support issue resolution and validation.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing activities.
  • Integrate automated testing solutions into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery and release quality.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews to promote testability and quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Monitor test execution results, quality metrics, and defect trends, providing regular status updates to project stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the improvement of quality engineering tools, processes, standards, and best practices.
  • Mentor junior quality engineers and support the growth of quality-focused engineering practices across the organization.


What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, Quality Assurance, or Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) roles.
  • Experience designing and implementing automated testing solutions using tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG, NUnit, Postman, JMeter, or similar technologies.
  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language, such as Java, C#, or Python.
  • Hands-on experience developing automation solutions using TypeScript, messaging and event-driven platforms including Kafka, and applications hosted on AWS cloud services.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


Core Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, risks, impacts, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Ability to develop and execute quality engineering strategies across complex technology environments.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and engineering excellence.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.


Preferences:

  • Experience performing API testing, database validation using SQL, and non-functional testing activities including performance or security testing.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL/SQL and database testing techniques.
  • Proven experience testing large-scale, enterprise-level applications with complex integrations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience working on mission-critical enterprise platforms with high availability, scalability, and compliance requirements.


Pay Range:

$91,400.00 - $152,400.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.

For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.

Information on Interviews:

LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an @lplfinancial.com email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855) 575-6947.

Job Description

Job Title: QA Senior Test Engineer

Location: Corporate

Department: Information Technology

Job Summary: The QA Senior Test Engineer is responsible for developing, executing, and maintaining automated and manual tests for web, API, and mobile applications. This role supports quality engineering practices across Digital, Mobile, and IT teams by contributing to test automation, validating application functionality, documenting defects, and helping improve overall software quality. This role is expected to actively participate in agile ceremonies, support CI/CD testing activities, and help ensure that features meet defined acceptance criteria and quality standards. Contribute to test planning, test case design, automated test development, defect validation, and continuous improvement of testing practices.

Principal Duties

  • Collaborate with software development engineers and QA team members to understand feature requirements, technical design, and test coverage needs.
  • Participate in and contribute to code reviews and design discussions to provide input on testability and automation considerations.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated functional, integration, API, and end-to-end tests for Digital, Mobile, and IT initiatives.
  • Assist with defining test cases, test data needs, and acceptance criteria in partnership with product and engineering teams.
  • Contribute to improvements to quality assurance practices by identifying opportunities to increase automation, reliability, and repeatability.
  • Find, isolate, document, regress, and track defects through resolution.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of manual and automated test execution across assigned products and features to ensure features meet defined acceptance criteria and quality standards.
  • Assist with end-to-end configuration, environment validation, and test data setup for digital, mobile, and other IT projects.
  • Track and report testing progress, automation results, and defect trends to help teams assess quality and readiness.

Essential Functions

  • Ability to work well individually and in a team environment
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with appropriate guidance and escalation
  • Detail oriented with strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate risks or blockers in a timely manner
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly with technical and non-technical peers
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and willingness to learn
  • Ability to follow established engineering and QA practices while contributing ideas for improvement
  • Enjoys working with partners, colleagues, and teams to solve software quality challenges
  • Passionate about QA, test automation, and continuous learning

Basic Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience writing test cases, executing software tests, documenting defects, and supporting test automation
  • 5+ years of experience with automated testing tools or frameworks
  • Familiarity with software development processes including Agile/Lean methodologies and DevOps concepts, particularly in a CI/CD environment
  • QA professional certifications preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver assigned work with quality and consistency
  • Experience using automation to support repeatable software testing
  • Experience creating and executing test cases for assigned features or applications
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as WebdriverIO, SmartBear, or similar platforms
  • Programming or scripting experience using TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages
  • Working knowledge of software development life cycle practices, including coding standards, code reviews, source control, build and release processes, CI/CD, and test suite maintenance

This role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation, SQL validation, and quality engineering practices to support the successful delivery of healthcare technology products. We're looking for a self-starter who can quickly learn complex applications, contribute to automation initiatives, and collaborate effectively within Agile development teams.

What You'll Do

  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.
  • Analyze requirements and user stories to develop comprehensive test coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to quality engineering best practices.
  • Monitor test results, regression coverage, and quality metrics to support continuous improvement.
  • Support adoption of automation-first testing practices and emerging AI-assisted testing capabilities.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve defects.


Preferred Skills/Experience

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience testing cloud-based applications, including Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience with API testing tools such as SoapUI or Postman.
  • Experience with Jira, qTest, or similar Agile testing tools.
  • Experience with behavior-driven development tools such as Cucumber or JUnit.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled testing tools and automation practices.
  • Healthcare technology, pharmacy, revenue cycle, or healthcare software experience


Work Environment & Travel

  • Preferred location: Atlanta, GA or Las Colinas, TX.
  • Hybrid work arrangement available based on business needs.
  • Team members in the Las Colinas office may be expected to work onsite a minimum of two days per week.

descriptionHtml:
Grow With Us

Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.


Stay Awesome

Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com


A Day In The Life

The Systems Software Test Engineer contributes to developing, executing, and documenting automated tests that verify end-to-end system functionality, robustness, and reliability in accordance with approved test plans, procedures, and defined metrics. The role supports system verification through test-case development, test automation and execution, analysis of data and results, and defect tracking and investigation. Working with Systems Test, Systems Engineering, Development, Test Tools, and Quality teams, the engineer contributes to verification and automation initiatives, supports CI/CD test workflows, and builds an understanding of system architecture and interfaces to support evaluation of the impact of software changes across the system.

Software Test Engineer 1's at Tandem are also responsible for:

  • Collaborates with Systems Test and Systems Engineering to review product requirements, feature designs, system robustness and reliability metrics, and system configurations, and develops test cases for system verification with appropriate guidance.
  • Develops and maintains automated test suites using established test automation frameworks and approved verification procedures.
  • Executes and monitors automated test suites through CI/CD pipelines; reviews test results, metrics, logs, and artifacts; investigates failures using established procedures; and escalates suspected product defects.
  • Participates in automation code reviews and follows established source control, branching, and documentation practices.
  • Stays current with industry trends and best practices in software testing and automation.
  • Assists development engineers in the diagnosis and replication of product failures.
  • Efficiently manages own time to complete work by assigned completion dates.
  • Records and compiles data for documentation of test procedures and prepares reports.
  • Assists with estimating test effort for project deliverables.

Job Description

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will be responsible for advancing software quality across the Post Production Automation platform through a combination of manual validation, test automation, performance testing, and quality engineering practices. The role will partner closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, and operational teams to improve test coverage, shorten feedback loops, and establish repeatable quality practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, performance, and regression tests for the Post Production Automation platform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable test frameworks, fixtures, utilities, test data, and automation standards to support scalable testing.
  • Create and maintain test cases for critical user workflows, including functional, negative, regression, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to identify high-value manual validation scenarios and convert appropriate scenarios into repeatable automated tests.
  • Partner with Development early in the delivery lifecycle to review requirements and acceptance criteria for testability, completeness, business risk, adjacent workflow impact, and potential defects.
  • Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not appropriate or additional investigation is required.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and application issues to distinguish between software defects, automation defects, test data issues, and environment-related failures.
  • Support root cause analysis for significant defects and production issues and develop regression coverage to help prevent recurrence.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish practical quality gates for software delivery.
  • Develop and maintain test reporting, dashboards, and quality metrics that provide visibility into test results, coverage, defects, and application quality.
  • Ability to provide off-hours operational support, including nightly deployments and incident response.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on release readiness, deployment validation, and production issues requiring additional test coverage or defect reproduction.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve test reliability, execution time, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering practices.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in hybrid QA, SDET, Software Quality Engineering, or similar roles combining manual testing and test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with test management tools such as QMetry, TestRail, or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance test suites.
  • Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with REST API and performance testing, including analysis of application behavior under load.
  • Experience creating and maintaining reusable test cases, test data, fixtures, and regression coverage for business-critical workflows.
  • Strong systems-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to trace failures across UI, API, application services, test automation, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking skills and the ability to analyze complex problems, identify risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and converting production defects into preventative regression coverage.
  • Experience with source control management, preferably Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and software build and deployment processes.
  • Ability to read and understand application code, logs, API responses, and system behavior to support defect investigation.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration skills with experience working across Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and operational teams.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or similar iterative software development environments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Production Asset Management and Media Asset Management systems.
  • Experience mentoring developers on unit testing, testability, and quality-engineering practices.
  • Experience testing applications deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure and deployment technologies.
  • Experience testing complex integrations, asynchronous workflows, file movement, databases, messaging, and distributed application components.
  • Familiarity with observability tools, logging, monitoring, dashboards, and test reporting platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements, priorities, release schedules, and production needs.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and operational teams

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000 - $105,000

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. Job Requirements

Sweetwater, the nation’s #1 online retailer of pro audio equipment and music instruments, is seeking to hire a QA engineer to add to our growing software quality assurance team. As a QA engineer, you will be responsible for analyzing product quality of our software applications. You will be expected to independently design effective test plans for new features (including acceptance and exploratory testing methods), to set up and execute tests in a timely fashion, to collaborate with developers to resolve discovered quality issues, and to produce clear and actionable bug reports.

This role represents the final step in the iterative development process before production release and must maintain a high attention to detail in a fast-paced environment. Additionally, this role will contribute to automated testing solutions to ensure the absence of critical regression defects.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for manual and automated software QA testing
  • Coordinating ticket assignments and collaborating with QA and Web/4D & Desktop team to complete assigned tickets
  • Test and script incoming software from Development Teams
  • Identify, analyze, and document problems with program function, output, or content
  • Monitor bug resolution efforts and track successes
  • Utilize Jira for managing incoming tickets and working with a high sense of urgency to resolve software bugs
  • Write and maintain automated end-to-end testing utilizing modern frameworks such as Cypress and languages such as JavaScript & Python

Qualifications

  • Experience testing web or native applications (MacOS)
  • Proficiency in modern software QA best practices (functional and non-functional testing)
  • Effective and articulate communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail with a creative edge to discover defects under various customer personas
  • Team player with excellent collaboration skills
  • A passion for growth in learning new technologies and tools to support testing strategy
  • Knowledge of Git version-control system
  • Familiarity with agile development processes and kanban project-management workflow is preferred
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated end-to-end tests using modern frameworks such as Cypress, and languages such as JavaScript and Python
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing and WCAG standards would be a bonus
  • Familiarity with application life-cycle management tools, including CI/CD processes preferred
  • Understanding of client/server interaction and network protocols
  • Basic understanding of query languages (such as SQL) and relational database-management tools preferred
  • ISTQB Foundation Level certification would be a big plus

Sweetwater "Ideal" Team-Player

  • WOWs The Customer - Deep passion and desire for creating amazing customer & colleague experiences
  • Get Things Done - Great work ethic and moves with a sense of urgency
  • Obsesses over the Details – committed to paying attention to the details
  • Drives Continuous Improvement – Always focusing on effective and efficient work and way to get better
  • Develops the Future – committed to pursuit of growing personally & professionally and has a focus on bringing your colleagues along with you on that journey

We function best as a unified team, so relocation to our state-of-the-art campus in Fort Wayne, IN is required. Interested and qualified candidates, please apply. We look forward to exploring your #FullTimeDream with Sweetwater!

Sweetwater’s culture is built upon celebrating the creative creation of music, which unifies people from all walks of life. Our individual differences make Sweetwater stronger as a company and a better place to work as we respect, learn, and grow from each team member’s unique perspective and experience. We have welcomed thousands of employees and their families from all over the world, and we invite you to discover why we consider a career at Sweetwater the full-time dream.

descriptionHtml:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We're hiring experienced Software Engineers in Test to work on Site Vault, a rapidly growing SaaS platform product in the Life Sciences industry encompassing the fields of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.

As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing to deliver a top-quality SaaS product. This is a hands-on position playing a vital role in ensuring customer success with each new release.

If you are an experienced Quality Engineering professional ready to make an impact and take your career to the next level, we want to hear from you. In our fast-paced environment, you'll be involved in the product development process, taking pride in building great software. You'll collaborate with like-minded engineers in a high-energy setting and leverage your existing skills to learn and grow with us.

What You'll Do

  • Create testing-related documentation, including test plans, test cases/scripts, and bug reports assessing quality and associated risk
  • Automate features for better regression coverage
  • Triage and/or assist with triaging of automation results
  • Develop deep expertise in the product
  • Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines
  • Work with software engineers, product managers, and other quality engineers in an Agile team environment
  • Operate at architecture and code level, driving technical discussions during design/implementation reviews
  • Be the technical quality expert in functional areas and influencing decisions that will help build quality into the product
  • Be comfortable providing technical leadership to junior teammates, enabling them to achieve targeted goals
  • Conduct POCs and make recommendations that would help raise the quality bar
  • Enhance your knowledge of code coverage tools and metrics
  • Work with quality management to come up with new processes and roll them out across the organization
  • Become a technical contributor, a product expert, and a team project manager and support your QA manager as and when you work on the product

Requirements

  • 2+ years relevant work experience, including software development and/or software test automation
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Understanding of Software QA methodologies, tools, and approaches (black box and/or automated testing) in a software company with short release cycles
  • Experience in writing test cases and automating them, covering both sanity and in-depth testing including and not limited to boundary, negative, compatibility, and concurrency tests
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Must be located in the Eastern Time Zone.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in JavaScript, Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming language.
  • Experience with Atlassian products like Jira, Confluence
  • Experience with TestRail or similar test case management software
  • Experience authoring automated tests in standard functional test automation frameworks. e.g., Cucumber/Selenium/TestNg. Playwright is preferred.
  • Knowledge of modern best practices for software development
  • Experience in a SaaS environment that has an agile development process is a huge plus
  • Experience working with remote teams
  • Experience working in the Health Sciences and Life Sciences industry

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    • A conversation with the hiring manager
    • A practical case exercise
    • A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $75,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Senior Software Test Engineer

Why This is an Exciting Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented, self-motivated Senior Software Test Engineer with strong UI testing expertise to ensure quality and compliance during the modernization of a critical government information system. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in functional and regression testing web applications, with a focus on user interface validation, accessibility compliance, and cross-browser compatibility testing.

Strong experience with UI automation frameworks, manual testing methodologies, and defect tracking systems is essential. You will validate that all system components meet federal cybersecurity requirements and government accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG) while ensuring a seamless user experience across the modernized platform.

Experience testing enterprise applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure), performing API testing for backend services (RESTful services), and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) for automated test execution is highly valued. This role requires excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, meticulous documentation practices, and the ability to collaborate with development and security teams in a regulated environment.

Position Responsibilities:

Test Planning & Execution:


  • Perform functional and regression testing of web applications
  • Conduct user interface validation and cross-browser compatibility testing
  • Execute manual testing methodologies for complex scenarios


Compliance & Accessibility Testing:


  • Validate compliance with federal cybersecurity requirements
  • Ensure adherence to government accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG)
  • Test enterprise applications in Windows Server environments
  • Verify security controls and data protection measures
  • Ensure seamless user experience across the modernized platform


Automation & Integration:


  • Develop and maintain UI automation frameworks for regression testing
  • Perform API testing for backend services (RESTful services)
  • Integrate automated tests into GitLab CI/CD pipelines
  • Manage defect tracking systems and coordinate issue resolution


Collaboration & Documentation:


  • Collaborate with development and security teams
  • Document test results, defects, and quality metrics
  • Provide detailed analytical reports on system quality and readiness
  • Participate in and adhere to Agile software development methodology


Experience and Qualifications:

To be eligible for this demanding position, the ideal candidate should demonstrate the following experience and qualifications:

Required Education and Years of Experience:


  • 13 Years of experience in Software Test Engineering roles or a highly related field of work with similar scope and responsibilities.
  • A Bachelor’s degree may be substituted for 4 years of experience and a Master’s Degree may be substituted for 6 years of experience.


Required Qualifications:


  • TS/SCI with an in-scope CI Polygraph
  • Extensive experience in functional and regression testing of web applications
  • Strong UI testing expertise including user interface validation and cross-browser compatibility
  • Proficiency with defect tracking systems
  • Knowledge of federal cybersecurity requirements and government accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG)
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure)
  • API testing experience (RESTful services)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitLab
  • Proven experience with UI automation frameworks and manual testing methodologies


Desired Qualifications:


  • Experience in Agile development environments
  • Self-motivated with excellent analytical skills and meticulous documentation practices
  • Strong collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams in regulated environments


Telework/Remote Availability: Telework/Remote work currently not authorized

Work Location(s): Annapolis Junction, MD or Washington, DC

Please note that the information shown below is a general guideline only. Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

$149,000 - $185,700

Every day, Boeing Intelligence & Analytics supports global missions by building and delivering intelligence, analytics, and cyber solutions that enable users to advance national security. From hardware and software engineering solutions to analytics that keep this nation safe, we create value that meets users’ needs. With vibrant partnerships and innovative approaches, we serve the Intelligence Community through innovation and vision. We have provided our customers with the tools needed to counter evolve global and cyber threats, and to improve wartime decision-making.

Position Description

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows.

This role will have an emphasis on managing performance/load testing within our current K6 environment.

In addition, you will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, troubleshoot and report on performance/load testing of web sites and components using our K6 environment. It measures the throughput and resilience of thousands of printers hitting a site for the purpose of issuing credit, debit and ID cards.
  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with C# and API-testing tools such as RestSharp and Playwright.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Performance/Load testing
  • Programming experience in C#. JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Powershell.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with K6 performance testing tool
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Software Tester / Quality Assurance Engineer to support the development of Clinical Trials Research Management applications for CTIS, a CMMI Level 3 certified company. This role focuses on designing, executing, and maintaining automated test solutions within an Agile DevOps environment. You will be responsible for thorough test coverage, writing and debugging automated scripts, executing exploratory testing, and validating software functionality across the web and mobile platforms.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS (Job Requirements)


Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • Support the design, development, and testing of software products with a focus on quality engineering and automated testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases, test scripts, and test suites for web, and web service/API applications based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.

  • Maintain a basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) concepts and utilize AI-assisted development and code assistant tools, where appropriate, to improve software testing efficiency and automation effectiveness. Experience with such tools is beneficial.

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize scalable automation frameworks using technologies such as Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, REST Assured (or equivalent API automation frameworks), and support cross-browser, cross-device, parallel, and environment-agnostic test execution.

  • Design and execute automated testing for web services and APIs (REST, and SOAP), including authentication, authorization, request/response validation, contract testing, error handling, performance, and integration testing.

  • Configure and maintain automated test environments using externalized configuration, parameterization, and secure credential management to enable execution across development, test, staging, and production-like environments.

  • Integrate UI and API automation into CI/CD pipelines using Bamboo, Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies to support continuous testing and continuous delivery.

  • Perform cross-browser, cross-device, accessibility, database, and backend validation testing, including SQL query development and execution to verify data integrity and application functionality.

  • Support testing of applications deployed in Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments, including cloud-hosted applications, cloud-native services, integrations, logging, monitoring, and distributed application architectures.

  • Identify, analyze, document, and track software defects, performance bottlenecks, and integration issues using test results, application logs, and cloud monitoring tools, providing clear and actionable recommendations for resolution.

  • Collaborate effectively with software developers, DevOps engineers, cloud engineers, product owners, and QA team members to ensure high-quality software delivery and continuous process improvement.

  • Communicate test strategies, execution status, quality metrics, risks, and defects to project stakeholders and provide technical guidance and QA best practices to strengthen the organization's quality engineering capabilities.

  • May be asked to Facilitate all Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, Backlog Refinement, and Inspect and Adapt sessions.

  • May be asked to Facilitate preparation and readiness for Agile Release Train (ART) ceremonies.

  • May be asked to Coordinate release planning and readiness activities with Product Owners, development, QA, and other stakeholders to ensure successful and timely releases.

  • May be asked track release milestones, dependencies, risks, and impediments, ensuring the team remains aligned with PI objectives and release commitments.

  • May be asked to Facilitate release readiness discussions, communicate delivery status, and coordinate cross-team activities to support successful production deployments.

    •  


    COMPETENCIES


  • SAFe Agile methodologies, Agile testing practices, and Acceptance Test-Driven Development (ATDD).

  • Proficiency in test automation technologies and scripting, including Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, REST Assured (or equivalent API automation frameworks), Jira, Xray, and related quality engineering tools.

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable, environment-agnostic automation frameworks for web, mobile, and API testing using reusable, configurable, and parameterized test components.

  • Knowledge of API and web service testing, including REST, SOAP, GraphQL, authentication and authorization, contract validation, and API security testing.

  • Knowledge of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices and tools to support automated testing within modern software development lifecycles.

  • Working knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and cloud-native application testing, including cloud architecture fundamentals, microservices, containerized applications, distributed systems, cloud logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose application, integration, database, and cloud-related issues using logs, monitoring tools, and test results.

  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong commitment to software quality, customer requirements, and continuous process improvement.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional Agile, DevOps, and cloud engineering teams while effectively managing priorities and meeting commitments.

    •  


     


    PHYSICAL DEMANDS


    The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.


     


    While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. This is largely a sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.


     


    POSITION TYPE/EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK 


    This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. 






    REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • 5+ years of software testing experience, including both manual and automated testing.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in automation testing.

  • Proficiency with Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, Gherkin, Jira, Deque AXE, and Xray.

  • Strong experience with cross-browser and mobile platform testing.

  • Experience setting up, optimizing, and maintaining test automation frameworks.

  • Understanding of Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Bamboo and Bitbucket.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and take initiative in identifying automation opportunities.

  • Experience with Section 508 compliance testing and accessibility tools.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.

  • Experience developing automated test suites for REST/SOAP/GraphQL web services using REST Assured, Postman/Newman, ReadyAPI, or equivalent API automation frameworks.

  • Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and testing applications deployed in cloud environments.

  • Experience testing microservices-based and cloud-native applications.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments is preferred.

    •  


    PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Experience running continuous integration build life cycles focused on automation

  • Hands-on experience certifying that software is section 508-compliance

  • Knowledge of clinical trials and their conduct

  • Experience testing hospital management systems and/or electronic medical records

  • Experience working in a CMMI environment

  • Experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile team facilitator in a SAFe environment, including facilitating Agile/Scrum and ART ceremonies, coordinating release readiness, tracking risks and impediments, and reporting status using Jira; Agile certification (CSM, PSM, or SAFe Scrum Master) is a plus

    •  


    OTHER DUTIES


    Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

- Collaborate effectively with software developers, DevOps engineers, cloud engineers, product owners, and QA team members to ensure high-quality software delivery and continuous process improvement.

- Proficiency in test automation technologies and scripting, including Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, REST Assured (or equivalent API automation frameworks), Jira, Xray, and related quality engineering tools.

- Experience designing and implementing scalable, environment-agnostic automation frameworks for web, mobile, and API testing using reusable, configurable, and parameterized test components.

- Knowledge of API and web service testing, including REST, SOAP, GraphQL, authentication and authorization, contract validation, and API security testing.

- Knowledge of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices and tools to support automated testing within modern software development lifecycles.

- Working knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and cloud-native application testing, including cloud architecture fundamentals, microservices, containerized applications, distributed systems, cloud logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose application, integration, database, and cloud-related issues using logs, monitoring tools, and test results.

- Exceptional attention to detail with a strong commitment to software quality, customer requirements, and continuous process improvement.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional Agile, DevOps, and cloud engineering teams while effectively managing priorities and meeting commitments.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. This is largely a sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

 

POSITION TYPE/EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK 
 

 This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. 


 



REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- 5+ years of software testing experience, including both manual and automated testing.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience in automation testing.

- Proficiency with Selenium, Java, TestNG, Cucumber, Gherkin, Jira, Deque AXE, and Xray.

- Strong experience with cross-browser and mobile platform testing.

- Experience setting up, optimizing, and maintaining test automation frameworks.

- Understanding of Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD).

- Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Bamboo and Bitbucket.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and take initiative in identifying automation opportunities.

- Experience with Section 508 compliance testing and accessibility tools.

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.

- Experience developing automated test suites for REST/SOAP/GraphQL web services using REST Assured, Postman/Newman, ReadyAPI, or equivalent API automation frameworks.

- Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and testing applications deployed in cloud environments.

- Experience testing microservices-based and cloud-native applications.

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments is preferred.

 

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Experience running continuous integration build life cycles focused on automation

- Hands-on experience certifying that software is section 508-compliance

- Experience testing hospital management systems and/or electronic medical records
