descriptionHtml:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the quality of our web, desktop, and mobile products. You'll combine hands-on manual testing with building and maintaining automated test suites, working closely with developers and product managers from requirements through release. You'll also play an important part in triaging and investigating issues reported by customers and Support.

Our product suite includes an ASP.NET / Angular web platform, Windows desktop applications, backend services, and Android/iOS mobile apps. You'll work across all of them, and grow our automation from web and desktop into mobile.

This is a hybrid position. You'll be required to come into our Annapolis, Maryland office three times a week.

Duties And Responsibilities

Manual testing

  • Review requirements, specifications, and designs, and give timely, meaningful feedback.
  • Plan and run functional, exploratory, regression, integration, permission, and user acceptance testing across web, desktop, and mobile applications.
  • Write clear test plans, test cases, and checklists using appropriate test design techniques.
  • Test APIs and data: validate requests and responses with API tools and check results in the database with SQL.
  • Find, reproduce, and document defects with clear steps and evidence, and work with developers to understand the root cause and verify fixes.

Test automation

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites:
    • Web: Playwright with C#, and SmartBear Reflect, an AI-assisted test automation tool.
    • Desktop: FlaUI and Playwright for Windows desktop applications.
    • Mobile: Help evaluate and introduce Android (and potentially iOS) test automation.
  • Integrate automated tests into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and keep them reliable, fast, and maintainable.
  • Build reusable test environments and test data, e.g. virtual machine snapshots and seeded test accounts.
Release quality and testing

  • Support product releases: identify changes and risk areas, plan and run regression testing.
  • Track quality metrics, such as defect counts and automation coverage, and use them to improve the process.

Issue triage and investigation

  • Investigate root causes of customers’ issues with developers using logs, database queries, browser and API tools, and recent code changes; distinguish configuration, data, and environment issues from code defects.
  • Verify fixes and add regression tests so resolved issues stay resolved.

Collaboration and leadership

  • Work closely with developers, product managers, support, and DevOps to deliver high-quality software.
  • Mentor other QA team members, and share knowledge of products, tools, and testing practices.
  • Keep up with new testing tools, including AI-assisted testing, and continuously improve team efficiency.

Requirements

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software quality assurance experience, including at least 2 years building and maintaining automated tests.
  • Strong manual testing skills: test design, exploratory and regression testing, and reproducing and isolating defects.
  • Experience triaging and investigating reported issues, including root-cause analysis with developers.
  • Hands-on test automation experience with Playwright (C# preferred) or similar frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of C# / .NET, enough to read code, review pull requests, and write test code.
  • Strong SQL skills (SQL Server preferred) for data validation and investigation.
  • Experience testing web APIs with tools such as Postman or Swagger. Comfortable with browser developer tools (network, console).
  • Experience testing web and desktop applications. Mobile testing is a plus.
  • Solid knowledge of Jira, Confluence, a test management system (e.g. Zephyr), and Git / Azure DevOps.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and written communication skills. You write bug reports developers can act on right away.
  • A high level of ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

Nice To Haves

  • Security testing experience is preferred, e.g. authentication and authorization checks and OWASP concepts.
  • Experience with FlaUI or other Windows desktop UI automation.
  • Experience with SmartBear Reflect or other AI-assisted or low-code test tools.
  • Introduce mobile test automation for our Android apps: evaluate tools, then set up and grow a test suite, starting with Appium, on emulators and real scanner devices (e.g. Zebra, Honeywell). Experience with Espresso / UI Automator, XCUITest, or Maestro is a plus.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), virtual machines, and test environment management.
  • Familiarity with ASP.NET MVC / Web API, Angular, and multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as Datadog or Application Insights.
  • Relevant testing certifications (e.g. ISTQB).

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

About The Role

ANDOR Health is seeking an experienced QA Engineer III to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our healthcare technology solutions. This role leads quality assurance across web applications, APIs, databases, and healthcare integrations, combining hands-on testing, automation, healthcare interoperability expertise, and mentorship. You will work with Engineering, Product, Implementation, and Support to deliver software supporting critical clinical workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead QA strategy, test planning, and execution for complex features, integrations, and releases.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and cross-browser testing.
  • Validate HL7 v2.x messages, interface mappings, and EHR integration workflows.
  • Test REST APIs using Postman or similar tools; use SQL to validate data and investigate defects.
  • Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Selenium, Playwright, or similar frameworks; contribute to CI/CD integration.
  • Document and track defects in Azure DevOps or comparable tools; assess quality risks and release readiness.
  • Mentor junior engineers and strengthen QA processes, security practices, and HIPAA-aligned handling of patient data.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on software QA experience, including 3+ years in healthcare technology.
  • Experience with HL7 v2.x interfaces, web application testing, REST APIs, and SQL.
  • Hands-on API testing with Postman and test automation with Selenium, Playwright, or similar tools.
  • Scripting or programming in C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.
  • Knowledge of Agile, SDLC/STLC, and defect management tools such as Azure DevOps.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FHIR APIs; Mirth Connect or other healthcare interface engines.
  • Integration experience with Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, Meditech, or similar EHR systems.
  • CI/CD automation, virtual care or telehealth testing, mobile testing, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions.

A quality-focused engineer who takes ownership, thinks critically, and balances technical testing with collaboration, mentorship, and continuous improvement. Occasional evening or weekend support may be needed for releases, deployments, and critical issues.

Description

Software Test Engineer

Omaha, NE

No clearance required to start – Must be clearable to Secret

Ready for your next career step? Leidos has an immediate opportunity for a Software Test Engineer to help with automated testing of our state-of-the-art software solutions delivered to our government customers. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with an outstanding software engineering team and will support the team’s software deployed into our customers' classified networks. Our engineers are at the forefront of defining and building solutions to address the challenges faced by our end users, applying a go-fast, agile approach driven by small teams that rely on and value each team member's contributions.

As a Software Test Engineer, you’ll participate in planning, designing and executing end-to-end automated testing in support of the Continuous Integration (CI)/Continuous Deployment (CD) of our products to customers worldwide. You’ll identify opportunities to increase the level of automated testing of our customer products and solutions, plan and execute strategies to achieve test automation objectives, continuously measure and improve the effectiveness of that testing based on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and evaluate and integrate new testing tools, technologies, and procedures to achieve the organization’s technical objectives.

In this capacity, you’ll collaborate with engineering and product team members, architects, and other IT resources to create and execute test strategies, detailed test plans, and scenarios. You’ll always respect others' opinions, accept constructive criticism, share your views with a passion for improving the team’s performance, and collaborate openly and positively with your teammates.

Most of the work will be on site in Leidos' facility in Omaha, Nebraska. Some level of remote/work from home is possible.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain test methodology documentation for traceability and repeatability.
  • Identify regression test candidates for automation, plan automation activities across the team and automate test cases.
  • Execute test cases/scripts including functional, regression, exploratory, performance, load and smoke tests for both web applications and database.
  • Report issues in work management tool (e.g., Jira) along with steps required to re-create the issue.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning meetings, sprint reviews and sprint retrospectives.
  • Participate in all phases of risk management assessments and software development with emphasis on analysis of user requirements, test design and test tools selection.
  • Support metrics program by creating, collecting and tracking test related metrics.
  • Inform innovative solutions for more efficient testing strategy.

Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?

As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!

Join Amazon's Prime Video Ads QA team, where we ensure seamless ad delivery across millions of customers worldwide and deliver high-quality advertising experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for Prime Video Ads platform, ensuring high coverage across functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Participate in org-level quality initiatives and define QA strategy & test plans across multiple concurrent projects, collaborating with engineering, product, and data science teams.
  • Leverage AI in test automation to generate test cases, predict risk areas, detect anomalies, and accelerate defect resolution.
  • Drive shift-left testing practices by embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle, including requirements review and design validation.
  • Track quality metrics and KPIs, providing data-driven insights to stakeholders on release readiness.
  • Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively drive improvements to reduce customer-impacting defects.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed efficiently across build and deployment workflows.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Prime Video Ads team, your day involves collaborating with engineers, program and product managers to review requirements, identify risks early, and define test strategies. You'll write and review automation scripts, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and leverage AI tools to improve test coverage. You will optimize QA processes using AI adoption. You'll participate in sprint ceremonies, contribute to design reviews, and mentor junior QA engineers. You'll also partner with development teams to validate ad delivery and measurement accuracy, and present quality metrics to stakeholders to drive release readiness decisions.

About The Team

The Prime Video Ads QA team is at the forefront of ensuring seamless and high-quality advertising experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We are a passionate group of quality engineers who thrive on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our team works closely with engineering, product, and data science teams to deliver reliable and impactful advertising solutions at scale. We embrace a culture of ownership, where every team member is empowered to drive quality initiatives and make a meaningful impact. We are committed to leveraging AI tools and automation to stay ahead in a fast-paced, ever-evolving landscape.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our performance analysis squad, a team dedicated to building best-in-class tools that help coaches and analysts turn game video and data into winning insights. You'll help us build and scale the products that power film breakdowns, tagging, stats, and reporting, so every clip, metric, and playlist is accurate, fast, and reliable. In this role, you'll lead testing efforts within your squad, focusing on both prevention and efficiency so that coaches and analysts have a seamless experience, from game day through the film room.

As a QA Engineer, You’ll

  • Champion squad quality. Attend and actively voice quality focus in squad sprint scrum ceremonies, understand the core problem being solved and ensure backlog defects are prioritized.
  • Drive test strategy. Create test plans, implement squad quality best practices, use data to drive high-quality outcomes and ensure post-mortems or root cause analyses (RCAs) are created for all hotfixes.
  • Test and merge. Leverage multiple testing approaches—including automated, exploratory and manual testing—from start to finish, ensuring sub-defects are resolved and merge builds run cleanly.
  • Grow professionally. Dedicate time to your own professional development and skill-building.

Location

Time spent collaborating with other Hudlies in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently prioritizing applicants within commuting distance of Lincoln or Omaha, Nebraska. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Experienced. You have 2+ years of software testing experience and have worked in fast-paced environments with changing deadlines.
  • Technical. You have solid experience designing and executing tests across the stack, from front-end UI validation to in-depth API testing, including proven, hands-on experience and proficiency with key languages (e.g. Python, Typescript) and modern automation frameworks (e.g. Playwright, Selenium).
  • Mobile testing exposure. You have experience testing iOS or Android applications and an understanding of mobile-specific performance, UI nuances and automation using Appium, Detox, and/or React Native tooling and the associated APIs that apps rely on (protocols such as GraphQL, REST, etc.).
  • A team player. You work effectively within a global team, leading with empathy and clear communication to help your squad achieve the best outcomes.
  • Problem solver. You can navigate technical and team challenges during changing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Naturally curious. You think outside the box by exploring creative solutions to break software.
  • User-focused. You think critically about the user experience and easily relate to our users.
  • Constantly learning. You are passionate about learning and open to growth areas.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Domain experience. You’ve worked in a SaaS environment or have a background in a STEM-related field.
  • AI Tool Exposure. Curiosity and exposure to leveraging AI tools (such as LLMs, specialized coding assistants, or test data generators) to increase efficiency in documentation, test case creation, or initial failure diagnosis.
  • Agile fluency. Experience working within a Scrum framework and participating in sprint ceremonies will help you jump right in.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$51,000 - $106,000 USD

About the Role:

Join us as a Principal Software Test Engineer (Quality Assurance) and lead the charge in ensuring the quality and reliability of a revolutionary music discovery experience. You will own our quality strategy from the ground up, creating the tools, processes, and systems that enable fast, confident product development.

This role is ideal for a highly autonomous, technically deep, and strategically minded engineer who is passionate about building robust systems and scalable practices. Our product combines real-time audio, content delivery, ML-driven recommendations, and an immersive Flutter mobile experience. If you're excited by complex systems and the chance to impact the future of music technology, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead QA Strategy Across the Stack Architect and implement scalable, maintainable testing strategies across mobile, backend, and data layers.
  • Define test coverage, automation frameworks, and CI/CD integration points with long-term sustainability in mind.
  • Own Execution With High Autonomy Scope, plan, and execute major QA initiatives independently. Anticipate risks and blockers, drive technical decisions, and ensure product quality with minimal oversight.
  • Serve as QA Expert be the go-to authority on quality engineering practices for the broader organization. Advise other teams on QA approaches, tools, architecture, and represent QA in cross-functional technical discussions.
  • Support Product Innovation & Launches; Partner with engineering and product leaders to evaluate changes, support feature launches, and ensure quality at every step of the product lifecycle.
  • Integrate emerging trends and keep our test systems aligned with modern best practices.
  • Mentor and Grow Talent; Act as a technical mentor and talent ambassador. Support junior engineers, help contextualize career development opportunities, and contribute to a high-performance, high-learning culture.
  • Continuously Improve Tools & Processes Drive improvements to our automation infrastructure, test data management, and performance testing practices. Ensure quality metrics and standards are clearly defined and monitored across teams.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally, working closely with Flutter developers, backend engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists. Translate complex product and system behavior into clear, actionable quality strategies.

What You Need to Be Successful:

  • Experience: 10+ years in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on testing fully localized mobile applications that incorporate backend services, data pipelines, and recommendation systems.
  • Technical Skills: Deep understanding of modern QA methodologies, best practices, and tools, with a specific focus on testing Flutter applications, including widget testing, integration testing, regression testing, end-to-end testing, and localization testing.
  • Automation Systems: Proven ability to build and maintain robust automated test pipelines across mobile, backend, and data systems. Skilled in CI/CD integration (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Strong understanding of testing strategies for distributed systems, asynchronous event flows, APIs, mobile performance, and real-time data integrity.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to define long-term QA vision aligned with engineering and product goals and translate it into actionable plans.
  • Decision-Making & Judgment: Makes fast, effective decisions in ambiguous environments. Routinely anticipates and mitigates quality risks before they escalate.
  • Mentorship & Influence: Track record of mentoring team members, shaping team culture, and being recognized as a trusted technical voice across the organization.
  • Trend Sensitivity: Comfortable identifying and integrating industry trends into quality workflows to ensure testing infrastructure stays ahead of the curve.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Has successfully driven breakthrough ideas and quality improvements in multi-team environments.

Bonus Points if You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Passion for music and interest in shaping next-gen music products
  • Experience with recommendation systems, social products, or real-time audio streaming
  • Background testing audio software, DSP, or audio UX on mobile devices
  • Experience supporting international launches or localization-heavy products

What Makes You Eligible:

  • This is a 100% remote position
  • Must be available during typical continental U.S. business hours
  • Willingness to travel up to 5%, domestically or internationally
  • Successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment

- Remote

Pay Transparency

$ 108,750 - $ 159,500

Dependent on the position offered, other forms of compensation are also available, such as bonuses or commission.

Pay is based on a wide range of factors, including, without limitation, skill set, experience, training, location, and business need. While the above range is a reasonable estimate of the wage range for this position, please note the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographical differential associated with the location where the position may be filled.

Benefits

HARMAN is interested in the health and wellbeing of you and your family and offers a range of benefits designed to support your needs for holistic wellbeing. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with HARMAN, and may include paid vacation and holidays, paid sick leave, volunteer leave, and paid bonding and care giver leave. Employees may also be eligible to participate in comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, fertility support and adoption assistance, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan with employer match, short and long term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

descriptionHtml:
About Goosehead

Since 2003, Goosehead Insurance has been disrupting the insurance industry by giving clients the power of choice, utilizing a smarter marketing approach, and delivering world-class service. This is all powered by our focus on hiring and retaining extraordinary people. Our clients trust us with their most valuable possessions, so we’re more than just a bit selective when it comes to hiring new team members.


Job Summary

Senior Quality Assurance Engineer will play an integral role in the development of our enterprise technology platform. They will be responsible for ensuring that our software products meet and exceed quality standards through the implementation and execution of effective testing strategies. This position requires an individual with exceptional attention to detail, a commitment to product excellence, and a passion for staying ahead of the latest industry trends and technologies.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement effective testing strategies that ensure software products meet and exceed quality standards.
  • Design and implement test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Goosehead’s software products to ensure high quality, reliability and efficient test coverage.
  • Conduct functional, regression, performance, and security testing of web applications, mobile applications and APIs.
  • Perform manual and automated test execution to ensure applications meet business requirements.
  • Analyze requirements, identify gaps, and provide feedback to development teams for improvements and bug fixes.
  • Focus on early bug detection, working with developers to apply requirements analysis and the refining of acceptance criteria
  • Provide feedback to the development team on the quality of the product, and advocate for quality improvements and best practices.
  • Monitor the software development process to ensure compliance with standards, guidelines, and regulations.
  • Continuously review and improve QA processes to increase efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of product releases.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA team members.


Experience and Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks, test tools, and scripting languages such as Selenium.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Highly developed software troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Excellent bug reporting ability and experience with bug tracking system.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality software products.
  • Track and report on key quality metrics.
  • Experience with performance testing, security testing, and cross-browser/cross-platform testing.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Ability to mentor and train junior team members.
  • Stays up to date on industry trends and technologies.
  • Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery tools and practices.


Preferred Experience

  • Web and Mobile testing experience.
  • Salesforce platform testing experience.
  • Experience with writing and/or executing test Automation.
  • Experience in an Agile environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an unwavering commitment to ensuring the highest level of quality.


Required Skills and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Playwright, Selenium and AI automation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Highly developed software troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Excellent bug reporting skills and familiarity with bug tracking systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality software products.
  • Ability to track and report on key quality metrics.
  • Experience with performance testing, security testing, and cross-browser/cross-platform testing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Ability to mentor and train junior team members.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and technologies.
  • Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools and practices.
  • Strong critical thinking and an unwavering commitment to quality (preferred).


Benefits Summary

  • High-quality voluntary health, vision, disability, life, and dental insurance programs
  • 401K Matching Plan
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave
  • Corporate-sponsored programs to enhance employee physical, financial, mental, and emotional wellness
  • Financial Solution Program


Equal Employment Opportunity:

Goosehead is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, guidelines, and regulations. Goosehead strictly prohibits and does not tolerate unlawful discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered person because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, transgender status, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, uniformed service, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Throne is a fast growing Series C startup transforming local communities by delivering clean, safe, accessible restrooms to cities, transit agencies, and public spaces. With flagship customers in Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Ann Arbor, and Washington DC, and recent launches in New York City, Atlanta, and Seattle, we're rapidly scaling into new markets in 2027 and beyond.

We recognize an unspoken problem: that better bathroom accommodations are sorely needed in most cities. Public and retail bathrooms are neither positioned to meet demand, nor incentivized to provide the quality experience people deserve.

Our mission is to provide peace of mind to the millions of people who set out on an adventure on any given day. That adventure may be big or small. It may involve taking your toddler to the park, driving a stranger to the airport, running a half marathon, or exploring a new city for the first time.

About The Role

Throne is looking for a full-time Software Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to be a crucial member of the Software and R&D Engineering Teams. Thrones are proprietary technology which include mechanical components, smart plumbing, smart HVAC, various sensors, actuators, and on-board processing systems, cellular connectivity and a solar/battery driven power system. Software QA Engineer will be contributing into establishing QA/QC processes, improving time-to-market and maintaining high quality of our custom firmware and software solutions for internal Staff, and external Users and Partners.

You will work closely with Throne's extended team, consisting of start-up veterans, creative innovators, and portable sanitation experts. We are passionate about defining Throne as the reliably clean option at some of life's most stressful moments. We are ruthless about results, relentless about improvement, and we value diversity, inclusion, and having fun.

The person hired in this role will work a hybrid schedule, and will be expected to work onsite about 3 days a week from either Brentwood, MD (right outside of Washington, D.C.) or Seattle, WA (Industrial District).

  • Investigate logs, identify and localize issues on production and QA environments.
  • Provide traceability/test coverage information, contribute to the Test Plan.
  • Setup/maintain QA test environment.
  • Optimize testing, considering different contexts and different constraints, by applying various testing practices, utilizing AI and other tools for test and process automation.
  • Contribute to technical and testing documentation creation and maintenance.

We Are Looking For

  • Solid knowledge in software quality assurance with a minimum 4 years of relevant commercial experience.
  • Experience with back-end (API, database testing), web and mobile testing.
  • Understanding of cloud-based architecture and hands-on experience with AWS tools and services (e.g. Lambda, CloudWatch).
  • Understanding of specifics of micro-services and serverless architecture.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, OpenSearch, or similar).
  • Experience with test automation (JavaScript, TypeScript or Python).
  • Willingness to work in a startup lab environment in an active R&D phase.
  • Tolerance to changing requirements and priorities, and context switching between different products.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with on-site and remote teams, and explain technical concepts and issues to less tech savvy colleagues.
  • Proactiveness in giving feedback and improving existing processes.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools for test case generation, log analysis, or automation (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Testim, or similar).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Awareness of security testing fundamentals and/or accessibility standards (WCAG) is a plus.
  • Experience with performance testing is a plus.
  • Experience with testing of IoT and hardware products is a plus.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with medical options that are 100% employer-paid
  • Equity for all US-based positions, so you share in Throne's growth
  • Daily access to earned wages
  • 401(k) plan
  • Paid time off that grows with tenure, in addition to paid sick time and paid parental leave
  • Life insurance, AD&D coverage, and short and long-term disability insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits offered to full-time and part-time employees may vary by State.

l'he QA Tester is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web-based, desktop, and enterprise applications through manual and automated testing. This role works closely with developers, business analysts, and product owners to validate functional requirements, identify defects early, and support continuous delivery through test automation and Cl/CD pipelines.

Scope Of Role And Responsabilities

  • Analyze business and technical requirements to develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenanos
  • Execute functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing across web, desktop, and enterprise applications
  • Perform manual testing for desktop workflows and scenarios where automation is not feasible
  • Validate user interfaces, business logic, and backend data
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using automation tools
  • Identify and prioritize test cases suitable for automation
  • Execute automated test suites through Cl/CD pipelines and scheduled runs
  • Identify, document, track, and retest defects across web and desktop environments
  • Collaborate with development teams to analyze root cause and validate fixes
  • Ensure defects are resolved and verified prior to release
  • Support Cl/CD pipelines by integrating and executing automated tests
  • Monitor pipeline results and troubleshoot automation or environment failures
  • Perform release and post-deployment validation
  • Create and maintain test data for manual and automated testing
  • Validate and manage test environments for desktop and web applications
  • Coordinate testing across DEV, QA, and UAT environments


Required Education, Training And Profesional Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience
  • 3-6 years of experience in software quality assurance and testing or;
  • A satisfactory equivalent combination of training, education, and experience.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills
  • Experience testing web, mobile, and desktop applications
  • API testing experience (REST services, KeyRunner)
  • Strong knowledge of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies
  • Knowledge of object oriented programming concepts, including experience working with C# or comparable programming languages
  • Hands-on experience with test automation, manual testing, and defect tracking tools
  • Experience using automated testing tools to design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web based applications
  • Knowledge of established test automation design patterns, including the Page Object Model (POM)
  • Ability to identify and create reliable test locators, including dynamic XPath and CSS selectors, to support stable and maintainable automated test scripts
  • Ability to perform data validation to verify accuracy, completeness, and consistency of application data
  • Knowledge of relational databases, including the ability to write and execute basic to intermediate SQL queries for testing and validation purposes
  • Healthcare, insurance, or enterprise system experience a plus
  • Experience testing Salesforce or CRM applications a plus
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps or Jenkins a plus
  • Knowledge of cloud computing fundamentals, including familiarity with Microsoft Azure, a plus
  • General knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts and terminology as they relate to modern software technologies
  • General familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and their fundamental operating principles
  • Awareness of how AI-based tools and technologies may be applied to support software testing and test automation activities


Professional Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail across multiple platforms
  • Ability to manage multiple testing priorities independently
  • Proactive and quality-focused mindset
  • Effective communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Integrity and Trust
  • Customer Focus
  • Functional/Technical skills
  • Written/Oral Communication

Alarm.com is seeking a Quality Engineer with an interest in Software Development in Test (SDET) to join our Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will support the quality, performance, and reliability of our web and mobile applications through a combination of manual testing, test automation, and modern quality practices.

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Engineering, UX Design, DevOps, and Support while learning how quality is built into Alarm.com products throughout the development lifecycle. The ideal candidate has 0–1 years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, internships, or academic projects; is eager to grow automation skills; and is curious about emerging tools and techniques—including AI‑assisted testing solutions—to improve test coverage and efficiency.

This role is well‑suited for a motivated engineer at the start of their career who enjoys learning, collaborating with others, and developing a strong foundation in quality engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Learn and develop an understanding of Alarm.com’s products, customer workflows, and system architecture.
  • Execute manual test cases, identify and document defects, and help track issues through resolution and verification.
  • Assist in the development, execution, and maintenance of automated UI and API tests with guidance from more experienced team members.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Software Engineers to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected behavior.
  • Participate in design and technical discussions to learn about testability, quality, and automation best practices.
  • Help maintain test frameworks, tools, test data, and test environments.
  • Support issue investigation by reviewing logs, validating data, and learning to read and understand code.
  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, and sanity testing to support releases.
  • Learn how automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows.
  • Gain exposure to AI‑assisted testing tools and techniques as part of continuous improvement and skill development.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 0–1 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, internships, co‑ops, or relevant academic projects.
  • Basic programming or scripting experience in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
  • Foundational understanding of software testing concepts such as functional and regression testing.
  • Exposure to UI or API test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman) through coursework, projects, or internships.
  • Basic familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship, academic, or personal project experience related to QA, automation, or software development.
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL or data validation concepts.
  • Interest in test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and modern quality engineering practices.
  • Curiosity about AI‑driven or intelligent testing tools and how they can support software quality.

  • Focus on fun: Alarm.com places high value on our team culture. We even have a committee dedicated to hosting a stand-out holiday party, happy hours, and other fun corporate events.


Company Info

Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 6 million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. And every day, we’re innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more. Alarm.com earned the Top Workplace™ award for our employee culture and the meaningful work we do to give property owners peace of mind, help them conserve energy and water, and stay connected to loved ones. We’re seeking those who are passionate about creating change through technology and who want to make a lasting impact on the world around them.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com.

If you are interested in working with Alarm.com, please email your company information and standard agreement to RecruitingPartnerships@Alarm.com.

Position Summary

GreatAmerica Financial Services is a highly successful entrepreneurial company providing equipment financing to businesses across the United States. Our exemplary customer service, principle-centered business philosophy, and team-based operating approach are crucial to our success and growth.

GreatAmerica operates with cross-functional product teams, empowering individuals to make well-informed decisions that support both the company and its customers. There is no doubt that we are building the greatest company of its kind, offering the finest products and services available anywhere. When you are part of the GreatAmerica team, you are part of the future, part of an opportunity to gain experience professionally and to reach your potential while enjoying your work.

We are seeking a Senior QA Performance Tester with deep expertise to lead performance engineering initiatives for enterprise-scale applications. The ideal candidate will design, execute, and optimize performance test strategies, mentor team members, and drive continuous improvement in our QA processes. If you have experience in quality roles, enjoy performing an integral role in large-scale transformative projects, and you are a collaborative and assistive team member who champions all things quality, this may be for you. You will support our Product Teams with design, creation, and executing performance tests on our various platforms. You will be responsible for designing and executing load and stress tests for business-critical processes, reporting issues, and sharing results.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, You Will

  • Define, develop, and maintain comprehensive performance test plans and automated scripts to validate system scalability and reliability.
  • Lead execution of performance, load, stress, and endurance testing for critical business scenarios, including SaaS Platforms, web applications, APIs, microservices, and full application workflows.
  • Analyze test results, interpret key metrics, and produce detailed reports with actionable insights for stakeholders.
  • Identify and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks across application tiers—frontend, middleware, and database—using advanced diagnostic techniques and performance monitoring strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with development, architecture, and QA teams to resolve defects and optimize system performance for stability and efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with established QA governance frameworks, supporting regression, functional, integration, and user acceptance testing as required.
  • Mentor junior testers, provide constructive feedback, and lead knowledge-sharing sessions to elevate team capabilities.
  • Communicate test status, risks, and recommendations clearly and proactively to management and teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging performance testing tools, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to define performance benchmarks, SLAs, and capacity planning strategies for critical applications.
  • Contribute to architectural reviews and provide input on scalability and reliability considerations during design phases.

Education

To be successful in this role you will need:

  • Bachelor’s degree required

Experience

  • 5+ years’ relevant experience in software quality assurance, including designing and authoring test cases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Performance Testing
  • 5+ relevant financial services industry experience.
  • 5+ years of experiences in Tricentis NeoLoad, APM tools, CI/CD integration.
  • 3+ years of experience with scripting language
  • Strong analytical skills and detailed orientation
  • High level understanding of system architecture
  • Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies and QA lifecycle.

Computer Skills

  • Experience with core software applications (Salesforce, Open Finance Platform, FiServ) is desirable.
  • Expert knowledge of MS Office products and Design & Development best practices preferred.

Financial Benefits

Sharing rewards is an integral part of our culture. We believe in the value of hard work and reward our employees beyond the paycheck. Our total rewards package is based on eligibility and includes:

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Monthly Bonuses for Eligible Employees
  • 401(k) and Company Match
  • Annual Profit Sharing
  • Paid Time Off

Health, Wellbeing, And Family Planning Benefits

  • Paid Vacation
  • Paid Sick Days
  • Paid Holidays
  • Gym Reimbursement
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Parental Leave

Education And Career Planning Benefits

  • Tuition Assistance
  • Networking Opportunities
  • Leadership Development Opportunities

Perks

  • Paid Parking
  • Service Awards
  • Hybrid work arrangements
  • Business casual environment
  • A strong organizational culture focused on our greatest asset: you!

Rockwell is looking for a Senior Software Test Engineer to join an agile team. This team is building and validating FactoryTalk Optix, a modern industrial visualization and HMI platform. The platform is used by customers to design, deploy, and maintain applications for manufacturing environments.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Test Engineer will help ensure the quality of FactoryTalk Optix by creating and executing manual and automated tests for new and existing product functionality. This role will work closely with product owners, developers, and other test engineers to understand requirements, validate features, reproduce and document defects, and support regression and release testing activities. The scope of work is focused on developing solid test engineering practices, learning the product and industrial automation domain, and contributing to a high-quality customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and execute manual and automated tests for FactoryTalk Optix features.
  • Validate design-time and runtime workflows to help ensure a reliable customer experience.
  • Lead test planning, estimation, execution, and defect triage as part of an Agile team.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects with clear titles, descriptions, steps, and supporting details.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other test engineers to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support regression, release, and exploratory testing activities.
  • Contribute to test documentation, quality procedures, and continuous improvement of test practices.
  • Use tools such as JIRA, QTest, Confluence, GitHub, and Jenkins to support testing and quality tracking.
  • Learn FT Optix product functionality and relevant industrial automation concepts over time.
  • Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams.

The Essentials - You Will Have

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

  • Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of experience in software testing, software development, test automation, or a related technical role.
  • Experience creating, executing, and documenting manual or automated test cases.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated tests using Python, C#, or similar programming or scripting languages.
  • Experience with Squish and Selenium test frameworks
  • Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Linux
  • Experience with C# scripting
  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, JIRA, Confluence, or QTest.
  • Exposure to performance, reliability, longevity, or regression testing.
  • Experience with industrial automation, HMI software, PLCs, and protocols such as CIP or OP-CUA

What We Offer

  • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401k
  • Paid Time off
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

Position: Automation Engineer - QA Test Automation

As an Automation Engineer on the QA team, the candidate will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining reliable automated test suites for complex enterprise financial aid applications across desktop and web platforms. This role blends hands-on automation scripting with strong quality-engineering judgment — translating business requirements and acceptance criteria into complete, repeatable, and maintainable automated coverage — while ensuring high-quality delivery within established release timelines. The engineer will also update and extend existing automation scripts each release cycle, produce clear test documentation and result reports, and help triage and report defects. Strong collaboration with QA colleagues, developers, business analysts, and cross-functional technology teams is essential.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on automation engineer with strong scripting craft and a genuine passion for quality, paired with solid experience automating enterprise applications that rely on SQL Server, structured data files, and integrations with external systems. They are comfortable working independently in established enterprise environments, supporting the move from legacy desktop to web, and delivering well-structured, dependable, production-ready automation with minimal ramp-up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated regression and functional test suites for desktop and web applications
  • Update and extend automation scripts each release cycle to reflect new features, changed behavior, and evolving requirements
  • Build data-driven tests that cover multiple data-creation and import paths and multiple academic/award years
  • Create and manage test data using SQL Server queries and XML or other structured data files
  • Run tests across browsers and devices, and analyze failures to separate product defects from script or environment issues
  • Participate in sprint planning and estimation, and provide effort and story-point input for automation work
  • Review user stories and acceptance criteria, and flag gaps, ambiguities, or missing scenarios before test development
  • Report results, defects, and quality risks clearly to the QA Manager, developers, and stakeholders
  • Contribute to automation standards, reusable libraries, and documentation that improve team efficiency

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–6+ years of professional experience in software test automation or QA engineering, with hands-on ownership of automation frameworks
  • Strong proficiency in Python, C# and XML scripting for test automation, with clean, maintainable, reusable code
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining UI test automation using Playwright (or comparable tools such as Selenium) for web applications
  • Experience automating Windows desktop applications using tools such as pywinauto, WinAppDriver, FlaUI, or similar
  • Experience logging, tracking, and reporting defects and test results using a defect or test management tool (e.g., Jira)
  • Experience with cross-browser and cross-device test execution platforms (e.g., BrowserStack) and diagnosing environment-specific failures
  • Solid working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, including writing T-SQL queries to set up, validate, and clean up test data
  • Experience with XML and structured data files, including generating and validating files for import/export and integration testing
  • Experience testing and automating RESTful APIs, and validating integrations between internal and external systems
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), QA methodologies, and test design techniques (regression, functional, integration, data-driven)
  • Ability to analyze requirements and acceptance criteria, identify gaps, and translate them into complete, well-structured automated test coverage
  • Skill in debugging flaky or failing tests, performing root-cause analysis, and clearly reporting defects to development teams
  • Working knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA) and an ability to include accessibility checks in automated test suites
  • Mentor QA engineers on automation best practices

Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing data-driven automation that covers multiple record-creation paths (e.g., manual entry, file import, API) and multiple academic/award years
  • Experience with Excel-based test artifacts (e.g., openpyxl) for test data generation and reporting
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, automated test execution in build and release processes, and source control systems such as Git
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint-based release cycles
  • Experience supporting the migration or modernization of legacy desktop applications to web, including re-baselining automation suites
  • Experience with performance, load, or security testing tools
  • Familiarity with automated accessibility tools and assistive technology testing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain test results and quality risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Provide guidance to QA engineers in automated testing best practices.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

The QA Engineer will develop and execute testing strategies to ensure the reliability, functionality, performance, and security of enterprise data platform services, applications, and customer-facing capabilities.

This position will work with engineering, product, and customer enablement teams to validate new functionality, verify system integrations, and support the delivery of production-ready solutions that meet Government-approved requirements and acceptance criteria.

Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, and automated testing frameworks for Summit platform services, applications, integrations, and customer-facing functionality.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing to verify that solutions meet documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute automated tests for application programming interfaces (APIs), data services, user interfaces, and platform workflows.
  • Validate system integrations and data exchanges across Microsoft Azure services, Azure Databricks, and other Summit platform components.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and product teams to identify test requirements, establish acceptance criteria, and incorporate testing throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Execute performance, scalability, and reliability testing to identify potential issues before production deployment.
  • Document defects, assess severity and operational impact, and coordinate resolution and retesting with responsible technical teams.
  • Support release readiness assessments by verifying test coverage, documenting results, and identifying unresolved defects and associated risks.
  • Integrate automated testing into Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to support consistent validation of application and platform changes.
  • Verify that implemented solutions comply with applicable Government-approved technical, security, accessibility, and operational requirements.
  • Develop and maintain testing documentation, including test procedures, traceability records, defect reports, and test execution summaries.
  • Analyze recurring defects and testing trends to recommend improvements to development practices, test coverage, and overall solution quality.


Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Five or more years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test engineering, or automated software testing.
  • Experience developing and executing functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end test cases for enterprise applications or platforms.
  • Hands-on experience developing automated tests using Python, JavaScript, or comparable programming languages.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as pytest, Selenium, Playwright, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience testing APIs, web applications, and integrated enterprise systems.
  • Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL) for validating application data, system integrations, and test results.
  • Experience using defect tracking and test management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based applications, distributed systems, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience supporting Agile development teams and incorporating testing into CI/CD workflows.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.
  • The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting VA or other federal agency information technology modernization initiatives.
  • Experience testing solutions deployed within Microsoft Azure Government cloud environments.
  • Experience validating Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or other enterprise data platform services.
  • Experience conducting automated performance and load testing using tools such as JMeter, Locust, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience testing role-based access controls, authentication workflows, and other security-sensitive application functionality.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements and experience conducting accessibility testing for federal applications.
  • Experience working with sensitive healthcare data and federal privacy and security requirements.
  • International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) certification or comparable software testing credential.


Benefits (including but not limited to):

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Optional FSA
  • Paid parental leave
  • Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
  • Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
  • No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
  • Pet insurance
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend
  • Tuition and training reimbursement

Description

Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

As a member of the SMGS Planning Tools team, you will shape the AWS business's direction as a whole. You will build greenfield solutions from the ground up while using native AWS services and frameworks. The right candidate will have a robust system delivery background, well-rounded technical knowledge, and demonstrated experience working on large scale projects. The candidate must be customer-obsessed, have strong analytical and communication skills, and passionate about learning new technologies.

You will work with software development engineers to understand features and technical implementation. You will also work with groups such as product management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will develop automated tests to help fasten testing cycles and release faster to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features.

This position may be based in Seattle (WA), Dallas (TX), or Herndon (VA). Relocation offered for US residents only.

Key job responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy: Developing comprehensive test plans and strategies based on project requirements, ensuring all aspects of the application are covered.

Test Case Development: Designing, writing, and maintaining detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases.

Test Execution: Executing test cases (both manual and automated) and ensuring software quality across various stages of the software development lifecycle.

Defect Identification and Reporting: Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using bug tracking tools, and working closely with the development team to resolve them.

Automation Development: Writing and maintaining automated test scripts using appropriate tools and frameworks to increase test coverage and efficiency.

Continuous Improvement: Continuously identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance the testing process and improve product quality.

Collaboration and Communication: Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to ensure quality standards are met.

Performance and Load Testing: Conducting performance, scalability, and load testing to ensure the application can handle the expected load.

Test Environment Management: Setting up, maintaining, and managing test environments to ensure they reflect production environments as closely as possible.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Assessing risks associated with releases and working on strategies to mitigate them, ensuring minimal impact on production environments.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
