descriptionHtml:
Who We Are…

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. Verra Mobility Commercial Services creates smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for more than 8.5 million vehicles. Verra Mobility is a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year through connectivity with more than 50 individual tolling authorities and more than 400 issuing authorities. Arizona-based Verra Mobility Corp. currently operates in 15 countries and in 22 languages.

The company is constantly looking toward the future, ensuring it creates relevant solutions today that will work tomorrow. Seeking to understand new customers, regions, and businesses that will shape tomorrow’s smart mobility experiences, Verra Mobility strives to ensure more people around the world reach their destination safely and easily. Keeping its core principles front and center, Verra Mobility is fueled by relationships, driven by impact, guided by what’s right, and energized by what’s next.

Culture

Verra Mobility Corporation is a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial company that operates with a people-first philosophy and approach. The company lives by its core values—Do What’s Right, Lead with Grace, Win Together, and Own It—in everything it does for its customers and team members. The company seeks to grow aggressively, both organically and through acquisition, to continue to be the undisputed market leader with these five core competencies: bias for action, customer focus, teamwork, drive for results, and commitment to excellence.

Position Overview

Verra Mobility is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure end-to-end quality of modern cloud-based and legacy enterprise applications through a combination of test design, manual testing, exploratory testing, and automated testing. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, TypeScript, C#, API testing, microservices testing, and micro frontends testing. This role requires the ability to analyze requirements, design comprehensive test scenarios and test cases, determine what should be automated versus manually tested, execute hands-on testing when appropriate, leverage AI-assisted testing/code-generation tools, and mentor other testers.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and system integrations to identify test scenarios, risks, dependencies, and coverage needs.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test data, traceability, and regression test suites covering positive, negative, boundary, exception, integration, and end-to-end business scenarios.
  • Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, integration, regression, end-to-end, and production-validation testing where manual testing provides appropriate value.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Tech Leads, Developers, Architects, and QA team members early in the SDLC to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, architecture, integrations, risks, and testability.
  • Determine the appropriate testing approach for each capability, including what should be automated, what should remain manual, and the appropriate testing layer.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, and end-to-end tests using Playwright, Selenium, TypeScript, and related technologies.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable automation frameworks, components, fixtures, utilities, and test-data capabilities using sound software engineering principles.
  • Test modern applications built with React, micro frontends, C#/.NET APIs, microservices, and cloud technologies, as well as legacy applications built with .NET Framework and ASP.NET.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish appropriate quality gates and automated feedback during development and deployment.
  • Design automation that supports parallel execution, cross-browser testing, test-data management, environment configuration, retries where appropriate, and reliable unattended execution.
  • Analyze escaped production defects and recurring issues to identify requirements gaps, test coverage gaps, automation opportunities, and preventive improvements.
  • Effectively use generative AI/code-generation tools for requirement analysis, test scenario/test-case generation, automation development, test-data generation, debugging, defect analysis, documentation, and automation code review, while validating AI-generated outputs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of software testing/quality engineering experience, including significant hands-on automation experience.
  • Proven ability to independently analyze requirements and create comprehensive, high-quality test scenarios and test cases.
  • Strong hands-on experience performing both manual/exploratory testing and automated testing.
  • Experience testing modern applications involving React, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud technologies.
  • Excellent communication (written & verbal), knowledge sharing, analytical, debugging, problem-solving, collaboration, and ownership skills.
  • Experience within team environments and Agile project methodologies is a must.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, TypeScript/JavaScript, reusable automation frameworks, test fixtures, assertions, test-data management, parallel execution, and cross-browser testing.
  • Strong ability to analyze requirements and independently create and execute functional, exploratory, regression, integration, negative, boundary, exception, and end-to-end test scenarios and test cases.
  • Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON/HTTP services, microservices, backend integrations, databases, and asynchronous/event-driven workflows.
  • Working knowledge of C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, React, microservices, micro frontends, REST APIs, and legacy .NET Framework/ASP.NET applications.
  • Strong SQL/SQL Server skills for test-data preparation, backend validation, reconciliation, and defect investigation.
  • Ability to develop maintainable automation using SOLID principles, object-oriented concepts, separation of concerns, reusable components, clean code, and appropriate design patterns.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, and CI/CD technologies such as Azure DevOps, including automated execution, pipelines, environments, reporting, logging, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong knowledge of risk-based testing, test pyramid, shift-left testing, regression strategy, defect management, root-cause analysis, traceability, test coverage, release readiness, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Strong ability to leverage generative AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, test design, automation development, test-data generation, debugging, code review, and documentation without compromising engineering judgment or quality.

Aligned With Verra Mobility Values

  • Do What’s Right – We’re committed to doing the right thing for each other and for our customers – integrity is our DNA.
  • Lead With Grace – We embrace the importance of our colleagues and customers and always treat them with kindness and grace.
  • Own It – We foster a culture of accountability and excellence, where going the extra mile is standard practice.
  • Win Together – We are ambitious and like to win, but we know we win more when we include others and work together.

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.

Verra Mobility is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure end-to-end quality of modern cloud-based and legacy enterprise applications through a combination of test design, manual testing, exploratory testing, and automated testing. - Strong hands-on experience performing both manual/exploratory testing and automated testing.
- Experience testing modern applications involving React, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud technologies.
- Excellent communication (written & verbal), knowledge sharing, analytical, debugging, problem-solving, collaboration, and ownership skills.
- Experience within team environments and Agile project methodologies is a must.

- Strong hands-on expertise with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, TypeScript/JavaScript, reusable automation frameworks, test fixtures, assertions, test-data management, parallel execution, and cross-browser testing.
- Strong ability to analyze requirements and independently create and execute functional, exploratory, regression, integration, negative, boundary, exception, and end-to-end test scenarios and test cases.
- Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON/HTTP services, microservices, backend integrations, databases, and asynchronous/event-driven workflows.
- Working knowledge of C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, React, microservices, micro frontends, REST APIs, and legacy .NET Framework/ASP.NET applications.

- Ability to develop maintainable automation using SOLID principles, object-oriented concepts, separation of concerns, reusable components, clean code, and appropriate design patterns.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Automation & Testing Execution: Design, write, and maintain robust automated test suites while creating targeted manual test cases for features requiring hands-on validation.
  • Agile Requirements Refinement: Active participation in story grooming and refinement sessions to clarify acceptance criteria, spot edge cases early, and ensure testability.
  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

Description

Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

As a member of the SMGS Planning Tools team, you will shape the AWS business's direction as a whole. You will build greenfield solutions from the ground up while using native AWS services and frameworks. The right candidate will have a robust system delivery background, well-rounded technical knowledge, and demonstrated experience working on large scale projects. The candidate must be customer-obsessed, have strong analytical and communication skills, and passionate about learning new technologies.

You will work with software development engineers to understand features and technical implementation. You will also work with groups such as product management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will develop automated tests to help fasten testing cycles and release faster to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features.

This position may be based in Seattle (WA), Dallas (TX), or Herndon (VA). Relocation offered for US residents only.

Key job responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy: Developing comprehensive test plans and strategies based on project requirements, ensuring all aspects of the application are covered.

Test Case Development: Designing, writing, and maintaining detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases.

Test Execution: Executing test cases (both manual and automated) and ensuring software quality across various stages of the software development lifecycle.

Defect Identification and Reporting: Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using bug tracking tools, and working closely with the development team to resolve them.

Automation Development: Writing and maintaining automated test scripts using appropriate tools and frameworks to increase test coverage and efficiency.

Continuous Improvement: Continuously identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance the testing process and improve product quality.

Collaboration and Communication: Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to ensure quality standards are met.

Performance and Load Testing: Conducting performance, scalability, and load testing to ensure the application can handle the expected load.

Test Environment Management: Setting up, maintaining, and managing test environments to ensure they reflect production environments as closely as possible.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Assessing risks associated with releases and working on strategies to mitigate them, ensuring minimal impact on production environments.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Flexjet is currently seeking a QA Automation Engineer. The QA Automation Engineer analyzes the functionality of applications and designs automated tests to validate their performance and reliability. Completes development, execution, and documentation of test plans and scripts. Assists non-QA resources in the planning and execution of user acceptance testing.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain, design, and implement test automation frameworks for a continuous integration and execution model.
  • Create and design the testing approach (Unit, Functional, Integration, System, User).
  • Create automation tests by analyzing user stories, acceptance criteria, creating initial test designs, writing scripts, installing the automation testing tools, and reporting results.
  • Develop a repeatable process for designing, developing, and executing scripts.
  • Conduct tests, document, and analyze test results, and present findings to development teams.
  • Preparing reports on all aspects related to software testing.
  • Participating in project meetings including Agile/Scrum grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and daily stand-ups.
  • Collaborate within an agile software development process with software engineers, subject matter experts and stakeholders.

Education & Experience

  • Understanding and knowledge of software engineering concepts and methodologies.
  • Understanding of test cases and negative, positive and regression testing.
  • Understanding of automation testing and experience writing automation tests for REST APIs and UI.
  • Experience with writing automation tests using one or more of the following: Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, ect.
  • Extremely proficient in one or more development languages (i.e. C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry best practices for manual, automation and performance testing.
  • Experience with deployments and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience gathering, refining, and validating business/technical requirements, interdependencies, cross-functional dependencies & risks/issues.
  • Knowledge of application functions, bug fixing, and testing practices.
  • Experience with system/platform integrations and the ability to work cross-functionally.
  • Shows initiative and is motivated to learn.
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written); ability to communicate technical information to non-technical people.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration and consultative skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and committed to a high level of accuracy & quality.

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

About the Role:

As a Software Test Automation Engineer, you will perform a wider range of testing tasks with greater autonomy. You will help design test cases, execute them, and report on their effectiveness. Your contributions will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality software solutions, making you an invaluable team member in our quality assurance efforts.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement automated test cases based on software requirements.
  • Execute and analyze automated test results, logging defects as necessary.
  • Collaborate with developers and QA team members to refine testing strategies.
  • Maintain and update existing test scripts for improved accuracy and coverage.
  • Assist in integrating automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline.
  • Participate in test case reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Conduct basic performance and load testing activities.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of automation issues.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of test plans and test cases.
  • Provide input on improving test automation frameworks and tools.


Skills:

  • Intermediate Programming: Proficient in programming languages like Java or Python.
  • Test Automation Frameworks: Knowledgeable in frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, or JUnit.
  • CI/CD Integration: Understanding of integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins).
  • Performance Testing: Basic skills in conducting performance tests.
  • Defect Management: Effective use of bug tracking and management tools (e.g., JIRA).
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyze and interpret test results.
  • Communication: Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Team Collaboration: Proven ability to work well in team settings.


Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

Description

About Us

Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

TP-Link is seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Cloud Web Platforms Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality of TP-Link's global websites, web applications, and AI-powered customer experiences, which reach millions of users across dozens of countries and languages.

You will drive quality throughout the development lifecycle—from reviewing requirements and identifying risks to designing tests, expanding automation coverage, investigating failures, and supporting release decisions. The work ranges from product pages and content-management platforms to AI-powered search and support assistants. You also have the opportunity to contribute to testing the cloud services and APIs behind these experiences. Throughout, you'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, designers, and senior quality engineers.

This role is ideal for a quality engineer who enjoys both breadth and depth: someone comfortable moving between browser-based UI testing, backend API validation, and automation, and who wants to grow expertise across web and cloud technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Develop risk-based test strategies and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for websites, web applications, content-management systems, APIs, and supporting cloud services.
  • Participate in requirements reviews and design discussions to clarify acceptance criteria, identify risks early, and improve product testability.
  • Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript and frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent tools. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Validate backend APIs, service integrations, database behavior, and data integrity using API tools, code-based test frameworks, and SQL.
  • Investigate failures and isolate root causes using browser developer tools, network traces, application logs, system telemetry, and database queries.
  • Perform release validation across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, including responsive UI, visual regression, functional, and end-to-end testing to ensure seamless product rollouts.
  • Conduct web performance, load, and accessibility testing, monitoring metrics like Core Web Vitals and ensuring compliance with WCAG guidelines.
  • Produce clear test reports, defect analyses, and go/no-go risk assessments to support release decisions.
  • Advocate for QA best practices, test-code quality, and continuous improvement, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in software quality engineering, with significant experience testing web applications.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, using browser developer tools to inspect network requests, console errors, and page behavior.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated UI and API tests in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs with tools such as Postman or code-based test frameworks, and validating data using SQL.
  • Working knowledge of how websites are built and delivered, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP, redirects, caching, and content-management systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain quality risks and test results clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning quality for a web product, website migration, or CMS platform from planning through release.
  • Experience testing SEO elements, structured data (Schema.org), analytics and tag implementations, or localized content across many locales.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features such as chatbots, search, or recommendations, including approaches for evaluating non-deterministic output.
  • Experience with web performance and accessibility testing tools such as Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or axe.
  • Experience testing applications deployed on AWS or other public cloud platforms, or backend services built on microservices.
  • Familiarity with visual regression testing tools such as Percy, Applitools, or Chromatic.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted testing solutions to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity.
  • Experience with networking products, smart home technologies, connected device ecosystems, or e-commerce websites.

Why Join TP-Link

  • Shape the quality of TP-Link’s global websites and web experiences, used by customers in over 170 countries.
  • Work across web and cloud technologies, from browser-based applications to the APIs and services behind them.
  • Help define how the team tests emerging AI-powered features such as conversational assistants and intelligent search.
  • Build scalable automation using modern frameworks and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Collaborate with talented engineering, product, and design teams across global locations.
  • Grow your career with broad ownership and visible impact on TP-Link’s next generation of web and cloud experiences.

TP-Link is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Benefits

Salary Range:

$100,000 - 130,000

Benefits:

  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
  • Contributions to 401k funds
  • Over four weeks of PTO per year
  • Bi-annual pay increases
  • Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
  • Quarterly team-building events

At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP-Link Systems Inc.

Description

About Us

Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

TP-Link is seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Cloud Web Platforms Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality of TP-Link's global websites, web applications, and AI-powered customer experiences, which reach millions of users across dozens of countries and languages.

You will drive quality throughout the development lifecycle—from reviewing requirements and identifying risks to designing tests, expanding automation coverage, investigating failures, and supporting release decisions. The work ranges from product pages and content-management platforms to AI-powered search and support assistants. You also have the opportunity to contribute to testing the cloud services and APIs behind these experiences. Throughout, you'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, designers, and senior quality engineers.

This role is ideal for a quality engineer who enjoys both breadth and depth: someone comfortable moving between browser-based UI testing, backend API validation, and automation, and who wants to grow expertise across web and cloud technologies.

Responsibilities



- Develop risk-based test strategies and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for websites, web applications, content-management systems, APIs, and supporting cloud services.
- Participate in requirements reviews and design discussions to clarify acceptance criteria, identify risks early, and improve product testability.
- Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript and frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent tools. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
- Validate backend APIs, service integrations, database behavior, and data integrity using API tools, code-based test frameworks, and SQL.
- Investigate failures and isolate root causes using browser developer tools, network traces, application logs, system telemetry, and database queries.
- Perform release validation across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, including responsive UI, visual regression, functional, and end-to-end testing to ensure seamless product rollouts.
- Conduct web performance, load, and accessibility testing, monitoring metrics like Core Web Vitals and ensuring compliance with WCAG guidelines.
- Produce clear test reports, defect analyses, and go/no-go risk assessments to support release decisions.
- Advocate for QA best practices, test-code quality, and continuous improvement, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity.

Required Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of experience in software quality engineering, with significant experience testing web applications.
- Solid understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.
- Hands-on experience testing web applications across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, using browser developer tools to inspect network requests, console errors, and page behavior.
- Experience developing and maintaining automated UI and API tests in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
- Experience testing RESTful APIs with tools such as Postman or code-based test frameworks, and validating data using SQL.
- Working knowledge of how websites are built and delivered, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP, redirects, caching, and content-management systems.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain quality risks and test results clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience owning quality for a web product, website migration, or CMS platform from planning through release.
- Experience testing SEO elements, structured data (Schema.org), analytics and tag implementations, or localized content across many locales.
- Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features such as chatbots, search, or recommendations, including approaches for evaluating non-deterministic output.
- Experience with web performance and accessibility testing tools such as Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or axe.
- Experience testing applications deployed on AWS or other public cloud platforms, or backend services built on microservices.
- Familiarity with visual regression testing tools such as Percy, Applitools, or Chromatic.
- Experience leveraging AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted testing solutions to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity.
- Experience with networking products, smart home technologies, connected device ecosystems, or e-commerce websites.

Why Join TP-Link



- Shape the quality of TP-Link’s global websites and web experiences, used by customers in over 170 countries.
- Work across web and cloud technologies, from browser-based applications to the APIs and services behind them.
- Help define how the team tests emerging AI-powered features such as conversational assistants and intelligent search.
- Build scalable automation using modern frameworks and AI-assisted engineering tools.
- Collaborate with talented engineering, product, and design teams across global locations.
- Grow your career with broad ownership and visible impact on TP-Link’s next generation of web and cloud experiences.

TP-Link is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Benefits

Salary Range: 

$100,000 - 130,000

Benefits:



- Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
- Contributions to 401k funds
- Over four weeks of PTO per year
- Bi-annual pay increases
- Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
- Quarterly team-building events

At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP-Link Systems Inc.

Please, no third-party agency inquiries, and we are unable to offer visa sponsorships at this time.

Responsibilities

This role is on site 5 days/week in Madison.

  • Work with the QA Lead to develop test documentation, conduct system testing, and secure, organize, and maintain the test environment.

  • Collaborate with local and remote Software Development teams to support testing efforts and gain exposure to cross-functional project work.

  • Follow established site and corporate policies and procedures while assisting in the creation and maintenance of QA procedures, installation procedures, test plans, test cases, and checklists.
  • Conduct routine data research and analysis to support testing activities, issue investigation, and operational decision-making under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Maintain regular communication with Software Development, Operations, and QA team members to ensure alignment on testing objectives and project status.
  • Participate in day-to-day interactions with local site customers and stakeholders, developing an understanding of customer needs and expectations.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to learn, ask questions, accept feedback, and continuously develop QA and technical skills through mentorship from the QA Lead and hands-on experience.
  • Assist the QA Lead with the implementation of software releases into production environments, verifying that all deployments are executed according to approved installation procedures and successfully tested release packages.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent or 3-5 years related experience.
  • Basic understanding of software quality assurance concepts, testing principles, and software development life cycles.
  • Knowledge of test planning, test case creation, test execution, and defect reporting gained through coursework, training, or personal projects.
  • Familiarity with UI, functional, and integration testing concepts.
  • Exposure to bug tracking and project management tools such as Jira through academic projects, internships, or self-study.
  • Strong attention to detail with a natural ability to identify issues, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Ability to learn new technologies, tools, and processes quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Understanding of software development and release processes.
  • Passion for technology, quality, and finding defects before they impact users.
  • Enjoy working with social games and applications, with an interest in evaluating user experiences and identifying areas for improvement.

Success Profile

  • Leading Complexity
  • Leading People
  • Leading the Business
  • Leading Self

At Brightstar, we consider a wide range of factors in determining compensation, including background, skills, experience, and work location. These factors can cause your compensation to vary. The estimated starting compensation range is $39,848 - $103,002. The actual pay offered may end up being higher or lower. The Company will comply with all local pay requirements and collective bargaining agreements, where applicable.

Base pay is only one part of our Total Rewards program. Sales roles may be eligible for commission payments, while other roles are eligible for discretionary bonuses. In addition, we offer employees a 401(k) Savings Plan with Company contributions, health, dental, and vision insurance, life, accident, and disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid time off, wellness programs, identity theft insurance. Note: programs are subject to eligibility requirements.

Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role.

All Brightstar employees have a role in information security. Annual training will be assigned and required as appropriate.

Haas Automation is the largest machine tool builder in the western world, manufacturing a complete line of CNC vertical machining centers, horizontal machining centers, CNC lathes and rotary products. The company also builds a variety of specialty machines, including 5-axis machining centers, mold making machining centers, toolroom machines, and gantry routers. Gene Haas founded Haas Automation, Inc., in 1983 to manufacture economical and reliable machine tools. The company entered the machine tool industry with the first-ever, fully automatic, programmable collet indexer – a device used to position parts for machining with very high accuracy. The Haas 5C collet indexer was a huge success, and over the next four years, the company expanded its product line to include a wide selection of fully programmable rotary tables, rotary indexers, and machine tool accessories.

Today, Haas manufactures four major product lines: vertical machining centers (VMCs), horizontal machining centers (HMCs), CNC lathes and rotary tables, as well as a number of large five-axis and specialty machines. The company's expansive facilities in Henderson, Nevada and Oxnard, California are among the largest, most modern machine tool manufacturing operations in the United States.

descriptionHtml:
Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Sr. Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software products through comprehensive testing activities, process improvements, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with a passion for quality and customer satisfaction, helping to deliver high-quality software products that meet business and user requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Software Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Quality Assurance Activities
  • Develop, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and performance testing.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify software defects.
  • Analyze test results and provide clear recommendations for product improvements.
  • Validate bug fixes and ensure resolution quality.

Test Automation

  • Design and implement automated test solutions.
  • Maintain and improve automated test frameworks.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Monitor automation results and troubleshoot failures.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Software Developers, Product Managers, and mechanical Engineers
  • Participate in requirements reviews, design reviews, and sprint activities.
  • Provide quality risk assessments during project planning.
  • Advocate for quality best practices across the development lifecycle.

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA methodologies and standards.
  • Help define test strategies and quality metrics.
  • Support root cause analysis activities for production issues.
  • Promote shift-left testing and quality engineering practices.

Key Competencies

  • Attention to Detail
  • Critical Thinking
  • Customer Focus with Willingness to travel
  • Teamwork and Collaboration
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset
  • Technical Curiosity
  • Effective Communication
  • Accountability and Ownership

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
  • Experience creating and executing test plans and test cases.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools.
  • Knowledge of API, and backend testing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, C#.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Git, or Jenkins.
  • ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification.
  • Experience in performance or reliability testing.

Skills

Description

The Senior Test Automation Engineer is responsible for creating and maintaining test scripts ensuring software quality standards are met. This includes coordinating all testing activities with developers and functional analysts to create and manage test plans, test scripts both manual and automated, and testing artifacts in accordance with VA mandated testing documentation standards and templates.

Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and collaborate with developers and functional analysts to create test plans and test scripts (Manual and Automated) in accordance with VA mandated testing documentation standards and templates.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Ensure high quality and reliability of software
  • Lead continuous integration, and performance testing events.
  • Manage and track all testing artifacts in GitHub, Jira, and associated repositories.
  • Lead and conduct testing in accordance with Master Test Plan specifications that provide tracking, monitoring and reporting of results.
  • Manage and assist staff test events with appropriate resources.
  • Identify and document defects.
  • Monitor and update defect and bug reports in the Application Life Cycle Management (ALM) tool Jira.
  • Perform code reviews of scripts
  • Execute manual and automated test scripts

Requirements

Required Experience:

  • Must have experience working with developers, end users and organizations to create test plans and test scripts
  • Must have comprehensive technical expertise in IT products, operating systems, software, hardware, systems and networks and specialized environments.
  • Must have experience in writing or assisting in the development of test plans and test procedures.
  • Must manage the defect database under the guidance of QA Manager.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, electronics engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in manual and automation testing
  • 8+ years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education
  • Eligibility limited to U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents (green card holders)
  • Must be able to receive a Security Clearance / Public Trust

Required Skills

  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have experience in the coordination and management of test events in accordance with approved test plans, procedures, and scripts.
  • Must have knowledge and skills to ensure that test environments are set up accurately.
  • Proficient in developing test automation scripts using a scripting language (Python, JavaScript)
  • Hands-on experience with QA automation tools (e.g., Selenium, JMeter, TestNG, Cypress, Playwright).
  • Must be able to create test reports.
  • Experience working in a SAFe / Agile environment
  • Application Life Cycle (ALM) tool experience preferred (Jira, etc.)
  • Proficiency in defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail, Bugzilla, HP ALM).
  • Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, and DevOps practices.
  • Strong experience in CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-based testing solutions (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Highly proficient in Scripting languages (Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, C++, Go, TypeScript, PHP)
  • Experienced in backend testing
  • Ability to perform manual testing
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Experience in working with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured, SoapUI).
  • Experience working with GitHub and repositories.
  • Must have experience with configuring necessary hardware and operating environments as needed to complete assigned testing.
  • Tracks problems and reports on errors that are identified.
  • Attention to detail and excellent customer service.
  • Highly motivated and analytical; proven problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to take initiative
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to learn new skills, new client environments, and grow domain expertise.
  • Ability to conduct independent research to lead or support the resolution of complex questions and issues.
  • Excellent analytical skills, the ability to integrate information from multiple sources to execute effectively and efficiently in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team setting.
  • Stay updated on emerging QA tools, trends, and methodologies, recommending new technologies and best practices
  • Experience working with the Department of Veterans’ Affairs (preferred)
  • Medical claims X.12 Transaction (837, 835, 277, etc.) - (preferred)
  • Medical claims processing application knowledge (preferred)
  • Experience working with accessibility testing tools.
  • Certified in ISTQB (preferred)

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)

  • Experience in mobile gaming industry a plus
  • Proficiency in writing and executing test cases and test scripts.
  • Understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; or a combination of education and equivalent work experience in a related role

Must be able to operate routine office equipment including computer terminals and keyboards, telephones, copiers, facsimiles, and calculators. Must be able to routinely perform work on computer for an average of 6-8 hours per day, when necessary. Must be able to work extended hours or travel off site whenever required or requested by management. Must be capable of regular, reliable and timely attendance.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Must be able to routinely perform work indoors in climate-controlled shared work area with minimal noise.

Mental And/Or Emotional Requirements

Must be able to perform job functions independently or with limited supervision and work effectively either on own or as part of a team. Must be able to read and carry out various written instructions and follow oral instructions. Must be able to complete basic mathematical calculations, spell accurately, and understand computer basics. Must be able to speak clearly and deliver information in a logical and understandable sequence. Must be capable of dealing calmly and professionally with numerous different personalities from diverse cultures at various levels within and outside of the organization and demonstrate highest levels of customer service and discretion when dealing with the public. Must be able to perform responsibilities with composure under the stress of deadlines / requirements for extreme accuracy and quality and/or fast pace. Must be able to effectively handle multiple, simultaneous, and changing priorities. Must be capable of exercising highest level of discretion on both internal and external confidential matters.

  • Must be authorized to work in the US **

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

About The Job

We are seeking a Software QA Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Reston, Virginia. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing test plans, identifying software defects, and ensuring the overall quality of our products

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute manual and automated test plans, test cases, and test scripts for software & firmware products
  • Perform thorough functional, regression, and user acceptance testing with hardware-in-the-loop
  • Identify, document, and track software/firmware defects
  • Collaborate with developers to debug issues and verify fixes
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing methodologies
  • Create comprehensive validation plans to include clear pass/fail criteria and adherence to relevant industry standards, ensuring precise traceability from design requirements to specific test procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in software quality assurance
  • Testing in Linux and Windows environments
  • Strong understanding of core networking principles and basic IP networking protocols
  • Proficiency in using network analysis tools, such as Wireshark.
  • Attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience with Git and common platforms like Gitlab, Github or Bitbucket
  • Experience with bug tracking systems (e.g., JIRA, Bugzilla)
  • Strong debugging, analytical and creative problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
  • Aptitude for learning
  • Good documentation skills
  • Ability to adapt & contribute to changing priorities
  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active secret security clearance (at a minimum)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic proficiency in Python or other coding languages
  • Familiarity of automated testing frameworks such as Pytest
  • Automated UI testing tools like Playwright or Selenium is a plus
  • Experience validating designs intended for harsh or deployed environments (ruggedized, airborne, or space).

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.
Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Quality Assurance Engineer  - RF-SMART for NetSuite

US East Office (Jacksonville, FL)We exist to transform our customers and change lives 

 

 

Who We're Looking For        

RF-SMART is seeking a QA Engineer to test enterprise grade software in a fast-paced scrum development team at our US East Office in Jacksonville, FL. The QA Engineer job description encompasses two main roles: testing and documentation. After Software Developers complete their development tasks, Quality Assurance Engineers test them. They use a variety of tools, testing applications and reports to compare the software to user requirements. They ensure that the software functions according to those requirements. After testing, Quality Assurance Engineers recommend changes and improvements for software. They work with developers to make the appropriate changes and then test everything all over again.

What You'll Do:

Quality Assurance Engineers document the entire quality testing process. They describe the program, evaluation, testing methods, and any improvements made to the software. Because Quality Assurance Engineers work so closely with the software, they often create training materials and instruct users how to use the software properly. The QA Engineer will be responsible for creating an end-to-end test plan, executing the plan, and managing all activities in the plan to ensure that all the objectives are met, and that the solution works as expected. The solution should be tested in terms of functionality, performance, reliability and stability.

  • Developing and executing software test plans
  • Identifying and facilitating issue resolution with functional and technical groups
  • Documenting and communicating test results
  • Testing alongside DevOps initiatives to shift-left in testing approach
  • NetSuite and Supply Chain/Warehousing knowledge would be a big plus

What You Bring:

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's Low Earth Orbit satellite network, with a mission to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will connect people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team builds the systems that provide deep, end-to-end insight into the health, performance, and reliability of this global telecom network. Our systems span the full Leo service, from satellites and customer terminals to ground gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure, and help engineers understand network behavior, detect failures quickly, and diagnose complex issues.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the network health metrics, dashboards, and APIs our engineers and leaders rely on are accurate, reliable, and ready for release. You will test systems that turn network telemetry and events into answers to critical questions: Is the network healthy? Where is a failure occurring? What is its customer impact?

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

  • Create and execute test plans and test cases for new and existing features across our network health services, data pipelines, APIs, and dashboards, ensuring thorough functional, integration, and end-to-end coverage across straightforward and moderately complex scenarios.
  • Develop, maintain, and extend automated tests for APIs, UI, and data pipelines using languages such as Python, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to reduce manual testing effort.
  • Validate the accuracy of network health metrics (such as availability, latency, and packet loss) against source data and expected results.
  • Troubleshoot and isolate defects from test and pipeline failures, file clear and actionable bug reports, and work with developers to drive root cause analysis and resolution.
  • Review requirements, designs, and change requests with engineers and product managers to identify risks and test gaps early, and recommend changes that improve quality and the customer experience.
  • Participate in defect triage, test planning, and prioritization discussions, helping the team balance time constraints with test coverage goals.
  • Use AI tools to help generate test cases, expand coverage, and speed up defect investigation.
  • Track quality metrics and share release readiness status with the team.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Network Observability team, you'll work with software engineers, network engineers, and product managers to review new features, identify risks, and plan how to test them. You might validate that a new availability metric matches the underlying telemetry one day, and build API automation for a new service the next. You'll write and run automated tests, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and partner with developers to reproduce and fix defects. You'll take part in sprint ceremonies and design reviews, and help make sure the data engineers and leaders use to operate the Leo network is right.

About The Team

The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team is responsible for making a highly distributed global telecom network understandable and operable at scale. We build the visibility layer that connects network signals across satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial infrastructure, turning individual telemetry signals into an end-to-end view of network health so issues can be detected, diagnosed, and resolved faster.

The problems we solve are inherently distributed and combine software engineering with networking and data science. We are building new capabilities rather than applying existing observability patterns to a conventional cloud service. If you enjoy ambiguous problems, care about getting the details right, and want to help build foundational systems for Amazon Leo, this team is a great place to grow.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. About The Role

As a QA Automation Lead, you will make an impact by developing and maintaining automated testing solutions for user interfaces, APIs, integrations, and data. You will collaborate with engineering and delivery teams to strengthen product quality, investigate defects, and integrate automated testing into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.

In this role, you will

  • Develop, maintain, and execute UI and API automation test suites using Java, Selenium WebDriver, and REST Assured.
  • Create comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on business and technical requirements.
  • Validate application functionality, system integrations, APIs, and data across multiple testing stages.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices.
  • Investigate defects, analyze test results, and collaborate with engineering teams to drive issues through resolution.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a Remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in quality assurance, software testing, and test automation.
  • Proficiency in Java, Selenium WebDriver, and REST Assured.
  • Experience testing REST APIs, including working with HTTP methods and JSON payloads.
  • Experience with database testing using SQL or other database-testing tools.
  • Working knowledge of a Java testing framework such as JUnit or TestNG.
  • Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Git and version-control practices.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.

These will help you stand out

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.

Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

The annual salary for this position is between $71,100 to $112,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This is an early-career Software Test Engineer II position intended for engineers with a minimum of two years of relevant experience in embedded systems and software validation. The engineer will perform both manual and automated testing, support hardware/software integration activities, develop and maintain test documentation and automation solutions, and follow company policies and approved engineering processes throughout the validation lifecycle.

  • Create and maintain test cases with complete requirements traceability.
  • Perform manual and automated testing of embedded software.
  • Document results and produce clear, comprehensive test reports.

U.S. work authorization is required. No visa sponsorship is available at this time.

Location: Remote (EST hours)

Responsibilities

  • Execute comprehensive manual testing across front-end applications, APIs, databases, and integrated backend systems to validate functionality and performance
  • Develop and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, and testing documentation to support new feature releases and ongoing platform enhancements
  • Identify, document, and track software defects, partnering closely with engineering teams to ensure timely resolution and successful delivery
  • Validate complex data flows, system integrations, and operational workflows that support business-critical processes
  • Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure quality is incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Act as a champion for quality assurance best practices, helping improve testing processes, standards, and overall product reliability

  • 3-5+ years of hands-on manual QA experience across both front-end user interface testing and backend system validation
  • Strong experience with test case creation, test execution, defect management, and quality reporting processes
  • Experience testing complex software applications involving integrations, data movement, and business-critical workflows
  • Proficiency with SQL for database validation and data testing activities
  • Experience testing REST or SOAP APIs using Postman or similar testing tools
  • Solid understanding of Agile development methodologies and the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Strong communication, analytical thinking, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams

Compensation: Base Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 + Full Comprehensive Health Benefits

Additional Information

  • Role is primarily remote, but candidates must be based in the U.S. and available to work Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States — no visa sponsorship available
