Software Quality Assurance Engineer

Seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Application Development QA team. This position is ideal for a hands-on QA professional with strong manual testing experience and exposure to test automation. We are looking for someone who enjoys finding defects, validating business requirements, and ensuring software quality throughout the development lifecycle.



What You'll Do

  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web, desktop, and API applications.
  • Perform hands-on manual testing, including functional, regression, smoke, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • Design and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, WebDriverIO, or similar technologies.
  • Validate applications against business requirements, user stories, and technical specifications.
  • Document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Partner closely with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to ensure software quality throughout the SDLC.
  • Execute regression testing activities prior to production releases.
  • Provide testing status, quality metrics, and risk assessments to leadership and project teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on Software QA experience.
  • Strong background in manual testing with proven experience creating and executing test cases.
  • Experience performing functional, regression, smoke, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • At least 1 year of hands-on automation experience using Playwright, Cypress, WebDriverIO, or similar tools.
  • Ability to write and maintain automation scripts using JavaScript, TypeScript, or Node.js-based technologies.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar defect management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, SDLC, and Agile development practices.
  • Experience testing web-based applications; desktop and API testing experience is a plus.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a genuine hands-on tester who has spent the majority of their career performing manual QA while developing some automation capabilities along the way. We are seeking someone who can confidently discuss testing methodologies, test case design, defect management, and automation tools they have personally used in production environments. This is not a role for a pure automation engineer, framework architect, or QA manager. It is a hands-on testing position requiring strength in both manual QA fundamentals and automation scripting.

descriptionHtml:
Applied Medical is a new-generation medical device company with a proven business model and commitment to innovation fueled by rapid business growth and expansion. Our company has been developing and manufacturing advanced surgical technologies for over 35 years and has earned a strong reputation for excellence in the healthcare field. Our unique business model, combined with our dedication to delivering the highest quality products, enables team members to contribute to a larger capacity than is possible in typical positions.

Position Description

As a Software Test Engineer at Applied Medical, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safety, reliability, and compliance of our advanced surgical devices, including the Voyant Intelligent Energy System. You will focus on testing embedded software and components, collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to validate product performance, identify issues, and support regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle. This role is centered on testing, not software development, making it an excellent opportunity for those passionate about quality assurance in embedded medical systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Verify and validate embedded software and PC applications for medical devices
  • Review, analyze, and decompose requirements into effective test plans and protocols
  • Design, execute, and document manual and automated test procedures in accordance with regulatory standards
  • Participate in design reviews to ensure comprehensive test coverage and adequacy
  • Log, track, and drive issues to closure while collaborating closely with development and engineering teams
  • Collect and analyze test data, report findings, and support engineering documentation for compliance and submissions

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Delivering thorough, well-documented test protocols and reports that ensure regulatory compliance and product safety
  • Building strong relationships with software and hardware engineers to proactively identify and resolve issues
  • Increasing reliability and performance of embedded software systems through rigorous testing and validation
  • Contributing to efficient product development cycles by providing clear, actionable test feedback
  • Demonstrating growth from early learning to independently leading complex testing projects

Position Requirements

This position requires the following skills and attributes:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Knowledge of the software development life cycle and testing methodologies
  • Strong documentation, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills
  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication abilities
  • Willingness to learn and work at the hardware-software boundary of embedded devices
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Commitment to quality by maintaining compliance with Applied Medical’s Quality Management System

Preferred

The following skills and attributes are preferred:

  • Programming experience with C, C++, assembly, Python, or other comparable languages
  • Familiarity with embedded firmware, Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), and test automation frameworks
  • Industry experience in medical device or embedded systems testing
  • Knowledge of electronic test practices, schematics, and test equipment
  • Experience supporting electronics teams in development or manufacturing
  • Exposure to content and document management systems

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation range: $72500 - $85000 / year (California).
  • Comprehensive benefits package.
  • Training and mentorship opportunities.
  • On-campus wellness activities.
  • Education reimbursement program.
  • 401(k) program with discretionary employer match.
  • Generous vacation accrual and paid holiday schedule.

Please note that the compensation range may be adjusted in the future, and bonus and incentive compensation plans may apply.

Our total reward package reflects our commitment to employee growth and well-being, as we invest in your development and offer a range of benefits designed to enhance your career and life.

All compensation and benefits are subject to plan documents and written agreements.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Applied Medical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, disability (mental and physical), exercising the right to family care and medical leave, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, political affiliation, race, religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), or sexual orientation, or any other status protected by federal, state or local laws in the locations where Applied Medical operates.

descriptionHtml:
As a Senior QA Engineer at Plus One Robotics, you will ensure that our robotic systems, including the software and hardware that make them up, are dependable and of the highest quality. 


You will deploy and test software on Linux-based industrial PCs (IPCs), build and maintain automated test suites, analyze logs and stack traces to pinpoint failures, and verify that products work end to end in a physical robot cell. You will work closely with developers to find and verify fixes, with product owners to confirm the product does what they intended, and with customers to understand how it is used in the field. 


This is a senior level position; we are not considering entry-level candidates for this role. 


Essential Functions 

Software Testing and Automation 

  • Define and implement testing strategies for new and existing products, covering functional, regression, integration, performance, and stability testing 
  • Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans, test cases, and documentation from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria 
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites to validate functionality, performance, and stability. Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines so builds are validated before release. Perform manual tests when automation isn't feasible
  • Build internal tools and scripts to optimize and automate QA workflows, test data collection, and log analysis 

Deployment, Debugging, and Defect Management 

  • Install, deploy, and configure software builds and deploy packages on Linux-based industrial PCs (IPCs) and test systems 
  • Read stack traces, application logs, and system output to isolate where and why a failure occurred, and deliver actionable findings to developers 
  • Identify, thoroughly document, and track bugs in GitLab throughout the development cycle, with clear steps to reproduce and supporting logs or screenshots. Work with developers to verify fixes and confirm no regressions
  • Use git and GitLab daily to check out branches and tags under test, review merge requests and pipelines to understand what changed, and manage issues and epics 

Hardware and System Testing 

  • Perform hands-on testing of POR robotic systems, including InductOne, verifying that software, electrical, and mechanical sub-systems work together end to end 
  • Troubleshoot at the system level to determine whether a fault originates in software, electrical, or mechanical sub-systems 

Collaboration and Leadership 

  • Be an advocate for our customers and end users by holding a high standard for quality and usability 
  • Work with product owners to confirm features meet requirements and intended customer use, and participate in acceptance and release sign-off 
  • Present QA data, test results, and analyses to stakeholders, including customers, leadership, and cross-functional teams, in a clear, accessible manner tailored to the audience  
  • Mentor interns and junior-level teammates by sharing QA best practices, providing technical guidance, reviewing their work, and supporting their professional development 


Qualifications 

Required 

  • Strong software QA fundamentals: test strategy, test plan development, test case design, bug reporting, regression testing, fix verification, and acceptance testing 
  • Proficient in Python, TypeScript, or a similar language used in test automation 
  • Working proficiency with the Linux command line, including file system navigation, permissions, SSH, managing services, and reading logs 
  • Experience installing and deploying software builds or deploy packages to test or production systems 
  • Experience with git and GitLab (or GitHub): branches, tags, merge requests, and issue tracking 
  • Experience testing hardware or physical systems, or a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn hands-on hardware testing 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English 
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment 

Preferred 

  • Experience with testing frameworks such as Pytest, Puppeteer, Playwright, or similar. Familiarity with C++
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab CI 
  • Experience with Docker or other containerized deployments 


Required Education and Experience 

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience 
  • 5+ years of experience in QA or test engineering, with the majority in software testing 
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing software test automation 
  • Experience testing products that combine software and hardware, such as robotics, automation, or embedded systems 


Work Environment & Travel 

  • This position operates in a professional office setting with occasional exposure to robotic systems and moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment and job sites may at times be loud. 
  • There is some travel expected for the purposes of customer support and deployments. 

 

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work/Locatio

Full time, 40 hours/week between M-F, 9:00am-6:00pm, In office at our San Antonio based HQ.


Salary Information

The range for this role starts at $112,000 per year. Starting salary is based on years of experience.


We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

Our cutting-edge Modular brand solutions are powering mines worldwide, driving efficiency and sustainability in ways that seemed impossible just years ago.

The Company

Modular Mining Systems is the global leader in mine management technology and a wholly owned subsidiary of Komatsu Ltd. Our innovative technology powers mine operations in every corner of the globe. The products we cultivate, the solutions we engineer and the service we deliver set us apart in the Mining Technology industry.  We are more than a company, we’re a community of passionate, creative professionals striving toward a shared vision: to revolutionize the way the mining industry operates. 

With a presence stretching from Johannesburg to Vancouver, Sydney to Lima, you are part of a global brand that supports creativity, fosters innovation and encourages you to think big, share ideas and be yourself.

Job Purpose

Support the Product Development team by providing Quality Assurance with for software development, maintenance, and support. As part of Modular’s Product Development team, the Software QA Engineer will research, design, build and improve the quality of the products. Develop unit tests, automation tests, simulation tools, and Test Plans to ensure our products high quality. Analyze, decompose large software systems and design a strategy to test this system using the knowledge of System Design. Develop tools/frameworks to increase the productivity of day-to-day activities from Software and QA engineering teams using the knowledge of System Design. Perform analysis, estimating work, creating and updating software architecture and design using the knowledge of System Design. Help define and negotiate the scope of releases, suggest process improvements, as well as make recommendations for structural and technical improvements. Assist Quality Engineering team with manual software testing to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality. Assist Software Engineering team with writing and executing tests to assess broader quality concerns.

This position may be based in either Tucson or Phoenix, Arizona. Candidates residing in both locations are encouraged to apply.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 25%

Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Participates in test planning, creating traceability to requirements, risk-based testing, estimation, and scheduling of QA efforts
  • Develops and maintains test cases, traceability, procedures, scripts, and test data for verifying quality of OEM Drivers
  • Develops and executes plans to identify, document, and mitigate technical risks
  • Directly participates in the execution of manual and automated system test procedures for delivering reports of pass/fail results compared to quality plan
  • Continuous monitoring and enhancement of approaches and methodologies to improve testing.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical degree with emphasis in software Quality Assurance.
  • Proven knowledge in Requirements Management, Quality Control, and Configuration Management
  • Understanding of networking protocols, wired and wireless networking
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and within team environment
  • Detail oriented, excellent planning and communication skills

Desired Skills

  • Knowledge of Scripting Languages (PowerShell)
  • Experience working with SQL databases

Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

At Komatsu we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions.  We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose.  We are authentic, ambitious, and innovative in our pursuit of Diversity & Inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. 

If you want to learn more about Komatsu, please visit our website at https://www.komatsu.com/ .

Company Information

Komatsu is a world leader in manufacturing construction, mining, forestry, and industrial heavy equipment. Founded in 1921, Komatsu has a long history of quality, reliability, innovation, and excellence. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu facilities, distributors and dealers are in more than 140 countries and employ more than 60,000 people. Komatsu offers a diverse and challenging work environment, where you can grow your skills and career, and contribute to a sustainable, clean-energy future. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, be a part of something big and join a team that is shaping the world!

EEO Statement

Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Join us at Sparksoft, where we're not just another tech company—we're a catalyst for change. Our mission isn't just to offer IT solutions; it's to revolutionize the way you work. Here, passion isn't just a buzzword; it's the fuel behind groundbreaking ideas and transformative technologies. Our true strength lies in our people. They're the problem-solvers and innovators consistently delivering extraordinary outcomes. Through our specialized Innovation Centers, we continuously refine our methods, ensuring we remain industry leaders.

We are Sparksoft!

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain test artifacts, including test data, and perform data verification.
  • Execute and evaluate functional, integration, performance, and regression test cases to ensure software products meet requirements, specifications, and standards; report test results.
  • Identify and report defects and issues and track them to closure.
  • Set up, configure, and maintain test suites, with a focus on continuous testing and DevOps processes.
  • Analyze requirements and technical design documents for use cases and user stories, create test cases, and perform impact analysis.
  • Prepare and present testing activity reports to customers and senior management.
  • Analyze and resolve problems in coordination with the Scrum team.
  • Identify, document, and track defects effectively.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong understanding of software development, testing principles, and methodologies, with proficiency in a range of testing techniques and tools.
  • Strong technical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience working with Jira, Confluence, and TestRail.
  • Stay up to date with the latest testing trends and tools to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing and tools such as Protractor, Postman, Selenium, TestNG, JMeter, PactumJS, and Playwright.

  • Ensure testing activities align with project timelines and deliverables.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integration of automated tests using tools such as Jenkins.
  • Collaborate with developers to establish and maintain robust unit and integration testing strategies.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and strong debugging skills.
  • Perform end-to-end testing to ensure application workflows meet business and technical requirements.
  • Work with development and DevOps teams to integrate test automation into DevOps pipelines.
  • Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Candidates must have lived in the United States 3 out of the past 5 years.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience working on federal projects (preferably CMS).
  • Familiarity with AWS, AI concepts to automate testing scenarios, databases and SQL for testing applications that rely on data storage and retrieval.
  • Experience with automation and core Java to support the team as needed.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in an IT- related field
  • Five years of experience establishing comprehensive testing practices and methodologies.

WHAT WE OFFER:

At Sparksoft, we know that people do their best work when they feel supported, inspired, and connected. That’s why we’ve built a workplace that balances comprehensive benefits with a culture of collaboration and innovation. From flexible time off to professional growth opportunities, we’re committed to helping you thrive both inside and outside of work. When you join Sparksoft, you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation and a 401(k) with employer contributions to help you plan for the future
  • Flexible paid time off and hybrid ways of working that support true work-life balance
  • Comprehensive health coverage—including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • A curated in-office experience designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back through Sparksoft Cares, including annual company-wide fundraising events
  • Training and development programs that build new skills and prepare you for leadership roles
  • A collaborative, transparent, and fun culture—recognized as a Great Place to Work®

If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at Sparksoft.Accommodations@sparksoftcorp.com or call 410-424-7700. Requests are reviewed and fulfilled on a case-by-case basis.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0248509

Software Test Engineer

The Opportunity:

When a user tries new software, they expect it to be intuitive and run smoothly. Functionality, reliability, and user experience are key to successful software development, and that means rigorous testing. That’s why we need a knowledgeable test engineer like you who knows how to thoroughly test software and work with developers to make sure our team releases the best software possible.

As a Software Test Engineer on our team, you’ll collaborate with developers, requirements analysts, and government stakeholders to validate software for your client. You’ll create test strategies and detailed procedures, trace requirements to verification methods, and execute tests that span functional, integration, regression, performance, and mission‑relevant evaluation. You’ll track and report bugs, verify fixes, and help guide improvements throughout the development lifecycle.

Work with us to make an impact by supporting national security.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience performing software testing, systems validation, or verification activities
  • Experience with Jira
  • Experience analyzing and comprehending software requirements, and defining test methods
  • Experience developing test plans, test cases, and detailed test procedures
  • Experience conducting functional, integration, regression, or performance testing
  • Experience in communicating findings to development teams
  • Ability to collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, and government test organizations
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with SQL scripting
  • Experience with human resources IT systems
  • Experience with automation and API tools such as Selenium, JUnit, Postman, or Cypress
  • Experience with Agile frameworks and Continuous Integration or Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
Rain is the world's first AI Financial Health Platform, serving 3.5 million employees at leading organizations like McDonald's, Marriott, and T-Mobile. Rain works in the background to optimize every employee's financial life to prevent shortfalls and build long-term stability. Backed by top investors including QED and Prosus, Rain has raised $150M in venture funding to fuel our next stage of hyper growth.

About The QA Team

We are looking for an experienced QA Engineer to be a part of our engineering team. You will help us to improve QA processes, run tests and collaborate with teams to maintain product excellence. You will work together with the QA Lead, Engineers in all squads, Product Managers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, etc.

You will have a key role in automation efforts and helping us balance what to automate and when to automate, prioritizing actions according to our goals. We strongly believe in the importance of having close contact with our users, so you will talk a lot with our operational people in the United States to understand issues from admin users and end users. This position is hybrid in New York City.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and scale robust UI test automation frameworks using Playwright
  • Drive quality integration by embedding automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools like Docker
  • Perform comprehensive manual and automated testing across API, web, and mobile interfaces.
  • Lead non-functional testing, including performance, stress, and exploratory tests
  • Implement best practices (BDD, Page Object Model, and Object Orientation) to ensure scalable automation code

Who You Are

  • You have 3+ years experience designing and executing web/mobile/API automation, proficient in Playwright and Linux/Unix
  • You have solid experience with React JS (Chakra UI a plus) and working knowledge of Relational Databases
  • You are an expert in the software QA process, proficient in writing test scenarios (Gherkin syntax), and conducting rigorous end-to-end and regression testing
  • You have experience with mobile app testing on Android/iOS devices, utilizing specialized tools like Appium, UIAutomator, or Espresso

Required Technical Qualifications

  • Hands-on expertise with Playwright, Appium, Selenium, or Cypress for robust UI automation
  • Solid experience with React JS or Python (familiarity with Chakra UI is a plus)
  • Proven ability to automate and manually test both APIs and user interfaces
  • Proficiency working within Linux/Unix environments
  • Working knowledge of Relational Databases
  • Practical experience applying the Page Object Model and Object Orientation principles in automation code
  • Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines and proficiency with Docker

Compensation

$165,000 - $185,000

Note this is a range and we take in a variety of factors when determining total compensation for the position.

How We Care For Our Team

Along with competitive salaries, Rain offers great benefits including:

  • Flexible PTO
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability coverage
  • Parental leave
  • Monthly stipend
  • Equity options

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Commitments

As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, Rain is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sex (including pregnancy), protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any unlawful criterion existing under applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Careers@rain.us.

What’s Next

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

Compensation Range: $165K - $185K

At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. AFS is searching for a Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer and Tester to develop and execute software test plans to identify software defects and determine their root causes.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, analyze, and document issues related to program functionality, outputs, user interfaces, or content.
  • Document software defects using bug-tracking systems and report findings to software developers.
  • Develop testing programs that address database impacts, software scenarios, regression testing, negative testing, bug retesting, and usability.
  • Design test plans, test scenarios, scripts, and procedures. Document test procedures to ensure repeatability and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Provide feedback and recommendations to development teams regarding software usability and functionality. Install, maintain, and utilize software testing tools and programs.
  • Test system modifications and enhancements prior to implementation.
  • Create and maintain databases of known test defects and issues.
  • Develop or define standards, methodologies, and procedures for evaluating product quality and release readiness.
  • Monitor defect resolution efforts and track testing outcomes and improvements. Participate in product design reviews and provide input on functional requirements, system designs, project schedules, and potential risks.
  • Plan testing schedules and strategies in alignment with project scope, milestones, and delivery timelines.
  • Monitor program performance to ensure efficient and reliable operation.
  • Conduct software compatibility testing across applications, hardware platforms, operating systems, and network environments.
  • Investigate customer-reported issues escalated by technical support teams.
  • Review software documentation for technical accuracy, completeness, compliance, and risk mitigation. Identify deviations from established standards and recommend corrective actions to ensure compliance.
  • Perform initial debugging activities by reviewing configuration files, system logs, and source code to identify root causes of issues.
  • Design and develop automated testing tools and frameworks. Install and configure test environments that replicate production systems to evaluate software performance and behavior.
  • Collaborate with field personnel and customers to evaluate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues.
  • Conduct historical analysis of test results to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate and recommend software tools for testing, defect tracking, and quality assurance activities.
  • Modify existing software to correct defects, adapt to new hardware environments, and improve overall performance.
  • Store, retrieve, and analyze data to assess system capabilities, performance, and requirements.

Required Skills

  • Experience in any of the following:
    • Experience in DevOps and QA; strong background in software/hardware integration testing
    • Expertise in building secure CI/CD pipelines, Python scripting, automated security testing tools, and container-based solutions (Docker, Kubernetes
    • Experience with advanced automation frameworks and secure DevSecOps environments
Clearance

  • An active TS/SCI is required

descriptionHtml:
Whova is seeking a in-person Software QA Engineer.

As a Software QA Engineer, you will be responsible for design, implementation, and maintenance of test automation systems, the creation of software tools and test infrastructure used to perform feature verification and regression tests, and driving quality-centric methodologies in the software development process. You will work with the product team closely to help define product requirements and generate acceptance criteria and contribute to all aspects of the product quality: reliability, performance, user experience.

Whova revolutionizes event engagement and attendee networking by providing the Whova mobile app and event management software for conferences and trade shows globally every day.

Whova is a fast-growing company with brand-name customers, including US-Bank, L’Oreal, Hilton, LEGO, Vetafore, NASA, IKEA, TEDx, etc. We are proud to receive the San Diego Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in San Diego award, 5 years in a row. We also won the Fastest Growing Private Companies award for 3 years. More recently, we won Event Technology Awards’ Best Product Team Award, and Global Top Rated Product Award. Currently, we are named as G2’s Global Top 50 Best Software.


Responsibilities & Requirements:

  • Help product owners define understandable and testable user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Develop and execute test plans, test design, test objectives, and test cases
  • Test, automate, and maintain manual and automated regression suites
  • Develop and improve testing automation tools and infrastructure
  • Investigate product quality in order to make improvements to achieve better customer satisfaction
  • Collaborate with the Product Development team to ensure consistent project execution
  • Learn and adapt to new software, technologies and testing strategies to improve the process


Job Qualifications

  • Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree or higher, in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experiences with Web and Mobile applications testing frameworks such as Appium, Selenium, Cucumber etc. Experiences with scripting languages(Python, Javascript, etc) and version control tool(Git)
  • Strong collaborator and proactive team player in a cross-functional environment
  • Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations


Benefits

  • Salary: $60K-$75K per year, based on experiences in software quality assurance(QA process, mobile and web automation tools, test case design and writing, etc)
  • 401k after 6 months
  • Health benefits package (medical, dental, vision).
  • 18 days/year vacation leave/sick leave.
  • Two company-provided lunches and Bagel Wednesdays!
  • A collaborative, fast-paced team environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute directly to a globally top-ranked product (awarded by G2, Event Technology Awards, and others).

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Agilent is seeking an experienced and motivated Advanced Test Engineer to join the Software Quality Engineering organization within the Services Division of the Agilent CrossLab Group (ACG).

The Advanced Test Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions across the Services software portfolio. This role partners closely with Product Management, Software Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Customer Support teams to define test strategies, implement automated quality solutions, and drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will combine strong testing expertise, technical depth, business understanding, and Agile delivery experience to identify quality risks, improve engineering practices, and ensure reliable software releases. The role is expected to leverage modern test automation, AI-assisted testing techniques, and continuous quality engineering principles to improve product quality and delivery efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own quality planning, test strategy, and validation activities for one or more software products.
  • Participate as an active member of Agile product teams, collaborating with Product Owners, developers, architects, and DevOps engineers.
  • Define and execute risk-based testing strategies focused on business-critical functionality and quality risks.
  • Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, API, and automated testing.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions that support CI/CD pipelines.
  • Perform backend and data validation testing, including database verification and system integration validation.
  • Review requirements and designs to ensure testability, quality, and customer value.
  • Identify quality risks early and drive preventative quality engineering practices.
  • Perform root cause analysis and partner with engineering teams to improve product quality and reliability.
  • Contribute to test environment management, test data strategy, release readiness assessments, and defect governance.
  • Drive continuous improvement of testing approaches, frameworks, and engineering processes.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across quality initiatives.
  • Support compliance, cybersecurity, and regulatory validation activities where applicable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline.
  • 4+ years of software testing, quality engineering, or software development experience. 5 years of experience is helpful.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing comprehensive test strategies and test plans.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies including functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and automated testing practices.
  • Experience validating web applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise software systems.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause investigation skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while influencing cross-functional teams and technical decisions.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated testing solutions.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting automated tests within CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman, REST API testing, or similar automation technologies.

Your day-to-day activities will involve designing and executing test cases, identifying defects, and collaborating closely with development teams to resolve issues efficiently. You will leverage your expertise in .Net, Python, bash, PowerShell and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to create robust automation scripts, while also applying your knowledge of front-end frameworks to validate user interfaces and workflows. Your attention to detail will be crucial as you verify that all software components meet stringent quality standards before deployment. In this role, you will benefit from hands-on experience with a variety of testing tools and processes, such as automated testing frameworks, bug tracking systems, and continuous integration pipelines. Exposure to front-end technologies and scripting languages will enhance your ability to identify and troubleshoot issues across different layers of the application.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, develop, and execute automated and manual test cases for web applications
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle

  • Analyze test results and provide actionable feedback to developers
  • Participate in test planning, estimation, and status meetings
  • Maintain and update test documentation as needed

  • Experience with Gitlab/Git for source control of code

  • Previous experience with automated testing tools & frameworks
  • Prior experience in a secure environment

At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Automation & Testing Execution: Design, write, and maintain robust automated test suites while creating targeted manual test cases for features requiring hands-on validation.
  • Agile Requirements Refinement: Active participation in story grooming and refinement sessions to clarify acceptance criteria, spot edge cases early, and ensure testability.
  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

Why Jack Henry?

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Culture of Commitment

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business - and our society - stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law.

descriptionHtml:
CMS

At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.

ZOLL Cardiac Management Solutions Offers a Unique Portfolio Of Novel Technologies Designed To Deliver Better Insights And Better Outcomes. On Any Given Day, Clinicians Utilize These ZOLL Products For Tens Of Thousands Of Cardiac Patients Around The World

  • LifeVest, the world's first wearable defibrillator, has been trusted to protect more than 1M patients at risk of sudden cardiac death.
  • HFMS (Heart Failure Management system) is a non-invasive, patch-based device that monitors pulmonary fluid levels and has been shown to reduce heart failure readmissions rates by 38 percent.
  • TherOx Super Saturated Oxygen (SSO2) Therapy is the first FDA-approved therapy since the stent 20+ years ago to reduce infarct size in patients with the most severe heart attacks.

Heart disease is the leading cause of death for both men and women in the U.S. At ZOLL, your work will help to ensure cardiac patients get the life-saving therapy they need.

ZOLL has been Pittsburgh's Manufacturer of the Year, one of Western PA's Healthiest Employers, and even one of Pittsburgh's Coolest Offices. But it's our unique opportunity to impact people's lives that makes ZOLL the ideal place to build your career.

Job Summary

This position will be responsible for the development, execution and maintenance of software test plans, test cases and test status reporting. This position will be conducting software testing activities on a Scrum team, and must be highly collaborative, demonstrate technical competence, and personal productivity including the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

Essential Functions

  • Ability to lead the testing activities for projects and provide status on those activities
  • Testing of software running on safety critical medical devices and associated applications
  • Designs and reviews test plans and test cases
  • Execute and maintain test plans and test cases to verify the design meets the specified requirements
  • Identify and communicate risk throughout the software development lifecycle and works cross-functionally to mitigate risk
  • Identify and point out ambiguities in requirements
  • Generate detailed defect reports for failed tests
  • Assist Development teams with the troubleshooting of defects
  • Facilitates cross-functional defect, test plan and test case reviews
  • Provide estimates on the test effort for work items
  • Participate in program, design and document reviews
  • Adheres to department software release schedules
  • Complies with regulatory guidelines and maintain associated documentation
  • Ensures and documents traceability from requirements to tests
  • Monitor test automation results for assigned application
  • Development and maintenance of automated test scripts
  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; stay current on SQA best practices; participating in professional societies

Required/Preferred Education And Experience

  • BS or MS degree or equivalent industry experience in a STEM discipline required
  • Typically 5+ years of relevant experience required
  • Proven track record performing the above Duties and Responsibilities required
  • Experience writing SQL queries required
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, Python or PowerShell required
  • Experience working with Linux OS file system required
  • Experience testing web services using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Swagger required

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Language Skills:  Ability to read and interpret documents of advanced technical complexity.  Ability to write reports and research findings of a technical nature.  Ability to speak and present effectively one-on-one as well as in small and large groups of professionals including customers, clients and collaborators, both inside and outside the organization.
  • Mathematical Skills:  Basic mathematical skills required, including the understanding and ability to apply basic statistical and arithmetic principles, work with tabular data, and create and interpret graphs.
  • Reasoning Ability:  Advanced reasoning skills required.  Must have the ability to solve complex problems and weigh possible solutions to determine rank options to deliver optimal outcomes.  Ability to assess problems involving several variables in changing situations.
  • Computer Skills:  To perform this job successfully, an individual should be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Standing - Occasionally
  • Walking - Occasionally
  • Sitting - Constantly
  • Talking - Occasionally
  • Hearing - Occasionally
  • Repetitive Motions - Frequently

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients' lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives.

The Annual Salary For This Position Is

$110,000.00 to $130,000.00

Factors which may affect starting salary include geography, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Details of ZOLL's comprehensive benefits plans can be found at www.zollbenefits.com.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until this position is filled. For fully remote positions, compensation will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local wage laws, including minimum wage requirements, based on the employee’s primary work location.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

ADA: The employer will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems has an opening for a Software Test Engineer/Principal Software Test Engineer to join our team in San Diego, CA.

The candidate should be a self-starter with familiarity working in an Integrated Product Team construct. Candidates will work on software supporting systems in all phases of the software development lifecycle including design, development and test. The selected candidate will work in an environment that at times is fast-paced with high expectations with the ability to adapt to change.

Roles And Responsibilities Will Include

  • Perform software unit and integration test and test automation on the host environment.
  • Work in development and lab environments. Understand the differences between them and ensure integration and testing of components in complex system is happening in the appropriate environment.
  • Perform integration and troubleshooting of software components across multiple networks interfacing with customer SMEs. Ensure that through documentation is created and maintained to allow others to integrate in the future.
  • Facilitate collaboration with software developers, system engineers, hardware engineers, and integration/test engineers to diagnose and identify the root cause of problems found during software installation, integration, acceptance test, and operational events.
  • Utilize familiarity of the full development life-cycle processes
  • Develop clear and concise detailed technical documentation.
  • Submit detailed problem reports for errors found.

Basic Qualifications

  • For T02: Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and 2 years of related engineering experience; OR a Master’s degree in a STEM discipline and 0 years of related engineering experience.
  • For T03: Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and 5 years of related engineering experience; OR a Master’s degree in a STEM discipline and 3 years of related engineering experience.; OR a PhD degree in a STEM discipline and 1 year of related engineering experience.
  • Experience in C/C++ or related programming language.
  • Experience in integration and testing of software and hardware component in unix and windows environments.
  • Experience with formal software life cycle development methodologies, requirements through test.
  • Candidate must be able to obtain a Security+ certification within 6 months of employment
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with software network interfaces.
  • Experience in automation of installation, configuration and test.
  • Experience in Agile methodologies. Agile Systems Engineering Experience.
  • Demonstrated communication and technical writing skills.
  • Experience with Confluence and JIRA.
  • Experience with scripting languages (developing, debugging and maintaining).

Primary Level Salary Range: $91,800.00 - $137,600.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $114,000.00 - $171,000.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

companyDescription: Since 2005, Vimo® has provided innovative solutions for health insurance shopping and enrollment under the GetInsured name. With the acquisition of Change & Innovation Agency in 2021, we’ve expanded our mission to transform government IT infrastructures with proven SaaS, Contact Center Services, and AI technologies. Today, our work extends beyond health insurance exchanges—we’re helping states modernize the administration of critical safety net programs, including Medicaid, SNAP, child care, and unemployment insurance. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we empower agencies to serve more people, more efficiently, and are redefining the future of health care and human services delivery.
companySlogan: Government technology and services, designed for people.
descriptionHtml:
About Vimo:

Vimo® started as the “Expedia” of health insurance and has evolved into a leader in transforming government IT infrastructure with its proven SaaS and AI technology. Our innovative approach to health insurance shopping and enrollment has expanded beyond exchanges, and we are now reinventing how states administer safety net programs such as Medicaid, SNAP (food stamps), child care, and unemployment insurance. With our cutting-edge technology, we are helping agencies serve more people, faster, and transforming healthcare service delivery as we know it.


Job Title : QA Automation Engineer (SDET) AI-Enhanced Testing:

We are seeking a highly analytical and technically strong QA Engineer with an SDET background to join our team responsible for validating a complex web-based health insurance marketplace. This role combines hands-on manual testing, test automation development, and the use of AI tools in the SDLC. You will contribute to building reliable test coverage, improving automation, and ensuring overall product quality.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze requirements and workflows to design effective manual and automated test cases, prioritizing automation where appropriate
  • Perform comprehensive manual and automated testing, including exploratory, functional, regression, and end-to-end testing
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks for high-value and repeatable scenarios
  • Contribute to test coverage across UI, API, and integration layers
  • Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps and root cause insights
  • Use AI tools to enhance testing, including test case generation, defect analysis, automated test development, and test optimization
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to ensure quality throughout the SDLC
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster feedback cycles
  • Continuously evaluate and improve what should be tested manually vs. automated


Required Basic Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Proven experience in manual testing of web applications
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and best practices
  • Strong experience with SQL and data validation
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java)
  • Experience testing APIs and data-driven systems
  • Experience working with modern CI/CD pipelines
  • Comfort using AI tools within the software development lifecycle (e.g., AI-assisted test creation, code generation, debugging, or analysis tools)


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience testing complex, data-driven web applications
  • Familiarity with healthcare or health insurance or Medicaid domains
  • Experience with modern automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar)
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and microservices architectures
  • Experience with performance or load testing


Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation - All In range of ($120,000-$140,000). (Please note that salary and compensation may vary based on factors such as skills, experience, performance and location.)
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to:
  • Health, Dental, Life, Disability, and Vision insurance
  • Healthcare spending or reimbursement accounts (HSA/FSA)
  • Retirement benefits (401k)
  • Paid time off
  • Holidays: 13 paid days per year
  • Education assistance or tuition reimbursement
  • Employee discounts for Gym memberships & commuting/travel assistance


Our Vaues:

  • We believe that working hard, when it is imbued with purpose, can and should be fun.
  • You’ll find we are a “can do” place where people work together and roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
  • Everyone has a voice; everyone’s ideas count, and everyone is respected.
  • We have built a company, as well as a community of friends and colleagues, with respect for each other.


Information Security & Data Protection:

  • This role may involve access to sensitive or regulated information. The candidate is expected to handle all data in accordance with company security, privacy, and data protection policies.
  • Compliance with access control, data classification, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements is required.

descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Software Quality Engineer at vCluster Labs, you aren't just writing test cases; you are the architect of how we know our product works. You'll own test strategy end-to-end across a fast-moving codebase, build the automation frameworks that give engineering the confidence to ship daily, and be the voice for testability and reliability in every design conversation you're part of.

As a Senior Software Quality Engineer, your role will include:

  • Test framework ownership: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test frameworks spanning backend services and UI, built to scale with a fast-growing product.
  • Test strategy: Own and drive test strategy across services and features, ensuring coverage is thorough and tied directly to product goals, not just ticket checkboxes.
  • Cross-functional influence: Work closely with engineering and product to shape features early, advocate for testability, and align the team on what "quality" means for this product.
  • Architectural input: Sit in on architecture and design discussions, bringing a testability and reliability lens before code gets written, not after.
  • CI/CD integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) so engineers get fast, high-confidence feedback on every change.
  • Exploratory testing: Run exploratory testing to catch usability issues, edge cases, and regressions that automation won't find on its own.
  • Parallel execution: Move across multiple projects at once in a startup environment where priorities shift, without losing rigor.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience depth: 7+ years in QA or software testing, including 2+ years operating at a senior or staff level.
  • Programming ability: Strong hands-on skills in at least one of Go, Python, or JavaScript, used for building automation and tooling, not just scripting one-off checks.
  • AI-assisted QA workflow: Daily use of AI tools for reviewing PRs and design docs, writing test plans, and automating test cases, paired with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it yourself.
  • Ownership mindset: You spot what needs to happen and drive it forward without waiting to be told.
  • Startup fluency: Proven ability to stay calm under ambiguity and juggle competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to advocate for quality across engineering and product.
  • CI/CD depth: Deep understanding of CI/CD systems and hands-on experience integrating automated test suites into pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Kubernetes fluency: Working knowledge of Kubernetes environments and distributed systems, or a strong aptitude and willingness to learn quickly.
  • Debugging skill: Excellent analytical and debugging ability, particularly for backend and infrastructure-related issues.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience testing in tenant cluster or Tenant Isolation environments.
  • Prior experience owning QA at a startup through a period of rapid product growth.

About VCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At VCluster Labs, We Value And Stand For

  • Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
  • Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
  • Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
  • Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
  • Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: €65K - €110K

Description

SAIC is seeking a Software Test Engineer to join our NSITE team in Huntsville, AL.

The Network, System Integration and Test Environment (NSITE) is a Government owned, managed, and developed software suite. NSITE is used by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA), Joint Services, and numerous labs in support of continued testing of systems employed for defense of the United States and our Allies. The NSITE software provides data collection, situational awareness, and analysis capabilities to a wide range of users who benefit from NSITE’s ability to act as an independent third-party truth teller. The NSITE team has in-depth experience in Tactical Data Links (TDL), Ballistic Missile Defense System (BMDS) Test, Enterprise Information Technology, Software and Systems Engineering and Information Assurance.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Work on an agile development team where success is defined by the ability to understand your path forward, effectively communicate that path, and complete the task inherent to that path in a timely matter.
  • Analyze the software requirements from Interface Control Documents (ICD) to identify and verify what functionality needs to be tested.
  • Develop test documentation and conduct test cases to verify each software fix/change associated with correcting a software design deficiency or enhancement.
  • Provide inputs to formal test documents to include the Test Workbook, Test Readiness Review, and the post-test After Action Reports.
  • During the conduct of formal and informal tests, create problem reports in GitLab for each software implementation that does not comply with its associated software requirement.
  • Interface directly with members of Software and Functional Test Teams, NSITE Development Team, NSITE Operations Team, and NSITE Program Management.
  • Write and execute test procedures for Formal Qualification Tests. Work with Software Quality Control personnel as required during testing.
  • Actively participate in team meetings that include sprint kickoffs, sprint retrospectives, and daily standup meetings.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain automation scripts for application testing, ensuring thorough and reliable test coverage.
  • Develop application and test automation codes and scripts.

Qualifications

Education Requirements

  • BS in Computer Science or related degree and two (2) years’ or more experience; Additional six (6) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree (per contract vehicle).

Clearance Requirements

  • Active Secret Clearance, or ability to acquire one; US Citizenship required.

Required Qualifications

  • Self-starter; able to function independently and in a team environment where priorities and assignments can quickly shift.
  • 2-5 years’ experience in software testing and test automation.
  • Ability to create structured test documentation and standard work instructions tailored to varying levels of technical detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of common computer network protocols.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Tactical Communications Data Links (6016, 3011, DIS, VMF, B Series, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of Agile Software Development processes.
  • Familiarity with GitLab.
  • Experience operating or testing 3D graphical displays.
  • Currently have an Information Assurance Technical certification (CompTia A+, Net+ or Sec+) or the ability to obtain one.

Travel Required

  • Less than 10% annually.

Target salary range $60,001 - $100,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.
