We're Hiring: Quality Assurance Engineer at True Rx Health Strategists!

At True Rx Health Strategists, we're passionate about building better healthcare solutions through innovation, technology, and continuous improvement. We're looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer - Automation & Business Processes who thrives on problem-solving, process improvement, and creating scalable automation solutions that improve quality across the organization.

If you're someone who enjoys building automated testing frameworks, uncovering opportunities for efficiency, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring systems perform reliably, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks and scripts to support application and business process validation
  • Create and execute functional, regression, and end-to-end test cases
  • Monitor automated test pipelines, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve test reliability
  • Expand automation coverage for high-risk and high-volume business processes
  • Validate business rules and system workflows through automated testing
  • Analyze test results, identify defects, and provide actionable recommendations
  • Develop and manage realistic test data that reflects real-world business scenarios and edge cases
  • Report on quality metrics, trends, and automation effectiveness
  • Collaborate closely with developers, analysts, and business stakeholders to define testing strategies and acceptance criteria
  • Participate in project planning, requirements reviews, and user acceptance testing readiness activities
  • Communicate testing outcomes and potential risks clearly to project teams and leadership
  • Maintain documentation for test cases, automation frameworks, and quality standards
  • Support training efforts and knowledge sharing across teams
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 3-5 years of experience in quality assurance, test automation, or a related discipline
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cucumber, TestNG, or comparable technologies
  • Experience working with SQL and data validation techniques
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills
  • Flexibility, adaptability, and a willingness to support evolving business needs

True Rx Health Strategist Benefits

  • Path to Wellness: Health, Vision, & Dental Insurance, Health Savings Account, and Wellness Incentives for a balanced life.
  • Financial Fitness: 401k Matching and Employer-Provided Life Insurance to secure your future.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Flex Time, Hybrid/Fully Remote Work, Paid Time Off, and 8 Paid Holidays for a well-rounded lifestyle.

We’ve been pharmacy innovators since the Wright Brothers took flight. For more than 120 years, we have been innovating pharmacy solutions and taking care of patients. Our team of pharmacists and strategists delivers proven programs that find maximum savings and minimum disruption by creating a benefits plan that fits the unique needs of clients and patients. Learn more about us here.

Our Mission

True Rx Health Strategists cultivates health, integrity, innovation, and care to transcend pharmacy benefit solutions for employers and patients.

As a pharmacist-led company, True Rx Health Strategists has an oath to treat members as patients. descriptionHtml:
WHO are we looking for?

CAPTRUST is seeking a Quality Assurance Automation Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing tests, debugging and defining corrective actions in both manual and automated testing contexts. A successful candidate for this role will review system requirements, create test cases in both manual and automated formats, manage test suites, execute test cases, manage defects and track multiple quality assurance metrics. This role includes participating in the software development life cycle (SDLC) and communicating with the Business Analysts, Product Managers, Developers and other project team members including business and operations stakeholders. This individual must be highly motivated, detailed oriented and ready continue building our comprehensive QA program that not only safeguards the quality of our software but also foster a “quality culture” within the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Interpret , build upon, and comply with company quality assurance standards
  • Carefully maintain defect records and track until completion and testing of fixes, assist in root cause analysis and help to implement corrective and preventative actions to prevent recurrence
  • Document quality assurance activities with internal reporting and audits
  • Improve standards for quality across all phases including production and design
  • Identify training needs and take action to ensure company-wide awareness and compliance with quality mandates
  • Pursue continuing education on new solutions, technology, and skills
  • Develop and execute exploratory and automated tests to ensure product quality throughout the SDLC
  • Creating detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field required or equivalent experience
  • 2-5 years of experience as a Quality Assurance Analyst/Associate
  • Intermediate understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) in an agile (two week sprint) setting
  • Intermediate ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical product and business users
  • Intermediate ability to understand application interactions at the various layers - data, API, UI - and to utilize various testing tools and methodologies to test complex systems effectively and efficiently
  • Beginner ability to contribute automated tests to an existing framework and execute within an existing pipeline
  • Intermediate SQL testing experience to include SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE and multiple JOIN types to help retrieve and manipulate medium and larger data sets.
  • Beginner ability with VS Code or other modern IDE
  • Beginner ability with test automation utilizing Selenium, Playwright or other modern open source offerings

descriptionHtml:
About CoreSite:

CoreSite is a leading colocation data center company providing the space, power, cooling and connectivity that businesses rely on to operate and grow. Our data centers bring dozens of organizations together under one roof, supporting the technology and services that keep our world connected. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing the expertise, ideas and commitment that power our business and help our customers succeed. With a culture built on collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence, CoreSite is a place to make an impact.

 

Quality Assurance Engineer:

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our dynamic development team. In this role, you will be responsible for defining test strategies, writing comprehensive test plans, and driving both manual and automated testing efforts. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of QA methodologies, hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks, and the ability to bridge the gap between technical execution and business requirements. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable software solutions.

 

Duties:

  • QA Strategy & Planning: Define, design, and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios across the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Test Automation: Build, maintain, and scale robust automated testing frameworks for web applications.
  • Agile Collaboration: Participate actively in sprint planning, refinement, and daily stand-ups, advocating for TDD/BDD practices to ensure quality is integrated from the start.
  • Defect Management: Identify, log, track, and manage defects using test management tools, collaborating closely with developers to ensure swift resolution.
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines.
  • API & Platform Verification: Perform rigorous API testing and validate core platform functionalities, including specific enterprise CRM ecosystems.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Effectively communicate complex technical issues, risks, and test coverage status to both technical engineering teams and non-technical business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Technical Expertise

  • Automation Frameworks: Strong, hands-on experience in test automation using Selenium and Java.
  • Methodologies: Deep understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) paradigms.
  • Test Management: Proficiency with industry-standard tools such as Jira and TestRail for requirement traceability and defect tracking.
  • API Testing: Solid experience testing RESTful/SOAP APIs using tools like Postman or Parasoft SOATest.
  • CI/CD Tools: Practical knowledge of Continuous Integration environments, specifically Jenkins, to execute automated nightly or regression builds.
  • Enterprise Platforms: Strong working knowledge or foundational experience testing within the Salesforce ecosystem.

Professional Skills

  • QA Fundamentals: Strong core knowledge of manual QA processes, regression testing, and test design techniques.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical skills with a sharp eye for detail and edge-case scenarios.

Education/Experience:

  • Experience in SalesForce Testing.
  • Familiarity with version control systems like Git.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

 

Compensation: Compensation for this role includes a base salary between $86,200.00 and $99,400.00. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus and equity, based upon individual and company performance.

Job Post Timeline: This position is expected to be open for applications for 30 days.

 

Benefits: Not only does CoreSite have a fun, team-focused work environment, but we also offer great benefits to all employees regularly scheduled to work more than 20 hours a week!

  • Medical coverage starting day one, plus dental, vision, telemedicine, HSA/FSA options.
  • 401(k) with a 5% company match, plus bonus and equity opportunities.
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
  • Starting 16 days of PTO, 11 paid company holidays, floating holidays and additional paid time for volunteering, family care, parental leave and other life events.
  • Free parking or public transportation support.

Additional Perks:

  • Up to $800 annually in wellness reimbursements and up to $450 in wellness incentives.
  • $100 monthly technology stipend.
  • Up to $5,250 annually in educational reimbursement plus LinkedIn Learning.
  • Up to $5,000 annually in charitable donation matching.
  • Financial coaching and student loan support.
  • Family planning, mental health, and caregiving support.
  • Pet insurance, employee discounts and cash back offers.

General Statements:

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas.
  • Please note that all offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and, where permitted by law, a 5-panel drug test conducted after the offer letter is signed, which will screen for THC, opiates, PCP, cocaine, and amphetamines. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Applicant Privacy Notice:

  • CoreSite is committed to protecting the privacy and security of personal information submitted by applicants. The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) requires us to provide you information about our personal information handling practices. As a result, we’re providing this Privacy Notice that describes how we collect, use, share, and update personal information from individuals who wish to be considered for employment with CoreSite. To read the Applicant Privacy Notice, please go to https://www.coresite.com/applicant-privacy-notice.
  • Unauthorized reproduction or distribution of this job posting on external sites is prohibited without prior written consent from CoreSite. We are not responsible for any postings or offers not originating from our official channels or approved partners.

Job Description

ECS is seeking a QA Automation Engineer to work remotely.

We are seeking a QA Automation Engineer with experience in end-to-end testing, test automation, performance testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to join the Professional Services team. This role will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive testing strategy across functional, integration, automation, performance, security, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.

The ideal candidate will have experience validating complex web applications, APIs, data platforms, and third-party integrations. This individual will work closely with engineering teams, technical leadership, and customer stakeholders to ensure solutions meet functional requirements, performance expectations, security controls, and release readiness criteria.

Candidates should have hands-on experience with automation frameworks and testing tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Python-based testing solutions, Jira, Confluence, and performance testing tools such as Locust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional, integration, end-to-end, performance, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Define test strategies, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and release readiness metrics in collaboration with project stakeholders.
  • Design, develop, and execute automated test suites for web applications, APIs, and integrated workflows.
  • Perform end-to-end testing across frontend applications, APIs, Databricks environments, and third-party platform integrations.
  • Validate integrations spanning web applications, backend services, data platforms, and external systems.
  • Execute functional testing across multiple user personas and business workflows.
  • Coordinate and facilitate multiple rounds of User Acceptance Testing (UAT), document findings, validate remediation efforts, and support final release approvals.
  • Design and execute performance and load testing using tools such as Locust, validating system behavior under concurrent user activity and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure software quality and system stability prior to production releases.
  • Validate role-based access controls, security requirements, governance controls, and data access restrictions.
  • Identify, document, classify, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Collaborate with engineers, TPMs, product owners, and customer stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Produce testing reports, quality metrics, defect summaries, and release recommendations.
  • Utilize Jira and Confluence to manage testing activities, document results, and track defects and remediation efforts.

Salary Range: $140,000-$165,000

General Description Of Benefits

Required Skills

  • Active Secret Clearance
  • Experience with UAT (User Acceptance Testing)
  • Strong background in Software Quality Assurance (SW QA)
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective test cases
  • Experience identifying and documenting defects clearly and concisely
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Effective communication skills for cross‑team collaboration

Desired Skills

  • Active Secret Clearance.
  • Experience with end-to-end testing, software quality assurance, and test automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright for automated web application testing.
  • Experience developing automated test frameworks and automated regression test suites.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining automated testing pipelines.
  • Experience using Python-based testing tools, including performance and load testing solutions such as Locust.
  • Experience testing web applications, REST APIs, and distributed system integrations.
  • Experience testing applications deployed within secure cloud environments, including AWS GovCloud and IL5 environments.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, data engineering workflows, ETL pipelines, Delta Lake, and AI/ML-enabled platforms.
  • Experience validating integrations with external platforms and services, including data, analytics, and AI-related systems.
  • Experience testing React or other modern web application frameworks.
  • Familiarity with RBAC, data governance controls, compliance requirements, and secure application workflows.
  • Experience conducting performance, load, regression, functional, integration, and UAT testing.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments using Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting production releases and formal release readiness activities.

  • Deliver quality products by thoroughly testing throughout all phases of development life cycle (Regression, Functional, Integration, End to End testing) using a combination of testing methods.
  • Develop testing tools that can improve the reliability and efficiency of testing.
  • Collaborate with offshore teams to validate and obtain approvals for software release build distribution.

Marginal Job Functions

  • Other projects as assigned.
  • Evening conference calls with global teams (as needed)
  • International travel (as needed)

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related engineering field

Experience

  • Classroom project level experience with object-oriented programming such as C++ or Java.
  • Familiar with Android Studio
  • Familiar with using shell scripting in Unix.
  • Familiar with Ubuntu and Windows platforms and commands.
  • Passionate about software quality assurance.

  • Wellness programs

descriptionHtml:
Are you inquisitive? Thorough? Diplomatic? Ever worked as part of a program that is Agile? Are you interested in being an agent of change on a team committed to achieving client-focused, mission-driven excellence?

Steampunk is looking for you to join our team as a Test Engineer . You'll implement automation for increased efficiency and provide hands-on testing and QA expertise in mission critical work across our client base.

Contributions

Responsibilities

As a Test Engineer, you will work with our growing DevSecOps practice delivering quality assurance services to support application, cloud and data systems development. We are looking for candidates with 3-5 years experience with experience with quality assurance and test automation practices in an Agile/DevSecOps work environment. Responsibilities include:

  • Understanding the needs of stakeholders and conveying this to developers
  • Meet with product design team to determine testing parameters
  • Write test plans, create test cases, test procedures, bug reports, final QA reports for products
  • Manage test data architecture definition and requests
  • Troubleshoot errors and streamline the test procedures
  • Testing and examining code written by others and analyzing results, including three or more of the following:
    • Data validation testing
    • Functional testing
    • Performance and load testing
    • Usability testing
    • Accessibility (508) testing
  • Establishing automated testing tools and infrastructure for test automation
  • Provide validation testing of different system and data sets for cloud migrations
  • Develop automated testing scripts considering parallelization and idempotency
  • Automate and improve development, testing, deployment, and release processes
  • Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats
  • Working with software developers and software engineers to ensure that development follows established processes and works as intended
  • Document as-is state of the environment, perform a gap analysis, and produce artifacts that articulate options and recommendations
  • Leverage virtualization and containerization to optimize testing software systems
  • Work with teams to bring continuous improvement to DevSecOps processes and tools.
  • Engineer and implement solutions and provide recommendations for continuous improvement for the services provided
  • Present regular status updates and provide cross training to other DevOps team members.
  • Act as an individual contributor and mentor more junior team members
Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain a U.S. government Security Clearance
  • BS Degree in an IT field OR BS in a non-IT field and 2 years related IT experience
  • 3 Years of Experience with Git SCM providers such as GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket
  • 3 Years of Experience with one or more programming or scripting languages
  • 3 Years of application DevSecOps Experience with actual/active development experience in an Agile environment
  • Experience utilizing docker containers and utilizing platforms such as Kubernetes
  • 3 Years of Experience implementing test automation, using tools such as Selenium, Appium, Soap UI, RestAssured, Postman
  • Experience integrating test automation including performance, security, and functional tests into CI/CD Pipelines
  • Experience with performance and load testing
  • Experience in one or more cloud computing environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Preferred

  • Certifications:
    • CAST (Certified Associate in Software Testing)
    • International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) Certification
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills
  • Experience with documenting an as-is state of the environment, perform a gap analysis, and produce artifacts that articulate options and recommendations preferred
About Steampunk

Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $90,000 to $130,000. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here.

Identity Statement

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Steampunk is a Change Agent in the Federal contracting industry, bringing new thinking to clients in the Homeland, Federal Civilian, Health and DoD sectors. Through our Human-Centered delivery methodology, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges. If you want to learn more about our story, visit http://www.steampunk.com .

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Cyber Software Test Engineer

Peraton's Space & Intelligence Sector is looking for an experienced Automated Software Test Engineer to design, implement, and maintain automated testing frameworks that ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. The ideal candidate has a strong background in automated test development, continuous integration workflows, and modern testing tools.

This role will support ongoing development efforts by creating scalable test solutions, improving test coverage, and contributing to overall software quality throughout the SDLC. This position is 100% onsite working in our Herndon SCIF.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test scripts for functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.
  • Design and implement scalable automated test frameworks and harnesses.
  • Collaborate closely with developers to identify testing needs and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and document defects with clear and actionable detail.
  • Support manual testing when needed and help define overall QA best practices.
  • Contribute to requirement reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning when necessary.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree with 8 years of relevant experience OR a Master's degree with 6 years of relevant experience; An additional 4 years of experience considered in lieu of a degree requirement
  • Active TS/SCI clearance with poloygraph
  • Extensive experience with automated software testing
  • Experience with automated test tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, JMeter, SoapUI, or Junit.
  • Experience documenting test plans/procedures.
  • Experience maintaining and enhancing existing automated software testing scripts
  • Experience in an Agile software development environment utilizing Python
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software development experience in a virtual environment like AWS
  • Experience working with developers to ensure test coverage and quality gates.
  • Experience with Jenkins, and Gitlab

Details

Target Salary Range: $112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a member of IT Strategy & Business Management role, as a Senior Automation Test Engineer you will develop, conduct, and evaluate testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. This role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Building robust, scalable, and high-quality test automation solutions for functional and regression testing.
  • Developing code for quality automation and ensuring extensive test coverage of the code.
  • Building, customizing, deploying, and managing the test automation frameworks.

NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above.*

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent in Computer Science or related field (e.g. Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering).
  • Min 6 years of relevant experience

Talents Needed For Success

  • 3+ years of QA Testing experience
  • 2 Years hands on Automation Experience
  • Experience using Java, TestNG, Selenium.
  • Must have experience with Xpath axes and CSS selectors
  • Firm knowledge of automation standard and best practices
  • In depth knowledge of common automation design patterns such as the page object model
  • In depth knowledge of software development methodologies
  • Strong debugging and triage skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Strong analysis and problem solving skills
  • Candidate must be organized, detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and able to handle multiple responsibilities in an enterprise agile environment
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Demonstrate a high level of motivation confidence, integrity, and responsibility.
  • Strong knowledge of agile best practices including QA’s role on a scrum team
  • Must be able to present work in a clear and understandable manner
  • Must be able to work independently with minimal assistance

Preferred

  • Experience working with multithreaded test execution

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We're hiring Associate Quality Engineers to work at Veeva, working on various products in the Life Sciences industry encompassing the fields of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.

As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing of software, ensuring customer success with every release.

Graduates or anyone curious about Quality Engineering can apply. Our onboarding program provides a dedicated buddy to guide you through the process, and our collaborative environment is the perfect place to enhance your skills alongside like-minded engineers.

What You'll Do

  • Create testing-related documentation, including test plans, test cases/scripts, and bug reports assessing quality and associated risk
  • Automate and work closely with the automation group to automate features for better regression coverage
  • Triage and/or assist with triaging of automation results
  • Develop deep expertise in the product
  • Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines
  • Work with software engineers, product managers, and other QA testers in an Agile team environment

Requirements

  • Experience coding in Java AND/OR mobile languages
  • Understanding of Software QA methodologies, tools, and approaches (black box and/or automated testing) in a software company with short-release cycles
  • Graduate or relevant work experience, including software development and/or software test automation
  • Curiosity and ability to quickly learn new technologies
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Must be located in the PST/MST timezone

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SQL
  • Knowledge of Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming language
  • Knowledge of Atlassian products like Jira, Greenhopper, and Clover is an advantage
  • Knowledge of modern best practices for software development
  • Knowledge of Mobile Testing and Automation –Appium, XCUI, Espresso, KIF
  • Knowledge of Mobile Apps Development (Android/iOS)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    • A conversation with the hiring manager
    • A practical case exercise
    • A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $70,000 - $100,000 USD
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. About The Role

Total Wine & More is seeking a Senior QA Engineer, to join our Tecnology team in our Bethesda, MD office to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our digital platforms. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain automated tests across web, mobile, and API layers to support scalable, high-quality software delivery. You will collaborate closely with engineers, fellow QA team members, and platform engineering teams to integrate automation early in the development lifecycle, enhance CI/CD pipelines, and continuously improve test coverage. The ideal candidate brings strong test automation skills, a solid understanding of modern development practices, and a commitment to driving quality throughout the engineering process. You will report to the Sr. Director, Engineering.

You will

  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product managers to understand features, acceptance criteria, and test scope.
  • Write and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scripts for manual and automated testing.
  • Develop and execute automated tests using modern frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for web applications and Postman / REST Assured for API testing.
  • Participate in code reviews for test scripts and automation frameworks to ensure maintainability and consistency.
  • Contribute to CI/CD integration by automating smoke, regression, and functional tests within pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps).
  • Log, track, and verify defects using tools such as Jira, Zephyr, or TestRail; work with developers to validate fixes.
  • Contribute to test data setup and mocking/stubbing as needed for reliable automation.
  • Support non-functional testing such as performance, accessibility (a11y), or security in collaboration with senior engineers.

You will come with

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field required or equivalent years of experience.
  • 3-6 years experience in software testing or test automation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running automated UI and API tests using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Postman.
  • Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Java).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for automation execution and reporting.
  • Good understanding of QA fundamentals, including functional, regression, and integration testing.
  • Exposure to BDD frameworks such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Gauge is a plus.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON structures, and basic API validation principles.
  • Experience using Git for version control and collaboration.
  • Ability to debug issues across environments and communicate findings clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership, and curiosity to learn new automation techniques.
  • Familiarity with microservices testing, mock servers, or contract testing.
  • Awareness of performance testing tools (k6, JMeter) or accessibility testing (axe-core, Lighthouse).
  • Interest in AI-assisted testing or intelligent test optimization tools.

We offer

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous store discounts
  • Health care plans (medical, prescription, dental, vision)
  • 401(k), HSA, FSA, Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Disability & life insurance coverage
  • Paid parental leave
  • Pet insurance
  • Critical illness and accident insurance
  • Discounted home and auto insurance
  • College tuition assistance
  • Career development & product training
  • Consumer classes
  • & More!

Crafted for you

We recognize our team members are our biggest asset, and we value the critical role each play in contributing to the company’s success. It is our commitment to support and provide access to the resources needed to take care of their health and wellbeing. That is why we offer a variety of benefits, tools, and resources to support through our Total Rewards program. To view our full career page, click here: https://careers.totalwine.com/!

Job Summary

The Senior Associate – QA Tester designs, develops, and executes test cases to ensure the quality, reliability, and security of applications and solutions. Building on foundational QA experience, this role is responsible for creating and maintaining test automation frameworks, supporting regression and integration testing, and ensuring alignment with SDLC and SSDLC practices. The Senior Associate – QA Tester works closely with developers, product owners, and business analysts to validate functionality and drive continuous improvement in testing practices.

Essential Duties

  • Design, develop, and maintain manual and automated test cases, scripts, and frameworks.
  • Plan and execute regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA peers, and business analysts to ensure requirements are testable and verifiable.
  • Perform defect tracking, logging, and validation to resolution.
  • Apply QA best practices and ensure alignment with SDLC and SSDLC.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation tools, processes, and QA standards.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, providing QA insights to improve delivery quality and velocity.

Successful Characteristics/Skills

  • Experience & Background
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in QA testing, automation, or related technical roles.
  • Practical experience with test planning, execution, and automation in Agile environments.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and integration testing practices.
  • Core Technical Proficiency
  • Proficiency in test planning and execution across multiple testing types (functional, regression, integration, UAT).

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Effective communicator, able to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Growth mindset with eagerness to adopt new testing practices and tools.

AI Test Engineer II


Department: Software Engineering

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote


Introduction

SG2 Recruiting has partnered with Trend Health Partners to spearhead the search for a visionary AI Test Engineer II. This is a pivotal opportunity to join a dynamic team and directly influence the company’s next phase of growth. If you are a strategic thinker ready to make a tangible impact, we want to hear from you.


Company Overview

At Trend Health Partners, we are transforming healthcare reimbursement through a tech-enabled payment integrity platform that aligns the common objectives of payers and providers. Our mission is to eliminate friction and administrative waste, fostering true collaboration that ultimately expands patient access to high-quality care. By cultivating an innovative, agile, and transparent culture, we empower our engineering teams to build high-impact technology solutions that solve healthcare's most complex challenges.


Your Role

As an AI Test Engineer II, you validate and elevate the quality, reliability, and safety of AI-powered systems across the Trend Health Partners platform. In this mid-level role, you will build and maintain automated testing suites, integrate AI-assisted engineering tools into your daily workflows, and safeguard data integrity across distributed cloud systems. Working alongside senior engineers, QA peers, and product managers, you will help ensure our payment integrity products run seamlessly, securely, and at high performance.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites spanning API, UI, regression, and integration testing layers.
  • Develop resilient end-to-end tests using Playwright (or modern equivalent frameworks), focusing on maintainability and minimizing test flakiness.
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding and testing tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and related tools) to accelerate test creation, refactor code, and optimize testing workflows.
  • Author and execute API tests for REST and GraphQL services, validating data contracts, schema integrity, and edge-case error handling.
  • Perform security and performance checks as part of regular release cycles, testing basic OWASP hygiene, access controls, and system responsiveness under load.
  • Validate data integrity across integrations and backend data pipelines using solid SQL queries and automated data validation scripts.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within an Agile development team, taking an active role in sprint ceremonies, release validations, and root-cause analysis for reported defects.


What You Will Need


Must-Haves

  • Core Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), with 2–4+ years of dedicated experience in QA automation or software test engineering.
  • Test Automation Tooling: Hands-on proficiency building automated tests with modern web frameworks (Playwright strongly preferred; Cypress or Selenium acceptable) and API validation tools.
  • Data & Cloud Fundamentals: Solid SQL skills to verify database transactions and data pipelines, plus experience testing services in cloud environments (AWS preferred).
  • CI/CD & Agile Workflows: Working knowledge of integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines within standard Agile/Scrum development sprints.


Nice-to-Haves

  • AI/ML Curiosity & Validation: Hands-on exposure to validating AI/ML-generated outputs, prompt-based workflows, or using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot) in real testing workflows.
  • Specialized Testing Tools: Exposure to performance or load testing tools (e.g., k6, JMeter) and security scanning utilities (e.g., OWASP ZAP).
  • Regulated Healthcare Environments: Background working with healthcare technologies, HIPAA-compliant systems, or protected health data.


Logistics

  • Salary Range: $130,000 – $150,000 per year (commensurate with experience)
  • Work Location: 100% Remote (United States)
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; paid parental leave; and competitive paid time off (PTO).


Mental and Physical Demands

  • Work Environment: Sedentary role performed primarily in an indoor/home office environment using computer hardware and standard office equipment.
  • Physical Demands: Repetitive motion from continuous computer keyboarding, mouse use, and sustained screen viewing throughout the workday.
  • Mental Demands: High level of sustained focus and analytical reasoning, complex problem solving, technical documentation review, and frequent written and verbal communication across distributed remote teams.


Related Duties as Assigned

  • This job description documents the general nature and level of work expected for this position; it is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities or tasks. You may be asked to perform additional related duties as operational and business needs dictate.
  • Candidates and employees may be required to fulfill compliance requirements mandated by our business partners, including background checks, credential verification, and adherence to strict protocols for protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII). All processes adhere to Title VII of the Civil Rights Act and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).


Equal Opportunity and Disability Statement

Trend Health Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We make all employment decisions based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

companyDescription: Founded in 1987, CFD Research develops innovative technologies that advance national security, aerospace, defense, life sciences, materials, and energy. companySlogan: Delivering Breakthrough Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About CFD Research: Since its inception in 1987, CFD Research has delivered innovative technology solutions within the Aerospace & Defense, Biomedical & Life Sciences, Intelligence & Sensing, and Energy & Materials industries. CFD Research has earned multiple national awards for successful application and commercialization of innovative component/system technology prototypes, multi-physics simulation software, multi-disciplinary analyses, and expert support services. Based in Huntsville, Alabama where laboratory facilities and headquarters are located, CFD Research also has office and laboratory facilities in Dayton, Ohio, prototyping test and evaluation facilities in Hollywood, Alabama, and office facilities in Fort Walton Beach, Florida. CFD Research is an ISO9001:AS9100D registered company and is appraised at CMMI Level II for Services. CFD Research is a 100% ESOP (employee-owned company) recognized in Inc. Magazine's Inc5000 as a top growing company for four of the last five years. Learn more at www.cfd-research.com

CFD Research is seeking Automated Test Engineers to validate, verify, and stress-test core software capabilities. You will construct automated test suites, execute unit testing frameworks, and perform formal software verification workflows to guarantee that operational software meets rigorous mission criteria.

Basic Qualifications

  • Security Clearance: Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active Department of Defense Secret clearance (must maintain throughout contract performance).
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in software verification, quality assurance, and automated system testing.
  • Technical Proficiency: Mastery of automated testing frameworks, unit test creation, test script generation, and test report compilation.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience testing complex real-time software systems or missile defense simulation technologies.
  • Proficient track record working in an Agile/Scrum delivery framework.

Location: This role is based in the Huntsville, AL area, and is 100% onsite.

Benefits: CFD Research offers competitive salaries and excellent employee benefits, including an employer matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). CFD Research offers our Full-Time, permanent employee-owners a highly competitive insurance package, including medical, vision, and dental insurance. Additionally, we offer company paid leave, compensation time, parental leave, long-term and short-term disability, accidental death and dismemberment, and life insurance. Part-Time and Temporary employee-owners may receive partial or reduced benefits and leave time based on their employment status level. Performance appraisals occur twice a year and annual pay increases are based upon corporate goals, personal development, performance, and outstanding achievements. In addition, group and individual bonuses are awarded for exceptional performance.

CFD Research is an EO employer - Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories

QA (Quality Assurance) Engineer

Location: Pittsburgh, PA (Hybrid)

Classification: Exempt

Status: Full-Time

Reports to: Manager, Quality Assurance Business

Purpose

PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy is looking for a talented and experienced intermediate level professional IT QA (Quality Assurance) Engineer to join our Specialty Pharmacy team. As a member of our IT Quality Assurance team, you will design and execute test plans to ensure the highest quality software products for our specialty pharmacy customers.

The ideal candidate for this role will have strong technical knowledge of software quality assurance and emerging AI-driven testing methodologies. The candidate should have excellent communication and problem-solving skills and be able to think critically to evaluate and analyze software applications. This position will be responsible for evangelizing and executing QA policies and procedures, adhering to QA standards, and monitoring the QA process to ensure a high quality of deliverables.

Responsibilities

  • Develops test plans and executes test cases based on business requirements.
  • Ability to test across multiple platforms and applications on mobile and desktop as well as APIs
  • Monitors the QA process to ensure the highest quality of deliverables.
  • Follows comprehensive QA processes and procedures.
  • Analyzes and evaluates QA results.
  • Provides a voice during team meetings and scrum ceremonies.
  • Writes SQL queries to set up and validate test data.
  • Communicates QA results to stakeholders.
  • Develops and implements automated testing.
  • Ability to leverage AI-powered testing tools and frameworks to enhance test coverage and efficiency.
  • Implements machine learning models for predictive defect analysis and risk-based testing.
  • Utilizes AI-driven test case generation and optimization techniques.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in software quality assurance.
  • Knowledge of software testing processes and methodology.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Basic understanding of AI concepts and their application in software testing.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven software tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Two (2) years of experience testing mobile applications.
  • Experience testing SMS.
  • Experience testing APIs
  • Experience in the pharmacy industry
  • Experience using proprietary project and issue tracking software (Azure DevOps, JIRA, etc.).
  • Experience using test management systems (Azure Test Plans, TestRail, etc.)
  • Experience in developing and implementing automated testing using a scripting language (C# preferred) and Selenium.
  • Experience with AI-based visual testing and intelligent defect prediction tools.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, see, talk, or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Visual acuity is necessary for tasks such as reading, or working with various forms of data on a screen for extended periods. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Benefits

Hybrid, remote and flexible on-site work schedules are available, based on the position. PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy also affords an excellent benefit package, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, health savings and flexible spending accounts, 401K with employer matching, employer-paid life insurance and short/long term disability coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program! Generous paid time off is also available to all full-time employees, as well as limited paid time off for part-time employees. Of course we offer paid holidays too!

Equal Opportunity

PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer, and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotions or any term or condition of employment based on race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran's status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

descriptionHtml:
About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a results driven Software Quality Engineer with 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, preferably within the retail industry. The ideal candidate will lead end-to-end quality engineering efforts, including manual and automated testing, API and database validation, defect management, and test strategy execution across enterprise and distributed applications. Working on-site in Irving, TX, this role will collaborate closely with vendors, customers, project managers, program managers, developers, DevOps teams, and QE leadership to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases aligned with functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Perform end-to-end system validation, including functional, integration, system, and regression testing across distributed applications.
  • Develop and execute test scenarios for applications deployed on Kubernetes clusters, validating scalability, resiliency, and fault tolerance under dynamic workloads
  • Implement and drive Behavior Driven Development (BDD) practices and contribute to quality engineering culture.
  • Validate application behavior and performance in edge computing environments, ensuring reliability under constrained network, latency, and offline scenarios
  • Manage the defect lifecycle, including identification, logging, prioritization, tracking, and closure using standard tools.
  • Conduct detailed root cause analysis (RCA) of defects using logs [java, xml, json etc.], monitoring tools, and data analysis techniques to ensure effective resolution.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, DevOps, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues and improve product quality.
  • Validate APIs, databases, and system integrations, ensuring contract compliance and data integrity across services.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure adherence to quality standards, testing best practices, and CI/CD processes, while continuously enhancing test coverage and efficiency.

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field with 3–5 years of QA experience in enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience in manual and automated testing methodologies and tools.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and database validation (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, PractiTest, or HP QC.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including defect triaging and root cause analysis.
  • Working knowledge of object-oriented programming (Java, Python, or similar) for test automation development.
  • Experience in retail domain applications, including POS systems and transaction flows (preferred but highly valued).
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and stakeholders

This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake additional duties and projects that are consistent with their skills, capabilities, and the overall purpose of the position

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

Statement to Third Party Agencies

To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes

descriptionHtml:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?

As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!

Join Amazon's Prime Video Ads QA team, where we ensure seamless ad delivery across millions of customers worldwide and deliver high-quality advertising experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for Prime Video Ads platform, ensuring high coverage across functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Participate in org-level quality initiatives and define QA strategy & test plans across multiple concurrent projects, collaborating with engineering, product, and data science teams.
  • Leverage AI in test automation to generate test cases, predict risk areas, detect anomalies, and accelerate defect resolution.
  • Drive shift-left testing practices by embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle, including requirements review and design validation.
  • Track quality metrics and KPIs, providing data-driven insights to stakeholders on release readiness.
  • Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively drive improvements to reduce customer-impacting defects.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated tests are integrated and executed efficiently across build and deployment workflows.

A day in the life

As a QAE on the Prime Video Ads team, your day involves collaborating with engineers, program and product managers to review requirements, identify risks early, and define test strategies. You'll write and review automation scripts, triage failures in CI/CD pipelines, and leverage AI tools to improve test coverage. You will optimize QA processes using AI adoption. You'll participate in sprint ceremonies, contribute to design reviews, and mentor junior QA engineers. You'll also partner with development teams to validate ad delivery and measurement accuracy, and present quality metrics to stakeholders to drive release readiness decisions.

About The Team

The Prime Video Ads QA team is at the forefront of ensuring seamless and high-quality advertising experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We are a passionate group of quality engineers who thrive on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our team works closely with engineering, product, and data science teams to deliver reliable and impactful advertising solutions at scale. We embrace a culture of ownership, where every team member is empowered to drive quality initiatives and make a meaningful impact. We are committed to leveraging AI tools and automation to stay ahead in a fast-paced, ever-evolving landscape.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience in manual testing
  • Experience in automation testing
  • Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in API & Mobile testing
  • Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

Role Description

QA Engineer

The Role

UST is seeking a highly motivated QA Engineer with strong Pharmacy and Retail domain experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in testing pharmacy applications, prescription processing workflows, claims management, fulfillment systems, inventory management, and pharmacy-related integrations.

The candidate should be proficient in both manual and automation testing with strong API and end-to-end testing capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
  • Perform Functional, Integration, API, Regression, System, and End-to-End testing.
  • Validate pharmacy business processes including:
  • Prescription intake and processing
  • Claims adjudication
  • Medication fulfillment
  • Inventory management
  • Pharmacy operations workflows
  • Test and validate data quality, data migration, and system integrations.
  • Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites.
  • Execute API testing using REST services and validate backend integrations.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Developers, Architects, and Stakeholders to ensure quality deliverables.
  • Identify, document, track, and validate defects through resolution.
  • Support release validation, production deployment testing, and post-release verification.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Ensure quality standards and best practices are followed throughout the SDLC.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

What You Need

  • Experience Range: 5 - 10 Years
  • Test Automation using: Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Rest Assured, Functional Testing, API Testing
  • Integration Testing, Regression Testing, End-to-End Testing, Test Automation Framework Development
  • API & Backend Testing: Postman, REST APIs, API Validation
  • Service Integration Testing
  • Data Validation: SQL, ETL Testing, Big Data Validation, Spark, Hadoop
  • DevOps & Tools: CI/CD Pipelines, Git, JIRA. Test Management Tools
  • 5+ years of Quality Assurance experience.
  • 3+ years of Pharmacy/Retail domain testing experience preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright and API automation.
  • Proven experience in end-to-end and integration testing of enterprise applications.
  • Knowledge of:
  • Prescription Processing
  • Pharmacy Claims Management
  • Medication Fulfillment
  • Inventory Management
  • Pharmacy Operations
  • Understanding pharmacy application workflows, business processes, and integrations.
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience testing Pharmacy Management Systems (PMS), Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) platforms, or Retail Pharmacy applications.
  • Experience working with healthcare or pharmacy-related integrations.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience with test automation architecture and framework design.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based testing environments is a plus.

Location & Compensation

Compensation can differ depending on factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, education, and level of experience. UST provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in various U.S. markets as set forth below.

Role Location: Bentonville, Arkansas

Compensation Range: $68,000-$102,000

Who We Are

Since 1999, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a powerful impact through transformation. Headquartered in the United States, UST is powered by technology, driven by AI, inspired by people, and led by our purpose, we partner with our clients from design to operation. Our AI-driven digital solutions, proprietary platforms, engineering, R&D, products, and innovation ecosystem turn core challenges into impactful, disruptive business outcomes. With deep industry knowledge and a future-ready mindset, we infuse expertise, innovation, and agility into our clients’ organizations—delivering measurable value and positive lasting change for them, their customers, and communities around the world. Together, with 30,000+ employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .

About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Senior Software Quality Engineer to lead quality engineering efforts for enterprise-scale retail solutions. This role will be responsible for developing and executing quality strategies that ensure the delivery of reliable, scalable, and high-performing software solutions supporting critical business initiatives within CFR space.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a continuous improvement mindset, leveraging experience in test automation, API and database validation, defect analysis, and Agile methodologies to elevate product quality. They will work cross-functionally with business and technology teams to identify quality risks early, improve delivery outcomes, and ensure confidence in product releases.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute quality engineering strategies, test plans, and validation approaches that align with business objectives, product requirements, and release goals.
  • Lead end-to-end testing activities across distributed enterprise applications, including functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end validation.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and reusable test assets, while driving the adoption of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices to improve collaboration, testability, and requirement traceability.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous validation, rapid feedback, and increased delivery confidence.
  • Validate REST/SOAP APIs, system integrations, and SQL/NoSQL databases to ensure contract compliance, data integrity, and seamless interoperability across platforms.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and manage defects through resolution, performing detailed root cause analysis using logs, monitoring tools, and system diagnostics.
  • Evaluate product quality and release readiness by proactively identifying risks, assessing gaps, and providing data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Validate application functionality, reliability, scalability, and resiliency across cloud-native, Kubernetes-based, and retail store operating environments.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Program Management, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive quality improvements throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Champion quality engineering best practices, Agile delivery processes, test automation adoption, and continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring junior Quality Engineers and contributing to quality metrics and release reporting.

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, with 10+ years of Quality Engineering experience supporting enterprise software applications.
  • Strong experience in both manual and automated testing methodologies, including test planning, execution, defect management, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or similar automation technologies.
  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language such as JavaScript (preferred), or Java used in test automation and software development.
  • Experience in API, integration, and service validation testing, including REST and SOAP services, with the ability to troubleshoot interface and data exchange issues.
  • Strong expertise in database validation and data testing, including SQL and NoSQL databases, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across systems.
  • Experience working within Agile, Scrum, and DevOps environments, including integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including defect triage, root cause analysis, performance investigation, and the use of monitoring and observability tools to diagnose issues.
  • Experience supporting retail, fuel retail, hospitality, POS, or other enterprise transaction-based platforms, including validation of payment processing, loyalty integrations, transaction flows, and store operations workflows.
  • Experience testing cloud-native and Kubernetes-based applications, with knowledge of BDD frameworks and practices, scalability, resiliency, and reliability testing, and participation in large-scale enterprise transformation or modernization initiatives

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

Statement to Third Party Agencies

To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes

“When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a @ncrvoyix.com email domain.”
