  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Our location in Lake Forest, IL (in Conway Park) currently has an opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer in Test. This position is open with our AlinIQ informatics products in Core Lab Division. This role is on site daily and is not remote. The Sr. Software Engineer in Test (SET) reports into the AlinIQ Product Research and Development organization in Abbott Diagnostics. The SET is responsible for design, development, execution, review and reporting of automated testing for informatics products in compliance with division, corporate, and industry regulation. This position will help build out and maintain our automation tools and test scripts.

The SET will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product research and development teams in automation practices. The role requires the ability to work in an environment that is fast paced, to work independently, and to communicate and collaborate well as part of a team.

What You’ll Work On

  • The SET will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for agile product research and development teams in automation practices.
  • Design test cases, script, and automate test cases for test-driven development and continuous testing for server, web, cloud, and mobile informatics products in collaboration with scrum-based cross-functional design and development teams
  • Design and perform manual test cases and informal testing
  • Design and maintain test automation framework
  • Identify and perform test case and test case run analysis to determine adequacy of testing, including coverage, boundary, and regression analysis
  • Understand the architecture, hosting infrastructure, interaction with dependency application and complete feature workflow to assess the risks around integration points before developing great test cases
  • Lead testing efforts in automation, design, development, execution, review, and reporting of testing for our AlinIQ informatics products in Core Diagnostics.
  • This position will lead the build out and maintenance of our automation tools, test scripts, and provide guidance to other test engineers.
  • Provide input to systems and applications developers on testing procedures and requirements, schedules, or potential problems
  • Provide test and automation leadership to testing team, including peer testing automation review, definition of criteria for testing, analyzing test results, and presenting results to developers and other stakeholders
  • Help organize QA activities for the project and delivery of release documentation in conformance with regulatory, security, and privacy standards for all types of testing such as functional, performance, and regression
  • Accountable for estimating, establishing commitments, and meeting incremental deliverables (software builds) according to plans, practices, and quality requirements
  • Able to apply the latest software design and development tools and techniques as required
  • Position includes mentoring junior members of the team and ensuring the correct procedures and processes are being followed for both software quality and compliance.
  • Review code diff analysis and develop a robust regression test strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • 2+ years of Software Quality Assurance in a regulated industry is required.
  • Moderate knowledge of Agile methodologies
  • Moderate level of understanding of test-driven methodologies
  • Demonstrated success in technical proficiency, creativity, and independent thought
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical & problem-solving skills
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize responsibilities

Preferred qualifications :

  • Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • At Least 5 years of experience in related work experience.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Postgres or other RDBMS technology
  • Experience with BrowserStack/Other Test Automation Tools and Selenium WebDriver preferred.
  • Experience in the management of requirements and test cases (JAMA, JIRA and Atlassian toolset experience preferred).
  • Experience in Scrum ceremonies.
  • Familiarity with design of diagnostic medical devices and/or informatics software is a plus.
  • Familiarity with design of diagnostic medical devices and/or informatics software is a plus.
  • Ability to work on site daily in Lake Forest, IL area as this role is not remote nor is relocation assistance available.

Enterprise continuously strives to modernize our applications to keep pace with the competitive market, and ARMS has upcoming projects to modernize applications.   • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong time management skills
  • Strong knowledge of various computer systems and technologies with an ability to learn new skills and technology quickly

  • Ability to be productive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, with changing priorities

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Required:

  • Must be presently authorized to work in the U.S. without a requirement for work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future
  • Must reside in St. Louis, Missouri, or immediate surrounding area

  • Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, SOAP, REST, JSON, Unix, Windows, AWS
  • Experience coordinating and/or conducting re-testing after defects are addressed and summarizing and publishing test results for internal customers
  • Experience executing automated test scripts that are already developed, analyzing results, and providing timely and accurate feedback to development teams
  • Experience participating in estimation discussions with the product and engineering teams
  • Must be committed to incorporating security into all decisions and daily job responsibilities

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or a related field
  • Good working knowledge on essential Cloud services on AWS is a plus.
  • Startup mentality: self-starter, proactive, flexible
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Design and develop system test automation scripts using Playwright, Jest, Cucumber, Postman, and Karate
  • Support test automation solution planning and estimation
  • 5+ years of experience in test automation including planning, assessments, script development & maintenance preferably in cloud environment; experience in manual functional and regression testing and preparing relevant test cases
  • Experience with the Atlassian suite including Jira, Confluence, BitBucket (Git)
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL and Azure

descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

The Test Engineer is a member of the AAMVA Quality Assurance Department within the IT Division, responsible for testing AAMVA applications and the REST services and microservices that compose them, and for supporting testing efforts with state and federal jurisdictions and commercial/third-party data consumers on motor vehicle administration and driver licensing systems. This role executes and contributes to test plans, runs functional and automated tests, and participates in testing sessions with external customers, working with a degree of independence and seeking guidance from senior team members on complex initiatives. It is a strong foundation for building modern quality engineering skills and growing toward senior technical roles.

About AAMVA

The IT Division develops and operates information systems for state and federal agencies conducting business related to motor vehicle and driver license administration. Our systems support critical government functions across multiple jurisdictions. Our systems run on a cloud-native, microservices architecture on Azure with REST interfaces across all internal and external integrations, and we invest in automation-first, AI-assisted test engineering. Our in-house test platform abstracts much of the underlying infrastructure, so we value strong test-design judgment, data and integration testing depth, and learning agility over pre-existing mastery of any single platform technology.

Key Responsibilities

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Create, execute, and maintain test cases, and contribute to test plans for AAMVA applications and their underlying REST services and microservices.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and regression testing based on AAMVA's business and technical specifications.
  • Build and maintain automated test scripts across UI, API/REST, and service layers, and run them within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Perform API testing of RESTful services — request/response and schema validation, status codes, and authentication.
  • Use existing service-virtualization and mocks to test components in isolation and manage test data (create/modify/reset) so tests are atomic and repeatable.
  • Validate data across relational and NoSQL data stores (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB).
  • Participate in testing for jurisdictions and partners making system or platform changes, ensuring quality standards are maintained.
  • Apply AI-assisted testing tools to speed up test creation, debugging, and reporting.

Defect & Issue Management

  • Log, track, and manage defects through resolution using established tracking systems (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps).
  • Communicate issues clearly to technical teams and stakeholders, with steps to reproduce and supporting detail.
  • Help determine whether a failure originates in the application, the test data, or a mocked dependency, escalating complex cases to senior team members.

Customer Engagement & Support

  • Facilitate and conduct testing sessions with jurisdictions and commercial/third-party consumers (e.g. DLDV, consumer-access, and CDLIS third-party customers) implementing new or enhanced applications.
  • Conduct customer outreach including surveys, scheduling, and consultations.
  • Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with internal and external customers.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Attend meetings on testing schedules, concerns, reviews, and documentation changes, and participate actively in work groups.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, business analysts, and project managers.
  • Participate in the review of testing and procedural documentation.

Learning, Knowledge & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain proficiency in AAMVA applications and the team's testing tools through ongoing training and hands-on experience.
  • Provide input and recommendations to improve testing processes, efficiency, and the customer experience.

Formal Education

Four-year degree from an accredited college or university; equivalent work experience may be substituted for the degree.

Experience & Technical Skills

The skills below are described by the depth we expect. “Strong / hands-on” indicates required, working depth. “Familiarity / awareness” indicates that exposure is sufficient — our test tooling abstracts much of the underlying platform, and the ability to learn quickly matters more than deep prior expertise in those areas.

  • 3–5 years of software quality assurance and testing experience with a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle.
  • Solid test-design ability — creating and executing test cases and contributing to test plans, including basic edge and negative cases.
  • Strong analytical skills and learning agility — able to reason about system behavior and quickly become proficient in new tools and proprietary applications. *(Non-negotiable.) *
  • Working knowledge of functional, system, integration, regression, and REST/API testing.
  • Working, hands-on knowledge of databases and SQL, including validating data across relational and NoSQL stores (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB).
  • Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps/ALM, or similar).
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and tools (Selenium, Postman, Playwright, or similar).
  • Familiarity with using service virtualization / mocks and managing test data for isolated, repeatable tests.
  • Awareness of the Azure request-path components (API Management, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall) — enough to recognize when a failure may originate outside the application.
  • Conceptual understanding of cloud-hosted, microservices environments; platform expertise is not required.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, and exposure to AI-assisted testing.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, escalating complex problems to senior team members.

Communication & Customer Service

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality customer service to internal teams and external jurisdictions and partners.
  • Experience facilitating meetings and testing sessions with stakeholders.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Professional Attributes

  • Self-motivated, able to work with a degree of independence while seeking guidance on complex issues.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and analytical thinking.
  • Proactive problem-solver with critical-thinking ability.
  • Eager to learn and grow toward senior technical roles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of AAMVA applications, systems, and standards.
  • Experience with government or public-sector IT systems in motor vehicle administration or driver licensing.
  • Exposure to data analytics and BI pipelines (e.g. Synapse, Power BI).
  • Understanding of or exposure to white box testing.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, or similar).
  • ISTQB Foundation Level or working toward relevant QA certifications.

Salary Range: $99,606 to $147,849 Annually

The expected hiring range for this position has been provided. Actual pay will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, specific skill sets, and geographic work location.

AAMVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

iHeartMedia

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

The World's Largest Broadcast Software Provider.

RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape.

Here is what makes us different:

We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics.

We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward.

If this opportunity excites you, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. At RCS Worldwide, we know that great talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive, collaborative workplace where people can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

What We Need:

Florical Systems is hiring an Intermediate Software Tester to join the team responsible for developing and validating software used at the core of the world's largest and most recognized broadcast television operations.

As a Software Tester, you will evaluate the functionality, reliability, and performance of our software across a broad range of technologies. You will identify and investigate issues, clearly communicate your findings, and work closely with developers and other team members to help ensure our products meet the standards required for mission-critical broadcast environments.

This position provides an opportunity to expand your software testing and technical skills while gaining experience with the systems and technologies that support modern television operations.

This is a full-time, non-exempt position.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop and execute manual and automated test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for broadcast television software.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
  • Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects through resolution using Atlassian Jira.
  • Verify software fixes and perform appropriate regression testing to identify unintended effects.
  • Analyze software and system behavior using application logs, diagnostic tools, SQL queries, databases, APIs, and other available data.
  • Write SQL queries and analyze SQL Server and MongoDB databases as part of software testing and troubleshooting.
  • Review and modify JSON, XML, and other configuration or data files used by the systems under test.
  • Deploy and configure software in containerized test environments and troubleshoot associated container platforms.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot broadcast industry equipment used in software test environments.
  • Install and configure COTS hardware used in test systems, including servers, network switches, and related equipment.
  • Configure and troubleshoot LAN connectivity and other networking required within non-production test environments.
  • Create documentation, as needed, including test results, defect details, procedures, and installation or configuration notes.
  • Collaborate with software developers, product owners, support personnel, and other team members to understand requirements, investigate issues, and validate expected behavior.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to the continued improvement of test processes, test coverage, automation, and product quality.


What You'll Need:

Required

Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related technical field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Ability to develop and execute test cases and test scenarios from requirements, specifications, and expected system behavior.
  • Experience identifying, reproducing, documenting, and communicating software defects.
  • Working knowledge of LAN/WAN networking concepts, including TCP/IP and common network troubleshooting techniques.
  • Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting Windows operating systems.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or NoSQL databases.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to investigate application logs, configuration files, databases, and system behavior.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly and professionally in written and verbal form, including defect reports, test results, and technical documentation.


Preferred

  • Professional experience performing software testing, including functional, regression, integration, or system testing.
  • Experience working within a software development lifecycle and an Agile development environment.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated software tests.
  • Experience with cloud platforms or cloud-based application environments.
  • Experience with or knowledge of a modern programming or scripting language, such as C#, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar.
  • Experience testing distributed, networked, real-time, or hardware-integrated software systems.


What You'll Bring:

Location:

Gainesville, FL: 4500 NW 27th Ave, Building B-1, 32606

Position Type:

Regular

Time Type:

Full time

Pay Type:

Hourly

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options
  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance (pursuant to the collective bargaining agreement if applicable)
  • Paid vacation and sick time
  • Paid company holidays
  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community
  • A 401K plan
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving
  • A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!


The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status.

Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Collaborates closely with embedded system software developers to define comprehensive test plans and ensure thorough test coverage for all new functionalities. Design, implement, and execute manual and automated tests, analyze results, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes. The ideal candidate has experience in embedded software testing, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for delivering high-quality products

Responsibilities

  • Design enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems and software tests.
  • Execute and author testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portions of applications; identify and debug issues with code, recommending changes or improvements as needed.
  • Analyse system designs to determine coding, programming, and integration activities required based on specific objectives and established project guidelines.
  • Develop and maintain manual and automated test cases, ensuring thorough test coverage of embedded software features and functionalities.
  • Participate as a key member of project teams, collaborating with other software systems engineers and internal or outsourced development partners to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions.
  • Collaborate and communicate regularly with internal and outsourced partners regarding software systems design status, project progress, and issue resolution.
  • Lead or contribute to the validation and resolution of complex technical issues, facilitating effective team decision-making.
  • Continuously improve testing methodologies, tools, and processes to enhance software quality and reliability.

Education And Experience Required

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent
  • Must graduate within 1 year before start date

Knowledge And Skills

  • Proficiency with software systems design tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, C, Go).
  • Expertise in software systems testing methodology, including creation and execution of test plans, debugging, and use of testing scripts and tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply these to complex system-level challenges.
  • Experience designing software systems running on multiple platform types.
  • Solid understanding of computer system architecture, devices, and communication protocols.
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux, device drivers, and related technologies.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; mastery of English and local language.
  • Ability to effectively communicate design proposals, negotiate technical options, and facilitate collaborative solutions.
  • Proven leadership abilities in directing team activities and supporting team-based decision processes.

Accessibility

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

descriptionHtml:
NYC HQ or Remote (U.S.) | Full-time | Engineering | Reports to: Quality Assurance Lead

Who we are.

Reality Defender is an award-winning AI company that develops models to help enterprises and governments tell what’s real from what’s AI-generated. Our multi-model platform detects AI-generated video, audio, and images in real time, and stays robust against new generative tools as they emerge.

The question our customers are asking is changing. It’s no longer only “is this a deepfake?” It’s “is this real, and is it who it claims to be?” Every day, organizations ask us:

  • “Is the voice on this call a real person?”
  • “Is that video of our CEO real?”
  • “Is everyone in this meeting who they say they are?”

We answer those questions in real time, across video, audio, images, and text, so security teams can act before the damage is done.

Reality Defender is backed by world-class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC. We work with leading enterprises, financial institutions, and government agencies to make sure AI-generated media can’t be used to deceive.

Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup

The Quality Assurance Engineer Role.

Our customers rely on Reality Defender to make high-stakes calls in real time — whether the voice on a bank's phone line or the face in a job interview is real. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you'll make sure what we ship holds up to that standard, testing our APIs, SDKs, web app, and real-time integrations, and building the automation that lets us release faster without breaking things. This is a full-time role based at our NYC headquarters or remote within the U.S., reporting to Quality Assurance Lead. Responsibilities include:

  • Own test planning and execution for assigned product areas — APIs, SDKs, the web app, and real-time voice and video integrations — from requirements review through release sign-off.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites (API, end-to-end, and regression) and integrate them into our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Find, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, and impact, and work with engineers through to resolution.
  • Test the reliability and performance of real-time detection under realistic conditions — latency, load, varied audio and video quality, and different platforms and devices.
  • Help maintain the test data and media sets used to validate each release.
  • Partner with the AI Research and Red Team to support model release validation and regression testing.
  • Help Customer Support and Solutions Engineering reproduce and triage customer-reported issues.
  • Contribute to QA standards, documentation, and release checklists across the engineering team.

Who you are.

  • 3+ years of experience in software QA or quality engineering, testing web applications and APIs in a fast-moving release environment.
  • Hands-on experience writing automated tests in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar, using frameworks such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
  • Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman or code-based API tests) and working within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).
  • Strong attention to detail and a systematic approach to finding edge cases — you think about how things break, not just whether they work.
  • Clear written communication: your bug reports and test plans are easy for engineers to act on.
  • Experience testing audio, video, or real-time communication products (WebRTC, telephony, conferencing). (nice to have)
  • Experience testing ML-powered products or working with test datasets. (nice to have)
  • Exposure to performance or load testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust, JMeter). (nice to have)

Within 12 months, you'll…

  • Own QA for multiple product areas with minimal oversight.
  • Have helped establish quality metrics (escaped defects, coverage, release stability) that the team tracks and acts on.
  • Be improving QA tooling and practices beyond your own areas.
  • Be ready to take on broader scope and mentor newer QA team members.

What we offer.

Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location:

  • Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents
  • Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents
  • Short/Long-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees
  • FSA/HSA and 401k programs
  • Equity compensation
  • 20 days of PTO per year
  • 12 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Learning and Development budget
  • Monthly wellness benefits
  • Annual company-sponsored offsite

For employees working from Reality Defender's HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits:

  • Daily in-office lunch through UberEats
  • Commuter benefits
  • Remote Fridays
  • Happy Hours and other local events

Base salary range: $120k-$150k, based on experience and location. Includes equity.

Compensation Range: $120K - $150K

descriptionHtml:
Public Trust Eligibility Required

About Aretum

Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. We believe in investing in our people and creating a culture where collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth are at the forefront.

Job Summary

Serve as a QA Automation Test Engineer supporting an Agile team that creates, maintains, and enhances applications for a federal government client. The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, executing, and maintaining manual and automated testing solutions/frameworks that ensure application quality, performance, accessibility, and reliability. 

Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements. 

Responsibilities 

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases for web applications, APIs, and integrated systems
  • Develop and maintain test strategies, test plans, and testing approaches that support the level of automation needed for application quality and delivery objectives
  • Provide clear feedback by following the standard testing process, including writing detailed descriptions, acceptance criteria, identifying problems, and documenting steps in the ticketing system
  • Build and maintain reusable automated test scripts, utilities, and testing components that reduce repetitive testing efforts and improve testing efficiency
  • Design, implement, and support scalable test automation frameworks that enable consistent and maintainable automated testing across teams
  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, and user story validation testing throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and Testers to determine quality expectations during backlog refinement and sprint planning
  • Contribute to the team's Definition of Done (DoD) by ensuring appropriate test coverage, successful test execution, and quality validation prior to story completion
  • Integrate automated testing into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and leverage continuous integration practices to provide rapid feedback on code quality
  • Develop and execute load, performance, and scalability tests to validate application stability, reliability, and capacity under expected usage conditions
  • Analyze test results, identify defects and risks, measure test coverage, and provide actionable recommendations to improve overall software quality and release readiness

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience
  • Bachelor's Degree (4 additional years of relevant experience is acceptable in lieu of degree)
  • 5+ years of experience using automation tools to test systems and applications, and writing and executing test scripts
  • 3+ years of experience with automation testing tools, Playwright preferred
  • Experience developing automation testing strategies and frameworks from the ground up
  • Experience performing functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Strong hands-on testing experience with database and API testing
  • Experience with Docker containers and testing containerized applications  
  • Experience creating reusable test automation solutions and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience collaborating and working across functional teams
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications{{:}}

  • Experience with GraphQL testing/framework 
  • Federal Government experience as a contractor
  • Experience with testing .NET applications and systems hosted in Azure Cloud  
  • Performance testing experience
  • Experience performing manual accessibility testing with screen readers and other accessibility tools
  • DHS Trusted Tester Certification

Travel Requirements

This is a remote position; however, occasional travel may be required based on project needs, client meetings, team collaboration events, or training sessions. Travel is expected to be less than 10% and will be communicated in advance whenever possible. 

EEO Statement

Aretum is committed to fostering a workplace rooted in excellence, integrity, and equal opportunity for all. We adhere to merit-based hiring practices, ensuring that all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills, and ability to perform the job, without preference or consideration of factors unrelated to job performance. 

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Aretum complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws. 

We are proud to support our nation's veterans and military families, providing career opportunities that honor their service and experience. 

If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process due to a disability, please contact hr@aretum.com for assistance. 

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

U.S. Work Authorization

Due to federal contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this position. This position supports a federal government contract and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability Determination, depending on the agency's background investigation requirements.  

Benefits

  • Salary Range{{:}} $80,000-$120,000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including education, experience, qualifications, skills, and applicable contract requirements.  
  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)  
  • Retirement Plan (401k) 
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)  
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)  
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability  
  • Training & Development

descriptionHtml:
About Lvt

LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it.

We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it.

  • A Top-Tier Growth Company: Named one of the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025 and #10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional list for 2025.
  • Innovative Leadership: Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame in 2024.
  • Product & Software Excellence: We were named one of The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023 and are a winner of the Security Today Govies Award for 2025.

About This Role

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET I), you will join our Software Quality team to ensure the elite performance and reliability of LVT’s intelligent site technology. You will sit at the intersection of development and quality, contributing to automated frameworks and executing sophisticated test strategies that challenge our systems' limits. This is an opportunity for a high-potential engineer to influence the stability of a rapidly scaling AI platform while working alongside a world-class engineering team.

This role is based in-office out of our Headquarters in American Fork, Utah.

Role Responsibilities

  • Maintain and scale automated test frameworks to ensure high-velocity software delivery without compromising quality.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive automated and manual test cases that validate complex system behaviors across our platform.
  • Collaborate deeply with developers and product managers to identify critical test requirements and edge-case scenarios early in the lifecycle.
  • Rigorous identification, documentation, and tracking of defects, working cross-functionally to drive rapid resolutions.
  • Uphold and advocate for test automation best practices, methodologies, and modern tooling within the engineering org.
  • Analyze complex test results and troubleshoot failures to provide actionable insights for continuous architectural improvement.
  • Proactively monitor emerging testing technologies to enhance our coverage of hardware-software integrations.
  • Adapt quickly to shifting priorities in a high-growth environment, ensuring quality remains a competitive advantage.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Technical Foundation: 1–3 years of experience in coding, test planning, and debugging within a professional software development environment.
  • Automation Expertise: Hands-on experience with modern test frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Pytest.
  • Language Proficiency: A foundational understanding of Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
  • Lifecycle Knowledge: Proven experience navigating rapid development and release cycles (CI/CD) and integrating tests into GitHub Actions.
  • Analytical Mindset: A proactive problem-solver who doesn't just find bugs but understands the "why" behind system failures.
  • Growth-Oriented: A self-motivated learner who thrives on feedback and is eager to master new technologies in the AI and IoT space.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical risks to both engineering peers and stakeholders.
  • Bonus Points: Experience with AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, Appium for mobile testing, or testing integrated hardware/software systems.

Benefits

We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. We invest in our crew’s health, families, and financial futures with a benefits package designed to support you inside and outside the office. Full-time benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.

LVT IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. All candidates must pass a drug screening and background check upon employment. Some roles may also require passing a federal background check and fingerprinting. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, and/or to perform essential job functions, please reach out to your recruiter.

Position Description:

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities:

  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with TypeScript, Selenium, and related API-testing tools.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.
  • Create and report test-cycle metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements that reduce cycle time.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Create reusable automation workflows and prompts that connect product requirements, code changes, Jira or Azure DevOps issues, test results, logs, and documentation into repeatable QA processes.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.
  • Improve automated test coverage, regression readiness, and feedback speed by identifying repeatable QA workflows and reducing manual effort across release cycles.
  • Document how AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, validated, and incorporated into automation assets when those outputs influence test coverage, quality decisions, or product release readiness.


Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Powershell and/or C#.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Cryptography knowledge including Key Management.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.


About Entrust

Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated, and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises, and financial institutions in more than 150 countries serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

Join us. Together we’ll create solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure life.


For more information, visit www.entrustdatacard.com. Follow us on Twitter, YouTube and LinkedIn.

Job Summary

An engineering position, under moderate supervision, participates in designing, building, and maintaining processes to test and verify software products used in medical devices and engineering projects related to medical technology. Applies standard engineering practices to resolve simple problems, and contributes to the validation and verification of software products.

Hybrid: Onsite 3 days per week

Salary Range: $98,000-$105,000 based on experience

  • Final pay determinations will depend on various factors, including, but not limited to experience level, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities.
  • Our benefits and programs are comprehensive and thoughtfully crafted to ensure our colleagues live healthy lives and have support when it matters most. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with company contributions, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, employee assistance program, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. Fresenius Kabi is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa either now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Defines and executes test cases for new and existing Ivenix Infusion System products. Following pre-established testing procedures. Ability to apply technical theories and principles. Accurately assess results for validity and conformance to specifications.

Develops and maintains detailed documentation for both internal and external customers. Traces test activities and results to system and subsystem requirements, escalating findings through the defined workflows.

Operates within defined processes and procedures consistent with a regulated environment. Works on problems of simple to moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors.

Effectively operates as an individual contributor and a member of the large team. Sets up and maintains test articles and test fixtures. Apply sound judgment to resolve routine and non-routine issues, follow established guidelines, and escalate when situations fall outside defined parameters.

Participates in technical reviews and is responsible for organizing data and preparing appropriate documentation for assigned projects.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field is preferred.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a regulated industry (e.g., medical device, pharmaceutical, or other ISO/FDA‑governed environments) is preferred.
  • Experience in medical device software development and testing is preferred.
  • Experience working on a medical device or other regulated industry is preferred.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment is preferred.
  • Experience with test case execution and reporting is required.
  • Experience in designing and developing manual test cases for complex systems and components is required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Thorough understanding of software test principles and best practices needed to produce high-quality software.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Experience working in virtual environments. Experience with VMWare or Hyper-V is preferred.
  • Experience testing devices with embedded Linux systems and/or platforms using IIS, ASP.NET, Web/Windows Services, and SQL is preferred.
  • Experience with Windows Server administration, setup, deployment, and configuration, and the ability to interpret error logs are preferred.
  • Proficiency with test‑automation tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Squish, and Python is preferred.
  • The Company’s primary business language is English. The successful candidate must be able to effectively speak, read, write, and understand English to perform the essential functions of the position, including independently understanding policies, procedures, training materials, and workplace communications written in English due to our heavily regulated work environment.

Additional Information

We offer an excellent salary and benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage, as well as life insurance, disability, 401K with company contribution, and wellness program.

Please note that joining our team does not create a guaranteed or permanent employment arrangement. All employment is at‑will, meaning both the employee and Fresenius Kabi have the right to end the employment relationship at any time, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws.

Fresenius Kabi is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, immigration status, disabilities, or protected veteran status.

Our Challenge


We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer with strong experience testing distributed software systems, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will design and maintain automated test frameworks, validate complex integrations and data workflows, and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites covering functional, integration, API, UI, regression, and performance testing.
  • Develop comprehensive test scenarios, edge cases, and validation strategies from business requirements and technical designs.
  • Test microservices, event-driven systems, REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging-based integrations.
  • Validate data movement, transformations, reconciliations, and end-to-end workflows across multiple systems.
  • Create SQL queries to validate relational databases, ETL processes, data integration workloads, data warehouses, and reporting solutions.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to improve release quality.
  • Perform performance, load, and reliability testing to identify bottlenecks and assess system behavior.
  • Investigate complex issues across applications, services, integrations, and data pipelines using logs and observability tools.
  • Manage test cases, report defects, and collaborate with stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
  • Build domain knowledge and communicate testing progress, risks, and findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience testing distributed software systems, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise applications.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites.
  • Proficiency with automation tools such as Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, Power Automate, Rest Assured, Postman, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, and/or Python.
  • Experience testing microservices-based architectures, event-driven systems, and distributed applications.
  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging-based integrations.
  • Experience validating data transformations, reconciliations, and workflows across multiple systems.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience validating data in databases such as PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
  • Experience testing ETL/data integration workloads, data warehouses, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or Angular, along with UI test automation.
  • Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency in SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices, including integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as PractiTest, Jira, Xray, or Zephyr.
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk.
  • Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

As a QA Analyst focused on APIs, you will play a key role in advancing mission-critical capabilities that support the future of Workplace Solutions. This role blends quality assurance, systems analysis, test strategy, technical problem solving, API validation, and automated and manual testing to help deliver reliable, scalable solutions for our Benefit Administrator partners. You will collaborate with business and technology teams, connect end-to-end system behavior to quality outcomes, and help ensure solutions improve efficiency, quality, and the customer experience.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary: $76,000 - $92,000 depending on skills and qualifications, plus annual bonus opportunity.
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Partner with business and technology teams to ensure API-enabled solutions that support Workplace Solutions initiatives meet quality standards and improve outcomes for Benefit Administrator partners.
  • Analyze end-to-end system behavior, data flows, requirements, dependencies, and assumptions to define test coverage and validate that solutions perform as expected across integrated systems.
  • Review requirements for clarity and testability, and maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results as needs evolve.
  • Create clear QA documentation, including test plans, test cases, test data, defect reports, and test result summaries that support solution delivery and long-term maintainability.
  • Lead or support test planning and execution for functional areas, including manual and automated API testing for enhancements, upgrades, regression, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Investigate defects and ambiguous issues using structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based recommendations to support sound release decisions.
  • Facilitate productive discussions with developers, business partners, and other stakeholders to triage defects, clarify expected behavior, and promote shared understanding of quality risks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve test processes, automation coverage, and delivery practices while setting quality expectations and supporting continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 4+ years of QA analysis experience, including hands-on experience analyzing, testing, and validating API functionality.
  • Experience using API testing tools such as Postman and Swagger to validate functionality and security.
  • Strong technical and systems acumen, with the ability to interpret architecture, tools, processes, data flows, and integration patterns and translate them into feasible testing scenarios and cases.
  • Proficiency with automated testing frameworks such as Karate, including the ability to design, execute, and maintain automated API test scripts that enhance test coverage, streamline validation, and improve software quality and reliability.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices, including integrating automated API tests into build and deployment pipelines to support continuous testing and release readiness.
  • Experience planning and executing performance and load testing of APIs, including analyzing response times, throughput, and scalability under expected and peak volumes.
  • Demonstrated ability to break down moderately complex or ambiguous requirements and system behavior, evaluate quality risks, structure testing strategies, and recommend testing actions.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience building trusted stakeholder relationships, balancing perspectives, addressing concerns, and helping negotiate test scope, priorities, and release-readiness tradeoffs.
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and the ability to bridge quality needs with business scenarios and technical solutions.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience supporting secure and accurate employee and benefit data exchanges with technical third-party Benefit Administrator partners through API integrations.
  • Prior experience working in the insurance industry.
  • Experience using AI-assisted testing tools to generate test cases and test data, accelerate test automation, and improve defect analysis.

We value unique experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area at careers@mutualofomaha.com. Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking on the status.

Stay Safe from Job Scams
Mutual of Omaha only accepts applications from mutualofomaha.com/careers. Legitimate communications will come from '@mutualofomaha.com.' We never request sensitive information or extend job offers without conducting interviews. For more details, check our Hiring FAQs. Stay alert for scams and apply securely!

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced, automation-focused Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our North American Sports product team. This team develops insightful analytics and Recruit products for American Football, helping high-level coaches and analysts make faster, data-driven decisions on player performance and talent acquisition.

As the testing expert within your cross-functional squad, you'll own quality end-to-end — building the strategies and automation that ensure we're shipping software our users love. You'll drive quality discussions, challenge the team to maintain high standards, and be the advocate for reliability and performance at every stage of delivery.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, You'll

  • Lead quality initiatives. Build risk-based testing strategies tailored to your squad's architecture, drive quality discussions in scrum ceremonies, challenge defect priorities, and continuously look for ways to improve practices and keep your squad's quality processes ahead of the curve.
  • Test across the stack. Design and execute tests spanning front-end UI, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines — validating transformations, service outputs, and complex logic at scale.
  • Automate with intent. Make informed decisions about what, when, and how to automate. Use Playwright and scripting to build reliable, maintainable automated checks that keep pace with development.
  • Mentor and grow others. Use your technical depth and quality instincts to coach teammates, raise the bar for quality standards across the team, and influence how the whole squad thinks about quality.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Design, contribute to hiring, and invest in your own professional development.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln and Omaha, Nebraska are prioritized, we're open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Quality focus. You see the big picture and use it to drive improvements in both quality and velocity.
  • Technical depth. 4+ years of software testing experience with hands-on expertise across the full stack — API testing, backend and data-heavy systems, and front-end validation — plus proficiency in automation frameworks like Playwright and languages like Python or TypeScript.
  • A track record of leadership. You've owned quality for a squad, led testing initiatives end-to-end, defined success criteria, and designed approaches that measurably reduce risk in production.
  • Investigative rigour. You dig to root causes of complex problems, back your findings with data, and measure outcomes.
  • User focus. You think critically about the user experience and let that understanding shape your testing approach.
  • AI-powered working. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — for test case creation, failure diagnosis, documentation, and beyond — and look for new ways to apply them to raise the team's efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Performance testing exposure. Familiarity with load, stress, and scalability testing concepts and tools (e.g. JMeter) for validating API and backend performance.
  • Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in Basketball, American Football or Ice Hockey — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent experience. A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000 - $137,000 USD

Job Description

Senior SDET – Robot Framework

Location: Omaha, NE (Onsite - 5 days a week)

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Test Engineer to drive quality across complex enterprise applications through thoughtful test strategy, hands-on test execution, and scalable automation. In this role, you will partner closely with developers, product owners, business analysts, and project teams to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions across evolving applications, technologies, and business domains.

This is an opportunity for a quality engineering professional who brings strong technical expertise, clear communication, problem-solving confidence, and the adaptability to succeed in dynamic environments where priorities and teams may shift based on business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for complex enterprise applications.
  • Perform manual and automated functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Analyze requirements, identify quality risks, and develop risk-based testing approaches that balance speed, coverage, and business impact.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites using frameworks such as Robot Framework, Playwright, and/or Selenium.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to improve release confidence and delivery efficiency.
  • Build reusable automation assets and continuously improve test coverage through automation.
  • Conduct API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
  • Manage defects through identification, documentation, triage, root cause analysis, and resolution validation.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and cross-functional project teams to clarify requirements and resolve quality concerns.
  • Communicate testing progress, quality risks, defects, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support multiple applications, products, projects, or business domains as priorities evolve.
  • Quickly learn new technologies, applications, and business processes with minimal ramp-up time.
  • Apply knowledge gained across one project, domain, or technology to solve challenges in another.
  • Contribute to Agile and DevOps testing practices that support continuous delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a proactive mindset in improving overall quality engineering outcomes.

Qualifications

  • 7–15 years of experience in Quality Assurance with strong hands-on expertise in test automation.
  • Strong experience in quality engineering, test planning, test design, and test execution for complex enterprise applications.
  • Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing across functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end scenarios.
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Experience with one or more automation frameworks, including Robot Framework, Playwright, or Selenium.
  • Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong API testing experience using Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI, or similar tools.
  • Programming or scripting experience in one or more of the following: Java, Python, JavaScript, or SQL.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git and GitHub.
  • Familiarity with test management tools such as Jira or TestRail.
  • Experience with build and deployment tools such as Maven or Jenkins.
  • Strong understanding of defect management, triage, and root cause analysis.
  • Working knowledge of Agile and DevOps testing practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with developers, product owners, business analysts, and project teams.
  • Proven ability to learn new applications, technologies, and business processes quickly.
  • Experience supporting multiple applications, products, projects, or business domains.
  • Demonstrated success transitioning between teams or initiatives with minimal ramp-up time.
  • Ability to remain effective in dynamic environments with changing priorities and business needs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, accountability, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Good to Have

  • Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure.
  • Experience testing microservices or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with Kafka testing.
  • Exposure to accessibility testing or security testing.
  • Experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, or railroad industry environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing and quality engineering tools.

The base salary for this position is $75,000 to $81,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

  • Contribute to improvements to quality assurance practices by identifying opportunities to increase automation, reliability, and repeatability.
  • Find, isolate, document, regress, and track defects through resolution.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of manual and automated test execution across assigned products and features to ensure features meet defined acceptance criteria and quality standards.
  • Assist with end-to-end configuration, environment validation, and test data setup for digital, mobile, and other IT projects.
  • Track and report testing progress, automation results, and defect trends to help teams assess quality and readiness.

Essential Functions

  • Ability to work well individually and in a team environment
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with appropriate guidance and escalation
  • Detail oriented with strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate risks or blockers in a timely manner
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly with technical and non-technical peers
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and willingness to learn
  • Ability to follow established engineering and QA practices while contributing ideas for improvement
  • Enjoys working with partners, colleagues, and teams to solve software quality challenges
  • Passionate about QA, test automation, and continuous learning

  • BS/BA degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience writing test cases, executing software tests, documenting defects, and supporting test automation
  • 5+ years of experience with automated testing tools or frameworks
  • Familiarity with software development processes including Agile/Lean methodologies and DevOps concepts, particularly in a CI/CD environment
  • QA professional certifications preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver assigned work with quality and consistency
  • Experience using automation to support repeatable software testing
  • Experience creating and executing test cases for assigned features or applications
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as WebdriverIO, SmartBear, or similar platforms

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows. You will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability.   • Execute product testing focusing on end-to-end, performance and load testing.

descriptionHtml:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We're transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It's what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That's why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to drive software quality, strengthen test automation, and improve testing practices throughout the software development lifecycle. In this role, you'll take ownership of designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automated testing solutions for web, API, and mobile applications while helping ensure reliable software releases. You'll collaborate closely with developers, product owners, DevOps, and the test lead to identify risks early, improve testability, and promote quality engineering best practices across the team. This position offers the opportunity to influence automation strategy, leverage emerging AI technologies, and contribute to continuous improvement in a hybrid work environment.

Our technology stack is Microsoft-centered, including .NET, MVC, WCF, MS SQL, and Visual Studio, with CI/CD pipelines supported by Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.

Our work directly impacts the experience of millions of users relying on Cisco wireless infrastructure.

Your Impact

Role

Role

As a QA / Automation Engineer, you will contribute to validating Cisco’s wireless platforms by writing test plans, developing automation, and analyzing system behavior. You will gain hands-on experience with real networking environments, lab setups, and modern AI-assisted development tools. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy breaking systems, understanding how they work, and ensuring high-quality product delivery. In This Role, You Will:

  • Write and execute test plans and test cases for wireless features and systems
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python or similar languages
  • Analyze test results and identify issues, inconsistencies, or performance gaps
  • Reproduce customer and system issues in controlled lab environments
  • Assist in setting up and maintaining testbeds and lab environments (routers, switches, access points)
  • Collaborate with development and platform teams to debug and resolve issues
  • Learn and apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to improve testing efficiency and automation

Minimum Qualification

  • Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
  • A Master's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
  • A Bachelor's degree with 2 years of work experience.

Isovalent, now part of Cisco, is the company founded by the creators of Cilium and eBPF. Cisco Isovalent is building the next generation of products for securing workloads and AI infrastructure using advanced technologies across Linux and Windows.

Our software agent team builds high-performance, secure, and lightweight software agents that run across Unix, Linux, and Windows environments and multiple architectures, including aarch64, x86_64, s390x, ppc64_le, and SPARC. These agents operate across traditional and modern workloads in on-premises and cloud environments, including virtual machines and major container orchestration platforms.

Our agents collect rich information about workloads, including network traffic and system activities such as processes, users, and file access. They enforce network policies from a central controller, monitor and protect container-based deployments, and provide runtime security capabilities designed to mitigate high-severity vulnerabilities.

You will be an integral member of the software agent team and work closely with software engineers and cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from initial design and development through testing and deployment into production environments.

You will work closely with software engineers throughout the development lifecycle to understand new capabilities, define appropriate testing strategies, identify defects, and improve overall product quality.
