Position Description

### Advance Quality Engineering for Mission-Critical Payment Platforms

Are you an experienced **Test Automation Engineer** who enjoys building scalable automation solutions and improving quality across complex, enterprise-scale applications? Do you have experience testing **payment systems and transaction processing**, including ACH, wire transfers, SWIFT, or other electronic payment flows?

CGI is seeking a **Senior Test Automation Engineer – Payments** to join our team supporting a high-profile enterprise client in **Salt Lake City, UT**.

In this role, you will help drive modern quality engineering practices across critical payment applications by designing and enhancing automation frameworks, expanding automated test coverage, and embedding testing throughout the software development lifecycle. You will work closely with product, business, development, and engineering teams to strengthen **shift-left testing, continuous testing, API automation, and CI/CD integration**.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced automation engineer who enjoys combining **hands-on development, payments domain knowledge, API and database testing, cloud technologies, and DevOps practices** to improve software quality and delivery efficiency.

  • Location:** This position is based onsite at a client location in the **Salt Lake City, UT area**.

Your future duties and responsibilities

How you'll make an impact

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable and reusable **test automation frameworks** for complex enterprise applications.
  • Develop and execute automated **functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression test suites** across critical business workflows.
  • Advance **shift-left testing** by incorporating automated quality validation earlier in the software development lifecycle.
  • Partner with Product Management, business stakeholders, developers, architects, and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and critical business processes.
  • Develop automated testing solutions for complex **payment applications and transaction-processing workflows**, including ACH, wire transfers, SWIFT, and related payment capabilities.
  • Design and execute automated **API and integration testing** for REST and SOAP-based services.
  • Create and execute SQL queries to validate application data, payment transactions, integrations, and expected processing outcomes.
  • Integrate automated test suites into **CI/CD pipelines** to support continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous testing.
  • Test applications deployed across **public cloud and containerized environments**, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Docker.
  • Analyze automated test results, identify defects and quality risks, troubleshoot automation failures, perform root-cause analysis, and partner with development teams to drive issues through resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, test efficiency, reliability, maintainability, and overall engineering productivity.
  • Evaluate and recommend new testing tools, frameworks, technologies, and automation approaches based on evolving application and delivery needs.
  • Estimate, plan, track, and report automation and testing activities throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Conduct automation code reviews and contribute to coding standards, reusable components, technical documentation, and secure development practices.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in **quality engineering, test automation, cloud-native development, DevOps, and continuous testing**.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

What you'll bring

  • **6+ years of experience** in test automation, quality engineering, software testing, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience testing **payment applications or transaction-processing systems**, including ACH, wire transfers, SWIFT, and/or other electronic payment capabilities.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, executing, and maintaining **enterprise-scale test automation frameworks**.
  • Hands-on automation experience using **Playwright and/or Selenium**.
  • Programming or automation development experience using **Java and/or Python**.
  • Experience testing **REST and SOAP APIs**, including experience with tools such as Postman or comparable technologies.
  • Strong **SQL and relational database** skills, including the ability to query and analyze data for transaction and test validation.
  • Experience testing applications deployed on at least one major public cloud platform, such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP**.
  • Experience testing applications within **containerized environments**, including Docker.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into **CI/CD pipelines** and working within continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous testing practices.
  • Experience with development and delivery tools such as **Bamboo, Git, Artifactory, Jira, and Confluence**, or comparable technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience planning, estimating, executing, tracking, and reporting automation and testing activities.
  • Experience working within **Agile and/or Waterfall** software delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex application and automation issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across business, product, development, and engineering teams.

## Education

  • Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**.

CGI is seeking a **Senior Test Automation Engineer – Payments** to join our team supporting a high-profile enterprise client in **Salt Lake City, UT**.

You will work closely with product, business, development, and engineering teams to strengthen **shift-left testing, continuous testing, API automation, and CI/CD integration**.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced automation engineer who enjoys combining **hands-on development, payments domain knowledge, API and database testing, cloud technologies, and DevOps practices** to improve software quality and delivery efficiency.

-  Develop and execute automated **functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression test suites** across critical business workflows.
-  Advance **shift-left testing** by incorporating automated quality validation earlier in the software development lifecycle.
-  Partner with Product Management, business stakeholders, developers, architects, and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and critical business processes.
-  Develop automated testing solutions for complex **payment applications and transaction-processing workflows**, including ACH, wire transfers, SWIFT, and related payment capabilities.
-  Design and execute automated **API and integration testing** for REST and SOAP-based services.
-  Create and execute SQL queries to validate application data, payment transactions, integrations, and expected processing outcomes.
-  Integrate automated test suites into **CI/CD pipelines** to support continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous testing.
-  Test applications deployed across **public cloud and containerized environments**, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Docker.
-  Analyze automated test results, identify defects and quality risks, troubleshoot automation failures, perform root-cause analysis, and partner with development teams to drive issues through resolution.
-  Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, test efficiency, reliability, maintainability, and overall engineering productivity.
-  Evaluate and recommend new testing tools, frameworks, technologies, and automation approaches based on evolving application and delivery needs.
-  Estimate, plan, track, and report automation and testing activities throughout the delivery lifecycle.
-  Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
-  Conduct automation code reviews and contribute to coding standards, reusable components, technical documentation, and secure development practices.
-  Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in **quality engineering, test automation, cloud-native development, DevOps, and continuous testing**.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

What you'll bring



-  **6+ years of experience** in test automation, quality engineering, software testing, or a related discipline.
-  Hands-on experience testing **payment applications or transaction-processing systems**, including ACH, wire transfers, SWIFT, and/or other electronic payment capabilities.
-  Strong experience designing, developing, executing, and maintaining **enterprise-scale test automation frameworks**.
-  Hands-on automation experience using **Playwright and/or Selenium**.
-  Programming or automation development experience using **Java and/or Python**.
-  Experience testing **REST and SOAP APIs**, including experience with tools such as Postman or comparable technologies.
-  Strong **SQL and relational database** skills, including the ability to query and analyze data for transaction and test validation.
-  Experience testing applications deployed on at least one major public cloud platform, such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP**.
-  Experience testing applications within **containerized environments**, including Docker.
-  Experience integrating automated tests into **CI/CD pipelines** and working within continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous testing practices.
-  Experience with development and delivery tools such as **Bamboo, Git, Artifactory, Jira, and Confluence**, or comparable technologies.
-  Demonstrated experience planning, estimating, executing, tracking, and reporting automation and testing activities.
-  Experience working within **Agile and/or Waterfall** software delivery methodologies.
-  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex application and automation issues.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our performance analysis squad, a team dedicated to building best-in-class tools that help coaches and analysts turn game video and data into winning insights. You'll help us build and scale the products that power film breakdowns, tagging, stats, and reporting, so every clip, metric, and playlist is accurate, fast, and reliable. In this role, you'll lead testing efforts within your squad, focusing on both prevention and efficiency so that coaches and analysts have a seamless experience, from game day through the film room.

As a QA Engineer, You’ll

  • Champion squad quality. Attend and actively voice quality focus in squad sprint scrum ceremonies, understand the core problem being solved and ensure backlog defects are prioritized.
  • Drive test strategy. Create test plans, implement squad quality best practices, use data to drive high-quality outcomes and ensure post-mortems or root cause analyses (RCAs) are created for all hotfixes.
  • Test and merge. Leverage multiple testing approaches—including automated, exploratory and manual testing—from start to finish, ensuring sub-defects are resolved and merge builds run cleanly.
  • Grow professionally. Dedicate time to your own professional development and skill-building.

Location

Time spent collaborating with other Hudlies in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently prioritizing applicants within commuting distance of Lincoln or Omaha, Nebraska. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Experienced. You have 2+ years of software testing experience and have worked in fast-paced environments with changing deadlines.
  • Technical. You have solid experience designing and executing tests across the stack, from front-end UI validation to in-depth API testing, including proven, hands-on experience and proficiency with key languages (e.g. Python, Typescript) and modern automation frameworks (e.g. Playwright, Selenium).
  • Mobile testing exposure. You have experience testing iOS or Android applications and an understanding of mobile-specific performance, UI nuances and automation using Appium, Detox, and/or React Native tooling and the associated APIs that apps rely on (protocols such as GraphQL, REST, etc.).
  • A team player. You work effectively within a global team, leading with empathy and clear communication to help your squad achieve the best outcomes.
  • Problem solver. You can navigate technical and team challenges during changing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Naturally curious. You think outside the box by exploring creative solutions to break software.
  • User-focused. You think critically about the user experience and easily relate to our users.
  • Constantly learning. You are passionate about learning and open to growth areas.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Domain experience. You’ve worked in a SaaS environment or have a background in a STEM-related field.
  • AI Tool Exposure. Curiosity and exposure to leveraging AI tools (such as LLMs, specialized coding assistants, or test data generators) to increase efficiency in documentation, test case creation, or initial failure diagnosis.
  • Agile fluency. Experience working within a Scrum framework and participating in sprint ceremonies will help you jump right in.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$51,000 - $106,000 USD

You'll work on sophisticated applications that control our analytical instruments, including mass spectrometers, electron microscopes, and other advanced scientific equipment.   • Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub)
  • Programming/Scripting skills in one or more languages: Python, C#, JavaScript, Java
  • Experience with agile methodologies and tools (JIRA, TestRail)
  • Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies and best practices
  • Experience with API testing and test management systems

  • Ability to write clear, comprehensive test plans, cases, and documentation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience working in cross-functional, global teams
  • Knowledge of Windows operating systems, Virtual Machine, Linux environment and IT fundamentals
  • Geed experience with Software release processes and ECN/ECO
  • Ability to identify, reproduce, and clearly document software defects
  • Understanding of scientific principles and laboratory workflows
  • Experience with performance testing and automation frameworks
  • Experience with using AI in daily tasks (ChatGPT, Codex, Copilot)
  • Strong attention to detail and quality focus
  • Knowledge of database systems and SQL
  • Travel may be required up to 20%

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$82,700 - 173,900 USD

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced, automation-focused Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our North American Sports product team. This team develops insightful analytics and Recruit products for American Football, helping high-level coaches and analysts make faster, data-driven decisions on player performance and talent acquisition.

As the testing expert within your cross-functional squad, you'll own quality end-to-end — building the strategies and automation that ensure we're shipping software our users love. You'll drive quality discussions, challenge the team to maintain high standards, and be the advocate for reliability and performance at every stage of delivery.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, You'll

  • Lead quality initiatives. Build risk-based testing strategies tailored to your squad's architecture, drive quality discussions in scrum ceremonies, challenge defect priorities, and continuously look for ways to improve practices and keep your squad's quality processes ahead of the curve.
  • Test across the stack. Design and execute tests spanning front-end UI, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines — validating transformations, service outputs, and complex logic at scale.
  • Automate with intent. Make informed decisions about what, when, and how to automate. Use Playwright and scripting to build reliable, maintainable automated checks that keep pace with development.
  • Mentor and grow others. Use your technical depth and quality instincts to coach teammates, raise the bar for quality standards across the team, and influence how the whole squad thinks about quality.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Design, contribute to hiring, and invest in your own professional development.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln and Omaha, Nebraska are prioritized, we're open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Quality focus. You see the big picture and use it to drive improvements in both quality and velocity.
  • Technical depth. 4+ years of software testing experience with hands-on expertise across the full stack — API testing, backend and data-heavy systems, and front-end validation — plus proficiency in automation frameworks like Playwright and languages like Python or TypeScript.
  • A track record of leadership. You've owned quality for a squad, led testing initiatives end-to-end, defined success criteria, and designed approaches that measurably reduce risk in production.
  • Investigative rigour. You dig to root causes of complex problems, back your findings with data, and measure outcomes.
  • User focus. You think critically about the user experience and let that understanding shape your testing approach.
  • AI-powered working. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — for test case creation, failure diagnosis, documentation, and beyond — and look for new ways to apply them to raise the team's efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Performance testing exposure. Familiarity with load, stress, and scalability testing concepts and tools (e.g. JMeter) for validating API and backend performance.
  • Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in Basketball, American Football or Ice Hockey — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent experience. A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000 - $137,000 USD

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

The Aircraft Media Gateway program enables the P-8A aircraft to deliver advanced maritime and littoral Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities, equipping the United States Navy to effectively counter existing, evolving, and emerging threats.

THE WORK

Integration & Test Engineers collaborate with the Software Engineering and Systems Engineering teams to design and execute automated software testing strategies. The ideal candidate will possess, or be willing to develop, expertise in testing integrated hardware systems. Working in an Agile environment as part of a cross-functional product team, the candidate will be responsible for performing tasks that require strong collaboration and communication skills. Success in this role requires the ability to effectively interact with and present to various stakeholders, including internal leadership, external customers, and cross-functional teams. Team-oriented engineers who are comfortable communicating technical capabilities to both internal and external audiences are encouraged to apply.

Who You Are

The Ideal candidate will have a bachelor's degree from an accredited university and over 5 years of related experience or a master's degree with 3 years of related professional experience.

Who We Are

You will be joining Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems. Learn more about Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems

Our Program team is an Integrated Engineering team that cares about each other and the mission. We embody the Lockheed Martin core values. Learn more about our Culture

WHY JOIN US

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s competitive and comprehensive benefits

Plans, implements, tests, documents, and maintains solutions for the integration and testing of in-house developed and COTS/GOTS components, elements, subsystems and/or systems. Synthesizes customer contractual needs and requirements into system test solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule and cost constraints. Establishes functional and technical specifications and standards, solves hardware/software interface problems, defines input/output parameters, and ensures integration of the entire system or subsystem. Reviews, evaluates and derives requirements for testability, develops and directs preparation and execution of comprehensive test plans, procedures and schedules for complete systems and/or subsystems. Coordinates subsystem and/or system testing activities with programs and other organizations. Performs analysis of test results and prepares comprehensive subsystem and/or system level evaluation reports which verify and validate system performance. Writes discrepancy reports and performs integration regression testing to verify/validate incorporated fixes to software, components, subsystems and systems.

Basic Qualifications

  • Excellent written/verbal communication skills
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Experience with Python and Linux
  • Experience with Automated Testing
  • While no clearance is required to start, candidate must be willing to obtain a Secret clearance

Desired Skills

Understanding/Experience with:

  • PostgreSQL
  • Robot Framework
  • Test Case Planning/Development
  • Requirement Writing/Reading

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.

Amazon's Leo ecommerce team is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer II to own the frontend quality of the Leo website — the destination where customers discover, purchase, and manage their internet service. In this role, you will build test strategies and Playwright automation for a product that is actively expanding into new countries, giving you the chance to define scalable testing practices from the ground up. You will work closely with product managers, UX designers, and software developers to catch issues early, surface missed use cases during grooming, and raise the quality bar so that every feature meets customer expectations before it ever reaches production.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end testing of the Leo ecommerce frontend experience, creating and executing test plans that cover functional, integration, and regression scenarios across multiple country launches.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, evaluate coverage ROI, and define strategies for when and what to automate — partnering with the development team to expand automation over time.
  • Participate in product grooming sessions alongside product managers and UX designers, providing the QA perspective to identify edge cases, clarify acceptance criteria, and flag risks before development begins.
  • Triage and prioritize bugs, perform root cause analysis, and drive defect resolution to reduce the number of issues that reach production.
  • Own testing runbooks and QA documentation for the team, ensuring processes are repeatable and scalable as the product grows into new markets.

A day in the life

You will start many mornings reviewing incoming bug tickets and prioritizing what needs attention, then shift into proactive work — writing test plans for upcoming features or extending Playwright automation. Expect to spend a good portion of your week in collaborative sessions with UX designers, developers, and product managers during grooming and sprint ceremonies, where your input directly shapes what gets built and how. Between those sessions, you will have heads-down time to execute tests, refine runbooks, and analyze quality metrics. This is an independent, self-directed role where you decide where your attention has the most impact.

The Leo ecommerce team builds and operates the website where customers learn about, purchase, and manage their Amazon internet service. As Leo expands into new countries, the team is investing in scalable processes and automation to keep pace with growth. You will join a collaborative group of developers, product managers, and UX designers who value clear communication and a shared commitment to getting the details right. This is a great opportunity to build expertise in commerce at scale, international expansion, and modern test automation in the age of AI.

  • Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects

  • 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
  • Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
  • Experience with performance and scalability testing
  • Experience working closely with development and business teams to communicate problem impacts and to understand business requirements

Job Description

QE Automation Engineer

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

We are seeking an experienced Automation Quality Engineer (QE) with strong expertise in test automation using Selenium and Cucumber. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation frameworks and ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of applications throughout the software development lifecycle.

The role requires strong hands-on automation experience, programming skills, knowledge of modern testing methodologies, and the ability to collaborate effectively with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other QE engineers in an Agile environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, and Test Automation.
  • Strong experience with Selenium WebDriver for web application automation.
  • Strong experience with Cucumber and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, preferably Java.
  • Strong understanding of Gherkin syntax, feature files, step definitions, hooks, and Cucumber test execution.
  • Experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks using patterns such as Page Object Model (POM).
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit or TestNG.
  • Experience with build and dependency-management tools such as Maven or Gradle.
  • Experience with REST API testing using tools/frameworks such as REST Assured, Postman, or equivalent.
  • Experience working with Git-based source control and branching strategies.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.
  • Good understanding of SQL and relational databases for backend data validation.
  • Strong understanding of software testing concepts, including functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, smoke, and negative testing.
  • Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and SDLC/STLC processes.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain robust test automation frameworks using Selenium and Cucumber.
  • Develop automated functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test suites for web-based applications.
  • Create and maintain BDD feature files and scenarios using Gherkin/Cucumber based on business and functional requirements.
  • Develop reusable automation components, utilities, page objects, and test libraries.
  • Execute automated test suites, analyze failures, identify root causes, and communicate defects to development teams.
  • Inte grate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster feedback.
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define appropriate test strategies.
  • Participate in requirement reviews, design discussions, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Identify appropriate candidates for automation and continuously improve automation coverage.
  • Perform API and service-level testing and validate integrations between application components.
  • Develop and maintain test data required for automated and manual testing.
  • Perform database validation using SQL queries where required.
  • Track defects through resolution and perform regression testing to validate fixes.
  • Analyze automation execution results and provide clear quality metrics and test reports.
  • Troubleshoot complex application and automation issues using logs, debugging tools, and other diagnostic techniques.
  • Conduct code reviews for automation scripts and ensure adherence to coding standards and automation best practices.
  • Continuously improve test frameworks, processes, execution efficiency, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to promote shift-left testing and quality engineering practices throughout the SDLC.

Salary Range- $100,000-$120,000 a year

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills



-  Proven experience as an Automation Tester, QA Engineering or similar role.
-  Strong understanding of software testing methodologies.
-  Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
-  Good communication and collaboration skills.

Roles & Responsibilities



-  Design, write, and execute automated test scripts using tools like Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, etc.
-  Good knowledge and hands-on in Java, Python, SQL are encouraged
-  Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for various applications.
-  Work closely with software developers to understand the code structure and design automated tests accordingly.
-  Participate in code reviews and provide feedback on automated test scripts.
-  Identify, document, and track software defects and issues.
-  Work with the development team to resolve bugs and verify fixes.
-  Set up and maintain test environments, including test data and test environments.
-  Ensure that test environments are kept up-to-date with the latest software builds and configurations

Salary Range: $90,000 to $115,000 per year

Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE
title: QA Engineer

companyDescription:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is the technology partner of choice for industry-leading organizations worldwide. Since its inception in 1968, TCS has upheld the highest standards of innovation, engineering excellence, and customer service.

It has set an aspiration to become the world's largest AI-led technology services company and is enabling its clients to transform themselves across the full AI stack, from infrastructure to intelligence.

Rooted in the heritage of the Tata Group, TCS is focused on creating long term value for its clients, its investors, its employees, and the community at large. With a highly skilled workforce spread across 56 countries and 194 service delivery centers across the world, the company has been recognized as a top employer in six continents. With the ability to rapidly apply and scale new technologies, the company has built long-term partnerships with its clients. Many of these relationships have endured into decades and navigated every technology cycle, from mainframes in the 1970s to artificial intelligence today.

TCS sponsors 14 of the world’s most prestigious marathons and endurance events, including the TCS New York City Marathon, TCS London Marathon, Tata Mumbai Marathon, and TCS Sydney Marathon with a focus on promoting health, sustainability, and community empowerment.

Caution against fraudulent job offers: TCS doesn’t charge any fee throughout the recruitment process. Refer here: https://www.tcs.com/careers/india/recruitment-fraud-alert

Job Description

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be a US Citizen or valid Green Card Holder.

This position is currently remote in the Greater Boston Area only OR hybrid 3 days per week in our Alpharetta, GA office.

Ready to take your career Global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We are looking for a Quality Assurance Analyst 1 to join our delivery teams, working on one of the highest‑volume global payment platforms in the world. Our platform processes millions of transactions daily, with a strong emphasis on robustness, security, scalability, and quality engineering excellence.

You will be part of a cross‑functional agile team consisting of developers, QA analysts, product owners, and a scrum master. Each team owns its backlog end‑to‑end, from discovery through delivery and post‑live support, operating within Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe frameworks as appropriate

What You’ll Own

As a Quality Assurance Analyst, you will contribute to delivering high‑quality software by supporting quality engineering and testing activities, collaborating closely with your team, and building strong technical and domain knowledge. You’ll help test and perfect fintech products that change the way people around the world pay, bank, and invest.

You will:

  • Contribute to the design and planning of test plans and test strategies for projects and applications
  • Support test planning activities for agile deliveries, working within Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe teams
  • Analyze requirements and user stories to understand risk and derive effective manual and automated test coverage for API's, Microservices and integrated systems
  • Execute testing thoroughly to assure software quality, including test case execution, exploratory testing, API testing, microservices testing, and automated test execution.
  • Analyze and report on quality risks based on manual and automation results, producing defect reports and test completion reports
  • Contribute to release support activities
  • Create automated tests to progress automation work items and enhance the existing test suite (using Karate framework for API and service automation)
  • Support and maintain the test automation framework, contributing to new features, existing functionality, and bug fixes
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to resolve issues in a timely manner, keeping progress and risks visible
  • Actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, recommending quality and process improvements where appropriate

What You’ll Bring

  • A Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science or other related discipline or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience
  • 3-5 years of practical experience working in a Quality Assurance or Test Automation role, supporting automated and manual testing activities with Microservices APIs
  • Curiosity – you ask the right questions, listening and learning to get better every day
  • Familiarity with working in an agile development environment (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe), ideally within complex systems
  • Hands‑on experience with test automation, including creating and maintaining automated tests
  • A solid understanding of software testing principles, including test planning, estimation, prioritization, and risk‑based testing
  • Exposure to agile testing practices such as BDD, TDD, or similar approaches and with tools like Karate or Cucumber
  • Ability to analyze requirements and user stories, identifying risks and appropriate test coverage
  • An understanding of quality management methods, tools and technologies, with a mindset focused on continuous improvement
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Expertise in at least one object-oriented language, preferably Java

It’s a bonus if you have

  • A keen interest in AI and the ability to use AI tools in your day‑to‑day work
  • Experience working in a global online business, fintech, payments, or other complex industries
  • Familiar with Contract testing, CI/CD tools like Jenkins, HTTP simulation/mocking libraries like Wiremock and exposure to Spring Framework or Spring Boot

About The Team

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

$87,300.00 - $114,800.00

The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

EEOC Statement

Global Payments is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here.

If you are made a conditional offer of employment and will be working in the United States, you will be required to undergo a drug test. In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies and requirements needed to successfully perform the position. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for individuals with qualified disabilities both during the hiring process, as well as to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, if hired.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

The Aircraft Media Gateway program enables the P-8A aircraft to deliver advanced maritime and littoral Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities, equipping the United States Navy to effectively counter existing, evolving, and emerging threats.

THE WORK

Integration & Test Engineers collaborate with the Software Engineering and Systems Engineering teams to design and execute automated software testing strategies. The ideal candidate will possess, or be willing to develop, expertise in testing integrated hardware systems.

Working in an Agile environment as part of a cross-functional product team, the candidate will be responsible for performing tasks that require strong collaboration and communication skills. Success in this role requires the ability to effectively interact with and present to various stakeholders, including internal leadership, external customers, and cross-functional teams.

Team-oriented engineers who are comfortable communicating technical capabilities to both internal and external audiences are encouraged to apply.

Who You Are

The Ideal candidate will have a bachelor's degree from an accredited university and over 2 years of experience or a master's degree with no additional experience.

Who We Are

You will be joining Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems

Learn more about Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems

Our Program team is an Integrated Engineering team that cares about each other and the mission. We embody the Lockheed Martin core values.

Learn more about our culture

WHY JOIN US

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work.

Basic Qualifications

Basic Qualifications :

  • Excellent written/verbal communication skills
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Understanding/Experience with Python and Linux
  • While no clearance is required to start, candidate must be willing to obtain a Secret clearance

Desired Skills

Understanding/Experience with:

  • PostgreSQL
  • Robot Framework
  • Automated Test
  • Test Case Planning/Development
  • Requirement Writing/Reading

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $79300.00 - $147300.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0248509

Software Test Engineer

The Opportunity:

When a user tries new software, they expect it to be intuitive and run smoothly. Functionality, reliability, and user experience are key to successful software development, and that means rigorous testing. That’s why we need a knowledgeable test engineer like you who knows how to thoroughly test software and work with developers to make sure our team releases the best software possible.

As a Software Test Engineer on our team, you’ll collaborate with developers, requirements analysts, and government stakeholders to validate software for your client. You’ll create test strategies and detailed procedures, trace requirements to verification methods, and execute tests that span functional, integration, regression, performance, and mission‑relevant evaluation. You’ll track and report bugs, verify fixes, and help guide improvements throughout the development lifecycle.

Work with us to make an impact by supporting national security.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience performing software testing, systems validation, or verification activities
  • Experience with Jira
  • Experience analyzing and comprehending software requirements, and defining test methods
  • Experience developing test plans, test cases, and detailed test procedures
  • Experience conducting functional, integration, regression, or performance testing
  • Experience in communicating findings to development teams
  • Ability to collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, and government test organizations
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with SQL scripting
  • Experience with human resources IT systems
  • Experience with automation and API tools such as Selenium, JUnit, Postman, or Cypress
  • Experience with Agile frameworks and Continuous Integration or Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced, automation-focused Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our North American Sports product team. This team develops insightful analytics and Recruit products for American Football, helping high-level coaches and analysts make faster, data-driven decisions on player performance and talent acquisition.

As the testing expert within your cross-functional squad, you'll own quality end-to-end — building the strategies and automation that ensure we're shipping software our users love. You'll drive quality discussions, challenge the team to maintain high standards, and be the advocate for reliability and performance at every stage of delivery.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, You'll

  • Lead quality initiatives. Build risk-based testing strategies tailored to your squad's architecture, drive quality discussions in scrum ceremonies, challenge defect priorities, and continuously look for ways to improve practices and keep your squad's quality processes ahead of the curve.
  • Test across the stack. Design and execute tests spanning front-end UI, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines — validating transformations, service outputs, and complex logic at scale.
  • Automate with intent. Make informed decisions about what, when, and how to automate. Use Playwright and scripting to build reliable, maintainable automated checks that keep pace with development.
  • Mentor and grow others. Use your technical depth and quality instincts to coach teammates, raise the bar for quality standards across the team, and influence how the whole squad thinks about quality.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Design, contribute to hiring, and invest in your own professional development.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln and Omaha, Nebraska are prioritized, we're open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Must-Haves

  • Quality focus. You see the big picture and use it to drive improvements in both quality and velocity.
  • Technical depth. 4+ years of software testing experience with hands-on expertise across the full stack — API testing, backend and data-heavy systems, and front-end validation — plus proficiency in automation frameworks like Playwright and languages like Python or TypeScript.
  • A track record of leadership. You've owned quality for a squad, led testing initiatives end-to-end, defined success criteria, and designed approaches that measurably reduce risk in production.
  • Investigative rigour. You dig to root causes of complex problems, back your findings with data, and measure outcomes.
  • User focus. You think critically about the user experience and let that understanding shape your testing approach.
  • AI-powered working. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — for test case creation, failure diagnosis, documentation, and beyond — and look for new ways to apply them to raise the team's efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Performance testing exposure. Familiarity with load, stress, and scalability testing concepts and tools (e.g. JMeter) for validating API and backend performance.
  • Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in Basketball, American Football or Ice Hockey — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent experience. A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We're always investing in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Take care of your mental and physical health. Medical plans tailored for you and your family—including vision, dental, and fertility benefits—and stay supported with our EAP and Employee Resource Groups.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that's free money. We'll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000 - $137,000 USD

Job Number: R0251156

Quality Assurance Engineer

The Opportunity:

A Digital Twin is only as valuable as the trust users place in it. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you'll help ensure that the applications, services, data pipelines, and simulations behind a Digital Twin and Modeling and Simulation (M&S) platform for military test ranges perform reliably, accurately, and securely.

You'll own test strategy and execution across web applications, back-end APIs, 3D and geospatial data pipelines, and real-time 3D visualization environments built on game engines. You'll build automated test suites, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines, and verify that releases meet functional, visual, performance, and security requirements before they reach mission users. You'll also help confirm that simulation outputs and 3D content accurately represent the real-world systems and environments they model. You'll work alongside full-stack developers, M&S engineers, platform engineers, and UX practitioners to catch issues early and help build quality into every stage of delivery.

In this role, you'll help define how quality is measured on a complex, emerging platform. You'll also produce the test evidence that supports releases in regulated DoD environments.

Help us deliver Digital Twin capabilities that mission users can count on.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance or test engineering
  • Experience developing automated tests for web and desktop applications using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or pytest
  • Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman or REST Assured
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins
  • Experience writing test plans, test cases, and defect reports, and tracking them in tools such as Jira or Xray
  • Experience with scripting in Python, C#, or JavaScript
  • Ability to quickly learn engine-specific testing tools
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience testing real-time 3D, simulation, or XR applications using the Unity Test Framework, Unreal Automation Framework, AltTester, or GameDriver
  • Experience with visual regression or image-comparison testing for rendered 3D content
  • Experience profiling real-time application performance using tools such as Unity Profiler, Unreal Insights, or RenderDoc
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or Locust
  • Experience validating 3D and geospatial data, including OpenUSD, point clouds, meshes, or GIS formats
  • Experience with M&S verification, validation, and accreditation (VV&A), including comparing simulation outputs against reference data
  • Experience testing cloud-native applications deployed on AWS, including containerized services on Kubernetes
  • Experience with accessibility testing against Section 508 standards, security testing, or supporting DoD ATO test evidence and compliance requirements
  • Secret clearance
  • ISTQB or equivalent Testing Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

  • Contribute to automation frameworks utilizing technologies such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, Pytest, or similar tools.

  • Leverage QA metrics, KPIs, and testing analytics to improve quality processes, tools, and best practices.

  • Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and troubleshooting.
  • Experience using Jira, TestRail, or similar test management and defect tracking platforms.

  • Understanding of Git source control and pull-request workflows.
  • Experience testing telecommunications, broadband, IPTV, VoIP, or network-based services is highly preferred.

  • Experience building or maintaining automated tests using Python, Pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud environments.
  • Experience with API performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or Locust.
  • Experience testing IoT, smart-home, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or connected-device ecosystems.
  • ISTQB Foundation or Test Automation Certification.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools and automation technologies

Job Number: R0252916

Automation Test Engineer

The Opportunity:

When a user tries new software, they expect it to be intuitive and run smoothly. Functionality, reliability, and user experience are key to successful software development and that means rigorous testing. That’s why we need you, an experienced test engineer who knows how to thoroughly test software and work with developers to make sure our team releases the best software possible.

As a test engineer on our team, you’ll use your experience to work with testers and developers to evaluate an enterprise web application. You’ll create a test plan with test cases based on user stories. Using automated and manual processes, you’ll generate data and implement the test cases to observe how the application performs, then document the results and communicate defects to the development team so they can start improving the tool.

You’ll automate continuous security and performance testing and monitor the health of the application. This is an opportunity to supercharge your skills by writing the code to test. You’ll also broaden your experience in cloud development, and AI integration and gain skills in new areas such as automation, cloud computing, machine learning while sharing your testing experience with your team.

Work with us as we develop software solutions to protect our nation’s security

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience testing or developing software applications
  • Experience designing and executing test scripts, test plans, and procedures and documenting the expected and actual results
  • Experience creating and updating automated test cases and scripts
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines such as Github or Gitlab
  • Experience with test methodologies, software release cycle, test effort estimation, and tracking
  • Experience in Linux environments
  • Experience generating and managing test data
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience programming in Python
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or Locust
  • Experience testing Cloud-based architectures
  • Experience with an Agile release methodology
  • Experience in backend testing, API testing, UI testing, and DB queries
  • Experience with functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and performance testing
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative team environment
  • Possession of excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or an IT field


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Skill: QA Automation Engineer

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile testing methodologies, and QA best practices.
  • Hands-on experience in Playwright test automation framework development.
  • Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript for automation scripting.

  • Experience transforming or migrating Selenium-based automation scripts to Playwright.
  • Strong experience in API testing using Postman, Rest Assured, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience creating and maintaining automation frameworks from the ground up.
  • Strong understanding of automation framework design, test strategy, and test execution.
  • Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge for database validation and backend testing.
  • Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, ALM, or Azure DevOps.
  • Strong experience with Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, or Azure Repos.
  • Experience working in Unix/Linux environments and batch processing systems.
  • Ability to analyze job execution logs, automation logs, failures, and data load issues.
  • Experience developing automated data validation and reconciliation frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical designs to ensure testability and coverage.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web applications using Playwright.
  • Build and enhance automation frameworks to improve test coverage, maintainability, scalability, and execution efficiency.
  • Design, develop, and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, and automation suites.
  • Execute functional, regression, integration, system, UAT, smoke, and end-to-end testing.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Execute API testing and validate integrations across multiple systems.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing.
  • Identify, log, track, and retest defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and DevOps teams to resolve quality issues.
  • Validate fixes and ensure end-to-end traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects.
  • Create and maintain test data, automation assets, and testing documentation.
  • Support release activities, production deployments, and post-release validations.
  • Produce test execution reports, quality metrics, and status updates for stakeholders.
  • Continuously improve QA processes, automation frameworks, and testing best practices.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

Job Description

It’s about putting our best to the test.

Are you described as someone with an inquisitive mind and an innovative personality? Are you never satisfied with good enough? Does solving complex problems and ensuring top-quality applications excite you? If so, being a Quality Automation Engineer I with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who You Are

As a Quality Automation Engineer I - Enterprise Payments - Global Trade Systems, you are our quality control, ensuring every application is stable and built with integrity, caring and excellence. You’ll play an important role in the design, creation, and testing of applications to ensure the quality and stability in every system. You’ll use your strong problem-solving skills to ensure that the applications are performing optimally and meet our high standards. You are not afraid to ask the question why and thrive in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do



- Design, build, and deploy automated test scripts for an assigned system to ensure the quality and stability of software applications
- Assist with troubleshooting and triaging script and system issues with project teams to identify the root causes and resolve issues
- Document, track, and escalate issues with application changes or test scripts
- Communicate with product management, project management and development teams to develop a strong understanding of the project, product, and testing objectives
- Write and execute functional test cases as needed
- Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What You’ll Need



- Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent technical experience
- Proficiency in Java or scripting languages like Ruby or Python
- Strong understanding of Object-Oriented programming concepts
- Knowledge of SQL queries

Additional Preferred Skills



- Experience in processing Wires Payments (Domestic, International, FX, Global trade systems), knowing ISO 20022 standards
- Experience with identifying technical issues including misconfigurations and defects in code
- Knowledge of developing functional, load, or batch test automation solutions
- Knowledge of testing methodologies and processes
- Knowledge of Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, API - Postman/Karate
- Experience using automated testing tools like Junit, TestNG, Appium, JMeter, XCUITest, and/or Expresso
- Experience with a distributed version-control system like GIT

- Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance

Location

Hartford, Connecticut.

Work Model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible and support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a Hyrbid position requiring associates to work from the client location. Please note that this position is not eligible for visa transfer or sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

  • Support Agile teams through in-sprint and regression automation activities.
  • Design and enhance automation frameworks to improve efficiency and test coverage.
  • Leverage AI-assisted testing approaches to improve quality engineering outcomes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve quality issues.
  • Mentor offshore team members and provide technical guidance on automation best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Quality Engineering and Test Automation.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and Selenium.
  • Strong programming experience with Java.
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Experience with database testing and SQL validation.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
  • Ability to design scalable test automation frameworks.
  • Exposure to Generative AI or AI-assisted testing tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Insurance domain experience.
  • Experience leading offshore QA teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Passion for quality engineering and continuous improvement.

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled or withdrawn.

The annual salary for this position is between $53,477 and $104,500, depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences.
