The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Automation & Testing Execution: Design, write, and maintain robust automated test suites while creating targeted manual test cases for features requiring hands-on validation.
  • Agile Requirements Refinement: Active participation in story grooming and refinement sessions to clarify acceptance criteria, spot edge cases early, and ensure testability.
  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys.   • Execute Tests: Apply expertise in automation to execute tests, ensuring high-quality software delivery and identifying areas for process improvement.

  • Test Automation Tools Expertise: Exposure to various test automation tools and technologies, with the ability to design and implement automated testing solutions for IT systems and applications.

  • Test Data Management: Exposure to automation for managing test data and environment-related automation, supporting seamless testing processes.
  • Delivery Automation Integration: Experience working with integrating testing automation into overall delivery automation, aligning with contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers.
  • Automated Test Execution: Exposure to applying expertise in automation to execute tests, ensuring high-quality software delivery and identifying areas for process improvement.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Contemporary Trends Knowledge: Exposure to contemporary trends like Agile, DevOps, and Containers, with the ability to align testing automation with these methodologies.
  • Test Automation Optimization: Experience working with various test automation tools and technologies to optimize testing processes and ensure efficient software delivery.
  • Delivery Automation Understanding: Exposure to integrating testing automation into overall delivery automation, with the ability to collaborate and ensure alignment with organizational goals and methodologies.

Preferred Skills: Test Automation Specialist – Playwright & Selenium

WHERE DO WE START?

How about Kansas City? That’s our home. That’s where Garmin put a stake in the ground in 1989. We’ve grown substantially over the years, offering diverse products and global reach in 5 diverse markets. But some things won’t ever change: Our entrepreneurial spirit and a culture where everyone’s opinion matters. That’s because we believe it’s possible to light the tech world on fire and still be on a first name basis.

BIG IDEAS, SMALL EGOS

What we do best is make products that let our customers do what they love. To do that, we focus on practical innovation, never losing sight of the benefits our products bring to our customers. Sure, we love bells and whistles. What leading technology company doesn't? But we make sure ours have purpose. It’s not about the things we make. It’s about the things we make possible.

WE’RE GLOBAL, SERIOUSLY.

Yeah, we’re based in Kansas City, but we are truly a global company. With offices throughout Europe, Asia, Middle East, South America and Australia, our products are sold all over the world. One elevator ride at our headquarters and you’re likely to hear 4 (or more) different languages being spoken. At Garmin, we may act local, but we think global.

DREAM BIG. SLEEP WELL.

At Garmin, we like to encourage dreamers. But at some point it’s nice to wake up and enjoy a fully aware life. So we make it super easy to achieve a good balance between working, dreaming and enjoying life—from workout classes offered throughout the day, breaks to get out and move on our campus, and wellness programs offered throughout the year. It’s almost impossible not to take advantage of Garmin’s work-life balance opportunities.

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Automation Engineer to join our QA Engineering team and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using industry best practices. A QA Automation Engineer applies engineering principles to the design, development, and execution of software tests, with the primary goal of automating testing to identify defects before software reaches end users and to ensure product quality and reliability. This role develops and executes test cases, creates test plans, documents and tracks defects with clear reproduction steps, collaborates with developers and cross-functional teams to verify fixes, and supports bug remediation, system maintenance-including releases, patches, and upgrades-and software deployment. Success in this position requires hands-on automation experience, strong attention to detail, effective communication skills, a commitment to continuous learning, and comfort working in a SAFe Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the software quality assurance lifecycle within an Agile process, actively participating in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other ceremonies.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and execute scalable automated test frameworks and scripts for new and existing features using Selenium, Appium, TypeScript, Gherkin/BDD, and the Page Object Model.
  • Apply appropriate software development and design methodologies, industry best practices, and reusable automation components to continuously improve test efficiency, coverage, performance, and framework stability.
  • Establish test strategies and create test plans, test cases, scripts, and supporting documentation based on product and design requirements.
  • Perform functional, regression, and integration testing; review software components for adherence to design requirements; analyze results; and document outcomes.
  • Identify, report, and track defects in systems such as Jira, provide clear reproduction steps, and collaborate with developers, product managers, and QA and cross-functional teams to define test requirements and verify fixes.
  • Troubleshoot automation issues and update scripts and frameworks as application functionality and technical requirements evolve.
  • Enhance and maintain automated CI/CD workflows by integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

Qualifications

4 years with BS/BA; 8 years with HS degree; 6 years with AS Degree.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Web and browser test automation: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver, Selenium Grid, LambdaTest, and Sauce Labs.
  • Mobile test automation: Appium, Espresso for Android, XCTest for iOS, LambdaTest Real Device Mobile Cloud, Sauce Labs Government Cloud, and Kobiton.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript and behavior-driven development frameworks and specifications, including Cucumber and Gherkin.
  • Solid understanding of the Page Object Model design pattern and reusable test automation architecture.
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems; GitLab experience is a plus.
  • Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira and API testing tools such as Postman.
  • Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and workflows, including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps.

Requirements

  • 4+ years progressive experience in quality assurance job roles
  • BA/BS (4 year) degree in and IT or math related field/ or equivalent years of experience
  • Primary work locations in Tacoma, WA, Aurora, CO, San Antonio, TX, and Falls Church, VA. (Remote or hybrid work may be considered in special cases when approved by the customer.)
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Public Trust Clearance/ or ability to obtain one

Experience working within Military Health environments is a plus

Details

Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Job Description

About Us

Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.

We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

TP-Link is seeking a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Cloud Web Platforms Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality of TP-Link's global websites, web applications, and AI-powered customer experiences, which reach millions of users across dozens of countries and languages.

You will drive quality throughout the development lifecycle—from reviewing requirements and identifying risks to designing tests, expanding automation coverage, investigating failures, and supporting release decisions. The work ranges from product pages and content-management platforms to AI-powered search and support assistants. You also have the opportunity to contribute to testing the cloud services and APIs behind these experiences. Throughout, you'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, designers, and senior quality engineers.

This role is ideal for a quality engineer who enjoys both breadth and depth: someone comfortable moving between browser-based UI testing, backend API validation, and automation, and who wants to grow expertise across web and cloud technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Develop risk-based test strategies and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for websites, web applications, content-management systems, APIs, and supporting cloud services.
  • Participate in requirements reviews and design discussions to clarify acceptance criteria, identify risks early, and improve product testability.
  • Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript and frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent tools. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Validate backend APIs, service integrations, database behavior, and data integrity using API tools, code-based test frameworks, and SQL.
  • Investigate failures and isolate root causes using browser developer tools, network traces, application logs, system telemetry, and database queries.
  • Perform release validation across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, including responsive UI, visual regression, functional, and end-to-end testing to ensure seamless product rollouts.
  • Conduct web performance, load, and accessibility testing, monitoring metrics like Core Web Vitals and ensuring compliance with WCAG guidelines.
  • Produce clear test reports, defect analyses, and go/no-go risk assessments to support release decisions.
  • Advocate for QA best practices, test-code quality, and continuous improvement, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in software quality engineering, with significant experience testing web applications.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, using browser developer tools to inspect network requests, console errors, and page behavior.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated UI and API tests in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs with tools such as Postman or code-based test frameworks, and validating data using SQL.
  • Working knowledge of how websites are built and delivered, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP, redirects, caching, and content-management systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain quality risks and test results clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning quality for a web product, website migration, or CMS platform from planning through release.
  • Experience testing SEO elements, structured data (Schema.org), analytics and tag implementations, or localized content across many locales.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features such as chatbots, search, or recommendations, including approaches for evaluating non-deterministic output.
  • Experience with web performance and accessibility testing tools such as Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or axe.
  • Experience testing applications deployed on AWS or other public cloud platforms, or backend services built on microservices.
  • Familiarity with visual regression testing tools such as Percy, Applitools, or Chromatic.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted testing solutions to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity.
  • Experience with networking products, smart home technologies, connected device ecosystems, or e-commerce websites.

Why Join TP-Link

  • Shape the quality of TP-Link’s global websites and web experiences, used by customers in over 170 countries.
  • Work across web and cloud technologies, from browser-based applications to the APIs and services behind them.
  • Help define how the team tests emerging AI-powered features such as conversational assistants and intelligent search.
  • Build scalable automation using modern frameworks and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Collaborate with talented engineering, product, and design teams across global locations.
  • Grow your career with broad ownership and visible impact on TP-Link’s next generation of web and cloud experiences.

TP-Link is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Benefits

Salary Range:

$100,000 - 130,000

Benefits:

  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
  • Contributions to 401k funds
  • Over four weeks of PTO per year
  • Bi-annual pay increases
  • Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
  • Quarterly team-building events

At TP-Link Systems Inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. We believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. As a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. If you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at TP-Link Systems Inc.

Please, no third-party agency inquiries, and we are unable to offer visa sponsorships at this time.

Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to join our Atlanta-based Quality Assurance organization. In this role, you will combine strong functional testing discipline with practical automation, AI-assisted workflows, exploratory testing, defect management, and quality reporting.

This position will help shape how our organization adopts automation and artificial intelligence in a practical, sustainable way. You will use AI tooling and automation to strengthen our QA process, applying them across requirements analysis, test authoring, coverage review, automation planning, execution, and reporting. We are looking for an engineer who can meet the organization where it is today while helping establish scalable practices for where it needs to go next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role that does not require people management.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Functional Test Ownership
    • Assume full accountability for functional test coverage of assigned applications, including the user interface, service layers, and integration points.
    • Be hands-on across assigned applications, combining manual, exploratory, regression, integration, and automated testing based on risk, value, and maintainability.
    • Define and maintain the application's test strategy, determining which tests should remain manual, which should be automated, and how coverage should evolve over time.
    • Act as the quality authority for the application, providing evidence-based release readiness assessments to engineering and product leadership.
  • AI-Enabled Quality Workflow
    • You will apply AI tooling and automation selectively across the quality lifecycle, with emphasis on improving consistency, speed, coverage, and decision-making:
    • Evaluate requirements, acceptance criteria, and design documentation to surface ambiguities, missing edge cases, and untestable requirements prior to development.
    • Create manual test cases and scenarios from requirements, then apply engineering judgment to refine, consolidate, and prioritize them.
    • Review implemented functionality, requirements, and the existing test suite to identify coverage gaps, duplicate effort, ineffective assertions, and divergence between specified and actual behavior.
    • Assess each test for automation suitability based on stability, execution frequency, maintenance cost, and exploratory value, and make defensible recommendations on automated versus manual execution.
    • Build and maintain Playwright automation where it provides clear value, using AI tooling to accelerate authoring, refactoring, debugging, and long-term maintenance.
    • Operate automated suites within CI/CD pipelines while continuing to perform manual, exploratory, and scenario-based testing where human judgment is the better instrument.
    • Triage, reproduce, document, and drive defects to resolution, using AI-assisted analysis to shorten root-cause isolation.
    • Produce clear, decision-ready reporting on coverage, execution results, defect trends, and release risk.
  • Test Framework Development
    • Contribute substantively to the organization's growing QA automation framework, extending its capability while ensuring it complements a manual testing model.
    • Design and implement automation solutions when required, including architecture, page and component abstractions, fixtures, test data management, environment configuration, CI integration, and reporting, with attention to long-term adoption.
    • Establish automation standards and design patterns that keep test suites fast, reliable, readable, and approachable for QA engineers building automation skills.
  • Technical Leadership
    • Lead by example through code review, pairing, and hands-on guidance; help manual QA engineers build practical automation, AI, and technical testing skills over time.
    • Serve as a resource for the broader QA and engineering organization on practical automation, AI-assisted testing methods, and when manual testing remains the most effective approach.
    • Partner with software engineers, product managers, and DevOps to shift quality activities earlier in the delivery cycle.
Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, including strong manual testing experience and meaningful hands-on test automation work.
  • Demonstrated depth with Playwright, extending beyond test authoring to suite architecture, flakiness mitigation, test data strategy, and execution at scale within CI.
  • Practical, applied experience using AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of a routine development or testing workflow for example, AI coding agents, AI-assisted test authoring, or AI-supported code and requirements analysis.
  • Strong foundation in functional testing, including test design techniques, risk-based prioritization, boundary and negative testing, and structured exploratory testing.
  • Experience contributing to or building test automation frameworks, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and adapt solutions for teams at different automation maturity levels.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript, or comparable programming experience with the ability to become productive quickly.
  • Experience owning both manual and automated testing for an application, with sound judgment regarding the appropriate role of each in a hybrid QA model.
  • Working knowledge of defect and test management tooling such as Jira, Xray, or equivalent.
  • Experience integrating automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; test plans, defect reports, and quality summaries must stand on their own without narration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code or a comparable AI coding agent.
  • Experience creating AI agent skills and custom agents, and using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including building MCP servers when existing tooling is not sufficient.
  • API test automation experience across REST or GraphQL, including contract testing.
  • Experience helping a manual QA organization adopt automation, AI tooling, or modern quality practices in a practical and sustainable way.
  • Background in a regulated or high-reliability domain.

Job Description

Agilent is seeking an experienced and motivated Advanced Test Engineer to join the Software Quality Engineering organization within the Services Division of the Agilent CrossLab Group (ACG).

The Advanced Test Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions across the Services software portfolio. This role partners closely with Product Management, Software Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Customer Support teams to define test strategies, implement automated quality solutions, and drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will combine strong testing expertise, technical depth, business understanding, and Agile delivery experience to identify quality risks, improve engineering practices, and ensure reliable software releases. The role is expected to leverage modern test automation, AI-assisted testing techniques, and continuous quality engineering principles to improve product quality and delivery efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own quality planning, test strategy, and validation activities for one or more software products.
  • Participate as an active member of Agile product teams, collaborating with Product Owners, developers, architects, and DevOps engineers.
  • Define and execute risk-based testing strategies focused on business-critical functionality and quality risks.
  • Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, API, and automated testing.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions that support CI/CD pipelines.
  • Perform backend and data validation testing, including database verification and system integration validation.
  • Review requirements and designs to ensure testability, quality, and customer value.
  • Identify quality risks early and drive preventative quality engineering practices.
  • Perform root cause analysis and partner with engineering teams to improve product quality and reliability.
  • Contribute to test environment management, test data strategy, release readiness assessments, and defect governance.
  • Drive continuous improvement of testing approaches, frameworks, and engineering processes.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across quality initiatives.
  • Support compliance, cybersecurity, and regulatory validation activities where applicable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline.
  • 4+ years of software testing, quality engineering, or software development experience. 5 years of experience is helpful.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing comprehensive test strategies and test plans.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies including functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and automated testing practices.
  • Experience validating web applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise software systems.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause investigation skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while influencing cross-functional teams and technical decisions.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated testing solutions.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting automated tests within CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman, REST API testing, or similar automation technologies.
  • Experience testing cloud-native or SaaS applications.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing tools, test generation, or intelligent quality engineering approaches.
  • Experience in laboratory informatics, compliance software, scientific software, or regulated environments.
  • Experience with performance, security, and reliability testing.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers or leading quality initiatives across multiple teams.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 24, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $119,200.00 - $223,500.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

Lockheed Martin Space is seeking a full-time Software Test Engineer. In this role, you will support the software engineering lifecycle following the Software Development Plan (SDP) program to include requirements analysis, code & unit test, integration testing, requirements verification, and support to formal test/delivery.

The successful candidate will have experience and/or knowledge of languages such as Perl, Python, and C++. Must be a US Citizen; this position will require Interim Secret government security clearance prior to starting and the ability. This position is located at a facility that requires special access.

Basic Qualifications

  • Proficient in Python, and C++.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with multi‑disciplinary, team‑based groups.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance

Desired Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM‑related discipline from an accredited university.
  • Experience across the full software life‑cycle (design, architecture, development, integration, test, qualification).
  • Familiarity with embedded software/hardware (hands‑on or academic).
  • Working knowledge of DevOps/DevSecOps tools (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security scanning).
  • Comfortable in Agile development environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to test and verify software against defined requirements.
  • Active DOD Secret Clearance

Full-Time Salary Range: $98100.00 - $182100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a member of IT FinSight Delivery team, the Delivery Practice Office Testing ("DPO") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare, maintain and execute test cases based on user stories; present results and track defects to closure
  • Prepare, maintain and execute automated test scripts
  • Maintain traceability from business requirements through test cases to automated scripts
  • Review test cases / automation approach with stakeholder to ensure comprehensive coverage and obtain feedback
  • Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines
  • Construct appropriate end-2-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals
  • Collaborate with delivery pipeline teams to drive adoption and resolve open issues;
  • Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements; manage and maintain environment and data.
  • Provide guidance to colleagues related to test coverage and test cases
  • Develop a detailed understanding of the product being delivered
  • Responsible for process compliance & associated documentation
  • Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately

NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above.*

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 6 years of related experience
  • Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

  • Java-based test automation using frameworks such as TestNG, Karate, Rest Assured, and Cucumber, including BDD layer with Gherkin, data-driven testing, and API request/response validation.
  • REST API testing using tools like Postman, JMeter, Karate, and Rest Assured, working across multiple payload formats (JSON, XML, CSV).
  • Oracle database experience using Toad and Java JDBC for data access, along with automated data validation.
  • Familiarity with Amazon S3 and file storage across JSON, XML and CSV formats. Test Automation Exposure in S3.
  • Selenium Grid for UI automation testing
  • ALM (Micro Focus ALM / QC Center) for test case management.
  • JIRA integrated with ALM for requirements, test cases, and automation metrics.
  • Git / Bitbucket for source control
  • Fosters a culture where honesty and transparency are expected.
  • Stays current on changes in his/her own specialist area and seeks out learning opportunities to ensure knowledge is up-to-date.
  • Invests effort to individually coach others.
  • Builds collaborative teams across the organization.
  • Communicates openly keeping everyone across the organization informed.

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits



-  Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
-  Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
-  Pension / Retirement benefits
-  Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
-  DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a member of IT FinSight Delivery team, the Delivery Practice Office Testing ("DPO") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

-  Prepare, maintain and execute automated test scripts
-  Maintain traceability from business requirements through test cases to automated scripts
-  Review test cases / automation approach with stakeholder to ensure comprehensive coverage and obtain feedback
-  Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines

-  Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements; manage and maintain environment and data.

-  Develop a detailed understanding of the product being delivered
-  Responsible for process compliance & associated documentation
-  Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately

-  Minimum of 6 years of related experience
-  Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience

-  REST API testing using tools like Postman, JMeter, Karate, and Rest Assured, working across multiple payload formats (JSON, XML, CSV).
-  Oracle database experience using Toad and Java JDBC for data access, along with automated data validation.
-  Familiarity with Amazon S3 and file storage across JSON, XML and CSV formats. Test Automation Exposure in S3.
-  Selenium Grid for UI automation testing
-  ALM (Micro Focus ALM / QC Center) for test case management.
-  JIRA integrated with ALM for requirements, test cases, and automation metrics.
-  Git / Bitbucket for source control
-  Fosters a culture where honesty and transparency are expected.
-  Stays current on changes in his/her own specialist area and seeks out learning opportunities to ensure knowledge is up-to-date.

Position Description:

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you will work with multiple product teams to validate the quality, security, and scalability of user interfaces, web services, APIs, and distributed enterprise workflows.


This role will have an emphasis on managing performance/load testing within our current K6 environment.


In addition, you will design and execute end-to-end automated tests, benchmark system behavior, analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and improve the test suite for performance and reliability. You will also collaborate closely with software development partners to define test strategies, expand automation, and responsibly use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support test creation, code review, documentation, and regression analysis while maintaining strong human oversight.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage, troubleshoot and report on performance/load testing of web sites and components using our K6 environment. It measures the throughput and resilience of thousands of printers hitting a site for the purpose of issuing credit, debit and ID cards.
  • Author automated test cases using modern frameworks such as Playwright with C# and API-testing tools such as RestSharp and Playwright.
  • End-to-end automated deployment, setup and system testing of our solutions encompassing many of our software and hardware products.
  • Set up cloud and on-premises environments to verify supported solution scenarios, including LDAP, database, and network configurations.
  • Some possible Dev Ops work to automate creating different environments including single and distributed deployment.
  • Daily collaboration with the project teams, including project management, technical leads, and developers to provide status on current issues, upcoming issues, and possible future enhancements.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test-case generation, automation scripting, pull request analysis, test documentation, and regression impact assessment.
  • Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, privacy, completeness, and alignment with product behavior before incorporating it into test assets or automation suites.



Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Test/Quality Assurance, IT Infrastructure or Support
  • 3+ years of experience developing automated tests with automation frameworks such as RestAssured, Selenium, and/or Playwright.
  • Performance/Load testing
  • Programming experience in C#. JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Powershell.
  • Practical experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable approved AI-assisted coding tools for test automation, code review assistance, debugging support, documentation, and productivity improvement.
  • Ability to write clear prompts, provide relevant code and test context, evaluate AI-generated suggestions, and identify when manual QA judgment is required.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and a clear understanding of the QA role and responsibilities in an Agile development environment.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the U.S.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with K6 performance testing tool
  • Ansible experience scripting deployments from development to test to production.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Bitbucket for source code control.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Microsoft Azure DevOps Server for user-story coordination, test-case management, build integration, and issue tracking.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted QA workflows with pull requests, design documentation, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, logs, virtual machines, or test reporting.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including approved-tool usage, sensitive-data handling, intellectual-property awareness, secure coding guardrails, and review of AI-generated automation before reuse.


Where you will be: This is a hybrid role requiring three days per week in our Shakopee, MN headquarters office.


About Entrust


Our growing company relies on curious, dedicated and innovative colleagues to anticipate the future and provide solutions for a more connected, mobile and secure world. Entrust technologies and expertise help government agencies, enterprises and financial institutions in more than 150 countries, serve and safeguard citizens, employees and consumers. Each year, our solutions secure billions of transactions — and every day, our technologies issue and manage more than 10 million secure identities. How do we do all of this? Together.

At Entrust, we don’t just offer jobs – we offer career journeys. Here is what you can expect when you join our team:

  • Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority.
  • Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.
  • Inclusion: Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect.


For more information, visit www.entrust.com. Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

Entrust Corporation is an EOE/AA/Veteran/People with Disabilities employer.


NO AGENCIES, NO RELOCATION

Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector is seeking a Systems Test Engineer to join our team in Aurora, CO.

Role Overview

We are seeking mid- to senior-level Systems Test Engineers (Level 3 and Level 4) to join an Agile development team delivering mission-critical capabilities. In this role, you will define test objectives, design and execute manual and automated tests, and work closely with developers, product owners, and systems engineers to ensure high-quality, reliable software deliveries. Level 4 engineers are also expected to provide technical leadership, mentorship, and contribute to test strategy and process improvements across the team.

Responsibilities

  • Participate as a core member of an Agile/Scrum team, supporting sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Analyze test requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation to define clear, measurable test objectives.
  • Design detailed test cases, test procedures, and verification steps based on technical specifications and interface definitions.
  • Execute functional, regression, and end-to-end tests for developer-delivered software changes across web, service, and data layers.
  • Isolate, reproduce, troubleshoot, and document defects with clear, actionable defect reports.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated tests and scripts using tools and languages such as Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Test REST APIs, service interfaces, and data-driven workflows using tools such as Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Curl, or equivalent.
  • Review and interpret application, service, container, and system logs to support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, scrum masters, and systems engineers to clarify requirements, improve testability, and drive quality throughout the lifecycle.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of test strategies, tooling, and processes; Level 4 engineers lead and champion these improvements across the program.

This requisition may be filled at a higher job grade based on the qualifications listed below.

This requisition may be filled as either a Level 3 or Level 4.

Basic Qualifications For a Level 3

  • Must have an active Top Secret/SCI clearance at time of application
  • Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of relevant experience – OR – Master’s degree with 6 years of relevant experience – OR – PhD with 4 years of relevant experience. An additional 4 years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience defining clear, measurable test objectives from test requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to design detailed test cases, test procedures, and verification steps from technical specifications.
  • Proven experience executing functional, regression, and end-to-end testing for developer-delivered software changes.
  • Demonstrated skill in isolating, reproducing, troubleshooting, and documenting defects with precision and actionable defect reports.
  • Experience with automated testing tools and shell scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Experience testing REST APIs, service interfaces, and data-driven workflows using tools such as Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, curl, or equivalent.
  • Ability to read and interpret application, service, container, and system logs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively.

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of relevant experience – OR – Master’s degree with 6 years of relevant experience – OR – PhD with 4 years of relevant experience. An additional 4 years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Experience with automated testing tools and shell scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Experience testing REST APIs, service interfaces, and data-driven workflows using tools such as Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, curl, or equivalent.
  • Ability to read and interpret application, service, container, and system logs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within an Agile/Scrum development environment.
  • Experience working with requirements development, including refining, clarifying, and decomposing requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to implement process improvements, streamline verification activities, and develop efficiencies across the test lifecycle.
  • Experience with automated test frameworks such as JUnit, Jest, Vitest, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or comparable tools.
  • Experience supporting CI/CD-based test execution and pipeline troubleshooting using tools such as Jenkins or similar build and deployment systems.
  • Experience validating backend services and modern web applications built with technologies such as Spring Boot and React.
  • Experience performing data validation and query-based verification using MongoDB, Elasticsearch, SQL, or related data platforms.
  • Experience testing authentication, authorization, and role-based access controls, including OAuth2, OIDC, Keycloak, or similar identity solutions.
  • Experience working in Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or other containerized deployment environments.

About The Role

As a Senior Healthcare QA Engineer – Payer/ Claims, you will help ensure the quality, accuracy, and reliability of healthcare payer claims-processing applications and integrations. You will work closely with business, development, and quality engineering teams to validate complex claims workflows, EDI/X12 transactions, backend data, and downstream claim outcomes.

In this role, you will

Analyze healthcare claims requirements, user stories, and business rules to develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.

Execute functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing across healthcare payer claims-processing workflows.

Validate the claims lifecycle, including pre-adjudication logic, business validations, claim edits, rejects, pend scenarios, and downstream claim outcomes.

Perform SQL and database validation, data analysis, reconciliation, and test-data preparation to support test execution.

Conduct API and integration testing to validate accurate data exchange between upstream and downstream applications.

Investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis, collaborate with development teams, and drive issues through resolution and closure.

Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, or similar automation frameworks, while leveraging AI-assisted testing techniques where applicable.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a Remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ years of software testing experience within Healthcare Payer claims-processing environments.

Strong hands-on experience testing Healthcare Payer claims applications and workflows.

Strong understanding of the end-to-end claims’ lifecycle, including pre-adjudication, business validations, claim edits, rejects, pend processing, and downstream claim outcomes.

Hands-on experience testing EDI/X12 healthcare claims transactions, particularly 837P and 837I.

Strong SQL and database-testing skills, including backend data validation, reconciliation, and test-data preparation.

Experience creating and executing functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing for complex claims-processing workflows.

Knowledge of PEGA-based healthcare solutions.

Experience with API and integration testing using modern testing tools and methodologies.

Hands-on automation experience using Selenium, Playwright, or similar test-automation frameworks.

Experience using AI-powered testing tools or GenAI capabilities for test-case generation, test optimization, automation acceleration, defect prediction, or other quality-engineering activities.

The annual salary for this position is between $96,000 to $110,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Benefits

Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The SDET family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. This may include new development, maintenance, automation, enhancement, and modernization of software products used internally and externally across DTCC platforms.

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you will help drive quality engineering practices across strategic initiatives and enterprise delivery streams. In this role, you will contribute to functional and automated testing, support shift-left quality practices, maintain end-to-end traceability, and validate complex workflows spanning user interfaces, APIs, databases, regulatory reporting, file-based ingestion, and cross-system integrations.

You will partner closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, and partner platforms to understand complex business and regulatory requirements, identify quality issues earlier in the software development lifecycle, and ensure comprehensive test coverage. The role includes backend and database validation, structured file and XML testing, automation, regulatory and reporting validation, and end-to-end data verification across integrated systems.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Apply software development and testing methodologies, tools, and technologies to validate business, functional, technical, and regulatory requirements across enterprise applications and platforms.
  • Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests across the delivery lifecycle, including functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and automation-assisted testing.
  • Partner with Software Engineers and Product Owners during refinement, story grooming, and scenario walkthroughs to clarify requirements, identify ambiguities and dependencies early, and improve testability before code completion.
  • Perform backend and database testing, including SQL-based data validation, to verify data accuracy, completeness, business rules, transformations, and application outputs and troubleshoot data discrepancies.
  • Validate API, UI, database, and cross-system behavior and perform end-to-end testing across integrated enterprise applications and platforms.
  • Perform file-based and structured data validation, including XML and CSV processing, schema/XSD validation, field mapping, transformations, report verification, ACK/NACK handling, error validation, and simulator-driven testing.
  • Perform end-to-end data validation and reconciliation across source data, database records, file outputs, transformations, regulatory reports, and downstream systems to identify inconsistencies and ensure data accuracy.
  • Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance automated tests using Java and existing automation frameworks while identifying opportunities to expand automated coverage and reduce manual testing.
  • Support regulatory and control-focused testing, including validation of transaction and reporting accuracy, reporting timeliness, privacy and data masking, entitlements, auditability, portal access, and downstream impacts.
  • Maintain end-to-end traceability from user stories and acceptance criteria through test scenarios, test cases, automation assets, execution evidence, and defect tracking using tools such as JIRA and ALM/AQM.
  • Contribute to continuous testing and release readiness by integrating automated checks with CI/CD pipelines and supporting smoke, sanity, regression, defect investigation, troubleshooting, and issue triage.
  • Align risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk, escalate issues appropriately, and support secure and compliant software delivery.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of overall related technology experience, including 4+ years of hands-on software testing, quality engineering, and test automation experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience.

Talent Needed for Success

  • Strong experience with functional testing and test design, including the ability to understand complex business, technical, and regulatory requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and coverage.
  • Strong hands-on test automation experience, including experience developing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and enhancing automated tests using Java and established automation frameworks.
  • Strong experience with backend and database testing, including SQL-based data validation, data reconciliation, and troubleshooting of data discrepancies.
  • Hands-on experience testing XML and file-based workflows, including XML/CSV validation, schema/XSD validation, field mappings, transformations, and structured data outputs.
  • Experience with API, integration, UI, and cross-system testing across complex enterprise applications.
  • Experience validating data-intensive workflows across source data, database records, application outputs, reports, and downstream systems.
  • Experience with test design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision table testing, pairwise testing, and exploratory testing.
  • Experience with requirements traceability, test management, execution evidence, and defect lifecycle management using JIRA, ALM/AQM, or similar tools.
  • Experience working with source control and CI/CD technologies such as Git/Bitbucket and Jenkins.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues across application, API, file, data, database, and integration layers.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, and cross-functional partners.
  • Quality-first mindset with strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work effectively in Agile delivery environments and adapt to evolving technologies, automation frameworks, business requirements, and priorities.
  • Awareness of security, privacy, risk, and regulatory expectations within enterprise software delivery.
  • Familiarity with AI Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python scripting.
  • Experience with automation tools and frameworks such as TestNG, Selenium, Karate, or REST Assured.
  • Experience testing applications using Snowflake, Oracle, or other relational/data platforms.
  • Experience with Splunk or similar logging and monitoring tools.
  • Experience validating regulatory reports, structured data outputs, financial transactions, or reporting workflows.
  • Experience within financial services, fintech, regulatory reporting, or other data-intensive environments.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Job Title: CASPORT Test Engineer (ICAM Systems)

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: None

Type of Travel: None

* * *

The Opportunity

Join CACI in support of the MWIII Bridge program, where we deliver critical Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) capabilities across the Intelligence Community (IC). As a Prime Contractor, CACI provides innovative solutions that support both enterprise-wide and standalone deployments, enabling secure access to mission-critical systems.

In this role, you will be part of a highly collaborative team responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of a sophisticated enterprise ICAM platform. You will work alongside software engineers, systems engineers, platform engineers, and system administrators to test new capabilities, validate system functionality, and help deliver secure, high-quality solutions that directly support national security missions.

Responsibilities

As a Test Engineer, you will contribute to the development, execution, and continuous improvement of manual and automated testing solutions for an enterprise ICAM system.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Collaborate with software engineers and technical teams to develop effective test strategies and comprehensive test cases.
  • Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks, tools, and test harnesses.
  • Execute manual and automated tests to validate system functionality, performance, and reliability.
  • Identify, document, track, and help resolve software defects and issues.
  • Analyze test results and provide actionable feedback on performance, scalability, and system behavior.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain functional, integration, acceptance, and regression test suites.
  • Perform continuous testing activities to ensure new releases maintain existing functionality and backward compatibility.
  • Document test plans, procedures, outcomes, and recommendations.
  • Support Agile development processes by helping prioritize testing efforts and validate sprint deliverables.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of software engineering experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience within SIGINT, Information Assurance (IA), or Information Technology (IT) environments.
  • In lieu of a bachelor's degree, 4 additional years of software engineering experience may be substituted, for a total of 9 years of relevant experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly convey technical concepts to diverse engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile development environment while effectively managing priorities and timelines.

Desired

  • Experience designing, developing, and executing both manual and automated testing solutions.
  • Experience analyzing test results and assessing overall test coverage and effectiveness.
  • Experience testing applications in Windows and Linux/CentOS environments.
  • Working knowledge of test automation and testing tools such as:
    • Playwright
    • Behave
    • SoapUI
    • Selenium
    • JUnit
    • JRunner
  • Experience with or knowledge of:
    • REST-based web services and communication protocols
    • JSON and XML data formats
    • Scripting languages such as Python, Groovy, Perl, or Ruby
    • Cron job creation and management
    • Java development environments
    • Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP)
    • Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
    • Source code repositories such as Git, SVN, or CVS
    • SQL and database technologies
What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.
