The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by participating in product architecture discussions, promoting test‑driven development, and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Automation & Testing Execution: Design, write, and maintain robust automated test suites while creating targeted manual test cases for features requiring hands-on validation.
  • Agile Requirements Refinement: Active participation in story grooming and refinement sessions to clarify acceptance criteria, spot edge cases early, and ensure testability.
  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

Why Jack Henry?

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Culture of Commitment

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business - and our society - stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law.

Standard Job Description

Help ensure mission-critical software performs when it matters most.

As a Senior Software Test Engineer supporting the Sensor Fusion team, you'll help validate the software that enables advanced aerospace systems to process, fuse, and deliver critical mission data. Your work will play a key role in ensuring high-quality software is delivered with accuracy, reliability, and confidence.

Working alongside software, systems, and integration engineers, you'll analyze requirements, develop comprehensive test strategies, execute software validation activities, and identify opportunities to improve product quality throughout the software development lifecycle. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy problem solving, collaborating across disciplines, and ensuring complex software performs as designed.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Analyze software and system requirements to develop comprehensive test strategies, test cases, and validation plans for Sensor Fusion software.
  • Execute software verification and validation activities to ensure mission-critical capabilities meet quality and performance requirements.
  • Develop and maintain automated and manual test cases using C++ while supporting continuous software integration and delivery.Collaborate with Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Integration & Test teams to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects.
  • Support Agile software development by participating in test planning, defect tracking, and continuous process improvement activities.
  • Utilize engineering tools including Linux, GitLab, Jira, and automated testing frameworks to improve software quality and testing efficiency.
  • Contribute throughout the software development lifecycle by ensuring robust testing, documentation, and delivery of reliable Sensor Fusion capabilities.

Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering
  • Minimum of 2 years of testing experience
  • Experience coding in C++
  • Experience analyzing requirements

Desired Skills

  • Experience coding in C# or Python
  • Experience working in Agile teams
  • Experience with Linux operating systems
  • Experience with Jira and GitLab
  • F-35 Program access

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $98100.00 - $182100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.

Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Test Engineer to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This position is located in Herndon, VA. The qualified applicant will become part of Peraton's Department of State (DOS) Consular Systems Modernization (CSM) Program, for the Diplomatic Technology (DT). This initiative is intended to modernize and consolidate the operational environment under a common technology framework to better support the services provided to CA's customers.

This role requires excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively within a large, diverse program. As part of your responsibilities, you will build and execute manual test steps, automated test scripts, contribute to Agile development efforts and help ensure high-quality software delivery. This position is ideal for early career engineers who are eager to learn, grow, and make an impact.

Work Location: This is a hybrid position with a requirement to work on-site three days per week in Herndon, VA

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Using acceptance criteria, create and execute test steps and conduct manual testing on software applications
  • Work within an Agile Team to plan and develop automated test scripts to support the integration testing requirements of the teams you support.
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using modern frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
  • Collaborate with developers and testers to validate APIs, web services, and system integrations.

#DOSCSM

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's Degree and 2 years of experience, or a Masters Degree and 0 years of experience
  • Good knowledge of functional, environmental, operational, and performance testing.
  • Problem-solving skills to isolate and document issues and defects.
  • Ability to program in text-based languages and object-oriented languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript).
  • Experience in an agile testing environment including Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • Exposure to software engineering principles and basic test automation concepts

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active Secret Clearance (or higher). Interim clearances acceptable.
  • Familiarity with using AI-assisted development or testing tools.
  • Experience with Selenium WebDriver and Gauge a plus.
  • Experience writing SQL scripts for Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

Details

Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer with 10+ years of experience in functional and automation testing. The role requires strong functional testing skills, a thorough understanding of quality processes, and hands-on experience with Playwright and Selenium.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, works independently, and learns new technologies quickly. They should bring practical ideas for improving quality, reporting, and testing efficiency through automation and AI-assisted tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own test planning, test design, and execution for functional, regression, smoke, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
  • Review requirements, identify gaps and risks, and ensure coverage of business workflows, edge cases, and negative scenarios.
  • Develop and maintain reliable automated tests using Playwright, Selenium, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot test failures, environment issues, and test data problems.
  • Perform root cause analysis and analyze historical defect trends to identify recurring patterns and recommend preventive improvements.
  • Provide clear quality reports covering test results, coverage, defects, risks, and release readiness.
  • Improve quality dashboards, reporting, and testing efficiency by automating repetitive tasks and streamlining QA processes.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for test design, automation development, maintenance, and defect investigation. Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and reliability.
  • Develop testing approaches for new products built using AI, including validation of functionality, business workflows, and expected behavior.
  • Strengthen quality practices throughout the development lifecycle and mentor junior team members.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software quality engineering experience spanning functional and automation testing.
  • Strong functional testing expertise and knowledge of QA processes, defect management, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience with both Playwright and Selenium, including proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated experience improving quality dashboards, reporting, and testing efficiency through automation and process improvements.
  • Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile delivery practices.
  • Experience testing AI-powered products and prompts is a plus.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as ADO/JIRA
  • Practical familiarity with AI-assisted testing or development tools, including their limitations and methods for validating their outputs.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and documentation skills.
  • A thorough approach to testing, ownership of quality outcomes, and the ability to learn and apply new technologies quickly.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing AI-powered products, including prompt testing and evaluating AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance, consistency, and handling of edge cases.
  • Experience monitoring application exceptions, errors, and performance using Datadog, New Relic, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, agentic automation, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and cloud-hosted applications.
  • Experience with performance, accessibility, security, or reliability testing.


Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$71,300.00 - $124,500.00 USD

This role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

descriptionHtml:
As a quality automation tester, you will make an impact by validating the quality and reliability of card processing and payments systems through hands-on functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. You will be a valued member of the Software Engineering team and work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, testing teams, offshore team members, and Test leads.

In this role, you will

  • Design the test strategy and test plan, estimate and track testing efforts, and develop, review, and execute detailed test scenarios and test cases based on functional requirements and banking business workflows.
  • Coordinate defect triage with developers, business analysts, and testing teams to investigate, prioritize, and resolve defects, and perform defect retesting, regression validation, and root cause investigation.
  • Support test data preparation, test environment validation, and troubleshooting of testing dependencies.
  • Coordinate day-to-day testing activities across offshore team members, ensuring timely completion of assigned deliverables.
  • Work closely with the Test Lead to communicate testing progress, defects, blockers, and quality risks, and provide test execution status, defect metrics, and regression results to support release readiness, along with test closure and status reports.

Work model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Alpharetta, GA. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • Strong knowledge of card processing, payments, and customer servicing systems, including TS2, card lifecycle management, account servicing, card issuance and replacements, authorization processing, settlement, transaction research, fraud blocks, back-office operations, and customer service workflows.
  • Strong understanding of ISO 8583 message formats and payment interchange protocols, including validating financial transaction card-originated messages such as MTIs, bitmaps, and data elements, plus packet and protocol testing to ensure data integrity during transmission.
  • Strong hands-on experience in REST/SOAP API testing using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or Thunder Client, along with web UI functional and integration testing.
  • Strong experience in defect identification, defect triage, defect lifecycle management, and retesting, with Jira or similar defect and test management tools.

descriptionHtml:
Are you inquisitive? Thorough? Diplomatic? Ever worked as part of a program that is Agile? Are you interested in being an agent of change on a team committed to achieving client-focused, mission-driven excellence?

Steampunk is looking for you to join our team as a Test Engineer . You'll implement automation for increased efficiency and provide hands-on testing and QA expertise in mission critical work across our client base.

Contributions

Responsibilities

As a Test Engineer, you will work with our growing DevSecOps practice delivering quality assurance services to support application, cloud and data systems development. We are looking for candidates with 3-5 years experience with experience with quality assurance and test automation practices in an Agile/DevSecOps work environment. Responsibilities include:

  • Understanding the needs of stakeholders and conveying this to developers
  • Meet with product design team to determine testing parameters
  • Write test plans, create test cases, test procedures, bug reports, final QA reports for products
  • Manage test data architecture definition and requests
  • Troubleshoot errors and streamline the test procedures
  • Testing and examining code written by others and analyzing results, including three or more of the following:
    • Data validation testing
    • Functional testing
    • Performance and load testing
    • Usability testing
    • Accessibility (508) testing
  • Establishing automated testing tools and infrastructure for test automation
  • Provide validation testing of different system and data sets for cloud migrations
  • Develop automated testing scripts considering parallelization and idempotency
  • Automate and improve development, testing, deployment, and release processes
  • Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats
  • Working with software developers and software engineers to ensure that development follows established processes and works as intended
  • Document as-is state of the environment, perform a gap analysis, and produce artifacts that articulate options and recommendations
  • Leverage virtualization and containerization to optimize testing software systems
  • Work with teams to bring continuous improvement to DevSecOps processes and tools.
  • Engineer and implement solutions and provide recommendations for continuous improvement for the services provided
  • Present regular status updates and provide cross training to other DevOps team members.
  • Act as an individual contributor and mentor more junior team members
Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain a U.S. government Security Clearance
  • BS Degree in an IT field OR BS in a non-IT field and 2 years related IT experience
  • 3 Years of Experience with Git SCM providers such as GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket
  • 3 Years of Experience with one or more programming or scripting languages
  • 3 Years of application DevSecOps Experience with actual/active development experience in an Agile environment
  • Experience utilizing docker containers and utilizing platforms such as Kubernetes
  • 3 Years of Experience implementing test automation, using tools such as Selenium, Appium, Soap UI, RestAssured, Postman
  • Experience integrating test automation including performance, security, and functional tests into CI/CD Pipelines
  • Experience with performance and load testing
  • Experience in one or more cloud computing environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Preferred

  • Certifications:
    • CAST (Certified Associate in Software Testing)
    • International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) Certification
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills
  • Experience with documenting an as-is state of the environment, perform a gap analysis, and produce artifacts that articulate options and recommendations preferred
About Steampunk

Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $90,000 to $130,000. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here.

Identity Statement

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Steampunk is a Change Agent in the Federal contracting industry, bringing new thinking to clients in the Homeland, Federal Civilian, Health and DoD sectors. Through our Human-Centered delivery methodology, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges. If you want to learn more about our story, visit http://www.steampunk.com .

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Steampunk participates in the E-Verify program.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

Help ensure mission-critical software performs when it matters most.

As a Senior Software Test Engineer supporting the Sensor Fusion team, you'll help validate the software that enables advanced aerospace systems to process, fuse, and deliver critical mission data. Your work will play a key role in ensuring high-quality software is delivered with accuracy, reliability, and confidence.

Working alongside software, systems, and integration engineers, you'll analyze requirements, develop comprehensive test strategies, execute software validation activities, and identify opportunities to improve product quality throughout the software development lifecycle. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy problem solving, collaborating across disciplines, and ensuring complex software performs as designed.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Analyze software and system requirements to develop comprehensive test strategies, test cases, and validation plans for Sensor Fusion software.
  • Execute software verification and validation activities to ensure mission-critical capabilities meet quality and performance requirements.
  • Develop and maintain automated and manual test cases using C++ while supporting continuous software integration and delivery.Collaborate with Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Integration & Test teams to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects.
  • Support Agile software development by participating in test planning, defect tracking, and continuous process improvement activities.
  • Utilize engineering tools including Linux, GitLab, Jira, and automated testing frameworks to improve software quality and testing efficiency.
  • Contribute throughout the software development lifecycle by ensuring robust testing, documentation, and delivery of reliable Sensor Fusion capabilities.

Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering
  • Minimum of 2 years of testing experience
  • Experience coding in C++
  • Experience analyzing requirements

Desired Skills

  • Experience coding in C# or Python
  • Experience working in Agile teams
  • Experience with Linux operating systems
  • Experience with Jira and GitLab
  • F-35 Program access

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $98100.00 - $182100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Job Description

As a Software Test Engineer in Rockwell Automation, you will test industry-leading commercial software known for its innovation and usability. You will be an important player in software test case design, implementation and review. You will play an active role in all the stages of the development lifecycle and support your team throughout the process. You will also help ensure that developed products meet requirements and are within total quality management standards. You will collaborate with multiple global teams.

You will report to Engineering Team lead and will be based out of our office in Milwaukee.

In This Role You Will

  • Use your Python, Postman and Playwright skills to develop automated tests that ensure the quality and functionality of our software products.
  • Design, create tests that cover multiple scenarios and use cases.
  • Work with developers to identify targeted areas of new functionality to test.
  • Participate in reviews of documents, designs, and test cases and provide constructive feedback.
  • Monitor automated test results and report software defects to the development team.
  • Develop test documentation that follows the software development process and standards.
  • Ensure that the team's automated tests are aligned with the project scope and timeline and provide coverage for added and changed product functions.
  • Support the team's CI environment and approach by keeping the tests up to date, running them frequently, and reporting results.
  • Support the team in functional and system requirements analysis required to design and verify added and changed functionality.
  • Monitor and evaluate the testing process adopted by the team and report any inefficiencies.
  • Facilitate effective communication both within the local team and remote teams.

The Essentials- You Will Have

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

The Preferred- You May Also Have

  • Proficient in Python programming language Experience on an Agile software development team using Scrum Advanced knowledge of software test methodologies, including test design patterns and best practices.
  • Experience communicating updates and resolutions to customers and other partners skills.
  • Direct experience with the Industrial Automation Industry.
  • Experience with Postman and Playwright.
  • Experience with test management tools (e.g. qTest), automated test tools and testing integrated software products.
  • Experience collaborating with local and global technical development teams.

What We Offer

  • Health Insurance, including Medical-Dental-Vision.
  • 401K with Employer Match.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Flexible Work schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave.
  • To Learn more about our benefits package, please visit www.raquickfind.com

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

By bringing together people that use their passion for purposeful innovation, at Lockheed Martin we keep people safe and solve the world's most complex challenges. Lockheed Martin has been embedded with the USSTRATCOM Nuclear Mission for 30+ years and has a track record of bringing innovative mission software solutions to this domain. Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is seeking engineers to support our USSTRATCOM software teams which create Planning and Command and Control (C2) capabilities as part of the Strategic Mission Planning and Execution System (SMPES) in a DevSecOps environment. In this role, you will help our team create modern Web-based, Java mission systems for the Nuclear community. The successful candidate will have experience with software systems built to exacting standards that are delivered on a DevSecOps cadence using Agile Scrum.

  • Validate software deployments, author test scripts / test descriptions, and coordinate with developers on defects
  • Act as a quality gate to ensure delivered software meets its intent
  • Collaborate with architecture, cyber, integration, and product owner stakeholders.

Must be a US Citizen. This position will require a government security clearance.

WHY JOIN US

Joining our team offers you the opportunity to support a join a company and a team where your contributions are valued and you can develop your skills and expertise.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at work or online.

Instead, we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life both in and outside of work, along with competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits.

<a href=https://www.lockheedmartinjobs.com/working-here#benefits>Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s competitive and comprehensive benefits package.

descriptionHtml:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

This role is a hybrid position in either Atlanta, GA or Irving, TX. The selected candidate is expected to work on-site at our Las Colinas (Irving, TX) office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in-office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities.

About the Role:

McKesson is transforming healthcare through technology, data, and innovation. Within Macro Helix, part of Connected Care & Analytics, we help hospitals and health systems optimize pharmacy operations, improve financial performance, and maintain regulatory compliance.

As a Software Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst, you will ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and compliance of software applications, reporting solutions, and data products. This role combines manual and automated testing, SQL data validation, and quality engineering practices to support the delivery of healthcare technology solutions. Responsibilities include validating standard and custom reports, data extracts, reporting platforms, and analytics migrations; verifying business requirements and PHI compliance; identifying defects; and ensuring seamless customer experience. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can quickly learn complex applications, contribute to automation initiatives, and collaborate effectively within Agile teams to deliver high-quality, reliable solutions that support operational, compliance, auditing, and business decision-making needs.

What You'll Do:

  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for complex healthcare applications.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and reusable test frameworks.
  • Write and execute SQL queries to validate application functionality, business logic, and data integrity.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, product owners, and QA team members throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Create automated UI, API, and integration tests that run within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.
  • Analyze requirements and user stories to develop comprehensive test coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to quality engineering best practices.
  • Monitor test results, regression coverage, and quality metrics to support continuous improvement.
  • Support adoption of automation-first testing practices and emerging AI-assisted testing capabilities.


Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering.
  • Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of software testing or quality assurance experience.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience writing queries for testing and data validation.
  • Experience building or maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Tosca, Selenium, or similar platforms.
  • Experience testing APIs, integrations, and end-to-end workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control tools, and Agile teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve defects.


Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience testing cloud-based applications, including Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience with API testing tools such as SoapUI or Postman.
  • Experience with Jira, qTest, or similar Agile testing tools.
  • Experience with behavior-driven development tools such as Cucumber or JUnit.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled testing tools and automation practices.
  • Healthcare technology, pharmacy, revenue cycle, or healthcare software experience


Physical Requirements:

  • Must reside within a commutable distance to Atlanta, GA or Irving, TX.
  • Hybrid work arrangement available based on business needs.
  • Team members in the Las Colinas office may be expected to work onsite a minimum of two days per week.
  • Atlanta-based employees may periodically attend onsite team meetings.
  • Up to 5% travel required for team collaboration and business meetings.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a fulltime basis without the need for employer support or sponsorship now or in the future. This includes having the legal right to work in the United States without the need for McKesson support or sponsorship for any immigration related employment authorization (e.g., H1B, O1, E3, H1B1, TN, F1 OPT, F1 STEM OPT, F1 CPT, etc.) now or in the future.

descriptionHtml:

This role requires leadership in technical test guidance among the team and the ability to translate customer requirements and technical designs into test scenarios for solution verification. The STE will join a growing team of engineers dedicated to maintaining a strong team culture and driving quality solutions for retail.

Note: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work in the United States without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with test management to implement and maintain quality improvement processes and ensure proper test coverage. Identify testing gaps within the solution and advise on plans to improve.
  • Keep up to speed on industry process, practice, and technology developments to enhance the solutions and tooling applied to test.
  • Provide test estimates for system setup and configuration, test case creation, execution time, and resource requirements.
  • Setup test environments including hardware and software installations. Manage test equipment inventory and coordinate with management to acquire additional equipment.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies for software development. Collaborate with product and development teams to understand user requirements and define test coverage. Review software design documents, functional specifications, user scenarios, and existing test coverage.
  • Analyze, design, implement, and perform execution of test cases, test procedures, and test results. Report defects, and track defect resolutions.
  • Communicate closely with the project team leads and managers on test status, risks, mitigation plans. Provide input on risks and quality decisions.
  • Create documentation for test initiatives including test process and plans, custom installation procedures, process improvements, and traceability matrices. 
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering; or equivalent experience
  • Strong understanding of software test methodologies and quality strategy 
  • 5+ years' experience in software test engineering
  • Experience with test coverage analysis, test execution, and defect management 
  • Participation in agile SDLC; usage of agile project management tools 
  • Test automation experience (Selenium, Cucumber, Jenkins, Postman, TestNG, etc.) 
  • Basic programming skills in Java 
  • Basic understanding of Linux commands and filesystem 
  • Effective verbal and written communication; able to read, write, and speak English proficiently  

Preferred Skills

  • Retail industry experience
  • Experience setting up physical and virtual test environments, both local containerized environments (i.e., Docker, Kubernetes) and full customer-like integrated solutions

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands.  Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self-checkout at Lowe’s Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ’s, or Costco?  These are just a few examples of our in-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader.

  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Pre-tax spending accounts

  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee discounts

descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a member of testing team under IT Enterprise Architecture Data and Corporate Technology department, the Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Responsible for system integration testing, including automation, of newly developed or enhanced applications.
  • Play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete results.
  • Lead, develop, and advise on test automation strategies and provide critical feedback in requirements, design, implementation and execution phases.
  • Partner with collaborators - Product Management, Application Development, DevOps and other technical teams.
  • Track test execution milestones and report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
  • Construct appropriate end-2-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals.
  • Responsible for Delivery Pipeline adoption
  • Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements.
  • Contribute to standard framework of reusable functions.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of the product(s) being delivered.
  • Responsible for process compliance & associated documentation
  • Aligns risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.
  • Works closely with business and application development domain experts, to continually improve depth and breadth of knowledge for assigned applications/systems.
  • Responsible for Project Coordination and Technical Management tasks.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

  • Minimum 6 years of related experience in delivering software solutions with hands on automated testing.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.

Talents Needed For Success

  • Experience in Agile/Waterfall, onsite/offshore work model and coordination.
  • In depth knowledge of the software implementation lifecycle (specifically the testing model, methodology, and processes).
  • Experience with Test Engineering methodologies and Test Automation Frameworks
  • Proficient in automation at all software layers (e.g. UI, services, APIs, etc.) as well as CI/CD technologies (e.g. Cloudbees, Jenkins, Cucumber, Git, JUnit, Jira, etc.).
  • Sophisticated Java / Selenium development skills with significant experience applying those skills in test environments.
  • Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
  • Extensive experience with testing modern scripting language-based components.
  • Proven expertise in frontend test automation using Selenium Webdriver.
  • Expert and hands on with backend test automation for API testing (e.g. Rest Assured, Karate, Postman) and database testing (e.g. Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
  • Experience in writing sophisticated SQL queries.
  • Experience with JIRA, ALM, Bitbucket, Git, and Jenkins.
  • Requires the ability to work with both business clients and technical team and the ability to work independently, both individually and as part of a team.
  • Experience in mentoring junior test engineers, verifying work products and providing mentorship, as needed.
  • Unix, Python and AWS experience in a plus.
  • Accountable for process compliance & associated documentation
  • Aligns risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and written and verbal communication skills.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

descriptionHtml:
GreatAmerica is a highly successful entrepreneurial company providing equipment financing to businesses across the United States. Our exemplary customer service, our principle-centered business philosophy and our team-based operating approach are key to our success and growth. We have also recently become a bank!

Position Summary

GreatAmerica Financial Services is a highly successful entrepreneurial company providing equipment financing to businesses across the United States. Our exemplary customer service, principle-centered business philosophy, and team-based operating approach are crucial to our success and growth.

GreatAmerica operates with cross-functional product teams, empowering individuals to make well-informed decisions that support both the company and its customers. There is no doubt that we are building the greatest company of its kind, offering the finest products and services available anywhere. When you are part of the GreatAmerica team, you are part of the future, part of an opportunity to gain experience professionally and to reach your potential while enjoying your work.

We are seeking a Senior QA Performance Tester with deep expertise to lead performance engineering initiatives for enterprise-scale applications. The ideal candidate will design, execute, and optimize performance test strategies, mentor team members, and drive continuous improvement in our QA processes. If you have experience in quality roles, enjoy performing an integral role in large-scale transformative projects, and you are a collaborative and assistive team member who champions all things quality, this may be for you. You will support our Product Teams with design, creation, and executing performance tests on our various platforms. You will be responsible for designing and executing load and stress tests for business-critical processes, reporting issues, and sharing results.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, You Will

  • Define, develop, and maintain comprehensive performance test plans and automated scripts to validate system scalability and reliability.
  • Lead execution of performance, load, stress, and endurance testing for critical business scenarios, including SaaS Platforms, web applications, APIs, microservices, and full application workflows.
  • Analyze test results, interpret key metrics, and produce detailed reports with actionable insights for stakeholders.
  • Identify and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks across application tiers—frontend, middleware, and database—using advanced diagnostic techniques and performance monitoring strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with development, architecture, and QA teams to resolve defects and optimize system performance for stability and efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with established QA governance frameworks, supporting regression, functional, integration, and user acceptance testing as required.
  • Mentor junior testers, provide constructive feedback, and lead knowledge-sharing sessions to elevate team capabilities.
  • Communicate test status, risks, and recommendations clearly and proactively to management and teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging performance testing tools, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to define performance benchmarks, SLAs, and capacity planning strategies for critical applications.
  • Contribute to architectural reviews and provide input on scalability and reliability considerations during design phases.

Education

To be successful in this role you will need:

  • Bachelor’s degree required

Experience

  • 5+ years’ relevant experience in software quality assurance, including designing and authoring test cases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Performance Testing
  • 5+ relevant financial services industry experience.
  • 5+ years of experiences in Tricentis NeoLoad, APM tools, CI/CD integration.
  • 3+ years of experience with scripting language
  • Strong analytical skills and detailed orientation
  • High level understanding of system architecture
  • Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies and QA lifecycle.

Computer Skills

  • Experience with core software applications (Salesforce, Open Finance Platform, FiServ) is desirable.
  • Expert knowledge of MS Office products and Design & Development best practices preferred.

Financial Benefits

Sharing rewards is an integral part of our culture. We believe in the value of hard work and reward our employees beyond the paycheck. Our total rewards package is based on eligibility and includes:

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Monthly Bonuses for Eligible Employees
  • 401(k) and Company Match
  • Annual Profit Sharing
  • Paid Time Off

Health, Wellbeing, And Family Planning Benefits

  • Paid Vacation
  • Paid Sick Days
  • Paid Holidays
  • Gym Reimbursement
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Parental Leave

Education And Career Planning Benefits

  • Tuition Assistance
  • Networking Opportunities
  • Leadership Development Opportunities

Perks

  • Paid Parking
  • Service Awards
  • Hybrid work arrangements
  • Business casual environment
  • A strong organizational culture focused on our greatest asset: you!

If your experience aligns closely, please apply. We value diverse backgrounds and adding new perspectives. We encourage you to apply if you can make a strong impact in this role at www.greatamerica.com/careers.

Please note, applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer with a functional focus, you specialize in designing and executing testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies. Your expertise spans across all levels of testing, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Test Scenarios: Create optimized test scenarios, plan testing activities, estimate work efforts, and identify test environment and data requirements to ensure thorough testing of applications and systems.
  • Execute Testing: Perform manual and automation testing, execute test cases, report test status, and address defects through creation, triage, and resolution to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Analyze Test Outcomes: Apply analytical and cognitive techniques to analyze test outcomes, driving continuous improvements in testing processes and overall quality.
  • Utilize Testing Tools: Leverage various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality, ensuring optimal testing outcomes.
  • Report Defects: Identify, document, and report defects, collaborating with teams to resolve issues and improve overall product quality.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Exposure to Testing Methodologies: Experience working with various testing methodologies, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to design and execute testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies.
  • Core Testing Skills: Exposure to core testing, technical testing, and business domain/processes, enabling the creation of optimized test scenarios, planning testing activities, estimating work efforts, and identifying test environment and data requirements.
  • Testing Tools and Techniques: Experience working with various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality.
  • Manual and Automation Testing: Exposure to both manual and automation testing, including executing test cases, reporting test status, and addressing defects through creation, triage, and resolution.
  • Analytical and Cognitive Techniques: Experience applying analytical and cognitive techniques to analyze test outcomes, driving continuous improvements in testing processes and overall quality.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Proficiency in BDD/TDD: Experience working with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) approaches to enhance test efficiency and quality, ensuring optimal testing outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Test Accelerators: Exposure to test accelerators, leveraging them to streamline testing processes and improve overall quality.
  • Knowledge of Testing Tools: Experience working with various testing tools, utilizing them to enhance test efficiency and quality, and ensuring thorough testing of applications and systems.
  • Preferred Skills: BigData developer, PySpark, Hive, Google Cloud, Python, ETL, Testing

About the Role:

McKesson is transforming healthcare through technology, data, and innovation. Within Macro Helix, part of Connected Care & Analytics, we help hospitals and health systems optimize pharmacy operations, improve financial performance, and maintain regulatory compliance.

As a Software Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst, you will ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and compliance of software applications, reporting solutions, and data products. This role combines manual and automated testing, SQL data validation, and quality engineering practices to support the delivery of healthcare technology solutions. Responsibilities include validating standard and custom reports, data extracts, reporting platforms, and analytics migrations; verifying business requirements and PHI compliance; identifying defects; and ensuring seamless customer experience. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can quickly learn complex applications, contribute to automation initiatives, and collaborate effectively within Agile teams to deliver high-quality, reliable solutions that support operational, compliance, auditing, and business decision-making needs.

What You'll Do:

  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for complex healthcare applications.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and reusable test frameworks.
  • Write and execute SQL queries to validate application functionality, business logic, and data integrity.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, product owners, and QA team members throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Create automated UI, API, and integration tests that run within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.
  • Analyze requirements and user stories to develop comprehensive test coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to quality engineering best practices.
  • Monitor test results, regression coverage, and quality metrics to support continuous improvement.
  • Support adoption of automation-first testing practices and emerging AI-assisted testing capabilities.


Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering.
  • Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of software testing or quality assurance experience.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience writing queries for testing and data validation.
  • Experience building or maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Tosca, Selenium, or similar platforms.
  • Experience testing APIs, integrations, and end-to-end workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control tools, and Agile teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve defects.


Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience testing cloud-based applications, including Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience with API testing tools such as SoapUI or Postman.
  • Experience with Jira, qTest, or similar Agile testing tools.
  • Experience with behavior-driven development tools such as Cucumber or JUnit.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled testing tools and automation practices.
  • Healthcare technology, pharmacy, revenue cycle, or healthcare software experience

descriptionHtml:
The Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer is responsible for validating the functionality, reliability, security, and performance of a federal client's systems and applications. The role develops and executes functional, integration, regression, and release testing; identifies and tracks defects through resolution; validates data and system interfaces; and works closely with development, DevSecOps, and business teams to ensure system changes are thoroughly tested and ready for production deployment.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using relevant testing frameworks to validate application functionality across multiple user roles and workflows.
  • Design and implement UI automation using tools such as Playwright, ensuring automated test coverage is reliable, maintainable, and aligned with release objectives.
  • Lead test automation initiatives, including the integration of automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps processes.
  • Conduct manual testing of individual features, stress testing the system in order to ensure high-quality deployments
  • Create and organize testing suites in TestRails or a similar tool
  • Periodically run full manual test suite to perform regression testing
  • Conduct peer reviews of test automation code to promote quality, consistency, and adherence to engineering best practices.
  • Communicate test execution results, defects, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders during each release cycle.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship is required, along with the ability to obtain a public trust clearance.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in quality assurance, software testing, or application development for enterprise systems.
  • At least two (2) years of experience providing quality assurance and testing support for AWS-based workloads.
  • Bachelor’s degree or four (4) additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Demonstrated experience performing manual and automated testing, including defect documentation, issue reproduction, regression testing, and validation.
  • Strong experience developing test automation using Playwright with JavaScript or TypeScript, along with API testing, performance testing, Swagger, and Postman.
  • Experience designing, maintaining, and integrating CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions with AWS services such as Systems Manager and PostgreSQL.
  • Proficiency testing applications and workloads built with AWS services and technologies, including Vue.js, Python, Django, and Amazon S3.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment while collaborating with, mentoring, and supporting team members to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including planning, testing, and supporting iterative software releases.
  • Ability to test and validate workloads against AWS Well-Architected Framework principles and related quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting or testing Python/Django-based web applications.
  • Experience conducting penetration, performance, or load testing for applications hosted in AWS cloud environments.
  • Experience configuring and validating application monitoring, alerting, and error tracking using Sentry or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility testing standards, requirements, and validation practices.

PCI Federal is an equal opportunity employer. PCI Federal does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, race, national origin, religion, marital status, sexual orientation or identity, veteran status, or disability status.

Preference may be extended to qualified Native American Indian candidates in accordance with applicable federal law and PCI Federal policy.

descriptionHtml:
At BusRight, we're transforming an industry that has relied on outdated systems for far too long. School transportation is a critical part of everyday life for millions of students and families, yet much of the industry still depends on fragmented, manual processes.

We’re building a modern transportation platform that makes school buses safer, smarter, and more efficient for students, families, schools, and communities nationwide.

Our product ecosystem spans web, mobile, backend, mapping, real-time systems, and integrations. As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you’ll take a leading role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and overall quality of that ecosystem.

This role goes beyond executing test cases. You’ll help define how we approach quality, identify risks before they become customer problems, investigate complex production issues, improve automation and tooling, and influence engineering practices across teams.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll join an established QA function and help take it to the next level.

We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, make sound quality and risk decisions, and act as a trusted technical partner to engineering and product teams.

You’ll work across the entire development lifecycle—from requirements and technical design through implementation, release, production monitoring, and incident investigation.

You’ll be expected to question assumptions, uncover difficult edge cases, identify systemic quality risks, and improve how we test and ship software.

This is a hands-on senior role. You’ll still test products directly, but you’ll also help shape test strategy, automation, tooling, processes, and quality standards across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Own Quality Across Complex Product Areas

  • Take ownership of quality for complex features and product areas across Web, Android, and Flutter applications.
  • Define appropriate test strategies based on technical complexity, customer impact, risk, and system architecture.
  • Perform exploratory, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing across interconnected systems.
  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and risks that may not be obvious from product requirements alone.
  • Help teams determine appropriate release confidence and identify gaps before changes reach production.

Investigate Complex Problems

  • Lead investigation of difficult bugs and production issues across frontend, mobile, backend, infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
  • Analyze application logs, network traffic, API requests, database data, monitoring signals, and source code to isolate root causes.
  • Reproduce complex or intermittent issues and provide engineers with clear technical findings.
  • Distinguish symptoms from underlying causes and identify patterns across seemingly unrelated incidents.
  • Build scripts, utilities, or debugging tools when they can accelerate investigation or improve future troubleshooting.

Drive Test Automation and Engineering Quality

  • Design, build, and maintain E2E and integration automation using tools such as Playwright/Maestro/Appium.
  • Identify where automation provides meaningful value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate.
  • Improve automation architecture, reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
  • Work with engineers to improve testability at the application and system level.
  • Improve automated quality checks on CI/CD workflows.

Influence Engineering and Product Decisions

  • Partner with engineers and product managers during planning and technical design to identify risks early.
  • Challenge unclear requirements, assumptions, and implementation decisions when they introduce unnecessary quality risk.
  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly and help teams make informed release decisions.
  • Represent the customer and operational perspective during technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with Support and other customer-facing teams when investigating reported issues.

Improve QA Processes and Quality Culture

  • Identify weaknesses in existing QA processes and propose practical improvements.
  • Improve test documentation, defect reporting, release validation, incident analysis, and quality metrics.
  • Help establish scalable testing practices as the product and engineering organization grow.
  • Share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and help less-experienced QA engineers develop stronger testing and debugging skills.
  • Promote the idea that quality is a shared engineering responsibility rather than something owned only by QA.

Who We’re Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Engineering in Test, or another strongly technical software quality role.
  • Significant experience testing complex web and mobile applications involving multiple interconnected services.
  • Advanced exploratory testing and risk-analysis skills.
  • Strong experience investigating production issues using logs, APIs, databases, monitoring tools, and other technical signals.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks and methodologies.
  • Strong programming and debugging skills—you should be comfortable reading, understanding, and navigating production codebases.
  • Ability to write automation, debugging utilities, scripts, data-analysis tools, or other engineering support tooling when needed.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, client-server architecture, and data flows between services.
  • Strong understanding of the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), from requirements analysis and test design through execution, release validation, and production monitoring.

- Identify edge cases, failure modes, and risks that may not be obvious from product requirements alone.

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation.
