Join Us from Anywhere

While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the freedom to work remotely. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:

  • Nine Company-Wide Holidays
  • A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being

Benefits

Discover more about our perks and benefits here.

Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.

Travel Requirements:

As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

About The Team And What We'll Build Together

We are a team of software developers building the next-generation customer loyalty platform. Our software delivers surprise and delight every day for millions of customers for some of the best-loved brands in the world. As part of this team you’ll help us deliver software more predictably, more reliably, and with higher quality than we ever have before.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • This is both an enablement and an execution role. You’ll enable teams by providing them with the environment and knowledge to run a robust quality program. You’ll execute by performing tests where appropriate. You are a software engineer first, a quality practitioner second
  • You’ll change the way we develop and ship reliable software by “shifting left” on quality, automating our tests, and moving the needle on our key quality metrics
  • You’ll guide our world-class software engineering team on our continuous improvement journey
  • You’ll enable our engineering teams to thoroughly test their own code through tooling, piloting, advocacy, and education
  • Over time you’ll show continual, meaningful software quality progress, leading to high confidence among business stakeholders, partners, and clients.

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 0-3 years experience as a software developer, Software Developer in Test, or a similar role.
  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent, or analogous work experience.
  • Fluency in software testing methodologies: white box, black box, unit, integration, functional, performance, etc.)
  • Bias toward automation over manual testing. Proven track record automating complex software testing in real-world enterprise environments.
  • Expertise in proven testing frameworks, mocking frameworks, and curiosity to explore state of the art.
  • Production software coding experience is a must.
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript.
  • Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Cypress, Playwright, Cucumber, Karate).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner), a plus.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI), a plus.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture, a plus.
  • ISTQB or other relevant certifications, a plus.
  • Experience with compliance (SOC, HITRUST, etc.) a plus.

Who we are As a trusted partner, Kobie delivers market-leading, end-to-end loyalty solutions designed to enable customer experiences for the world's most successful brands. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. We believe that our team's passion and expertise are the driving forces behind our success and are proud to be named a Top Workplaces in the USA, where the best and brightest in loyalty drive our mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty.

A place for all We celebrate and embrace diversity at Kobie!

Employment at Kobie is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to professional competence. We do not discriminate against any teammate or applicant because of race,color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are fiercely committed to fostering a workplace where teammates can bring their authentic selves to work every day. Our DEI initiatives, including various committees, ensure that principles of equity, diversity, and inclusion are deeply ingrained throughout Kobie. While our leadership team fully supports our policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, it is the responsibility of all teammates to uphold these values.

Ready to join us? If you’re ready to make an impact and grow in a supportive, innovative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join the best and brightest in loyalty!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect both users and internal systems, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400-$115,000 based on experience and location.

  • Quality & Integration: Partner directly with cross-functional development teams to execute integration and regression testing, ensuring high performance, security, and end-user reliability before release.
  • Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Debug build failures, triage bug reports, and perform root-cause analysis to ensure rapid, effective resolutions in non-production and production environments.
  • Framework & Process Improvement: Maintain quality assurance documentation, adopt industry best practices in the industry, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • May lead unit tests and integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium, API Testing, Playwright etc).
  • Experience with Windows and Unix Based Systems
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

Lockheed Martin Space is seeking a full-time Software Test Engineer. In this role, you will support the software engineering lifecycle following the Software Development Plan (SDP) program to include requirements analysis, code & unit test, integration testing, requirements verification, and support to formal test/delivery.

The successful candidate will have experience and/or knowledge of languages such as Perl, Python, and C++. Must be a US Citizen; this position will require Interim Secret government security clearance prior to starting and the ability. This position is located at a facility that requires special access.

Basic Qualifications

  • Proficient in Python, and C++.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with multi‑disciplinary, team‑based groups.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance

Desired Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM‑related discipline from an accredited university.
  • Experience across the full software life‑cycle (design, architecture, development, integration, test, qualification).
  • Familiarity with embedded software/hardware (hands‑on or academic).
  • Working knowledge of DevOps/DevSecOps tools (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security scanning).
  • Comfortable in Agile development environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to test and verify software against defined requirements.
  • Active DOD Secret Clearance

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $98100.00 - $182100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

Position Description

The best version of us starts with You!

We CGI is seeking an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer who is passionate about automation, modern engineering practices, and delivering high-quality software.

The successful candidate will design and develop automated testing solutions across API, application, and database technology stacks while contributing throughout the software development lifecycle.

This is a full-time, on-site employment opportunity based in the Cary, NC area.

Your future duties and responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks.
  • Develop automated tests for RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Perform database validation and testing using SQL.
  • Good knowledge on relational database like Oracle.
  • Build reusable automation solutions using object-oriented programming languages such as Java or Python.
  • Participate throughout the SDLC, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD and DevOps pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, analysts, and other engineering team members.
  • Identify quality risks and drive improvements in test automation and engineering practices.
  • Evaluate and recommend new testing technologies, frameworks, and design patterns.
  • Contribute to Agile team ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

At least 10+ years of experience in software development and testing:

  • Strong experience testing RESTful web services/APIs.
  • Hands on experience with REST Assured, Bruno, or similar API testing tools/frameworks.
  • Expertise in SQL skills including data validation and comparison.
  • Must have hands on experience on relational database like Oracle.
  • Object oriented programming proficiency in Java, Python, or similar languages.
  • Understanding of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines, including tools such as Jenkins.
  • Strong automation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working within Agile engineering teams.

Education requirement:

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a closely related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS or other cloud platform certifications.
  • Experience developing RESTful web services using Java.

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies —an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing solutions. This role requires a deeper understanding of automation frameworks and the ability to lead testing efforts for complex features and systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable and maintainable automated test frameworks using Tricentis Tosca and other tools.
  • Analyze business and functional requirements related to P&C insurance systems and translate them into effective automated test strategies and plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API testing, accessibility testing across web and backend systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, and product owners to ensure test coverage and quality.
  • Execute automated test cases, log defects, and track them to closure using Azure DevOps.
  • Develop automated tests for APIs, UI, and backend systems.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and review their test scripts.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze test results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across QA teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, preferably in the P&C insurance domain
  • 3–5 years of experience in test automation.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools, with a strong emphasis on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks is also preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL for backend/database testing.
  • Experience with API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of Agile QA methodologies, test planning, and defect management.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Optional Certifications (Preferred But Not Required):

  • Tricentis Tosca Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2
  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer
  • Certified Agile Tester (CAT)
  • Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

Salary Range $56,000.00 - $130,000.00

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, this range represents a good-faith estimate. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, credentials, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

This role may be based out of any of our office locations, including:

Parsippany, NJ; Conshohocken, PA; Wilkes ‑ Barre, PA; Alpharetta, GA; Scottsdale, AZ

Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

  • BCT-Funded Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Health/Dental/Vision Coverage

  • Generous Employee Referral Program
  • Tuition/Training Reimbursement
  • Wellness Membership Program
  • Pet Adoption Program
  • Several Scholarship Opportunities- available to BCT family members/dependents

descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

At SpotHero, we work as a team to empower people to get everywhere, easier! We’re rapidly growing with the mission of bringing the parking industry into the future through technology. Drivers across the nation use the SpotHero mobile app and website to reserve convenient, affordable parking in advance, on-the-go or through their connected cars, and parking companies rely on us to help them reach new customers while optimizing their business. We connect the dots with cutting-edge technology, delivering value to both sides of this exciting, evolving marketplace. We’ve been quite busy, take a peek at some of our recent announcements.

Automation Engineer at SpotHero:

SpotHero is seeking an Automation Engineer to join one of our engineering teams within the Quality Guild. This role blends hands-on manual testing with the writing and long-term maintenance of automated test suites, working shoulder-to-shoulder with backend, frontend, and mobile engineers to keep our releases fast and reliable as SpotHero scales.

As an Automation Engineer, you'll be embedded in a team, participating in all of its ceremonies and reporting into that teams’ structure, while also staying closely connected to our central Automation team and the broader Quality Guild. You'll split your time between manual testing and building/maintaining automated coverage.

What You'll Do

  • Own and maintain all automated tests belonging to your team, keeping them consistently green and remediating failures quickly in collaboration with team members.
  • Identify automation opportunities as new functionality ships, and write new end-to-end and integration tests in Playwright to cover it.
  • Perform manual QA testing alongside automation work; exploratory testing, edge-case discovery, and release validation with backend and frontend engineers.
  • Represent automation work as planned work in Jira/Scrum, keeping it visible alongside the rest of the team's sprint commitments.
  • Communicate the state of your team's test coverage regularly to your team, the Quality Guild, and the Automation team, with a documented, historical view of progress.
  • Contribute to our shared automation dashboards and monthly Automation Test Review, helping track test-suite growth, flaky/failing tests, and coverage trends over time.
  • Give feedback to the central Automation team on the platforms, tooling, and processes SDETs maintain, surfacing bottlenecks you hit in day-to-day work.
  • Partner with the Automation team on emerging tooling, such as CI-integrated continuous testing pipelines and AI-assisted test maintenance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Test Automation
    • Write, run, and maintain automated tests in Playwright (migrating legacy web tests where applicable).
    • Keep test suites healthy. Failing tests should not sit red for more than a sprint, trending toward no more than a week as you grow in the role.
    • Contribute to observability tooling (e.g., Grafana dashboards) that gives the team and Quality Guild visibility into automation health.
  • Manual QA
    • Execute manual test plans for new features and releases, especially where automated coverage doesn't yet exist.
    • Identify edge cases and collaborate with engineers to resolve them before release.
  • Collaboration & Communication
    • Participate fully in your team's ceremonies (planning, refinement, retros, stand-ups) as a core member.
    • Maintain a rolling roadmap of what areas of functionality you plan to automate, feeding into your team's quarterly planning.
    • Represent your team in Quality Guild and Automation team forums, including the monthly Automation Test Review.
What you bring:

You might demonstrate the capabilities below through any combination of relevant professional experience, or a transition from a manual QA background.

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests with Playwright (or a comparable framework such as Cypress, Selenium, or WebdriverIO).
  • Working proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
  • Hands-on manual QA experience including functional, regression, exploratory, and/or black-box testing.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub and collaborating through pull requests and code review.
  • Familiarity with Jira/Confluence-based Scrum workflows.
  • Strong communication skills. You can clearly represent the state of testing to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A collaborative mindset: this role sits at the intersection of a team, the Quality Guild, and the central Automation team, and success depends on strong relationships across all three.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (we use Concourse) and integrating automated tests into them.
  • Experience with TestRail or similar test-management/reporting integrations.
  • Experience with backend testing against a Django/Python monolith or Go/Kotlin services.
  • Interest in AI-assisted testing tooling (e.g., self-healing tests, LLM-assisted authoring).
  • Prior experience as a QA Analyst or SDET.

Technology we use:

  • Our Automation Stack is: Playwright for end-to-end and integration testing, with results tracked on Grafana dashboards; Concourse for CI/CD; Jira and Confluence for planning and documentation; GitHub for version control and code review; AWS (including S3) for supporting test infrastructure and reporting.

Seeking Candidates in:

  • Chicago, Illinois

What we are offering:

  • Career game changer – A truly unique experience to work for a fast-growing company in a role with unlimited growth potential.
  • Excellent benefits
    • We cover a generous portion of Medical Premiums, 50% of Dental and Vision Premiums, company-sponsored Life Insurance, STD, and AD&D coverage, a 401(k) with match and immediate vesting, and comprehensive leave policies to meet your needs in creating space for life.
  • Flexible PTO policy and outstanding work/life balance – We value and support each individual team member.
  • UberEats weekly lunch stipend for in-office days
  • Udemy License and Personal Learning Budget – We support the professional and personal growth of our people by providing everyone with learning resources and development opportunities.
  • Annual parking stipend – Duh. We help people park!
  • The opportunity to collaborate with fun, innovative, and passionate people in a casual yet highly productive atmosphere.
  • Our commitment to allyship has been a central driver of how we Respect Fellow Drivers. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of Employee Resource Groups, access allyship learning resources, and actively contribute to our ongoing effort of making SpotHero inclusive for all.
  • Employee programs to grow and support our people such as Discovery Days for Product and Engineering, Gearing up for Aspiring Leaders, and Mentorship Program.
  • Wellness program – a workplace that actively supports your physical and mental wellbeing through ongoing events, initiatives, resources, and thoughtful perks and benefits.
  • A workplace recognized as CityLights award winner by 1871, 2026 Best Places To Work by BuiltIn, Most Loved Workplace Certified by the Best Practice Institute, and recipient of multiple Comparably awards, including Best Company Culture, Best Company for Women, and Best Company for Diversity.

Compensation in Illinois:

  • Depending on your skillset and experience, you can expect your base salary to be between $88,000 - $110,000 as well as a discretionary bonus, and leading total rewards package.

At SpotHero, we Respect Fellow Drivers by providing an inclusive interview experience for everyone, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process. Please let our team know of your need when you apply or as you begin interviewing with our team.

SpotHero is an equal opportunity employer. We know that a diverse workforce is the strongest workforce, and are committed to building and supporting an inclusive environment for all.Additionally, because we want to Remember to Signal, if you choose to provide us personal information in connection with a job application, please review our Applicant Privacy Notice which provides details about what information we collect and process about you in order to consider your candidacy.

PLEASE NOTE: This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship. To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the US and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future.

descriptionHtml:
Toyota Automated Logistics is seeking a Software QA Specialist who will graduate in Spring or Summer of 2027 to join our team in Louisville, KY.

Job Overview

The Quality Assurance team is the primary proponent for all quality assurance programs affecting software. The QA Specialist is integral in supporting the QA group to perform quality testing for existing, modified, and custom software to be implemented for clients, as well as leading other process improvement initiatives. This person manages the development of complete test plans as well as conducts quality, stress, regression and load tests for software programs developed in the US and India. The QA Specialist will perform complete validation ensuring that all software modules meet functional specifications, software design documents, and end user requirements.

Job Functions

  • Database Analysis. Performs backend database validation in Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle, including validating queries, updates, stored procedures, maintenance plans, data migration, and triggers.
  • Requirements Analysis. Analyzes project requirements from specifications, maps test cases to requirements and designs test coverage plan.
  • Test Case Management. Develops, documents, and maintains functional test cases and other test artifacts like test data, data validation, and automated scripts to validate all project requirements are fulfilled.
  • Test Plan Management. Holds and facilitates test plan/case reviews with cross-functional team members. Creates and executes User Acceptance Test plans with project team.
  • Software Testing. Executes and evaluates manual and automated test cases and records test results.
  • Issue Management. Identifies any potential quality issues per defined process and escalates high priority quality issues immediately to project team and management.
  • Defect Management. Isolates, replicates, documents, and reports root cause defects and verifies defect fixes.
  • Environment Management. Creates and maintains virtual machines for the customers whose programs are being tested. The analyst is responsible for maintaining synchronized environments and documenting changes.
  • Software Installation. Installs software promotes on test environments, performs needed configurations, and ensures that the program performs correctly. When called upon, may also help project managers to do the same thing in production environments.
  • Software Configuration. Understands the available configurations and is able to set and test appropriately for the project and test case being performed.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 15% overnight travel (Travel expenses paid by Toyota Automated Logistics)
  • Must maintain a valid driver's license and passport

Required Qualifications And Preferred Skills

  • Must be eligible to work in the USA long term without sponsorship.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or related degree.
  • Experience using Microsoft SQL
  • Previous software quality assurance or software oriented internship or co-op experience
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Excellent problem solving capability (business and technical)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Enjoys working in the software development and automation technology field (very computer literate)
  • Strong quality control, quality assurance and computer skills including: TFS, manual and automated testing tools, and various Databases (SQL Server and Oracle).
  • Employees must follow all information security policies, protect confidential data, complete required training, and report any suspected security incidents to support our information security controls.

To learn more about us, click the following link - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFKuN5mUw_8

descriptionHtml:
Description

Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

As a member of the SMGS Planning Tools team, you will shape the AWS business's direction as a whole. You will build greenfield solutions from the ground up while using native AWS services and frameworks. The right candidate will have a robust system delivery background, well-rounded technical knowledge, and demonstrated experience working on large scale projects. The candidate must be customer-obsessed, have strong analytical and communication skills, and passionate about learning new technologies.

You will work with software development engineers to understand features and technical implementation. You will also work with groups such as product management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will develop automated tests to help fasten testing cycles and release faster to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features.

This position may be based in Seattle (WA), Dallas (TX), or Herndon (VA). Relocation offered for US residents only.

Key job responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy: Developing comprehensive test plans and strategies based on project requirements, ensuring all aspects of the application are covered.

Test Case Development: Designing, writing, and maintaining detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases.

Test Execution: Executing test cases (both manual and automated) and ensuring software quality across various stages of the software development lifecycle.

Defect Identification and Reporting: Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using bug tracking tools, and working closely with the development team to resolve them.

Automation Development: Writing and maintaining automated test scripts using appropriate tools and frameworks to increase test coverage and efficiency.

Continuous Improvement: Continuously identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance the testing process and improve product quality.

Collaboration and Communication: Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to ensure quality standards are met.

Performance and Load Testing: Conducting performance, scalability, and load testing to ensure the application can handle the expected load.

Test Environment Management: Setting up, maintaining, and managing test environments to ensure they reflect production environments as closely as possible.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Assessing risks associated with releases and working on strategies to mitigate them, ensuring minimal impact on production environments.

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Quality Assurance Engineer III 9/30/26 Tucson, Arizona, USA, 85706 | Tucson, Arizona, USA, 85706 34060 Onsite Position

Shape the Future of Mining with Komatsu Mining Technology Solutions: At Komatsu Mining Technology Solutions, we're not just talking about progress and innovation - we're making it happen. Our cutting-edge Modular brand solutions are powering mines worldwide, driving efficiency and sustainability in ways that seemed impossible just years ago.

Job Overview

The Autonomous Haulage System (AHS) is a comprehensive fleet management system for mines. Autonomous trucks are centrally controlled through a wireless network that integrates on-board vehicle controllers, high precision global positioning, and obstacle avoidance systems. The AHS Product Development team is responsible for building innovative solutions to unique and challenging autonomous operation problems. Working with our partners around the world, you will help design and support the next generation of mine optimization technologies and build the future platforms that will drive the changes in the mining industry for generations.

As a Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer – Autonomous Haulage System (AHS), you will engage with experienced cross-disciplinary team members to conceive and design innovative automation products. You will work closely with product management, hardware engineering, and operations teams. You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed in an open and collaborative peer environment.

This position may be based in either Tucson or Phoenix, Arizona. Candidates residing in both locations are encouraged to apply.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Maintain deep understanding of AHS architecture, dependencies, and safety constraints; translate this knowledge into risk-based test plans and automated coverage.
  • Partner with product and engineering teams to extract, refine, and document functional + nonfunctional requirements; ensure each requirement has measurable acceptance criteria and automated validation.
  • Own the end-to-end quality strategy—including functional, performance, security, and fail over testing—leveraging service virtualization, contract testing, and containerized environments to maximize parallel execution in CI/CD.
  • Design, implement, and continuously enhance robust automation frameworks. Integrate tests seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines with infrastructure as code provisioning.
  • Drive a shift left culture: embed test hooks at design time, manage test data versioning, and maintain high signal regression suites that execute on every merge.
  • Lead execution of manual edge case and exploratory tests; automate everything else. Publish clear dashboards for pass/fail trends, defect escape rate, and MTTR; use metrics to guide continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate blameless postmortems, identify systemic issues, and convert findings into preventative automated checks.
  • Oversee compatibility matrices and deployment configurations, support field teams during installation, configuration, and on-site validation.
  • Mentor engineers, champion coding standards for test development, and pilot new tools or methodologies that increase team productivity and product quality. Coordinate cross functional initiatives to mature quality practices enterprise wide.
  • Be able to occasionally travel internationally.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software/Systems Engineering, or related discipline (Master’s a plus).
  • 6 + years combined experience in software / systems testing, with 4 + years focused on building and scaling test automation.
  • Ability to take a project from scoping requirements to production operations
  • Leadership defining comprehensive test strategies for complex, distributed or real‑time systems.
  • Proficient in at least one modern programming language used for automation (Java, Python, or C#); strong REST/gRPC API and UI automation experience.
  • Hands‑on expertise with CI/CD, containerization, and infrastructure‑as‑code for on‑demand test environments.
  • Ability to mentor, influence, and up‑level QA and development teams.
  • Excellent analytical, documentation, and cross‑functional communication skills.
  • Ability to travel for up to 10% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Experience in event-driven microservices and REST API’s
  • Experience with network protocols, network programming, and distributed application debugging and analysis
  • Excellence in technical communication with peers and non-technical cohorts

Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

At Komatsu we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions.  We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose.  We are authentic, ambitious, and innovative in our pursuit of Diversity & Inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. 

If you want to learn more about Komatsu, please visit our website at https://www.komatsu.com/ .

Company Information

Komatsu is a world leader in manufacturing construction, mining, forestry, and industrial heavy equipment. Founded in 1921, Komatsu has a long history of quality, reliability, innovation, and excellence. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu facilities, distributors and dealers are in more than 140 countries and employ more than 60,000 people. Komatsu offers a diverse and challenging work environment, where you can grow your skills and career, and contribute to a sustainable, clean-energy future. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, be a part of something big and join a team that is shaping the world!

EEO Statement

Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

descriptionHtml:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We're hiring Senior Quality Engineers to join Veeva, building mission-critical software for the global Life Sciences industry across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.

As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you will drive functional and automated quality across cutting-edge, complex systems—ensuring high reliability and customer success with every release.

What You'll Do

  • Design and execute multi-platform test strategies covering native mobile (iOS), Windows desktop/web, and hybrid environments to ensure consistent user experience across all surfaces
  • Create comprehensive testing documentation, including test plans, automated scripts, risk assessments, and detailed bug reports for fast-paced release cycles
  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to automate features and maximize regression coverage across modern web and mobile platforms
  • Mentor junior Quality Engineers in QA methodologies, automation design patterns, and debugging strategies
  • Develop deep technical and domain expertise across Veeva’s suite of industry-leading products
  • Collaborate daily in a fast, agile team environment with software engineers, product managers, and cross-functional partners
  • Test and validate quality across complex, multi-agentic modules—tackling some of the most challenging non-deterministic edge cases and architecture patterns in today’s software landscape

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, software development, or test automation
  • Strong expertise in QA methodologies, automated testing frameworks, and short-cycle software releases
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated test suites covering sanity, boundary, negative, concurrency, and compatibility scenarios
  • Proven experience in mobile testing across iOS and Android platforms, including native app, hybrid, and mobile web test execution on real devices and simulators/emulators
  • Experience with Windows application and cross-browser testing, including compatibility validation across OS versions, screen resolutions, and hardware configurations
  • Hands-on experience with device testing strategies—managing device farms, physical device labs, or cloud-based device platforms (e.g., BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm)
  • Strong technical background in Unix/Linux command-line environments for log analysis and backend debugging
  • Proficiency with SQL for database querying and data validation
  • Hands-on experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Must be located in the PST/MST timezone

Nice to Have

  • AI-Native QA Mindset: Experience utilizing AI testing tools, prompt engineering for test-case generation, LLM output evaluation, or generative AI to optimize testing workflows
  • Experience authoring automated tests in standard functional frameworks (e.g., Cucumber, Selenium, TestNG)
  • Mobile automation expertise: Hands-on experience with Appium, XCUITest (iOS), Espresso (Android), or equivalent frameworks for end-to-end mobile test automation
  • Windows & desktop automation: Familiarity with WinAppDriver, Playwright for Windows, or similar tools for automating Windows application testing
  • Proficiency with device management platforms such as BrowserStack App Automate, Sauce Labs, or Perfecto for scalable multi-device coverage
  • Familiarity with SaaS delivery models, CI/CD pipelines, and Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence)
  • Prior experience in the Health Sciences or Life Sciences domains
  • Experience working effectively within distributed/remote teams

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    • A conversation with the hiring manager
    • A practical case exercise
    • A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $80,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you.

The Software Engineer III: Test Automation works independently to design, build, and maintain advanced automated testing frameworks that ensure quality throughout the entire software development lifecycle. They guide products from early concept through production by embedding automation into prototyping, test creation, and continuous integration practices. The position also requires strong knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, with hands-on involvement in designing test plans and detailed test cases in addition to automation. The role requires close collaboration across teams, particularly in system analysis efforts focused on testability, scalability, and delivering high‑quality software.

This hire will create and enhance automation frameworks, ensuring they are robust, maintainable, and aligned with business and industry standards. The engineer evaluates how code changes affect existing functionality, maintains high levels of script reliability by reviewing work from junior team members, and supports overall quality engineering efforts. Working closely with DevOps and development teams, they integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help manage expectations around release readiness and test coverage.

The role includes defining automation standards, producing essential documentation, and staying informed about emerging QA technologies to recommend improvements. The engineer independently troubleshoots complex issues across environments or automation scripts and leads unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure system security and stability. They also contribute strategically by promoting test‑driven development and ensuring long-term maintainability throughout each application’s lifecycle.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

The target salary range for this position is $76,400 - $115,000, based on experience and location.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Performs and may lead programming activities which may require research and timely, effective, and quality delivery of software into production.
  • Performs, and may lead, technical/engineering support for new and existing applications from code delivery until the retirement of the application.
  • Tests and reviews applications based on business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Uses best practices and standard guidance to create and modify code.
  • Considers how code changes will affect internal teams. May review code created by less experienced team members.
  • Collaborates with QA team to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Participates in and may lead team in cross-functional meetings and discussions.
  • Creates required technical documentation.
  • Stays updated with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes.
  • Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. Participates in the definition and documentation of standards.
  • May lead integration tests to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software.
  • Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions.
  • Designs and contributes to comprehensive test plans and test cases using established Quality Assurance methodologies, in addition to developing automated tests.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • Minimum of 4 years of technical experience in software development and or quality assurance (C#, Java, Selenium).
  • Must have experience with test automation tools.
  • Must have strong effective communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Must have knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and QA methodologies, including experience designing test plans and test cases
  • Strong problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Agile Methodology experience.
  • Exposure to AI.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

Why Jack Henry?

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Culture of Commitment

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business - and our society - stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0253664

Software Tester

The Opportunity:

As a software tester, you understand the inner workings of complex systems. That knowledge is critical to ensuring the reliability, performance, and safety of mission-critical defense systems. We're looking for an engineer who can use their skills to develop, automate, and execute software test solutions for an embedded controls project.

At Booz Allen, you’ll use your engineering skills to transform the Navy. That’s why we need an engineer like you, who specializes in software testing, to help us research, design, and develop embedded control systems. You’ll impact the DoW by advancing future state-of-the-art personnel and shipboard defense capabilities. This is a chance to use your engineering skills while gaining experience in directed energy, embedded control systems, test and evaluation, and applied research. Take on exciting challenges in our Global Defense Sector with us as we develop defensive capabilities for our nation's warfighters!

Work with us to expand your technology skills and make a meaningful difference.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 4+ years of experience testing application and embedded software in a professional work environment
  • Experience developing automated test procedures and test frameworks using languages such as Python or C++
  • Experience across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, integration, and deployment
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including hardware and system engineers
  • Experience testing software in Linux environments
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a STEM field


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Agile development methodologies
  • Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop testing
  • Experience with Protocol Buffers (Protobuf), gRPC, and RabbitMQ
  • Experience testing safety-critical systems
  • Experience developing and utilizing automated test frameworks and tools
  • Experience working with Docker and containerized development environments
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Skills Assessment As part of Booz Allen’s skills first hiring process, candidates must complete the required skills assessment to ensure they meet the Basic Qualifications for this role. Candidates must complete the assessment and meet the minimum proficiency threshold to continue in the hiring process.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $69,300.00 to $158,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
As a quality automation tester, you will make an impact by validating the quality and reliability of card processing and payments systems through hands-on functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. You will be a valued member of the Software Engineering team and work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, testing teams, offshore team members, and Test leads.

In this role, you will

  • Design the test strategy and test plan, estimate and track testing efforts, and develop, review, and execute detailed test scenarios and test cases based on functional requirements and banking business workflows.
  • Coordinate defect triage with developers, business analysts, and testing teams to investigate, prioritize, and resolve defects, and perform defect retesting, regression validation, and root cause investigation.
  • Support test data preparation, test environment validation, and troubleshooting of testing dependencies.
  • Coordinate day-to-day testing activities across offshore team members, ensuring timely completion of assigned deliverables.
  • Work closely with the Test Lead to communicate testing progress, defects, blockers, and quality risks, and provide test execution status, defect metrics, and regression results to support release readiness, along with test closure and status reports.

Work model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Alpharetta, GA. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • Strong knowledge of card processing, payments, and customer servicing systems, including TS2, card lifecycle management, account servicing, card issuance and replacements, authorization processing, settlement, transaction research, fraud blocks, back-office operations, and customer service workflows.
  • Strong understanding of ISO 8583 message formats and payment interchange protocols, including validating financial transaction card-originated messages such as MTIs, bitmaps, and data elements, plus packet and protocol testing to ensure data integrity during transmission.
  • Strong hands-on experience in REST/SOAP API testing using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or Thunder Client, along with web UI functional and integration testing.
  • Strong experience in defect identification, defect triage, defect lifecycle management, and retesting, with Jira or similar defect and test management tools.
  • Good understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, and STLC, with strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on complex testing scenarios while supporting offshore team coordination.

These will help you stand out

  • Experience executing, developing, and maintaining automation scripts using frameworks such as BDD/Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured, or Robot.
  • Experience with data synchronization, source-to-target validation, and data lake/data-processing validation.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Git.
  • Knowledge of Kafka or other event-driven messaging platforms.
  • Basic understanding of microservices architecture, API integrations, and cloud-hosted applications, with experience using application monitoring and log analysis tools such as Splunk.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Applications will be accepted until November 20th, 2026.

The annual salary for this position is from $53k to $92.500K depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) plan and contributions
  • Long-term/Short-term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Our company was founded by Watson Powell in 1929 as American Republic Insurance Company. From the beginning with 200 charter policies, our company was dedicated to providing personal insurance services at an affordable price. 

Through sound fiscal responsibility, our young company survived the Great Depression, which came just six months later. This individual is responsible for supporting the quality and reliability of Wellabe’s platform products through hands-on test automation and quality assurance practices. This role executes automated and manual testing across UI, API, and integration layers, contributing to the ongoing growth of automation coverage.

This position works closely with Engineering and Product teams to validate quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. The QA Automation Engineer 2 builds and maintains automated test scripts, participates in CI/CD testing processes, and applies established quality assurance standards and tools to improve test coverage and release confidence, escalating complex issues to senior QA team members as needed.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design and implement automated test scripts for UI, API, and integration testing using established frameworks and tools such as Playwright.
  • Execute functional, regression, and integration testing across assigned applications and features.
  • Develop and maintain test cases and automated test scripts based on requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in iterative Agile development, validating individual features and integrations as they are delivered to testing environments
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, document, and track defects through resolution, contributing to improved test coverage and reliability.
  • Perform backend data validation by developing and executing SQL queries to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Contribute to test plans, including test case development, estimates, and test environment coordination.
  • Follow established quality assurance standards, processes, and best practices set by senior QA team members.
  • Support the integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions.
  • Assist with the adoption of AI-driven and intelligent testing tools, such as self-healing automation and test prioritization, under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Track and report on test execution status, defect trends, and quality metrics for assigned work.
  • Participate in sprint planning and backlog refinement, helping to define clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Escalate complex testing scenarios, framework issues, and automation design questions to senior QA Automation Engineers or team leads.
  • Ensure compliance with SDLC, regulatory, audit, and risk requirements in regulated or audit-heavy environments.

Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of test automation tools and frameworks, such as Playwright, and exposure to API testing tools such as ReadyAPI, Postman, or equivalent toolsets.
  • General understanding of modern application architectures, including APIs, microservices, and cloud-based environments.
  • Experience contributing to and maintaining automation frameworks under the direction of senior QA staff.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and continuous testing concepts.
  • Exposure to performance, resilience, and other non-functional testing concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with effective written and verbal communication.
  • Willingness to learn and apply AI-assisted testing tools in daily work, with a focus on continuous learning.
  • Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks while seeking guidance from senior team members on complex or ambiguous scenarios.
  • General understanding of Agile and SAFe delivery models within large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Experience in automation or manual testing, with a growing focus on automation as a primary responsibility.
  • Experience contributing to automation efforts across one or more test layers.
  • Experience participating in quality assurance practices within Agile and DevOps teams.
  • Prior exposure to AI-based or intelligent test automation tools preferred.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field preferred. A combination of education and relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree.

Benefits

  • Hybrid availability
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off, holidays
  • Volunteer time off
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Paternity leave

Growth opportunities

Skills

  • LinkedIn Learning Premium access
  • CliftonStrengths® assessment and coaching
  • On-site and virtual workshops and cohorts featuring world-class content from FranklinCovey, Crucial Learning, Gallup, and more
  • Free world-class insurance acumen courses through AHIP and LOMA
  • Reimbursement and bonus opportunities for professional designations and certifications, including a tuition reimbursement program
  • Opportunities to take part in Wellabe's mentorship programs

About Wellabe

Since 1929, Wellabe has been finding solutions to help our customers protect their health and financial well-being. And we’re committed to fostering an internal culture of inclusivity, well-being, and development so each of our team members can succeed. Learn more about Wellabe’s culture of betterment by visiting wellabe.com/culture.

Wellabe is full of smart, caring, hard-working people with a broad range of talents who understand collaboration is key. We bring our best selves every day, to connect with others to solve problems, spark innovation, and bring ideas to life. Meet the team and learn what makes Wellabe a great place to work by visiting wellabe.com/news/employee-spotlights.

Our Core Values

  • Be dedicated: Show unwavering commitment by proactively taking initiative, setting clear goals, and managing time effectively.
  • Be trustworthy: Take accountability for actions, navigate difficult conversations with integrity, and build strong relationships through consistent, honest behavior.
  • Be determined: Demonstrate enthusiasm and a relentless drive to overcome obstacles and achieve goals.
  • Be collaborative: Foster teamwork by being self-aware, actively listening, and effectively communicating across all levels.
  • Be open: Embrace diversity and new ideas to create an inclusive environment.
  • Be generous: Embody generosity and compassion by serving a greater purpose and helping others.
  • Be better: Commit to continuous improvement and adapt effectively to change.
  • Be well: Prioritize physical and mental health, manage stress, and demonstrate emotional intelligence.

descriptionHtml:
Looking for a job to get you out of bed?

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our Quality Engineering team and own functional and end‑to‑end testing across our systems. We want someone genuinely passionate about testing - eager to hunt down the bug nobody else found, think outside the box, and take real ownership and accountability for the quality of what ships. You'll report directly to the QA Manager and help ensure consistent, reliable quality across our systems.

Casper (Casper.com) believes everyone should sleep better. That’s why we obsess over designing sleep products that actually make a difference—from the littlest dreamers and beyond. Including mattresses, pillows, and bedding, our entire collection is dreamed up and engineered in-house by our product and design teams. Sleepers can shop online, visit one of our 40+ retail locations across the United States, or find us through a growing network of trusted retail partners.

This is a hybrid role, requiring that you work 4 days per week from our Richmond, VA office.

When youʼre not catching zzzʼs, this is what youʼll do...

  • Design and execute functional and end‑to‑end test cases across web and back‑end systems, covering happy paths, edge cases, and negative scenarios
  • Own test planning for features and releases - clear, traceable test plans and test cases tied to requirements
  • Perform exploratory testing to surface issues that scripted cases miss
  • Validate complex, cross‑system workflows across multiple interconnected platforms
  • Test and validate workflows across SaaS applications commonly used in e‑commerce, Shopify, OMS, Salesforce, and ERP environments
  • Detect, isolate, reproduce, and document defects with clarity and insight
  • Contribute to our existing Playwright + TypeScript automation framework, starting with the most repetitive or highest‑risk manual cases
  • Write and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright and TypeScript, following our existing Page Object Model patterns
  • Get hands-on with our automation suite — running, debugging, and extending existing Playwright tests as you build up your automation skill set
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure proper test coverage
  • Write documentation for test cases and workflows to support long‑term scalability
  • Provide regular updates to the QA Manager on progress, risks, and opportunities for improvement

Our dream candidate is/has…

  • Strong in functional and end‑to‑end testing, with some hands‑on exposure to automation using Playwright and TypeScript
  • Experience testing an e‑commerce or SaaS product - you understand order lifecycles, payment or fulfillment flows, and how integrations between systems break in non‑obvious ways
  • Strong test case design and bug reporting skills - clear repro steps, good judgment on severity and priority
  • A creative problem‑solver who thinks outside the box - not satisfied testing only what's written in the ticket
  • Organized - able to juggle multiple test cycles and keep documentation current without letting anything slip
  • Passionate about testing - you find real satisfaction in catching the thing nobody else caught, and it shows
  • Comfortable with bug/task/test management tools such as JIRA and Coda
  • Comfortable working across multiple interconnected systems and validating end‑to‑end workflows
  • A clear communicator who collaborates closely with engineering, product, and DevOps

Nice to have…

  • Experience with API testing tools such as Postman
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them
  • Familiarity with AWS resources
  • Familiarity with AI‑driven workflows and tools like Copilot, Claude, Kiro, and Amazon Q Developer
  • B.S. in Computer Science or a related field

Targeted Annual Base Salary Range: $90,000-110,000 USD

Casper’s compensation philosophy ensures that the actual base salary is based on factors including but not limited to skills, education, experience, special training, time in position, and/or years of service.

Benefits

We recognize that annual base salary is just one part of a total rewards package. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, wellbeing resources, and other perks including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance to help you with those coughs or cavities (too many waffles)...
  • Paid Time Off. We believe in the power of rest so take the time you need to recharge.
  • Employee Discount to use on whatever you like (with a few exceptions) and product discounts for friends and family!
  • Dreaming of your next degree? After one year of service, we’ll help make that dream a little easier with tuition reimbursement.
  • … and more!

If you dream about this stuff this job is probably right for you. We look forward to learning more about you!

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa support.

As part of our hiring process, employment offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check and drug screening, where permitted by law.
